package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/auction")
public class AuctionPriceController {

    private final AuctionApiPriceService auctionApiPriceService;
    private final AuctionRankingService auctionRankingService;

    public AuctionPriceController(
            AuctionApiPriceService auctionApiPriceService,
            AuctionRankingService auctionRankingService
    ) {
        this.auctionApiPriceService = auctionApiPriceService;
        this.auctionRankingService = auctionRankingService;
    }

    @GetMapping("/prices/{playerId}")
    public AuctionPriceResponse calculatePrice(
            @PathVariable Long playerId,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "#{@currentSeasonResolver.resolve()}")
            String season,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "1000")
            int budget,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "8")
            int teams,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "true")
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        return auctionApiPriceService.calculate(
                playerId,
                season,
                budget,
                teams,
                defenseModifier
        );
    }

    @GetMapping("/rankings")
    public List<AuctionRankingResponse> calculateRanking(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "#{@currentSeasonResolver.resolve()}")
            String season,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "1000")
            int budget,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "8")
            int teams,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "true")
            boolean defenseModifier,

            @RequestParam(required = false)
            String role,

            @RequestParam(required = false)
            String club,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "100")
            int limit
    ) {
        return auctionRankingService.calculateRanking(
                season,
                budget,
                teams,
                defenseModifier,
                role,
                club,
                limit
        );
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\auction\AuctionPriceModelService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class AuctionPriceModelService {

    public static final String ALGORITHM_VERSION =
            "B51_AUCTION_PRICE_V1";

    public static final String B50_VERSION =
            "B50_FANTASY_VALUE_V1";

    private static final double MARKET_PERCENTILE_WEIGHT = 0.50;
    private static final double MARKET_STRENGTH_WEIGHT = 0.50;

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public AuctionPriceModelService(JdbcClient jdbcClient) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    public List<AuctionPriceModelResult> calculateAll(
            String seasonCode,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        validateConfiguration(
                budget,
                teams
        );

        List<PlayerInput> players =
                loadPlayers(seasonCode);

        if (players.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Nessun giocatore disponibile per la stagione "
                            + seasonCode
            );
        }

        Map<String, List<PlayerInput>> byRole =
                groupByRole(players);

        List<AuctionPriceModelResult> results =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (String role : List.of("P", "D", "C", "A")) {

            List<PlayerInput> rolePlayers =
                    byRole.getOrDefault(
                            role,
                            List.of()
                    );

            if (rolePlayers.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }

            results.addAll(
                    calculateRole(
                            role,
                            rolePlayers,
                            budget,
                            teams,
                            defenseModifier
                    )
            );
        }

        return results;
    }

    private List<AuctionPriceModelResult> calculateRole(
            String role,
            List<PlayerInput> players,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        List<PlayerInput> rankedPlayers =
                players.stream()
                        .filter(player ->
                                "RANKED".equals(
                                        player.rankingStatus()
                                )
                        )
                        .filter(player ->
                                player.b50RolePercentile()
                                        != null
                        )
                        .toList();

        List<PlayerInput> insufficientPlayers =
                players.stream()
                        .filter(player ->
                                !"RANKED".equals(
                                        player.rankingStatus()
                                )
                        )
                        .toList();

        Map<Long, Double> fvmPercentiles =
                calculateFvmPercentiles(
                        rankedPlayers
                );

        Double maxFvm =
                rankedPlayers.stream()
                        .map(PlayerInput::fantasyMarketValue)
                        .filter(value ->
                                value != null
                        )
                        .max(Double::compareTo)
                        .orElse(null);

        List<ScoredPlayer> scored =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (PlayerInput player : rankedPlayers) {

            Double fvmPercentile =
                    fvmPercentiles.get(
                            player.playerId()
                    );

            Double fvmStrength = null;
            Double marketSignal = null;

            double auctionScore;

            if (
                    player.fantasyMarketValue() == null
                    || maxFvm == null
            ) {
                auctionScore =
                        player.b50RolePercentile();

            } else {
                /*
                 * Important:
                 *
                 * FVM = 0 is VALID market evidence.
                 * It is NOT equivalent to NULL.
                 */
                fvmStrength =
                        maxFvm > 0
                                ? (
                                        Math.log1p(
                                                player.fantasyMarketValue()
                                        )
                                        / Math.log1p(maxFvm)
                                        * 100.0
                                )
                                : 0.0;

                marketSignal =
                        fvmPercentile
                                * MARKET_PERCENTILE_WEIGHT
                                + fvmStrength
                                * MARKET_STRENGTH_WEIGHT;

                double b50Weight =
                        b50Weight(role);

                double marketWeight =
                        1.0 - b50Weight;

                auctionScore =
                        player.b50RolePercentile()
                                * b50Weight
                                + marketSignal
                                * marketWeight;
            }

            scored.add(
                    new ScoredPlayer(
                            player,
                            round2(fvmPercentile),
                            round2(fvmStrength),
                            round2(marketSignal),
                            auctionScore
                    )
            );
        }

        scored.sort(
                Comparator
                        .comparing(
                                ScoredPlayer::auctionScore
                        )
                        .reversed()
                        .thenComparing(
                                item ->
                                        item.player()
                                                .playerId()
                        )
        );

        int marketSlots =
                teams * roleSlots(role);

        List<ScoredPlayer> contenders =
                scored.stream()
                        .limit(marketSlots)
                        .toList();

        double leagueRoleBudget =
                budget
                        * teams
                        * roleAllocation(
                                role,
                                defenseModifier
                        );

        double budgetFactor =
                budget / 1000.0;

        double teamFactor =
                1.0
                        + (
                                (teams - 8)
                                        * 0.05
                        );

        Map<Long, Double> provisionalPrices =
                new HashMap<>();

        for (ScoredPlayer player : contenders) {

            double rawPrice =
                    interpolatePrice(
                            role,
                            player.auctionScore()
                    );

            rawPrice *= budgetFactor;
            rawPrice *= teamFactor;

            provisionalPrices.put(
                    player.player()
                            .playerId(),
                    Math.max(
                            1.0,
                            rawPrice
                    )
            );
        }

        double provisionalTotal =
                provisionalPrices
                        .values()
                        .stream()
                        .mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue)
                        .sum();

        boolean budgetCapApplied =
                provisionalTotal > leagueRoleBudget;

        if (budgetCapApplied) {

            int floors =
                    provisionalPrices.size();

            double distributableBudget =
                    Math.max(
                            0,
                            leagueRoleBudget
                                    - floors
                    );

            double rawExtra =
                    provisionalPrices
                            .values()
                            .stream()
                            .mapToDouble(price ->
                                    Math.max(
                                            0,
                                            price - 1
                                    )
                            )
                            .sum();

            double scale =
                    rawExtra > 0
                            ? distributableBudget
                                    / rawExtra
                            : 0;

            provisionalPrices.replaceAll(
                    (playerId, price) ->
                            1
                                    + Math.max(
                                            0,
                                            price - 1
                                    )
                                    * scale
            );
        }

        Map<Long, Integer> recommendedPrices =
                new HashMap<>();

        /*
         * Players outside the auction-market slots still receive
         * the minimum actionable price of 1 credit.
         */
        for (ScoredPlayer scoredPlayer : scored) {
            recommendedPrices.put(
                    scoredPlayer.player()
                            .playerId(),
                    1
            );
        }

        if (budgetCapApplied) {

            int integerBudgetTarget =
                    (int) Math.floor(
                            leagueRoleBudget
                                    + 0.000000001
                    );

            List<PriceRemainder> remainders =
                    new ArrayList<>();

            int assignedCredits = 0;

            for (ScoredPlayer contender : contenders) {

                Long playerId =
                        contender.player()
                                .playerId();

                double exactPrice =
                        provisionalPrices.get(
                                playerId
                        );

                int floorPrice =
                        Math.max(
                                1,
                                (int) Math.floor(
                                        exactPrice
                                )
                        );

                recommendedPrices.put(
                        playerId,
                        floorPrice
                );

                assignedCredits += floorPrice;

                remainders.add(
                        new PriceRemainder(
                                playerId,
                                exactPrice
                                        - floorPrice,
                                contender.auctionScore()
                        )
                );
            }

            int creditsToDistribute =
                    Math.max(
                            0,
                            integerBudgetTarget
                                    - assignedCredits
                    );

            remainders.sort(
                    Comparator
                            .comparing(
                                    PriceRemainder::fraction
                            )
                            .reversed()
                            .thenComparing(
                                    PriceRemainder::auctionScore,
                                    Comparator.reverseOrder()
                            )
                            .thenComparing(
                                    PriceRemainder::playerId
                            )
            );

            int distributableCredits =
                    Math.min(
                            creditsToDistribute,
                            remainders.size()
                    );

            for (
                    int index = 0;
                    index < distributableCredits;
                    index++
            ) {
                Long playerId =
                        remainders.get(index)
                                .playerId();

                recommendedPrices.computeIfPresent(
                        playerId,
                        (ignored, currentPrice) ->
                                currentPrice + 1
                );
            }

        } else {

            for (ScoredPlayer contender : contenders) {

                Long playerId =
                        contender.player()
                                .playerId();

                int roundedPrice =
                        Math.max(
                                1,
                                (int) Math.round(
                                        provisionalPrices.get(
                                                playerId
                                        )
                                )
                        );

                recommendedPrices.put(
                        playerId,
                        roundedPrice
                );
            }
        }

        List<AuctionPriceModelResult> results =
                new ArrayList<>();

        int position = 0;
        int auctionRank = 0;
        Double previousAuctionScore = null;

        for (ScoredPlayer scoredPlayer : scored) {

            position++;

            if (
                    previousAuctionScore == null
                    || Double.compare(
                            scoredPlayer.auctionScore(),
                            previousAuctionScore
                    ) != 0
            ) {
                auctionRank = position;
            }

            previousAuctionScore =
                    scoredPlayer.auctionScore();

            PlayerInput player =
                    scoredPlayer.player();

            int recommendedPrice =
                    recommendedPrices.getOrDefault(
                            player.playerId(),
                            1
                    );

            PriceRange range =
                    calculateRange(
                            recommendedPrice,
                            player.dataConfidenceScore(),
                            player.fantasyMarketValue()
                                    != null
                    );

            double auctionPercentile =
                    competitionPercentile(
                            auctionRank,
                            scored.size()
                    );

            results.add(
                    new AuctionPriceModelResult(
                            player.playerId(),
                            player.playerName(),
                            player.club(),
                            player.role(),
                            player.b50RoleRank(),
                            round2(
                                    player.b50RolePercentile()
                            ),
                            round2(
                                    player.dataConfidenceScore()
                            ),
                            player.quotation(),
                            player.fantasyMarketValue(),
                            scoredPlayer.fvmRolePercentile(),
                            scoredPlayer.fvmStrength(),
                            scoredPlayer.marketSignal(),
                            round2(
                                    scoredPlayer.auctionScore()
                            ),
                            auctionRank,
                            round2(
                                    auctionPercentile
                            ),
                            "PRICED",
                            range.minimumPrice(),
                            recommendedPrice,
                            range.maximumPrice(),
                            BigDecimal.valueOf(
                                            recommendedPrice
                                                    * 100.0
                                                    / budget
                                    )
                                    .setScale(
                                            3,
                                            RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                                    )
                    )
            );

        }

        for (PlayerInput player : insufficientPlayers) {

            results.add(
                    new AuctionPriceModelResult(
                            player.playerId(),
                            player.playerName(),
                            player.club(),
                            player.role(),
                            null,
                            null,
                            round2(
                                    player.dataConfidenceScore()
                            ),
                            player.quotation(),
                            player.fantasyMarketValue(),
                            null,
                            null,
                            null,
                            null,
                            null,
                            null,
                            "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE",
                            null,
                            null,
                            null,
                            null
                    )
            );
        }

        return results;
    }

    private List<PlayerInput> loadPlayers(
            String seasonCode
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    player.id AS player_id,
                    player.display_name,
                    club.name AS club_name,
                    role.fantasy_role,

                    value_profile.role_rank,
                    value_profile.role_percentile,
                    value_profile.data_confidence_score,
                    value_profile.ranking_status,

                    market.quotation,
                    market.fantasy_market_value

                FROM player_value_profiles value_profile

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id =
                        value_profile.reference_season_id

                JOIN players player
                    ON player.id =
                        value_profile.player_id

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND registration.season_id =
                        season.id
                    AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'

                JOIN clubs club
                    ON club.id =
                        registration.club_id

                JOIN season_clubs season_club
                    ON season_club.season_id = season.id
                    AND season_club.club_id = club.id

                JOIN player_roles role
                    ON role.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND role.season_id =
                        season.id
                    AND role.source =
                        'FANTACALCIO'

                LEFT JOIN player_market_values market
                    ON market.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND market.season_id =
                        season.id
                    AND market.source =
                        'FANTACALCIO'

                WHERE season.code = :seasonCode

                  AND value_profile.algorithm_version =
                        :b50Version

                  AND player.active = TRUE

                ORDER BY
                    role.fantasy_role,
                    value_profile.role_rank NULLS LAST,
                    player.id
                """)
                .param(
                        "seasonCode",
                        seasonCode
                )
                .param(
                        "b50Version",
                        B50_VERSION
                )
                .query(
                        (rs, rowNumber) ->
                                new PlayerInput(
                                        rs.getLong(
                                                "player_id"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "display_name"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "club_name"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "fantasy_role"
                                        ),
                                        integerOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "role_rank"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "role_percentile"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "data_confidence_score"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "ranking_status"
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "quotation"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "fantasy_market_value"
                                                )
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .list();
    }

    private Map<String, List<PlayerInput>> groupByRole(
            List<PlayerInput> players
    ) {
        Map<String, List<PlayerInput>> result =
                new HashMap<>();

        for (PlayerInput player : players) {
            result
                    .computeIfAbsent(
                            player.role(),
                            ignored ->
                                    new ArrayList<>()
                    )
                    .add(player);
        }

        return result;
    }

    private Map<Long, Double> calculateFvmPercentiles(
            List<PlayerInput> players
    ) {
        List<Double> values =
                players.stream()
                        .map(
                                PlayerInput
                                        ::fantasyMarketValue
                        )
                        .filter(value ->
                                value != null
                        )
                        .sorted()
                        .toList();

        Map<Long, Double> percentiles =
                new HashMap<>();

        int n = values.size();

        if (n == 0) {
            return percentiles;
        }

        for (PlayerInput player : players) {

            Double value =
                    player.fantasyMarketValue();

            if (value == null) {
                continue;
            }

            long lower =
                    values.stream()
                            .filter(item ->
                                    item < value
                            )
                            .count();

            long equal =
                    values.stream()
                            .filter(item ->
                                    Double.compare(
                                            item,
                                            value
                                    ) == 0
                            )
                            .count();

            double percentile;

            if (n == 1) {
                percentile = 100.0;

            } else {
                double averageRankZeroBased =
                        lower
                                + (
                                        equal - 1
                                ) / 2.0;

                percentile =
                        averageRankZeroBased
                                / (n - 1)
                                * 100.0;
            }

            percentiles.put(
                    player.playerId(),
                    percentile
            );
        }

        return percentiles;
    }

    private double b50Weight(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 0.55;
            case "D", "C", "A" -> 0.65;
            default ->
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Ruolo non valido: "
                                    + role
                    );
        };
    }

    private double roleAllocation(
            String role,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        if (defenseModifier) {
            return switch (role) {
                case "P" -> 0.07;
                case "D" -> 0.15;
                case "C" -> 0.23;
                case "A" -> 0.55;
                default ->
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Ruolo non valido"
                        );
            };
        }

        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 0.06;
            case "D" -> 0.10;
            case "C" -> 0.25;
            case "A" -> 0.59;
            default ->
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Ruolo non valido"
                    );
        };
    }

    private int roleSlots(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 3;
            case "D" -> 8;
            case "C" -> 8;
            case "A" -> 6;
            default ->
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Ruolo non valido"
                    );
        };
    }

    private double interpolatePrice(
            String role,
            double percentile
    ) {
        double[][] anchors =
                priceAnchors(role);

        if (percentile >= anchors[0][0]) {
            return anchors[0][1];
        }

        if (
                percentile
                        <= anchors[anchors.length - 1][0]
        ) {
            return anchors[
                    anchors.length - 1
            ][1];
        }

        for (int index = 0;
                index < anchors.length - 1;
                index++) {

            double highPercentile =
                    anchors[index][0];

            double highPrice =
                    anchors[index][1];

            double lowPercentile =
                    anchors[index + 1][0];

            double lowPrice =
                    anchors[index + 1][1];

            if (
                    percentile <= highPercentile
                    && percentile >= lowPercentile
            ) {
                double span =
                        highPercentile
                                - lowPercentile;

                if (span == 0) {
                    return highPrice;
                }

                double position =
                        (
                                percentile
                                        - lowPercentile
                        ) / span;

                return lowPrice
                        + position
                        * (
                                highPrice
                                        - lowPrice
                        );
            }
        }

        return 1.0;
    }

    private double[][] priceAnchors(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> new double[][] {
                    {100, 70},
                    {97, 58},
                    {95, 50},
                    {90, 38},
                    {80, 22},
                    {70, 12},
                    {50, 5},
                    {30, 2},
                    {0, 1}
            };

            case "D" -> new double[][] {
                    {100, 180},
                    {98, 145},
                    {95, 105},
                    {90, 65},
                    {80, 30},
                    {70, 15},
                    {50, 6},
                    {30, 2},
                    {0, 1}
            };

            case "C" -> new double[][] {
                    {100, 500},
                    {98, 420},
                    {95, 330},
                    {90, 190},
                    {85, 95},
                    {80, 42},
                    {70, 12},
                    {60, 4},
                    {50, 2},
                    {0, 1}
            };

            case "A" -> new double[][] {
                    {100, 340},
                    {98, 310},
                    {95, 270},
                    {90, 220},
                    {80, 150},
                    {70, 95},
                    {50, 40},
                    {30, 12},
                    {0, 1}
            };

            default ->
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Ruolo non valido"
                    );
        };
    }

    private PriceRange calculateRange(
            double price,
            double confidence,
            boolean hasFvm
    ) {
        double lowFactor;
        double highFactor;

        if (confidence >= 90) {
            lowFactor = 0.90;
            highFactor = 1.10;

        } else if (confidence >= 80) {
            lowFactor = 0.85;
            highFactor = 1.15;

        } else if (confidence >= 70) {
            lowFactor = 0.80;
            highFactor = 1.20;

        } else {
            lowFactor = 0.72;
            highFactor = 1.28;
        }

        if (!hasFvm) {
            lowFactor -= 0.05;
            highFactor += 0.05;
        }

        int minimum =
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        (int) Math.round(
                                price * lowFactor
                        )
                );

        int maximum =
                Math.max(
                        (int) Math.round(price),
                        (int) Math.round(
                                price * highFactor
                        )
                );

        return new PriceRange(
                minimum,
                maximum
        );
    }

    private double competitionPercentile(
            int rank,
            int total
    ) {
        if (total <= 1) {
            return 100.0;
        }

        return (
                (total - rank)
                        * 100.0
                        / (total - 1)
        );
    }

    private void validateConfiguration(
            int budget,
            int teams
    ) {
        if (
                budget < 150
                || budget > 1000
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Il budget deve essere compreso tra 150 e 1000"
            );
        }

        if (
                teams < 6
                || teams > 12
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Le squadre devono essere comprese tra 6 e 12"
            );
        }
    }

    private static Integer integerOrNull(
            Object value
    ) {
        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number.intValue();
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static Double doubleOrNull(
            Object value
    ) {
        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number.doubleValue();
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static Double round2(
            Double value
    ) {
        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        return BigDecimal
                .valueOf(value)
                .setScale(
                        2,
                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                )
                .doubleValue();
    }

    private record PlayerInput(
            Long playerId,
            String playerName,
            String club,
            String role,
            Integer b50RoleRank,
            Double b50RolePercentile,
            Double dataConfidenceScore,
            String rankingStatus,
            Double quotation,
            Double fantasyMarketValue
    ) {
    }

    private record ScoredPlayer(
            PlayerInput player,
            Double fvmRolePercentile,
            Double fvmStrength,
            Double marketSignal,
            Double auctionScore
    ) {
    }

    private record PriceRemainder(
            Long playerId,
            double fraction,
            double auctionScore
    ) {
    }

    private record PriceRange(
            int minimumPrice,
            int maximumPrice
    ) {
    }

    public record AuctionPriceModelResult(
            Long playerId,
            String playerName,
            String club,
            String role,
            Integer b50RoleRank,
            Double b50RolePercentile,
            Double dataConfidenceScore,
            Double quotation,
            Double fantasyMarketValue,
            Double fvmRolePercentile,
            Double fvmStrength,
            Double marketSignal,
            Double auctionScore,
            Integer auctionRoleRank,
            Double auctionRolePercentile,
            String pricingStatus,
            Integer minimumPrice,
            Integer recommendedPrice,
            Integer maximumPrice,
            BigDecimal budgetPercentage
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class AuctionPricePersistenceService {

    private static final String MODEL_FAMILY =
            "B50_MARKET_BLEND_AUCTION_PRICE";

    private static final BigDecimal GOALKEEPER_B50_WEIGHT =
            new BigDecimal("0.5500");

    private static final BigDecimal OUTFIELD_B50_WEIGHT =
            new BigDecimal("0.6500");

    private static final BigDecimal MARKET_PERCENTILE_WEIGHT =
            new BigDecimal("0.5000");

    private static final BigDecimal MARKET_STRENGTH_WEIGHT =
            new BigDecimal("0.5000");

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final AuctionPriceModelService modelService;

    public AuctionPricePersistenceService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            AuctionPriceModelService modelService
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.modelService = modelService;
    }

    @Transactional
    public PersistResult generateAndPersist(
            String seasonCode,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        Long seasonId =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM seasons
                        WHERE code = :seasonCode
                        """)
                        .param("seasonCode", seasonCode)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .optional()
                        .orElseThrow(() ->
                                new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Stagione non trovata: "
                                                + seasonCode
                                )
                        );

        verifyB50Algorithm(seasonId);

        String definitionPayload =
                """
                {
                  "version":"B51_AUCTION_PRICE_V1",
                  "b50_version":"B50_FANTASY_VALUE_V1",
                  "goalkeeper_b50_weight":0.55,
                  "outfield_b50_weight":0.65,
                  "market_percentile_weight":0.50,
                  "market_strength_weight":0.50,
                  "fvm_strength":"log1p(fvm)/log1p(role_max_fvm)",
                  "null_fvm":"renormalize_to_b50",
                  "zero_fvm":"valid_minimum_market_signal",
                  "confidence":"range_only",
                  "role_allocations_no_modifier":{
                    "P":0.06,
                    "D":0.10,
                    "C":0.25,
                    "A":0.59
                  },
                  "role_allocations_modifier":{
                    "P":0.07,
                    "D":0.15,
                    "C":0.23,
                    "A":0.55
                  }
                }
                """.replaceAll("\\s+", "");

        String definitionFingerprint =
                sha256(definitionPayload);

        registerAlgorithm(
                seasonId,
                definitionPayload,
                definitionFingerprint
        );

        List<AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult>
                results =
                modelService.calculateAll(
                        seasonCode,
                        budget,
                        teams,
                        defenseModifier
                );

        int inserted = 0;
        int unchanged = 0;

        for (
                AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult result :
                results
        ) {
            String evidence =
                    buildEvidenceJson(result);

            String inputFingerprint =
                    buildInputFingerprint(
                            seasonCode,
                            budget,
                            teams,
                            defenseModifier,
                            result
                    );

            ExistingProfile existing =
                    findExistingProfile(
                            result.playerId(),
                            seasonId,
                            budget,
                            teams,
                            defenseModifier
                    );

            if (existing != null) {
                if (
                        !existing.inputFingerprint()
                                .equals(inputFingerprint)
                ) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException(
                            "Conflitto profilo B51 immutabile per player_id="
                                    + result.playerId()
                    );
                }

                unchanged++;
                continue;
            }

            insertProfile(
                    result,
                    seasonId,
                    budget,
                    teams,
                    defenseModifier,
                    evidence,
                    inputFingerprint
            );

            inserted++;
        }

        return new PersistResult(
                AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION,
                results.size(),
                inserted,
                unchanged
        );
    }

    private void verifyB50Algorithm(
            Long seasonId
    ) {
        Integer count =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM player_value_algorithms
                        WHERE version = :version
                          AND reference_season_id = :seasonId
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "version",
                                AuctionPriceModelService.B50_VERSION
                        )
                        .param(
                                "seasonId",
                                seasonId
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        if (count != 1) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Algoritmo B50 richiesto non disponibile"
            );
        }
    }

    private void registerAlgorithm(
            Long seasonId,
            String payload,
            String fingerprint
    ) {
        Map<String, Object> existing =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            reference_season_id,
                            b50_algorithm_version,
                            definition_fingerprint
                        FROM auction_price_algorithms
                        WHERE version = :version
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "version",
                                AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION
                        )
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows()
                        .stream()
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElse(null);

        if (existing != null) {
            Long existingSeasonId =
                    ((Number) existing.get(
                            "reference_season_id"
                    )).longValue();

            String existingB50 =
                    existing.get(
                            "b50_algorithm_version"
                    ).toString();

            String existingFingerprint =
                    existing.get(
                            "definition_fingerprint"
                    ).toString();

            if (
                    !existingSeasonId.equals(seasonId)
                    || !AuctionPriceModelService.B50_VERSION
                            .equals(existingB50)
                    || !fingerprint.equals(
                            existingFingerprint
                    )
            ) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Conflitto definizione algoritmo B51 immutabile"
                );
            }

            return;
        }

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO auction_price_algorithms (
                    version,
                    reference_season_id,
                    b50_algorithm_version,
                    status,
                    model_family,
                    goalkeeper_b50_weight,
                    outfield_b50_weight,
                    market_percentile_weight,
                    market_strength_weight,
                    definition_payload,
                    definition_fingerprint
                )
                VALUES (
                    :version,
                    :seasonId,
                    :b50Version,
                    'ACTIVE',
                    :modelFamily,
                    :goalkeeperWeight,
                    :outfieldWeight,
                    :marketPercentileWeight,
                    :marketStrengthWeight,
                    CAST(:payload AS jsonb),
                    :fingerprint
                )
                """)
                .param(
                        "version",
                        AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION
                )
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .param(
                        "b50Version",
                        AuctionPriceModelService.B50_VERSION
                )
                .param(
                        "modelFamily",
                        MODEL_FAMILY
                )
                .param(
                        "goalkeeperWeight",
                        GOALKEEPER_B50_WEIGHT
                )
                .param(
                        "outfieldWeight",
                        OUTFIELD_B50_WEIGHT
                )
                .param(
                        "marketPercentileWeight",
                        MARKET_PERCENTILE_WEIGHT
                )
                .param(
                        "marketStrengthWeight",
                        MARKET_STRENGTH_WEIGHT
                )
                .param(
                        "payload",
                        payload
                )
                .param(
                        "fingerprint",
                        fingerprint
                )
                .update();
    }

    private ExistingProfile findExistingProfile(
            Long playerId,
            Long seasonId,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT input_fingerprint
                FROM auction_price_profiles
                WHERE player_id = :playerId
                  AND reference_season_id = :seasonId
                  AND algorithm_version = :algorithmVersion
                  AND league_teams = :teams
                  AND total_budget = :budget
                  AND defense_modifier = :defenseModifier
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param(
                        "algorithmVersion",
                        AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION
                )
                .param("teams", teams)
                .param("budget", budget)
                .param(
                        "defenseModifier",
                        defenseModifier
                )
                .query(
                        (rs, rowNumber) ->
                                new ExistingProfile(
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "input_fingerprint"
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .optional()
                .orElse(null);
    }

    private void insertProfile(
            AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult result,
            Long seasonId,
            int budget,

    ) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""

                    total_budget,

                    auction_score,
                    auction_role_rank,
                    auction_role_percentile,
                    pricing_status,
                    minimum_price,
                    recommended_price,
                    maximum_price,
                    budget_percentage,
                    evidence,
                    input_fingerprint
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :algorithmVersion,
                    :b50Version,
                    :teams,
                    :budget,
                    :defenseModifier,
                    :role,
                    :b50RoleRank,
                    :b50RolePercentile,
                    :confidence,
                    :quotation,
                    :fantasyMarketValue,
                    :fvmRolePercentile,
                    :fvmStrength,
                    :marketSignal,
                    :auctionScore,
                    :auctionRoleRank,
                    :auctionRolePercentile,
                    :pricingStatus,
                    :minimumPrice,
                    :recommendedPrice,
                    :maximumPrice,
                    :budgetPercentage,
                    CAST(:evidence AS jsonb),
                    :inputFingerprint
                )
                """)
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        result.playerId()
                )
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .param(
                        "algorithmVersion",
                        AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION
                )
                .param(
                        "b50Version",
                        AuctionPriceModelService.B50_VERSION
                )
                .param(

                .param(

                        budget
                )
                .param(
                        "defenseModifier",
                        defenseModifier
                )
                .param(

                        result.role()
                )
                .param(
                        "b50RoleRank",
                        result.b50RoleRank()
                )
                .param(
                        "b50RolePercentile",
                        result.b50RolePercentile()
                )
                .param(
                        "confidence",
                        result.dataConfidenceScore()
                )
                .param(

                )
                .param(

                )
                .param(
                        "minimumPrice",
                        result.minimumPrice()
                )
                .param(
                        "recommendedPrice",
                        result.recommendedPrice()
                )
                .param(
                        "maximumPrice",
                        result.maximumPrice()
                )
                .param(
                        "budgetPercentage",
                        result.budgetPercentage()
                )
                .param(
                        "evidence",
                        evidence
                )
                .param(
                        "inputFingerprint",
                        inputFingerprint
                )
                .update();
    }

    private String buildEvidenceJson(
            AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult result
    ) {
        return """
                {
                  "b50_algorithm_version":"%s",
                  "pricing_algorithm_version":"%s",
                  "market_source":"FANTACALCIO",
                  "role":"%s",
                  "pricing_status":"%s"
                }
                """.formatted(
                        AuctionPriceModelService.B50_VERSION,
                        AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION,
                        result.role(),
                        result.pricingStatus()
                ).replaceAll("\\s+", "");
    }

    private String buildInputFingerprint(
            String seasonCode,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier,
            AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult result
    ) {
        String canonical =
                String.join(
                        "|",
                        AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION,
                        AuctionPriceModelService.B50_VERSION,
                        seasonCode,
                        Integer.toString(budget),
                        Integer.toString(teams),
                        Boolean.toString(defenseModifier),
                        result.playerId().toString(),
                        safe(result.role()),
                        safe(result.b50RoleRank()),
                        safe(result.b50RolePercentile()),
                        safe(result.dataConfidenceScore()),
                        safe(result.quotation()),
                        safe(result.fantasyMarketValue()),
                        safe(result.fvmRolePercentile()),
                        safe(result.fvmStrength()),
                        safe(result.marketSignal()),
                        safe(result.auctionScore()),
                        safe(result.auctionRoleRank()),
                        safe(result.auctionRolePercentile()),
                        safe(result.pricingStatus()),
                        safe(result.minimumPrice()),
                        safe(result.recommendedPrice()),
                        safe(result.maximumPrice())
                );

        return sha256(canonical);
    }

    private String safe(
            Object value
    ) {
        return value == null
                ? "NULL"
                : value.toString();
    }

    private String sha256(
            String value
    ) {
        try {
            MessageDigest digest =
                    MessageDigest.getInstance(
                            "SHA-256"
                    );

            byte[] hash =
                    digest.digest(
                            value.getBytes(
                                    StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                            )
                    );

            return HexFormat
                    .of()
                    .formatHex(hash);

        } catch (
                NoSuchAlgorithmException exception
        ) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "SHA-256 non disponibile",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    private record ExistingProfile(
            String inputFingerprint
    ) {
    }

    public record PersistResult(
            String algorithmVersion,
            int calculatedProfiles,
            int insertedProfiles,
            int unchangedProfiles
    ) {
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class AuctionPriceService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public AuctionPriceService(JdbcClient jdbcClient) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional
    public AuctionPriceResponse calculate(
            Long playerId,
            String seasonCode,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        validateConfiguration(budget, teams);

        Map<String, Object> data = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    p.id,
                    p.display_name,
                    c.name AS club_name,
                    s.id AS season_id,

                    role.fantasy_role,

                    evaluation.projected_fantasy_average,
                    evaluation.projected_appearances,
                    evaluation.projected_starts,
                    evaluation.projected_goals,
                    evaluation.projected_assists,
                    evaluation.reliability_score,
                    evaluation.potential_score,
                    evaluation.risk_score,
                    evaluation.value_score,

                    tactical.starter_probability,
                    tactical.attacking_involvement,
                    tactical.penalty_taker,
                    tactical.set_piece_taker,

                    market.quotation,
                    market.fantasy_market_value

                FROM players p

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = p.id

                JOIN seasons s
                    ON s.id = registration.season_id

                JOIN clubs c
                    ON c.id = registration.club_id

                JOIN season_clubs season_club
                    ON season_club.season_id = s.id
                    AND season_club.club_id = c.id

                JOIN player_roles role
                    ON role.player_id = p.id
                    AND role.season_id = s.id
                    AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                LEFT JOIN player_evaluations evaluation
                    ON evaluation.player_id = p.id
                    AND evaluation.season_id = s.id

                LEFT JOIN player_tactical_profiles tactical
                    ON tactical.player_id = p.id
                    AND tactical.season_id = s.id

                LEFT JOIN player_market_values market
                    ON market.player_id = p.id
                    AND market.season_id = s.id
                    AND market.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                WHERE p.id = :playerId
                  AND s.code = :seasonCode
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonCode", seasonCode)
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .stream()
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Giocatore non trovato"
                        )
                );

        String role = stringValue(data, "fantasy_role");

        double quotation = number(
                data,
                "quotation",
                0
        );

        double fantasyMarketValue = number(
                data,
                "fantasy_market_value",
                0
        );

        double reliability = number(data, "reliability_score", 50);
        double potential = number(data, "potential_score", 50);
        double risk = number(data, "risk_score", 50);
        double value = number(data, "value_score", 50);

        double fantasyAverage = number(
                data,
                "projected_fantasy_average",
                6
        );

        double starterProbability = number(
                data,
                "starter_probability",
                50
        );

        double attackingInvolvement = number(
                data,
                "attacking_involvement",
                50
        );

        double projectedGoals = number(
                data,
                "projected_goals",
                0
        );

        double projectedAssists = number(
                data,
                "projected_assists",
                0
        );

        boolean penaltyTaker = booleanValue(
                data,
                "penalty_taker"
        );

        boolean setPieceTaker = booleanValue(
                data,
                "set_piece_taker"
        );

        double score =
                reliability * 0.18
                + potential * 0.22
                + value * 0.25
                + (100 - risk) * 0.15
                + starterProbability * 0.12
                + Math.min(attackingInvolvement, 100) * 0.08;

        score += Math.max(0, fantasyAverage - 6) * 8;
        score += projectedGoals * goalWeight(role);
        score += projectedAssists * assistWeight(role);

        if (penaltyTaker) {
            score += 7;
        }

        if (setPieceTaker) {
            score += 3;
        }

        double marketReference =
                maximumAllowedForRole(
                        1000,
                        role,
                        defenseModifier
                );

        double marketStrength = 0;

        if (fantasyMarketValue > 0
                && marketReference > 0) {

            marketStrength = Math.min(
                    100,
                    fantasyMarketValue
                            * 100
                            / marketReference
            );

            score =
                    score * 0.45
                    + marketStrength * 0.55;

        } else if (quotation > 0) {

            double quotationReference =
                    quotationReference(role);

            marketStrength = Math.min(
                    100,
                    quotation
                            * 100
                            / quotationReference
            );

            score =
                    score * 0.60
                    + marketStrength * 0.40;
        }

        score = Math.max(0, Math.min(score, 100));

        double roleAllocation = roleAllocation(
                role,
                defenseModifier
        );

        int roleSlots = roleSlots(role);

        double roleBudget = budget * roleAllocation;
        double slotBasePrice = roleBudget / roleSlots;

        double strengthMultiplier =
                0.40 + (score / 60.0);

        double leagueMultiplier =
                0.82 + (teams / 8.0) * 0.18;

        double scarcityMultiplier =
                scarcityMultiplier(role, teams);

        double calculatedPrice =
                slotBasePrice
                * strengthMultiplier
                * leagueMultiplier
                * scarcityMultiplier;

        if (fantasyMarketValue > 0) {
            double officialMarketPrice =
                    fantasyMarketValue
                    * budget
                    / 1000.0;

            calculatedPrice =
                    officialMarketPrice * 0.75
                    + calculatedPrice * 0.25;
        }

        int recommendedPrice = clamp(
                (int) Math.round(calculatedPrice),
                1,
                budget
        );

        double minimumFactor =
                risk >= 65 ? 0.68 : 0.78;

        double maximumFactor =
                score >= 95 ? 1.25 : 1.16;

        int minimumPrice = Math.max(
                1,
                (int) Math.round(
                        recommendedPrice * minimumFactor
                )
        );

        int maximumPrice = Math.max(
                recommendedPrice,
                (int) Math.round(
                        recommendedPrice * maximumFactor
                )
        );

        maximumPrice = Math.min(
                maximumPrice,
                maximumAllowedForRole(
                        budget,
                        role,
                        defenseModifier
                )
        );

        recommendedPrice = Math.min(
                recommendedPrice,
                maximumPrice
        );

        minimumPrice = Math.min(
                minimumPrice,
                recommendedPrice
        );

        BigDecimal budgetPercentage = BigDecimal
                .valueOf(
                        recommendedPrice * 100.0 / budget
                )
                .setScale(3, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);

        BigDecimal calculationScore = BigDecimal
                .valueOf(score)
                .setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);

        String recommendation = recommendation(
                score,
                risk,
                value
        );

        String explanation = explanation(
                role,
                score,
                starterProbability,
                projectedGoals,
                projectedAssists,
                risk,
                penaltyTaker,
                quotation,
                fantasyMarketValue
        );

        Long seasonId =
                ((Number) data.get("season_id")).longValue();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO auction_price_snapshots (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    league_teams,
                    total_budget,
                    defense_modifier,
                    fantasy_role,
                    minimum_price,
                    recommended_price,
                    maximum_price,
                    budget_percentage,
                    calculation_score
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :teams,
                    :budget,
                    :defenseModifier,
                    :role,
                    :minimumPrice,
                    :recommendedPrice,
                    :maximumPrice,
                    :budgetPercentage,
                    :calculationScore
                )
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("teams", teams)
                .param("budget", budget)
                .param("defenseModifier", defenseModifier)
                .param("role", role)
                .param("minimumPrice", minimumPrice)
                .param("recommendedPrice", recommendedPrice)
                .param("maximumPrice", maximumPrice)
                .param("budgetPercentage", budgetPercentage)
                .param("calculationScore", calculationScore)
                .update();

        return new AuctionPriceResponse(
                playerId,
                stringValue(data, "display_name"),
                stringValue(data, "club_name"),
                role,
                teams,
                budget,
                defenseModifier,
                minimumPrice,
                recommendedPrice,
                maximumPrice,
                budgetPercentage,
                calculationScore,
                recommendation,
                explanation
        );
    }

    private void validateConfiguration(
            int budget,
            int teams
    ) {
        if (budget < 150 || budget > 1000) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Il budget deve essere compreso tra 150 e 1000"
            );
        }

        if (teams < 6 || teams > 12) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Le squadre devono essere comprese tra 6 e 12"
            );
        }
    }

    private double roleAllocation(
            String role,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 0.08;
            case "D" -> defenseModifier ? 0.22 : 0.17;
            case "C" -> defenseModifier ? 0.27 : 0.30;
            case "A" -> defenseModifier ? 0.43 : 0.45;
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Ruolo non valido"
            );
        };
    }

    private int roleSlots(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 3;
            case "D" -> 8;
            case "C" -> 8;
            case "A" -> 6;
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Ruolo non valido"
            );
        };
    }

    private double scarcityMultiplier(
            String role,
            int teams
    ) {
        double teamImpact = 1 + ((teams - 8) * 0.035);

        double roleImpact = switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 0.90;
            case "D" -> 0.95;
            case "C" -> 1.02;
            case "A" -> 1.12;
            default -> 1;
        };

        return teamImpact * roleImpact;
    }

    private int maximumAllowedForRole(
            int budget,
            String role,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        double maximumPercentage = switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 0.09;
            case "D" -> defenseModifier ? 0.13 : 0.09;
            case "C" -> 0.20;
            case "A" -> 0.38;
            default -> 1;
        };

        return Math.max(
                1,
                (int) Math.round(
                        budget * maximumPercentage
                )
        );
    }

    private double quotationReference(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 20;
            case "D" -> 30;
            case "C" -> 40;
            case "A" -> 50;
            default -> 50;
        };
    }

    private double goalWeight(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 0.8;
            case "D" -> 2.2;
            case "C" -> 1.4;
            case "A" -> 1.1;
            default -> 1;
        };
    }

    private double assistWeight(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 0.7;
            case "D" -> 1.3;
            case "C" -> 1.2;
            case "A" -> 0.9;
            default -> 1;
        };
    }

    private String recommendation(
            double score,
            double risk,
            double value
    ) {
        if (score >= 92 && value >= 75 && risk <= 45) {
            return "PRIORITÃ€ ALTA";
        }

        if (score >= 75 && risk <= 60) {
            return "CONSIGLIATO";
        }

        if (score >= 60) {
            return "DA VALUTARE";
        }

        return "ACQUISTO RISCHIOSO";
    }

    private String explanation(
            String role,
            double score,
            double starterProbability,
            double goals,
            double assists,
            double risk,
            boolean penaltyTaker,
            double quotation,
            double fantasyMarketValue
    ) {
        String penalties = penaltyTaker
                ? " Ãˆ inoltre indicato come possibile rigorista."
                : "";

        String marketInformation =
                fantasyMarketValue > 0
                        ? String.format(
                                " Quotazione %.0f, FVM %.0f.",
                                quotation,
                                fantasyMarketValue
                        )
                        : "";

        return String.format(
                "Valutazione %.1f/100, titolarita prevista %.0f%%, "
                        + "%.0f gol e %.0f assist stimati. "
                        + "Rischio %.0f/100. Ruolo di listone %s.%s%s",
                score,
                starterProbability,
                goals,
                assists,
                risk,
                role,
                penalties,
                marketInformation
        );
    }

    private int clamp(
            int value,
            int minimum,
            int maximum
    ) {
        return Math.max(
                minimum,
                Math.min(value, maximum)
        );
    }

    private String stringValue(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            String key
    ) {
        Object value = row.get(key);
        return value == null ? null : value.toString();
    }

    private double number(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            String key,
            double defaultValue
    ) {
        Object value = row.get(key);

        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number.doubleValue();
        }

        return defaultValue;
    }

    private boolean booleanValue(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            String key
    ) {
        Object value = row.get(key);

        return value instanceof Boolean
                && (Boolean) value;
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class AuctionRankingService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final AuctionApiPriceService auctionApiPriceService;

    public AuctionRankingService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            AuctionApiPriceService auctionApiPriceService
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.auctionApiPriceService = auctionApiPriceService;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<AuctionRankingResponse> calculateRanking(
            String season,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier,
            String role,
            String club,
            int limit
    ) {
        int safeLimit = Math.min(
                Math.max(limit, 1),
                500
        );

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder("""
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    p.id
                FROM players p

                JOIN player_reconciliation_results reconciliation
                    ON reconciliation.player_id = p.id

                JOIN seasons s
                    ON s.id = reconciliation.season_id

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = p.id
                    AND registration.season_id = s.id

                JOIN clubs c
                    ON c.id = registration.club_id

                JOIN season_clubs season_club
                    ON season_club.season_id = s.id
                    AND season_club.club_id = c.id

                JOIN player_roles player_role
                    ON player_role.player_id = p.id
                    AND player_role.season_id = s.id
                    AND player_role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                WHERE s.code = :season
                  AND p.active = TRUE
                  AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'

                """);

        if (role != null && !role.isBlank()) {
            sql.append("""
                    AND player_role.fantasy_role = :role
                    """);
        }

        if (club != null && !club.isBlank()) {
            sql.append("""
                    AND (
                        LOWER(c.slug) = LOWER(:club)
                        OR LOWER(c.name) = LOWER(:club)
                    )
                    """);
        }

        sql.append("""
                ORDER BY p.id
                """);

        var query = jdbcClient
                .sql(sql.toString())
                .param("season", season);

        if (role != null && !role.isBlank()) {
            query = query.param(
                    "role",
                    role.trim().toUpperCase()
            );
        }

        if (club != null && !club.isBlank()) {
            query = query.param(
                    "club",
                    club.trim()
            );
        }

        Set<Long> allowedPlayerIds =
                new HashSet<>(
                        query
                                .query(Long.class)
                                .list()
                );

        if (allowedPlayerIds.isEmpty()) {
            return List.of();
        }

        List<AuctionPriceResponse> prices =
                auctionApiPriceService.calculateAll(
                                season,
                                budget,
                                teams,
                                defenseModifier
                        )
                        .stream()
                        .filter(price ->
                                allowedPlayerIds.contains(
                                        price.playerId()
                                )
                        )
                        .sorted(
                                Comparator
                                        .comparing(
                                                AuctionPriceResponse
                                                        ::calculationScore
                                        )
                                        .reversed()
                                        .thenComparing(
                                                AuctionPriceResponse
                                                        ::recommendedPrice,
                                                Comparator.reverseOrder()
                                        )
                                        .thenComparing(
                                                AuctionPriceResponse
                                                        ::playerName
                                        )
                        )
                        .limit(safeLimit)
                        .toList();

        return java.util.stream.IntStream
                .range(
                        0,
                        prices.size()
                )
                .mapToObj(index -> {
                    AuctionPriceResponse price =
                            prices.get(index);

                    return new AuctionRankingResponse(
                            index + 1,
                            price.playerId(),
                            price.playerName(),
                            price.club(),
                            price.role(),
                            price.minimumPrice(),
                            price.recommendedPrice(),
                            price.maximumPrice(),
                            price.budgetPercentage(),
                            price.calculationScore(),
                            price.recommendation()
                    );
                })
                .toList();
    }
}
