package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.function.Function;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class B67AuctionPriceModelService {

    public static final String ALGORITHM_VERSION =
            "B67_AUCTION_PRICE_V1";

    public static final String PERFORMANCE_VERSION =
            "B66_FEATURES_V3";

    public static final String MODEL_FAMILY =
            "B66_MARKET_ROLE_RELATIVE_AUCTION_PRICE";

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final B67AuctionValueScorer valueScorer;

    public B67AuctionPriceModelService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            B67AuctionValueScorer valueScorer
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.valueScorer = valueScorer;
    }

    public List<AuctionPriceModelResult> calculateAll(
            String seasonCode,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        validateConfiguration(
                budget,
                teams
        );

        List<PlayerInput> players =
                loadPlayers(seasonCode);

        if (players.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Nessun giocatore operativo B67 disponibile per la stagione "
                            + seasonCode
            );
        }

        Map<String, List<PlayerInput>> byRole =
                groupByRole(players);

        List<AuctionPriceModelResult> results =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (String role : List.of("P", "D", "C", "A")) {

            List<PlayerInput> rolePlayers =
                    byRole.getOrDefault(
                            role,
                            List.of()
                    );

            if (rolePlayers.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }

            results.addAll(
                    calculateRole(
                            role,
                            rolePlayers,
                            budget,
                            teams,
                            defenseModifier
                    )
            );
        }

        return results;
    }

    private List<AuctionPriceModelResult> calculateRole(
            String role,
            List<PlayerInput> players,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {

        Map<Long, Double> fvmPercentiles =
                calculatePercentiles(
                        players,
                        PlayerInput::fantasyMarketValue
                );

        Map<Long, Double> quotationPercentiles =
                calculatePercentiles(
                        players,
                        PlayerInput::quotation
                );

        List<ScoredPlayer> scored =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (PlayerInput player : players) {

            Double fvmPercentile =
                    fvmPercentiles.get(
                            player.playerId()
                    );

            Double quotationPercentile =
                    quotationPercentiles.get(
                            player.playerId()
                    );

            B67AuctionValueScorer.ScoreResult scoreResult =
                    valueScorer.score(
                            role,
                            fvmPercentile,
                            quotationPercentile,
                            player.fantasyAverageRolePercentile(),
                            player.usageRolePercentile(),
                            player.goalRateRolePercentile(),
                            player.assistRateRolePercentile()
                    );

            if (scoreResult.auctionValueScore() == null) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "B67 senza evidenza reale per player_id="
                                + player.playerId()
                );
            }

            Double marketSignal =
                    valueScorer.marketSignal(
                            fvmPercentile,
                            quotationPercentile
                    );

            String evidenceTier =
                    evidenceTier(
                            player,
                            scoreResult.performanceSignalCount()
                    );

            scored.add(
                    new ScoredPlayer(
                            player,
                            round2(fvmPercentile),
                            round2(quotationPercentile),
                            round2(marketSignal),
                            round2(scoreResult.auctionValueScore()),
                            scoreResult.performanceSignalCount(),
                            evidenceTier
                    )
            );
        }

        scored.sort(
                Comparator
                        .comparing(
                                ScoredPlayer::auctionScore
                        )
                        .reversed()
                        .thenComparing(
                                item ->
                                        item.player().playerId()
                        )
        );

        int marketSlots =
                teams * roleSlots(role);

        List<ScoredPlayer> contenders =
                scored.stream()
                        .limit(marketSlots)
                        .toList();

        double leagueRoleBudget =
                budget
                        * teams
                        * roleAllocation(
                                role,
                                defenseModifier
                        );

        double budgetFactor =
                budget / 1000.0;

        double teamFactor =
                1.0
                        + (
                                (teams - 8)
                                        * 0.05
                        );

        Map<Long, Double> provisionalPrices =
                new HashMap<>();

        for (ScoredPlayer player : contenders) {

            double rawPrice =
                    interpolatePrice(
                            role,
                            player.auctionScore()
                    );

            rawPrice *= budgetFactor;
            rawPrice *= teamFactor;

            provisionalPrices.put(
                    player.player().playerId(),
                    Math.max(
                            1.0,
                            rawPrice
                    )
            );
        }

        double provisionalTotal =
                provisionalPrices
                        .values()
                        .stream()
                        .mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue)
                        .sum();

        boolean budgetCapApplied =
                provisionalTotal > leagueRoleBudget;

        if (budgetCapApplied) {

            int floors =
                    provisionalPrices.size();

            double distributableBudget =
                    Math.max(
                            0,
                            leagueRoleBudget - floors
                    );

            double rawExtra =
                    provisionalPrices
                            .values()
                            .stream()
                            .mapToDouble(
                                    price ->
                                            Math.max(
                                                    0,
                                                    price - 1
                                            )
                            )
                            .sum();

            double scale =
                    rawExtra > 0
                            ? distributableBudget / rawExtra
                            : 0;

            provisionalPrices.replaceAll(
                    (playerId, price) ->
                            1
                                    + Math.max(
                                            0,
                                            price - 1
                                    )
                                    * scale
            );
        }

        Map<Long, Integer> recommendedPrices =
                new HashMap<>();

        /*
         * Every operational Fantacalcio player receives
         * an actionable market price.
         *
         * Players outside the active market slots are priced at 1.
         */
        for (ScoredPlayer scoredPlayer : scored) {
            recommendedPrices.put(
                    scoredPlayer.player().playerId(),
                    1
            );
        }

        if (budgetCapApplied) {

            int integerBudgetTarget =
                    (int) Math.floor(
                            leagueRoleBudget
                                    + 0.000000001
                    );

            List<PriceRemainder> remainders =
                    new ArrayList<>();

            int assignedCredits = 0;

            for (ScoredPlayer contender : contenders) {

                Long playerId =
                        contender.player().playerId();

                double exactPrice =
                        provisionalPrices.get(
                                playerId
                        );

                int floorPrice =
                        Math.max(
                                1,
                                (int) Math.floor(
                                        exactPrice
                                )
                        );

                recommendedPrices.put(
                        playerId,
                        floorPrice
                );

                assignedCredits += floorPrice;

                remainders.add(
                        new PriceRemainder(
                                playerId,
                                exactPrice - floorPrice,
                                contender.auctionScore()
                        )
                );
            }

            int creditsToDistribute =
                    Math.max(
                            0,
                            integerBudgetTarget
                                    - assignedCredits
                    );

            remainders.sort(
                    Comparator
                            .comparing(
                                    PriceRemainder::fraction
                            )
                            .reversed()
                            .thenComparing(
                                    PriceRemainder::auctionScore,
                                    Comparator.reverseOrder()
                            )
                            .thenComparing(
                                    PriceRemainder::playerId
                            )
            );

            int distributableCredits =
                    Math.min(
                            creditsToDistribute,
                            remainders.size()
                    );

            for (
                    int index = 0;
                    index < distributableCredits;
                    index++
            ) {
                Long playerId =
                        remainders
                                .get(index)
                                .playerId();

                recommendedPrices.computeIfPresent(
                        playerId,
                        (ignored, currentPrice) ->
                                currentPrice + 1
                );
            }

        } else {

            for (ScoredPlayer contender : contenders) {

                Long playerId =
                        contender.player().playerId();

                int roundedPrice =
                        Math.max(
                                1,
                                (int) Math.round(
                                        provisionalPrices.get(
                                                playerId
                                        )
                                )
                        );

                recommendedPrices.put(
                        playerId,
                        roundedPrice
                );
            }
        }

        List<AuctionPriceModelResult> results =
                new ArrayList<>();

        int position = 0;
        int auctionRank = 0;
        Double previousAuctionScore = null;

        for (ScoredPlayer scoredPlayer : scored) {

            position++;

            if (
                    previousAuctionScore == null
                    || Double.compare(
                            scoredPlayer.auctionScore(),
                            previousAuctionScore
                    ) != 0
            ) {
                auctionRank = position;
            }

            previousAuctionScore =
                    scoredPlayer.auctionScore();

            PlayerInput player =
                    scoredPlayer.player();

            int recommendedPrice =
                    recommendedPrices.getOrDefault(
                            player.playerId(),
                            1
                    );

            PriceRange range =
                    calculateRange(
                            recommendedPrice,
                            player.dataConfidenceScore(),
                            player.fantasyMarketValue() != null
                    );

            double auctionPercentile =
                    competitionPercentile(
                            auctionRank,
                            scored.size()
                    );

            results.add(
                    new AuctionPriceModelResult(
                            player.playerId(),
                            player.playerName(),
                            player.club(),
                            player.role(),
                            round2(
                                    player.dataConfidenceScore()
                            ),
                            player.historySeasonsAvailable(),
                            player.sourceMix(),
                            player.quotation(),
                            player.fantasyMarketValue(),
                            scoredPlayer.fvmRolePercentile(),
                            scoredPlayer.quotationRolePercentile(),
                            round2(
                                    player.fantasyAverageRolePercentile()
                            ),
                            round2(
                                    player.usageRolePercentile()
                            ),
                            round2(
                                    player.goalRateRolePercentile()
                            ),
                            round2(
                                    player.assistRateRolePercentile()
                            ),
                            scoredPlayer.marketSignal(),
                            scoredPlayer.performanceSignalCount(),
                            scoredPlayer.evidenceTier(),
                            scoredPlayer.auctionScore(),
                            auctionRank,
                            round2(
                                    auctionPercentile
                            ),
                            "PRICED",
                            range.minimumPrice(),
                            recommendedPrice,
                            range.maximumPrice(),
                            BigDecimal
                                    .valueOf(
                                            recommendedPrice
                                                    * 100.0
                                                    / budget
                                    )
                                    .setScale(
                                            3,
                                            RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                                    )
                    )
            );
        }

        return results;
    }

    private List<PlayerInput> loadPlayers(
            String seasonCode
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    player.id AS player_id,
                    player.display_name,
                    club.name AS club_name,
                    role.fantasy_role,

                    performance.history_seasons_available,
                    performance.source_mix,
                    performance.data_confidence_score,

                    (
                        performance.feature_values
                            ->> 'fantasy_average_role_percentile'
                    )::double precision
                        AS fantasy_average_role_percentile,

                    (
                        performance.feature_values
                            ->> 'usage_role_percentile'
                    )::double precision
                        AS usage_role_percentile,

                    (
                        performance.feature_values
                            ->> 'goal_rate_role_percentile'
                    )::double precision
                        AS goal_rate_role_percentile,

                    (
                        performance.feature_values
                            ->> 'assist_rate_role_percentile'
                    )::double precision
                        AS assist_rate_role_percentile,

                    market.quotation,
                    market.fantasy_market_value

                FROM seasons season

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.season_id = season.id
                    AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'

                JOIN players player
                    ON player.id = registration.player_id
                    AND player.active = TRUE

                JOIN clubs club
                    ON club.id = registration.club_id

                JOIN season_clubs season_club
                    ON season_club.season_id = season.id
                    AND season_club.club_id = club.id

                JOIN player_roles role
                    ON role.player_id = player.id
                    AND role.season_id = season.id
                    AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                JOIN player_performance_feature_profiles performance
                    ON performance.player_id = player.id
                    AND performance.reference_season_id = season.id
                    AND performance.algorithm_version =
                        :performanceVersion

                LEFT JOIN player_market_values market
                    ON market.player_id = player.id
                    AND market.season_id = season.id
                    AND market.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                WHERE season.code = :seasonCode

                ORDER BY
                    role.fantasy_role,
                    player.id
                """)
                .param(
                        "seasonCode",
                        seasonCode
                )
                .param(
                        "performanceVersion",
                        PERFORMANCE_VERSION
                )
                .query(
                        (rs, rowNumber) ->
                                new PlayerInput(
                                        rs.getLong(
                                                "player_id"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "display_name"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "club_name"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "fantasy_role"
                                        ),
                                        integerOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "history_seasons_available"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "source_mix"
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "data_confidence_score"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "fantasy_average_role_percentile"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "usage_role_percentile"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "goal_rate_role_percentile"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "assist_rate_role_percentile"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "quotation"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "fantasy_market_value"
                                                )
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .list();
    }

    private Map<String, List<PlayerInput>> groupByRole(
            List<PlayerInput> players
    ) {
        Map<String, List<PlayerInput>> result =
                new HashMap<>();

        for (PlayerInput player : players) {
            result
                    .computeIfAbsent(
                            player.role(),
                            ignored ->
                                    new ArrayList<>()
                    )
                    .add(player);
        }

        return result;
    }

    private Map<Long, Double> calculatePercentiles(
            List<PlayerInput> players,
            Function<PlayerInput, Double> extractor
    ) {

        List<Double> values =
                players.stream()
                        .map(extractor)
                        .filter(value -> value != null)
                        .sorted()
                        .toList();

        Map<Long, Double> percentiles =
                new HashMap<>();

        int n = values.size();

        if (n == 0) {
            return percentiles;
        }

        for (PlayerInput player : players) {

            Double value =
                    extractor.apply(player);

            if (value == null) {
                continue;
            }

            long lower =
                    values.stream()
                            .filter(item ->
                                    item < value
                            )
                            .count();

            long equal =
                    values.stream()
                            .filter(item ->
                                    Double.compare(
                                            item,
                                            value
                                    ) == 0
                            )
                            .count();

            double percentile;

            if (n == 1) {
                percentile = 100.0;

            } else {

                double averageRankZeroBased =
                        lower
                                + (
                                        equal - 1
                                ) / 2.0;

                percentile =
                        averageRankZeroBased
                                / (n - 1)
                                * 100.0;
            }

            percentiles.put(
                    player.playerId(),
                    percentile
            );
        }

        return percentiles;
    }

    private String evidenceTier(
            PlayerInput player,
            int performanceSignalCount
    ) {

        if (
                player.historySeasonsAvailable() != null
                && player.historySeasonsAvailable() == 0
        ) {
            return "MARKET_ONLY";
        }

        double confidence =
                player.dataConfidenceScore() == null
                        ? 0
                        : player.dataConfidenceScore();

        if (
                confidence >= 80
                && performanceSignalCount >= 3
        ) {
            return "HIGH_EVIDENCE";
        }

        if (
                confidence >= 70
                && performanceSignalCount >= 1
        ) {
            return "MEDIUM_EVIDENCE";
        }

        return "LOW_EVIDENCE";
    }

    private double roleAllocation(
            String role,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        if (defenseModifier) {
            return switch (role) {
                case "P" -> 0.07;
                case "D" -> 0.15;
                case "C" -> 0.23;
                case "A" -> 0.55;
                default ->
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Ruolo non valido"
                        );
            };
        }

        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 0.06;
            case "D" -> 0.10;
            case "C" -> 0.25;
            case "A" -> 0.59;
            default ->
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Ruolo non valido"
                    );
        };
    }

    private int roleSlots(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 3;
            case "D" -> 8;
            case "C" -> 8;
            case "A" -> 6;
            default ->
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Ruolo non valido"
                    );
        };
    }

    /*
     * Price curve inherited from certified B51.
     *
     * B67 changes the upstream value evidence, not the
     * already-tested conversion between role-relative value
     * and auction credits.
     */
    private double interpolatePrice(
            String role,
            double percentile
    ) {

        double[][] anchors =
                priceAnchors(role);

        if (percentile >= anchors[0][0]) {
            return anchors[0][1];
        }

        if (
                percentile
                        <= anchors[
                                anchors.length - 1
                        ][0]
        ) {
            return anchors[
                    anchors.length - 1
            ][1];
        }

        for (
                int index = 0;
                index < anchors.length - 1;
                index++
        ) {

            double highPercentile =
                    anchors[index][0];

            double highPrice =
                    anchors[index][1];

            double lowPercentile =
                    anchors[index + 1][0];

            double lowPrice =
                    anchors[index + 1][1];

            if (
                    percentile <= highPercentile
                    && percentile >= lowPercentile
            ) {

                double span =
                        highPercentile
                                - lowPercentile;

                if (span == 0) {
                    return highPrice;
                }

                double position =
                        (
                                percentile
                                        - lowPercentile
                        ) / span;

                return lowPrice
                        + position
                        * (
                                highPrice
                                        - lowPrice
                        );
            }
        }

        return 1.0;
    }

    private double[][] priceAnchors(String role) {
        return switch (role) {

            case "P" -> new double[][] {
                    {100, 70},
                    {97, 58},
                    {95, 50},
                    {90, 38},
                    {80, 22},
                    {70, 12},
                    {50, 5},
                    {30, 2},
                    {0, 1}
            };

            case "D" -> new double[][] {
                    {100, 180},
                    {98, 145},
                    {95, 105},
                    {90, 65},
                    {80, 30},
                    {70, 15},
                    {50, 6},
                    {30, 2},
                    {0, 1}
            };

            case "C" -> new double[][] {
                    {100, 500},
                    {98, 420},
                    {95, 330},
                    {90, 190},
                    {85, 95},
                    {80, 42},
                    {70, 12},
                    {60, 4},
                    {50, 2},
                    {0, 1}
            };

            case "A" -> new double[][] {
                    {100, 340},
                    {98, 310},
                    {95, 270},
                    {90, 220},
                    {80, 150},
                    {70, 95},
                    {50, 40},
                    {30, 12},
                    {0, 1}
            };

            default ->
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Ruolo non valido"
                    );
        };
    }

    private PriceRange calculateRange(
            double price,
            double confidence,
            boolean hasFvm
    ) {

        double lowFactor;
        double highFactor;

        if (confidence >= 90) {
            lowFactor = 0.90;
            highFactor = 1.10;

        } else if (confidence >= 80) {
            lowFactor = 0.85;
            highFactor = 1.15;

        } else if (confidence >= 70) {
            lowFactor = 0.80;
            highFactor = 1.20;

        } else {
            lowFactor = 0.72;
            highFactor = 1.28;
        }

        if (!hasFvm) {
            lowFactor -= 0.05;
            highFactor += 0.05;
        }

        int minimum =
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        (int) Math.round(
                                price * lowFactor
                        )
                );

        int maximum =
                Math.max(
                        (int) Math.round(price),
                        (int) Math.round(
                                price * highFactor
                        )
                );

        return new PriceRange(
                minimum,
                maximum
        );
    }

    private double competitionPercentile(
            int rank,
            int total
    ) {

        if (total <= 1) {
            return 100.0;
        }

        return (
                (total - rank)
                        * 100.0
                        / (total - 1)
        );
    }

    private void validateConfiguration(
            int budget,
            int teams
    ) {

        if (
                budget < 150
                || budget > 1000
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Il budget deve essere compreso tra 150 e 1000"
            );
        }

        if (
                teams < 6
                || teams > 12
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Le squadre devono essere comprese tra 6 e 12"
            );
        }
    }

    private static Integer integerOrNull(
            Object value
    ) {
        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number.intValue();
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static Double doubleOrNull(
            Object value
    ) {
        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number.doubleValue();
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static Double round2(
            Double value
    ) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        return BigDecimal
                .valueOf(value)
                .setScale(
                        2,
                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                )
                .doubleValue();
    }

    private record PlayerInput(
            Long playerId,
            String playerName,
            String club,
            String role,
            Integer historySeasonsAvailable,
            String sourceMix,
            Double dataConfidenceScore,
            Double fantasyAverageRolePercentile,
            Double usageRolePercentile,
            Double goalRateRolePercentile,
            Double assistRateRolePercentile,
            Double quotation,
            Double fantasyMarketValue
    ) {
    }

    private record ScoredPlayer(
            PlayerInput player,
            Double fvmRolePercentile,
            Double quotationRolePercentile,
            Double marketSignal,
            Double auctionScore,
            int performanceSignalCount,
            String evidenceTier
    ) {
    }

    private record PriceRemainder(
            Long playerId,
            double fraction,
            double auctionScore
    ) {
    }

    private record PriceRange(
            int minimumPrice,
            int maximumPrice
    ) {
    }

    public record AuctionPriceModelResult(
            Long playerId,
            String playerName,
            String club,
            String role,
            Double dataConfidenceScore,
            Integer historySeasonsAvailable,
            String sourceMix,
            Double quotation,
            Double fantasyMarketValue,
            Double fvmRolePercentile,
            Double quotationRolePercentile,
            Double fantasyAverageRolePercentile,
            Double usageRolePercentile,
            Double goalRateRolePercentile,
            Double assistRateRolePercentile,
            Double marketSignal,
            Integer performanceSignalCount,
            String evidenceTier,
            Double auctionScore,
            Integer auctionRoleRank,
            Double auctionRolePercentile,
            String pricingStatus,
            Integer minimumPrice,
            Integer recommendedPrice,
            Integer maximumPrice,
            BigDecimal budgetPercentage
    ) {
    }
}

    @Transactional
    public PersistResult generateAndPersist(
            String seasonCode,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {

        Long seasonId =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM seasons
                        WHERE code = :seasonCode
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "seasonCode",
                                seasonCode
                        )
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .optional()
                        .orElseThrow(() ->
                                new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Stagione non trovata: "
                                                + seasonCode
                                )
                        );

        verifyB66Algorithm(seasonId);

        String definitionPayload =
                """
                {
                  "version":"B67_AUCTION_PRICE_V1",
                  "model_family":"B66_MARKET_ROLE_RELATIVE_AUCTION_PRICE",
                  "performance_version":"B66_FEATURES_V3",
                  "catalogue":"CURRENT_OPERATIONAL_FANTACALCIO",
                  "market_source":"FANTACALCIO",
                  "score_aggregation":"MEDIAN_AVAILABLE_ROLE_RELATIVE_SIGNALS",
                  "market_signals":[
                    "fvm_role_percentile",
                    "quotation_role_percentile"
                  ],
                  "outfield_performance_signals":[
                    "fantasy_average_role_percentile",
                    "usage_role_percentile",
                    "goal_rate_role_percentile",
                    "assist_rate_role_percentile"
                  ],
                  "goalkeeper_performance_signals":[
                    "fantasy_average_role_percentile",
                    "usage_role_percentile"
                  ],
                  "null_policy":"NULL_STAYS_NULL_AND_SIGNAL_OMITTED",
                  "zero_policy":"ZERO_IS_REAL_EVIDENCE",
                  "confidence_policy":"RANGE_AND_EVIDENCE_ONLY",
                  "no_history_policy":"MARKET_ONLY_PRICING_ALLOWED",
                  "price_curve":"INHERITED_FROM_B51",
                  "role_allocations_no_modifier":{
                    "P":0.06,
                    "D":0.10,
                    "C":0.25,
                    "A":0.59
                  },
                  "role_allocations_modifier":{
                    "P":0.07,
                    "D":0.15,
                    "C":0.23,
                    "A":0.55
                  }
                }
                """.replaceAll("\\s+", "");

        String definitionFingerprint =
                sha256(definitionPayload);

        registerAlgorithm(
                seasonId,
                definitionPayload,
                definitionFingerprint
        );

        List<B67AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult>
                results =
                modelService.calculateAll(
                        seasonCode,
                        budget,
                        teams,
                        defenseModifier
                );

        int inserted = 0;
        int unchanged = 0;

        for (
                B67AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult result :
                results
        ) {

            String evidence =
                    buildEvidenceJson(result);

            String inputFingerprint =
                    buildInputFingerprint(
                            seasonCode,
                            budget,
                            teams,
                            defenseModifier,
                            result
                    );

            ExistingProfile existing =
                    findExistingProfile(
                            result.playerId(),
                            seasonId,
                            budget,
                            teams,
                            defenseModifier
                    );

            if (existing != null) {

                if (
                        !existing.inputFingerprint()
                                .equals(inputFingerprint)
                ) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException(
                            "Conflitto profilo B67 immutabile per player_id="
                                    + result.playerId()
                    );
                }

                unchanged++;
                continue;
            }

            insertProfile(
                    result,
                    seasonId,
                    budget,
                    teams,
                    defenseModifier,
                    evidence,
                    inputFingerprint
            );

            inserted++;
        }

        return new PersistResult(
                B67AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION,
                results.size(),
                inserted,
                unchanged
        );
    }

    private void verifyB66Algorithm(
            Long seasonId
    ) {

        Integer count =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM player_performance_algorithms
                        WHERE version = :version
                          AND reference_season_id = :seasonId
                          AND status = 'ACTIVE'
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "version",
                                B67AuctionPriceModelService.PERFORMANCE_VERSION
                        )
                        .param(
                                "seasonId",
                                seasonId
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        if (count != 1) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "B66_FEATURES_V3 ACTIVE richiesto per B67"
            );
        }
    }

    private void registerAlgorithm(
            Long seasonId,
            String payload,
            String fingerprint
    ) {

        Map<String, Object> existing =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            reference_season_id,
                            performance_algorithm_version,
                            definition_fingerprint
                        FROM auction_price_algorithms
                        WHERE version = :version
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "version",
                                B67AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION
                        )
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows()
                        .stream()
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElse(null);

        if (existing != null) {

            Long existingSeasonId =
                    ((Number) existing.get(
                            "reference_season_id"
                    )).longValue();

            String existingPerformanceVersion =
                    existing.get(
                            "performance_algorithm_version"
                    ).toString();

            String existingFingerprint =
                    existing.get(
                            "definition_fingerprint"
                    ).toString();

            if (
                    !existingSeasonId.equals(seasonId)
                    || !B67AuctionPriceModelService.PERFORMANCE_VERSION
                            .equals(existingPerformanceVersion)
                    || !fingerprint.equals(
                            existingFingerprint
                    )
            ) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Conflitto definizione algoritmo B67 immutabile"
                );
            }

            return;
        }

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO auction_price_algorithms (
                    version,
                    reference_season_id,
                    b50_algorithm_version,
                    performance_algorithm_version,
                    status,
                    model_family,
                    goalkeeper_b50_weight,
                    outfield_b50_weight,
                    market_percentile_weight,
                    market_strength_weight,
                    definition_payload,
                    definition_fingerprint
                )
                VALUES (
                    :version,
                    :seasonId,
                    NULL,
                    :performanceVersion,
                    'CANDIDATE',
                    :modelFamily,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    CAST(:payload AS jsonb),
                    :fingerprint
                )
                """)
                .param(
                        "version",
                        B67AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION
                )
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .param(
                        "performanceVersion",
                        B67AuctionPriceModelService.PERFORMANCE_VERSION
                )
                .param(
                        "modelFamily",
                        B67AuctionPriceModelService.MODEL_FAMILY
                )
                .param(
                        "payload",
                        payload
                )
                .param(
                        "fingerprint",
                        fingerprint
                )
                .update();
    }

    private ExistingProfile findExistingProfile(
            Long playerId,
            Long seasonId,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT input_fingerprint
                FROM auction_price_profiles
                WHERE player_id = :playerId
                  AND reference_season_id = :seasonId
                  AND algorithm_version = :algorithmVersion
                  AND league_teams = :teams
                  AND total_budget = :budget
                  AND defense_modifier = :defenseModifier
                """)
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        playerId
                )
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .param(
                        "algorithmVersion",
                        B67AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION
                )
                .param(
                        "teams",
                        teams
                )
                .param(
                        "budget",
                        budget
                )
                .param(
                        "defenseModifier",
                        defenseModifier
                )
                .query(
                        (rs, rowNumber) ->
                                new ExistingProfile(
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "input_fingerprint"
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .optional()
                .orElse(null);
    }

    private String buildEvidenceJson(
            B67AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult result
    ) {

        return """
                {
                  "performance_algorithm_version":"%s",
                  "pricing_algorithm_version":"%s",
                  "market_source":"FANTACALCIO",
                  "role":"%s",
                  "source_mix":"%s",
                  "evidence_tier":"%s",
                  "performance_signal_count":%d,
                  "pricing_status":"%s"
                }
                """.formatted(
                        B67AuctionPriceModelService.PERFORMANCE_VERSION,
                        B67AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION,
                        result.role(),
                        safeJson(result.sourceMix()),
                        result.evidenceTier(),
                        result.performanceSignalCount(),
                        result.pricingStatus()
                ).replaceAll("\\s+", "");
    }

    private String buildInputFingerprint(
            String seasonCode,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier,
            B67AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult result
    ) {

        String canonical =
                String.join(
                        "|",
                        B67AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION,
                        B67AuctionPriceModelService.PERFORMANCE_VERSION,
                        seasonCode,
                        Integer.toString(budget),
                        Integer.toString(teams),
                        Boolean.toString(defenseModifier),

                        safe(result.playerId()),
                        safe(result.role()),
                        safe(result.dataConfidenceScore()),
                        safe(result.historySeasonsAvailable()),
                        safe(result.sourceMix()),

                        safe(result.quotation()),
                        safe(result.fantasyMarketValue()),

                        safe(result.fvmRolePercentile()),
                        safe(result.quotationRolePercentile()),

                        safe(result.fantasyAverageRolePercentile()),
                        safe(result.usageRolePercentile()),
                        safe(result.goalRateRolePercentile()),
                        safe(result.assistRateRolePercentile()),

                        safe(result.marketSignal()),
                        safe(result.performanceSignalCount()),
                        safe(result.evidenceTier()),

                        safe(result.auctionScore()),
                        safe(result.auctionRoleRank()),
                        safe(result.auctionRolePercentile()),

                        safe(result.minimumPrice()),
                        safe(result.recommendedPrice()),
                        safe(result.maximumPrice())
                );

        return sha256(canonical);
    }

    private String safe(Object value) {
        return value == null
                ? "NULL"
                : value.toString();
    }

    private String safeJson(String value) {

        if (value == null) {
            return "";
        }

        return value
                .replace("\\", "\\\\")
                .replace("\"", "\\\"");
    }

    private String sha256(String value) {

        try {

            MessageDigest digest =
                    MessageDigest.getInstance(
                            "SHA-256"
                    );

            byte[] hash =
                    digest.digest(
                            value.getBytes(
                                    StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                            )
                    );

            return HexFormat
                    .of()
                    .formatHex(hash);

        } catch (
                NoSuchAlgorithmException exception
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "SHA-256 non disponibile",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    private record ExistingProfile(
            String inputFingerprint
    ) {
    }

    public record PersistResult(
            String algorithmVersion,
            int calculatedProfiles,
            int insertedProfiles,
            int unchangedProfiles
    ) {
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\auction\B67AuctionValueScorer.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class B67AuctionValueScorer {

    public ScoreResult score(
            String role,
            Double fvmRolePercentile,
            Double quotationRolePercentile,
            Double fantasyAverageRolePercentile,
            Double usageRolePercentile,
            Double goalRateRolePercentile,
            Double assistRateRolePercentile
    ) {

        List<Double> marketSignals = new ArrayList<>();

        addIfPresent(
                marketSignals,
                fvmRolePercentile
        );

        addIfPresent(
                marketSignals,
                quotationRolePercentile
        );

        List<Double> performanceSignals = new ArrayList<>();

        addIfPresent(
                performanceSignals,
                fantasyAverageRolePercentile
        );

        addIfPresent(
                performanceSignals,
                usageRolePercentile
        );

        if (!"P".equals(role)) {

            addIfPresent(
                    performanceSignals,
                    goalRateRolePercentile
            );

            addIfPresent(
                    performanceSignals,
                    assistRateRolePercentile
            );
        }

        Double marketScore =
                medianOrNull(
                        marketSignals
                );

        Double performanceScore =
                medianOrNull(
                        performanceSignals
                );

        Double auctionValueScore;

        if (
                marketScore != null
                && performanceScore != null
        ) {

            /*
             * Deliberately equal DOMAIN weighting.
             *
             * The number of individual historical features must not
             * silently give the performance domain more influence
             * than Fantacalcio market evidence.
             */
            auctionValueScore =
                    (
                            marketScore
                            + performanceScore
                    ) / 2.0;

        } else if (marketScore != null) {

            auctionValueScore =
                    marketScore;

        } else {

            auctionValueScore =
                    performanceScore;
        }

        return new ScoreResult(
                auctionValueScore,
                performanceSignals.size(),
                marketSignals.size()
                        + performanceSignals.size()
        );
    }

    public Double marketSignal(
            Double fvmRolePercentile,
            Double quotationRolePercentile
    ) {

        List<Double> values =
                new ArrayList<>();

        addIfPresent(
                values,
                fvmRolePercentile
        );

        addIfPresent(
                values,
                quotationRolePercentile
        );

        return medianOrNull(values);
    }

    private void addIfPresent(
            List<Double> values,
            Double value
    ) {

        if (value != null) {
            values.add(value);
        }
    }

    private Double medianOrNull(
            List<Double> values
    ) {

        if (values.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        values.sort(
                Comparator.naturalOrder()
        );

        int size =
                values.size();

        if (size % 2 == 1) {
            return values.get(
                    size / 2
            );
        }

        return (
                values.get(
                        size / 2 - 1
                )
                + values.get(
                        size / 2
                )
        ) / 2.0;
    }

    public record ScoreResult(
            Double auctionValueScore,
            int performanceSignalCount,
            int totalSignalCount
    ) {
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\auctionlive\LiveAuctionStrategyService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionlive;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionranking.AuctionRankingItemResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionranking.AuctionRankingResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionranking.IntelligentAuctionRankingService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squad.SquadPlayerResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squad.SquadResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squad.SquadRoleSummaryResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squad.SquadService;

@Service
public class LiveAuctionStrategyService {

    private static final List<String> ROLE_ORDER =
            List.of("P", "D", "C", "A");

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final SquadService squadService;
    private final IntelligentAuctionRankingService rankingService;

    public LiveAuctionStrategyService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            SquadService squadService,
            IntelligentAuctionRankingService rankingService
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.squadService = squadService;
        this.rankingService = rankingService;
    }

    @Transactional
    public LiveAuctionStrategyResponse buildActiveStrategy() {
        SquadResponse squad =
                squadService.findActiveSquad();

        return buildStrategy(squad.id());
    }

    @Transactional
    public LiveAuctionStrategyResponse buildStrategy(
            Long squadId
    ) {
        if (squadId == null || squadId <= 0) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "L'identificativo della rosa non Ã¨ valido"
            );
        }

        SquadResponse squad =
                squadService.findSquad(squadId);

        LeagueConfiguration configuration =
                findLeagueConfiguration(squadId);

        int remainingSlots =
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        squad.maximumPlayers()
                                - squad.totalPlayers()
                );

        int globalMaximumBid =
                calculateMaximumBid(
                        squad.remainingBudget(),
                        remainingSlots
                );

        Set<Long> acquiredPlayerIds =
                squad.players()
                        .stream()
                        .map(SquadPlayerResponse::playerId)
                        .collect(
                                java.util.stream.Collectors
                                        .toCollection(HashSet::new)
                        );

        Map<String, Integer> roleBudgets =
                allocateRemainingBudget(
                        squad,
                        configuration.defenseModifier()
                );

        List<LiveAuctionRoleStrategyResponse> roles =
                new ArrayList<>();

        List<String> globalWarnings =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (String role : ROLE_ORDER) {
            SquadRoleSummaryResponse roleSummary =
                    squad.roles().get(role);

            if (roleSummary == null) {
                globalWarnings.add(
                        "Configurazione mancante per il ruolo "
                                + role
                );

                continue;
            }

            roles.add(
                    buildRoleStrategy(
                            squad,
                            configuration,
                            role,
                            roleSummary,
                            roleBudgets.getOrDefault(role, 0),
                            globalMaximumBid,
                            acquiredPlayerIds
                    )
            );
        }

        boolean squadComplete =
                remainingSlots == 0;

        if (squadComplete) {
            globalWarnings.add(
                    "La rosa Ã¨ completa: non sono necessari "
                            + "altri acquisti"
            );
        }

        if (!squadComplete
                && squad.remainingBudget() < remainingSlots) {

            globalWarnings.add(
                    "Il budget residuo non garantisce un credito "
                            + "per ogni slot libero"
            );
        }

        if (!squadComplete
                && globalMaximumBid <= 1) {

            globalWarnings.add(
                    "Budget critico: il rilancio massimo globale "
                            + "Ã¨ limitato a un credito"
            );
        }

        String summary =
                buildSummary(
                        squad,
                        remainingSlots,
                        globalMaximumBid,
                        squadComplete
                );

        return new LiveAuctionStrategyResponse(
                squad.id(),
                squad.name(),
                squad.season(),
                configuration.teams(),
                configuration.defenseModifier(),
                squad.initialBudget(),
                squad.spentBudget(),
                squad.remainingBudget(),
                squad.totalPlayers(),
                squad.maximumPlayers(),
                remainingSlots,
                globalMaximumBid,
                squadComplete,
                summary,
                List.copyOf(roles),
                List.copyOf(globalWarnings)
        );
    }

    private LiveAuctionRoleStrategyResponse buildRoleStrategy(
            SquadResponse squad,
            LeagueConfiguration configuration,
            String role,
            SquadRoleSummaryResponse roleSummary,
            int allocatedBudget,
            int globalMaximumBid,
            Set<Long> acquiredPlayerIds
    ) {
        int remainingRoleSlots =
                roleSummary.remaining();

        boolean roleComplete =
                remainingRoleSlots == 0;

        List<String> warnings =
                new ArrayList<>();

        if (roleComplete) {
            warnings.add(
                    "Ruolo completo: nessun altro acquisto richiesto"
            );

            return new LiveAuctionRoleStrategyResponse(
                    role,
                    roleSummary.current(),
                    roleSummary.maximum(),
                    0,
                    0,
                    0,
                    true,
                    List.of(),
                    List.copyOf(warnings)
            );
        }

        int roleMaximumBid =
                Math.min(
                        globalMaximumBid,
                        Math.max(
                                1,
                                allocatedBudget
                                        - Math.max(
                                                0,
                                                remainingRoleSlots - 1
                                        )
                        )
                );

        AuctionRankingResponse ranking =
                rankingService.findRanking(
                        squad.season(),
                        squad.initialBudget(),
                        configuration.teams(),
                        configuration.defenseModifier(),
                        role,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        true,
                        100
                );

        List<LiveAuctionTargetResponse> targets =
                ranking.players()
                        .stream()
                        .filter(player ->
                                !acquiredPlayerIds.contains(
                                        player.playerId()
                                )
                        )
                        .map(player ->
                                toLiveTarget(
                                        player,
                                        roleMaximumBid
                                )
                        )
                        .filter(target ->
                                target.liveMaximumBid() >= 1
                        )
                        .limit(
                                Math.min(
                                        10,
                                        Math.max(
                                                4,
                                                remainingRoleSlots * 2
                                        )
                                )
                        )
                        .toList();

        if (targets.isEmpty()) {
            warnings.add(
                    "Nessun obiettivo disponibile compatibile "
                            + "con rosa e budget"
            );
        }

        if (roleMaximumBid <= 1) {
            warnings.add(
                    "Disponibile soltanto il rilancio minimo "
                            + "per questo ruolo"
            );
        }

        if (allocatedBudget < remainingRoleSlots) {
            warnings.add(
                    "Budget del ruolo insufficiente per coprire "
                            + "tutti gli slot residui"
            );
        }

        if ("D".equals(role)
                && configuration.defenseModifier()
                && remainingRoleSlots > 0) {

            warnings.add(
                    "Con il modificatore attivo privilegiare "
                            + "titolaritÃ  e affidabilitÃ  difensiva"
            );
        }

        return new LiveAuctionRoleStrategyResponse(
                role,
                roleSummary.current(),
                roleSummary.maximum(),
                remainingRoleSlots,
                allocatedBudget,
                roleMaximumBid,
                false,
                targets,
                List.copyOf(warnings)
        );
    }

    private LiveAuctionTargetResponse toLiveTarget(
            AuctionRankingItemResponse player,
            int roleMaximumBid
    ) {
        int liveMaximumBid =
                Math.min(
                        player.maximumPrice(),
                        roleMaximumBid
                );

        String category =
                liveCategory(
                        player,
                        liveMaximumBid
                );

        return new LiveAuctionTargetResponse(
                player.playerId(),
                player.playerName(),
                player.club(),
                player.fantasyRole(),
                safeDecimal(player.intelligenceScore()),
                safeDecimal(player.reliabilityScore()),
                safeDecimal(player.potentialScore()),
                safeDecimal(player.riskScore()),
                safeDecimal(player.starterProbability()),
                player.minimumPrice(),
                player.recommendedPrice(),
                player.maximumPrice(),
                liveMaximumBid,
                category,
                player.finalRecommendation(),
                player.strengths(),
                player.risks()
        );
    }

    private String liveCategory(
            AuctionRankingItemResponse player,
            int liveMaximumBid
    ) {
        if (liveMaximumBid < player.minimumPrice()) {
            return "FUORI BUDGET";
        }

        if (player.recommendedPrice() <= liveMaximumBid
                && (
                        "OBIETTIVO PRIORITARIO".equals(
                                player.finalRecommendation()
                        )
                        || "ACQUISTO CONSIGLIATO".equals(
                                player.finalRecommendation()
                        )
                )) {

            return "OBIETTIVO LIVE";
        }

        if (player.recommendedPrice() <= liveMaximumBid) {
            return "ALTERNATIVA COMPATIBILE";
        }

        return "SOLO A PREZZO RIDOTTO";
    }

    private Map<String, Integer> allocateRemainingBudget(
            SquadResponse squad,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        Map<String, BigDecimal> baseWeights =
                roleWeights(defenseModifier);

        Map<String, BigDecimal> effectiveWeights =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        BigDecimal totalEffectiveWeight =
                BigDecimal.ZERO;

        int totalRemainingSlots = 0;

        for (String role : ROLE_ORDER) {
            SquadRoleSummaryResponse summary =
                    squad.roles().get(role);

            if (summary == null || summary.remaining() <= 0) {
                effectiveWeights.put(
                        role,
                        BigDecimal.ZERO
                );

                continue;
            }

            totalRemainingSlots += summary.remaining();

            BigDecimal completionFactor =
                    BigDecimal.valueOf(
                            summary.remaining()
                    ).divide(
                            BigDecimal.valueOf(
                                    summary.maximum()
                            ),
                            6,
                            RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                    );

            BigDecimal effectiveWeight =
                    baseWeights.get(role)
                            .multiply(completionFactor);

            effectiveWeights.put(
                    role,
                    effectiveWeight
            );

            totalEffectiveWeight =
                    totalEffectiveWeight.add(
                            effectiveWeight
                    );
        }

        Map<String, Integer> result =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        if (totalRemainingSlots == 0) {
            for (String role : ROLE_ORDER) {
                result.put(role, 0);
            }

            return result;
        }

        int mandatoryReserve =
                totalRemainingSlots;

        int discretionaryBudget =
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        squad.remainingBudget()
                                - mandatoryReserve
                );

        int remainingToAllocate =
                squad.remainingBudget();

        List<String> openRoles =
                ROLE_ORDER.stream()
                        .filter(role ->
                                squad.roles().get(role) != null
                                        && squad.roles()
                                                .get(role)
                                                .remaining() > 0
                        )
                        .toList();

        for (int index = 0;
                index < openRoles.size();
                index++) {

            String role =
                    openRoles.get(index);

            SquadRoleSummaryResponse summary =
                    squad.roles().get(role);

            int allocation;

            if (index == openRoles.size() - 1) {
                allocation =
                        remainingToAllocate;
            }
            else {
                int reserve =
                        summary.remaining();

                int discretionaryShare =
                        totalEffectiveWeight.signum() == 0
                                ? 0
                                : effectiveWeights.get(role)
                                        .divide(
                                                totalEffectiveWeight,
                                                8,
                                                RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                                        )
                                        .multiply(
                                                BigDecimal.valueOf(
                                                        discretionaryBudget
                                                )
                                        )
                                        .setScale(
                                                0,
                                                RoundingMode.DOWN
                                        )
                                        .intValue();

                allocation =
                        Math.min(
                                remainingToAllocate,
                                reserve + discretionaryShare
                        );
            }

            result.put(role, allocation);

            remainingToAllocate -= allocation;
        }

        for (String role : ROLE_ORDER) {
            result.putIfAbsent(role, 0);
        }

        return result;
    }

    private Map<String, BigDecimal> roleWeights(
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        Map<String, BigDecimal> weights =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        weights.put(
                "P",
                BigDecimal.valueOf(0.08)
        );

        weights.put(
                "D",
                BigDecimal.valueOf(
                        defenseModifier
                                ? 0.22
                                : 0.17
                )
        );

        weights.put(
                "C",
                BigDecimal.valueOf(
                        defenseModifier
                                ? 0.27
                                : 0.30
                )
        );

        weights.put(
                "A",
                BigDecimal.valueOf(
                        defenseModifier
                                ? 0.43
                                : 0.45
                )
        );

        return weights;
    }

    private int calculateMaximumBid(
            int remainingBudget,
            int remainingSlots
    ) {
        if (remainingSlots <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        return Math.max(
                1,
                remainingBudget
                        - Math.max(
                                0,
                                remainingSlots - 1
                        )
        );
    }

    private LeagueConfiguration findLeagueConfiguration(
            Long squadId
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    league.teams_count,
                    league.defense_modifier

                FROM fantasy_squads squad

                JOIN league_configurations league
                    ON league.id =
                        squad.league_configuration_id

                WHERE squad.id = :squadId
                """)
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .query((rs, rowNumber) ->
                        new LeagueConfiguration(
                                rs.getInt(
                                        "teams_count"
                                ),
                                rs.getBoolean(
                                        "defense_modifier"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .single();
    }

    private String buildSummary(
            SquadResponse squad,
            int remainingSlots,
            int globalMaximumBid,
            boolean squadComplete
    ) {
        if (squadComplete) {
            return "Rosa completa con "
                    + squad.totalPlayers()
                    + " giocatori e "
                    + squad.remainingBudget()
                    + " crediti residui.";
        }

        return "Rosa composta da "
                + squad.totalPlayers()
                + " giocatori su "
                + squad.maximumPlayers()
                + ". Restano "
                + remainingSlots
                + " slot e "
                + squad.remainingBudget()
                + " crediti. Rilancio massimo sostenibile: "
                + globalMaximumBid
                + " crediti.";
    }

    private BigDecimal safeDecimal(
            BigDecimal value
    ) {
        return value == null
                ? BigDecimal.ZERO
                : value;
    }

    private record LeagueConfiguration(
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
    }
}
