--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\auctionranking\IntelligentAuctionRankingService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionranking;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction.AuctionApiPriceService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction.AuctionPriceResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.intelligence.PlayerIntelligenceResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.intelligence.PlayerIntelligenceService;

@Service
public class IntelligentAuctionRankingService {

    private static final Set<String> ROLES =
            Set.of("P", "D", "C", "A");

    private static final Set<String> RECOMMENDATIONS =
            Set.of(
                    "OBIETTIVO PRIORITARIO",
                    "ACQUISTO CONSIGLIATO",
                    "ACQUISTARE SOLO AL PREZZO GIUSTO",
                    "ATTENDERE AGGIORNAMENTI",
                    "EVITARE O PRENDERE A BASSO COSTO"
            );

    private static final Set<String> UNAVAILABLE_STATUSES =
            Set.of(
                    "INJURED",
                    "UNAVAILABLE",
                    "SUSPENDED"
            );

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final PlayerIntelligenceService intelligenceService;
    private final AuctionApiPriceService auctionPriceService;

    public IntelligentAuctionRankingService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            PlayerIntelligenceService intelligenceService,
            AuctionApiPriceService auctionPriceService
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.intelligenceService = intelligenceService;
        this.auctionPriceService = auctionPriceService;
    }

    @Transactional
    public AuctionRankingResponse findRanking(
            String season,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier,
            String role,
            String club,
            Integer maximumPrice,
            String recommendation,
            boolean excludeUnavailable,
            int limit
    ) {
        RankingRequest request =
                validateAndNormalize(
                        season,
                        budget,
                        teams,
                        role,
                        club,
                        maximumPrice,
                        recommendation,
                        limit
                );

        List<Long> playerIds =
                findEligiblePlayerIds(
                        request.season(),
                        request.role(),
                        request.club()
                );

        List<PlayerIntelligenceResponse> profiles =
                new ArrayList<>();

        if (playerIds.isEmpty()) {
            return emptyResponse(
                    request,
                    budget,
                    teams,
                    defenseModifier,
                    excludeUnavailable
            );
        }

        Map<Long, AuctionPriceResponse> pricesByPlayer =
                auctionPriceService.calculateAll(
                                request.season(),
                                budget,
                                teams,
                                defenseModifier
                        )
                        .stream()
                        .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                                AuctionPriceResponse::playerId,
                                Function.identity()
                        ));

        for (Long playerId : playerIds) {
            AuctionPriceResponse price =
                    pricesByPlayer.get(playerId);

            // An absent entry is explicitly INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE in B51.
            if (price == null) {
                continue;
            }

            PlayerIntelligenceResponse profile =
                    intelligenceService.findByPlayer(
                            playerId,
                            request.season(),
                            budget,
                            teams,
                            defenseModifier,
                            price
                    );

            if (matchesFilters(
                    profile,
                    request.maximumPrice(),
                    request.recommendation(),
                    excludeUnavailable
            )) {
                profiles.add(profile);
            }
        }

        profiles.sort(
                Comparator
                        .comparing(
                                PlayerIntelligenceResponse::auctionScore,
                                Comparator.nullsLast(
                                        Comparator.reverseOrder()
                                )
                        )
                        .thenComparing(
                                PlayerIntelligenceResponse
                                        ::recommendedPrice,
                                Comparator.reverseOrder()
                        )
                        .thenComparing(
                                PlayerIntelligenceResponse::playerName,
                                String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER
                        )
        );

        List<PlayerIntelligenceResponse> limitedProfiles =
                profiles.stream()
                        .limit(request.limit())
                        .toList();

        List<AuctionRankingItemResponse> items =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (int index = 0;
                index < limitedProfiles.size();
                index++) {

            PlayerIntelligenceResponse profile =
                    limitedProfiles.get(index);

            items.add(
                    new AuctionRankingItemResponse(
                            index + 1,
                            profile.playerId(),
                            profile.playerName(),
                            profile.club(),
                            profile.fantasyRole(),
                            safeDecimal(profile.auctionScore()),
                            profile.minimumPrice(),
                            profile.recommendedPrice(),
                            profile.maximumPrice(),
                            safeDecimal(
                                    profile.budgetPercentage()
                            ),
                            safeDecimal(
                                    profile.reliabilityScore()
                            ),
                            safeDecimal(
                                    profile.potentialScore()
                            ),
                            safeDecimal(
                                    profile.riskScore()
                            ),
                            safeDecimal(
                                    profile.starterProbability()
                            ),
                            profile.availabilityStatus(),
                            profile.availabilityMatchday(),
                            profile.strengths(),
                            profile.risks(),
                            profile.finalRecommendation()
                    )
            );
        }

        return new AuctionRankingResponse(
                request.season(),
                budget,
                teams,
                defenseModifier,
                request.role(),
                request.club(),
                request.maximumPrice(),
                request.recommendation(),
                excludeUnavailable,
                items.size(),
                List.copyOf(items)
        );
    }

    private AuctionRankingResponse emptyResponse(
            RankingRequest request,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier,
            boolean excludeUnavailable
    ) {
        return new AuctionRankingResponse(
                request.season(),
                budget,
                teams,
                defenseModifier,
                request.role(),
                request.club(),
                request.maximumPrice(),
                request.recommendation(),
                excludeUnavailable,
                0,
                List.of()
        );
    }

    private List<Long> findEligiblePlayerIds(
            String season,
            String role,
            String club
    ) {
        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder("""
                SELECT DISTINCT player.id

                FROM players player

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = player.id
                    AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = registration.season_id

                JOIN clubs club
                    ON club.id = registration.club_id

                JOIN season_clubs season_club
                    ON season_club.season_id = season.id
                    AND season_club.club_id = club.id

                JOIN player_roles role
                    ON role.player_id = player.id
                    AND role.season_id = season.id
                    AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'


                WHERE player.active = TRUE
                  AND season.code = :season
                """);

        if (role != null) {
            sql.append("""
                    AND role.fantasy_role = :role
                    """);
        }

        if (club != null) {
            sql.append("""
                    AND (
                        LOWER(club.name) = :club
                        OR LOWER(club.slug) = :club
                    )
                    """);
        }

        sql.append("""
                ORDER BY player.id
                """);

        var query =
                jdbcClient.sql(sql.toString())
                        .param("season", season);

        if (role != null) {
            query = query.param("role", role);
        }

        if (club != null) {
            query = query.param("club", club);
        }

        return query
                .query(Long.class)
                .list();
    }

    private boolean matchesFilters(
            PlayerIntelligenceResponse profile,
            Integer maximumPrice,
            String recommendation,
            boolean excludeUnavailable
    ) {
        if (maximumPrice != null
                && profile.recommendedPrice() > maximumPrice) {
            return false;
        }

        if (recommendation != null
                && !recommendation.equals(
                        profile.finalRecommendation()
                )) {
            return false;
        }

        if (excludeUnavailable
                && profile.availabilityStatus() != null
                && UNAVAILABLE_STATUSES.contains(
                        profile.availabilityStatus()
                                .toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)
                )) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private RankingRequest validateAndNormalize(
            String season,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            String role,
            String club,
            Integer maximumPrice,
            String recommendation,
            int limit
    ) {
        if (season == null || season.isBlank()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "La stagione Ã¨ obbligatoria"
            );
        }

        if (budget < 150 || budget > 1000) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Il budget deve essere compreso tra 150 e 1000"
            );
        }

        if (teams < 6 || teams > 12) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Le squadre devono essere comprese tra 6 e 12"
            );
        }

        String normalizedRole =
                normalizeNullable(role);

        if (normalizedRole != null) {
            normalizedRole =
                    normalizedRole.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);

            if (!ROLES.contains(normalizedRole)) {
                throw new BadRequestException(
                        "Il ruolo deve essere P, D, C oppure A"
                );
            }
        }

        String normalizedClub =
                normalizeNullable(club);

        if (normalizedClub != null) {
            normalizedClub =
                    normalizedClub.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        }

        if (maximumPrice != null
                && maximumPrice < 1) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Il prezzo massimo deve essere positivo"
            );
        }

        if (maximumPrice != null
                && maximumPrice > budget) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Il prezzo massimo non puÃ² superare il budget"
            );
        }

        String normalizedRecommendation =
                normalizeNullable(recommendation);

        if (normalizedRecommendation != null) {
            normalizedRecommendation =
                    normalizedRecommendation
                            .toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);

            if (!RECOMMENDATIONS.contains(
                    normalizedRecommendation
            )) {
                throw new BadRequestException(
                        "Raccomandazione non valida"
                );
            }
        }

        if (limit < 1 || limit > 100) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Il limite deve essere compreso tra 1 e 100"
            );
        }

        return new RankingRequest(
                season.trim(),
                normalizedRole,
                normalizedClub,
                maximumPrice,
                normalizedRecommendation,
                limit
        );
    }

    private String normalizeNullable(String value) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }

        return value.trim();
    }

    private BigDecimal safeDecimal(
            BigDecimal value
    ) {
        return value == null
                ? BigDecimal.ZERO
                : value;
    }

    private record RankingRequest(
            String season,
            String role,
            String club,
            Integer maximumPrice,
            String recommendation,
            int limit
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.SessionDecisionRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction.LiveAuctionDecisionRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction.LiveAuctionDecisionResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction.LiveAuctionDecisionService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.BoughtPlayerRequest;

@Service
public class AuctionContextAdapter {
    private final JdbcClient jdbc;
    private final AuctionStateService stateService;
    private final LiveAuctionDecisionService decisionService;
    public AuctionContextAdapter(JdbcClient jdbc,AuctionStateService stateService,
            LiveAuctionDecisionService decisionService){this.jdbc=jdbc;this.stateService=stateService;this.decisionService=decisionService;}

    @Transactional(readOnly=true)
    public LiveAuctionDecisionResponse decide(Long sessionId,SessionDecisionRequest request){
        if(request==null||request.proposedBid()==null||request.proposedBid()<1)
            throw new BadRequestException("proposedBid deve essere almeno 1");
        var state=stateService.state(sessionId);
        var session=state.session();
        if(session.status()!=AuctionSessionStatus.ACTIVE)throw new ConflictException("Sessione non ACTIVE");
        if(session.currentPlayerId()==null||session.currentPrice()==null)
            throw new ConflictException("Nessuna nomination corrente");
        String role=state.players().stream().filter(p->p.playerId().equals(session.currentPlayerId()))
                .map(AuctionStateDtos.PlayerStateResponse::role).findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(()->new ConflictException("Nomination fuori dallo stato sessione"));
        List<BoughtPlayerRequest> bought=jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT player_id,fantasy_role,purchase_price FROM fantasy_squad_players
                WHERE squad_id=:squad ORDER BY id
                """).param("squad",session.squadId()).query((rs,n)->new BoughtPlayerRequest(
                        rs.getLong("player_id"),rs.getString("fantasy_role"),rs.getInt("purchase_price"))).list();
        List<Long> unavailable=state.players().stream()
                .filter(p->p.availability()==AuctionPlayerAvailability.ACQUIRED_BY_OTHER
                        ||p.availability()==AuctionPlayerAvailability.EXCLUDED)
                .map(AuctionStateDtos.PlayerStateResponse::playerId).toList();
        Map<String,Integer> slots=jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT league.goalkeepers_count p,league.defenders_count d,
                       league.midfielders_count c,league.forwards_count a
                FROM fantasy_squads squad JOIN league_configurations league
                     ON league.id=squad.league_configuration_id WHERE squad.id=:squad
                """).param("squad",session.squadId()).query((rs,n)->Map.of("P",rs.getInt("p"),
                        "D",rs.getInt("d"),"C",rs.getInt("c"),"A",rs.getInt("a"))).single();
        return decisionService.decide(new LiveAuctionDecisionRequest(session.season(),session.leagueTeams(),
                session.totalBudget(),state.remainingBudget(),session.defenseModifier(),role,
                session.currentPlayerId(),session.currentPrice(),request.proposedBid(),null,slots,bought,
                request.currentMatchday(),request.horizon(),request.alternativeLimit(),List.of(),
                unavailable,state.availabilityComplete()));
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate;

import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;

import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.PurchaseRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.PurchaseResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction.LiveAuctionBudgetGuard;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.BoughtPlayerRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.DynamicBudgetEngine;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.SquadConstructionRequest;

@Service
public class AuctionPurchaseService {
    private final JdbcClient jdbc;
    private final AuctionStateService stateService;
    private final DynamicBudgetEngine budgetEngine;
    private final LiveAuctionBudgetGuard budgetGuard;

    public AuctionPurchaseService(JdbcClient jdbc,AuctionStateService stateService,
            DynamicBudgetEngine budgetEngine,LiveAuctionBudgetGuard budgetGuard){
        this.jdbc=jdbc;this.stateService=stateService;this.budgetEngine=budgetEngine;this.budgetGuard=budgetGuard;
    }

    @Transactional
    public PurchaseResponse purchase(Long sessionId,PurchaseRequest request){
        validate(request);
        Map<String,Object> session=stateService.lock(sessionId);
        stateService.requireStatus(session,AuctionSessionStatus.ACTIVE);
        PurchaseResponse previous=findByKey(sessionId,request.idempotencyKey());
        if(previous!=null){
            if(previous.playerId().equals(request.playerId())&&previous.buyerType()==request.buyerType()
                    &&Objects.equals(previous.paidPrice(),request.paidPrice()))return previous;
            throw new ConflictException("Idempotency key gia' usata con payload diverso");
        }
        Map<String,Object> playerState=jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT id,session_id,player_id,fantasy_role,availability,version,created_at,updated_at
                FROM auction_player_states WHERE session_id=:session AND player_id=:player FOR UPDATE
                """).param("session",sessionId).param("player",request.playerId()).query().listOfRows().stream()
                .findFirst().orElseThrow(()->new ResourceNotFoundException("Player non presente nella sessione"));
        if(!"AVAILABLE".equals(playerState.get("availability")))throw new ConflictException("Player gia' non disponibile");
        String role=playerState.get("fantasy_role").toString();
        boolean eligible=jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auction_sessions auction
                JOIN players player ON player.id=:player AND player.active=TRUE
                JOIN player_registrations registration ON registration.player_id=player.id
                     AND registration.season_id=auction.season_id AND registration.registration_status='ACTIVE'
                JOIN season_clubs season_club ON season_club.season_id=auction.season_id
                     AND season_club.club_id=registration.club_id
                JOIN player_roles role ON role.player_id=player.id AND role.season_id=auction.season_id
                     AND role.source='FANTACALCIO' AND role.fantasy_role=:role
                WHERE auction.id=:session)
                """).param("player",request.playerId()).param("role",role)
                .param("session",sessionId).query(Boolean.class).single();
        if(!eligible)throw new ConflictException("Player non piu' eleggibile nella sessione");
        if(request.buyerType()==AuctionBuyerType.USER) addUserPlayer(session,request,role);
        try{
            Long id=jdbc.sql("""
                    INSERT INTO auction_purchases(session_id,player_id,buyer_type,paid_price,idempotency_key)
                    VALUES(:session,:player,:buyer,:price,:key) RETURNING id
                    """).param("session",sessionId).param("player",request.playerId())
                    .param("buyer",request.buyerType().name()).param("price",request.paidPrice())
                    .param("key",request.idempotencyKey().trim()).query(Long.class).single();
            String availability=request.buyerType()==AuctionBuyerType.USER?"ACQUIRED_BY_USER":"ACQUIRED_BY_OTHER";
            jdbc.sql("""
                    UPDATE auction_player_states SET availability=:availability,version=version+1,
                        updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE session_id=:session AND player_id=:player
                    """).param("availability",availability).param("session",sessionId)
                    .param("player",request.playerId()).update();
            jdbc.sql("""
                    UPDATE auction_sessions SET current_player_id=NULL,current_price=NULL,
                        version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    WHERE id=:session AND current_player_id=:player
                    """).param("session",sessionId).param("player",request.playerId()).update();
            stateService.event(sessionId,"PURCHASE_"+request.buyerType().name(),request.playerId(),
                    request.idempotencyKey().trim(),request.paidPrice()==null?"{}":"{\"paidPrice\":"+request.paidPrice()+"}");
            return find(id);
        }catch(DataIntegrityViolationException ex){throw new ConflictException("Purchase concorrente o duplicato");}
    }

    private void addUserPlayer(Map<String,Object> session,PurchaseRequest request,String role){
        Long squad=((Number)session.get("squad_id")).longValue();
        jdbc.sql("SELECT id FROM fantasy_squads WHERE id=:id FOR UPDATE").param("id",squad).query(Long.class).single();
        String season=jdbc.sql("SELECT code FROM seasons WHERE id=:id")
                .param("id",session.get("season_id")).query(String.class).single();
        List<BoughtPlayerRequest> bought=jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT player_id,fantasy_role,purchase_price FROM fantasy_squad_players
                WHERE squad_id=:squad ORDER BY id
                """).param("squad",squad).query((rs,n)->new BoughtPlayerRequest(rs.getLong("player_id"),
                        rs.getString("fantasy_role"),rs.getInt("purchase_price"))).list();
        int spent=bought.stream().mapToInt(BoughtPlayerRequest::pricePaid).sum();
        int total=((Number)session.get("total_budget")).intValue();
        int remaining=total-spent;
        Map<String,Integer> slots=jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT league.goalkeepers_count p,league.defenders_count d,
                       league.midfielders_count c,league.forwards_count a
                FROM fantasy_squads squad JOIN league_configurations league
                     ON league.id=squad.league_configuration_id WHERE squad.id=:squad
                """).param("squad",squad).query((rs,n)->Map.of("P",rs.getInt("p"),"D",rs.getInt("d"),
                        "C",rs.getInt("c"),"A",rs.getInt("a"))).single();
        var budget=budgetEngine.calculate(new SquadConstructionRequest(season,
                ((Number)session.get("league_teams")).intValue(),total,remaining,
                (Boolean)session.get("defense_modifier"),role,slots,bought,1));
        if(!budgetGuard.evaluate(request.paidPrice(),remaining,budget).sustainable())
            throw new ConflictException("Purchase non sostenibile per budget/slot B54");
        try{
            jdbc.sql("""
                    INSERT INTO fantasy_squad_players(squad_id,player_id,season_id,fantasy_role,purchase_price)
                    VALUES(:squad,:player,:season,:role,:price)
                    """).param("squad",squad).param("player",request.playerId())
                    .param("season",session.get("season_id")).param("role",role)
                    .param("price",request.paidPrice()).update();
        }catch(DataIntegrityViolationException ex){throw new ConflictException("Player gia' presente nella rosa");}
    }

    private void validate(PurchaseRequest r){
        if(r==null||r.playerId()==null||r.playerId()<=0||r.buyerType()==null
                ||r.idempotencyKey()==null||r.idempotencyKey().isBlank()||r.idempotencyKey().length()>120)
            throw new BadRequestException("Purchase payload non valido");
        if(r.buyerType()==AuctionBuyerType.USER&&(r.paidPrice()==null||r.paidPrice()<1))
            throw new BadRequestException("paidPrice USER deve essere almeno 1");
        if(r.buyerType()==AuctionBuyerType.OTHER&&r.paidPrice()!=null&&r.paidPrice()<1)
            throw new BadRequestException("paidPrice OTHER, se noto, deve essere almeno 1");
    }
    private PurchaseResponse findByKey(Long session,String key){return jdbc.sql("""
            SELECT id,session_id,player_id,buyer_type,paid_price,idempotency_key,created_at
            FROM auction_purchases WHERE session_id=:session AND idempotency_key=:key
            """).param("session",session).param("key",key.trim()).query((rs,n)->map(rs)).optional().orElse(null);}
    private PurchaseResponse find(Long id){return jdbc.sql("""
            SELECT id,session_id,player_id,buyer_type,paid_price,idempotency_key,created_at
            FROM auction_purchases WHERE id=:id
            """).param("id",id).query((rs,n)->map(rs)).single();}
    private PurchaseResponse map(java.sql.ResultSet rs)throws java.sql.SQLException{return new PurchaseResponse(
            rs.getLong("id"),rs.getLong("session_id"),rs.getLong("player_id"),
            AuctionBuyerType.valueOf(rs.getString("buyer_type")),(Integer)rs.getObject("paid_price"),
            rs.getString("idempotency_key"),rs.getObject("created_at",OffsetDateTime.class));}
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\auctionstate\AuctionSessionAccessService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

@Service
public class AuctionSessionAccessService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbc;

    public AuctionSessionAccessService(JdbcClient jdbc) {
        this.jdbc = jdbc;
    }

    public String authenticatedUsername(Authentication authentication) {

        if (authentication == null
                || !authentication.isAuthenticated()
                || authentication.getName() == null
                || authentication.getName().isBlank()
                || "anonymousUser".equalsIgnoreCase(authentication.getName())) {

            throw new ResourceNotFoundException(
                    "Sessione asta non trovata"
            );
        }

        return authentication.getName().trim();
    }

    public void requireAccess(
            Long sessionId,
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        String username = authenticatedUsername(authentication);

        String owner = jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT owner_username
                FROM auction_sessions
                WHERE id = :id
                """)
                .param("id", sessionId)
                .query(String.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Sessione asta non trovata"
                        )
                );

        if (isAdmin(authentication)) {
            return;
        }

        if (!owner.equalsIgnoreCase(username)) {
            /*
             * Intenzionalmente 404 e non 403:
             * un utente non proprietario non deve poter verificare
             * l'esistenza di sessioni appartenenti ad altri utenti.
             */
            throw new ResourceNotFoundException(
                    "Sessione asta non trovata"
            );
        }
    }

    private boolean isAdmin(Authentication authentication) {

        return authentication.getAuthorities()
                .stream()
                .anyMatch(authority ->
                        "ROLE_ADMIN".equals(
                                authority.getAuthority()
                        )
                );
    }
}

import jakarta.validation.Valid;

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.CreateSessionRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.NominationRequest;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction.LiveAuctionDecisionResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squad.SquadService;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/auction/sessions")
public class AuctionStateController {

    private final AuctionStateService state;
    private final AuctionPurchaseService purchases;
    private final AuctionContextAdapter adapter;
    private final AuctionSessionAccessService access;
    private final SquadService squads;

    public AuctionStateController(
            AuctionStateService state,
            AuctionPurchaseService purchases,
            AuctionContextAdapter adapter,
            AuctionSessionAccessService access,
            SquadService squads
    ) {
        this.state = state;
        this.purchases = purchases;
        this.adapter = adapter;
        this.access = access;
        this.squads = squads;
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<SessionResponse> create(
            @Valid @RequestBody CreateSessionRequest request,
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        String owner =
                access.authenticatedUsername(authentication);

        squads.assertAccess(
                request.squadId(),
                owner,
                authentication.getAuthorities().stream()
                        .anyMatch(authority -> "ROLE_ADMIN".equals(authority.getAuthority()))
        );

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                state.create(
                        request,
                        owner
                )
        );
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/activate")
    public ResponseEntity<SessionResponse> activate(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        access.requireAccess(
                id,
                authentication
        );

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                state.activate(id)
        );
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/complete")
    public ResponseEntity<SessionResponse> complete(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        access.requireAccess(
                id,
                authentication
        );

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                state.complete(id)
        );
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/nomination")
    public ResponseEntity<SessionResponse> nominate(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @Valid @RequestBody NominationRequest request,
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        access.requireAccess(
                id,
                authentication
        );

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                state.nominate(
                        id,
                        request
                )
        );
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/purchases")
    public ResponseEntity<PurchaseResponse> purchase(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @Valid @RequestBody PurchaseRequest request,
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        access.requireAccess(
                id,
                authentication
        );

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                purchases.purchase(
                        id,
                        request
                )
        );
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/decision")
    public ResponseEntity<LiveAuctionDecisionResponse> decide(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @Valid @RequestBody SessionDecisionRequest request,
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        access.requireAccess(
                id,
                authentication
        );

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                adapter.decide(
                        id,
                        request
                )
        );
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<SessionResponse> find(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        access.requireAccess(
                id,
                authentication
        );

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                state.find(id)
        );
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}/state")
    public ResponseEntity<StateResponse> state(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        access.requireAccess(
                id,
                authentication
        );

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                state.state(id)
        );
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate;

import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.List;

import jakarta.validation.constraints.Max;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Min;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Positive;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;

public final class AuctionStateDtos {

    private AuctionStateDtos() {
    }

    public record CreateSessionRequest(
            @NotNull
            @Positive
            Long squadId
    ) {
    }

    public record NominationRequest(
            @NotNull
            @Positive
            Long playerId,

            @NotNull
            @Min(1)
            Integer currentPrice
    ) {
    }

    public record PurchaseRequest(
            @NotNull
            @Positive
            Long playerId,

            @NotNull
            AuctionBuyerType buyerType,

            Integer paidPrice,

            @NotBlank
            @Size(max = 120)
            String idempotencyKey
    ) {
    }

    public record SessionDecisionRequest(
            @NotNull
            @Min(1)
            Integer proposedBid,

            @Min(1)
            @Max(38)
            Integer currentMatchday,

            @Min(1)
            @Max(10)
            Integer horizon,

            @Min(1)
            @Max(20)
            Integer alternativeLimit
    ) {
    }

    public record SessionResponse(
            Long id,
            Long squadId,
            String season,
            int leagueTeams,
            int totalBudget,
            boolean defenseModifier,
            AuctionSessionStatus status,
            boolean playerStateInitialized,
            Long currentPlayerId,
            Integer currentPrice,
            long version,
            OffsetDateTime createdAt,
            OffsetDateTime updatedAt
    ) {
    }

    public record PurchaseResponse(
            Long id,
            Long sessionId,
            Long playerId,
            AuctionBuyerType buyerType,
            Integer paidPrice,
            String idempotencyKey,
            OffsetDateTime createdAt
    ) {
    }

    public record PlayerStateResponse(
            Long playerId,
            String playerName,
            String role,
            AuctionPlayerAvailability availability
    ) {
    }

    public record StateResponse(
            SessionResponse session,
            int spentBudget,
            int remainingBudget,
            List<PurchaseResponse> purchases,
            List<PlayerStateResponse> players,
            boolean availabilityComplete
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate;

import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.CreateSessionRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.NominationRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.PlayerStateResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.PurchaseResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.SessionResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.StateResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

@Service
public class AuctionStateService {
    private final JdbcClient jdbc;
    public AuctionStateService(JdbcClient jdbc) { this.jdbc = jdbc; }

    @Transactional
    public SessionResponse create(CreateSessionRequest request) {
        return create(request, "legacy");
    }

    @Transactional
    public SessionResponse create(
            CreateSessionRequest request,
            String ownerUsername
    ) {

        if (ownerUsername == null
                || ownerUsername.isBlank()
                || ownerUsername.length() > 120) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Owner sessione asta non valido"
            );
        }

        if (request == null || request.squadId() == null || request.squadId() <= 0)
            throw new BadRequestException("squadId non valido");
        Map<String,Object> source = jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT squad.id squad_id, season.id season_id, season.code,
                       league.teams_count, squad.initial_budget total_budget,
                       league.defense_modifier
                FROM fantasy_squads squad
                JOIN league_configurations league ON league.id=squad.league_configuration_id
                JOIN seasons season ON season.id=league.season_id
                WHERE squad.id=:squadId
                """).param("squadId", request.squadId()).query().listOfRows().stream().findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Rosa non trovata"));
        Long id = jdbc.sql("""
                INSERT INTO auction_sessions(
                    squad_id,
                    season_id,
                    league_teams,
                    total_budget,
                    defense_modifier,
                    owner_username
                )
                VALUES(
                    :squad,
                    :season,
                    :teams,
                    :budget,
                    :modifier,
                    :owner
                )
                RETURNING id
                """).param("squad", number(source,"squad_id").longValue())
                .param("season", number(source,"season_id").longValue())
                .param("teams", number(source,"teams_count").intValue())
                .param("budget", number(source,"total_budget").intValue())
                .param("modifier", source.get("defense_modifier"))
                .param("owner", ownerUsername.trim())
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
        event(id,"SESSION_CREATED",null,null,"{}");
        return find(id);
    }

    @Transactional
    public SessionResponse activate(Long id) {
        Map<String,Object> session = lock(id);
        requireStatus(session, AuctionSessionStatus.DRAFT);
        int initialized = jdbc.sql("""
                INSERT INTO auction_player_states(session_id,player_id,fantasy_role)
                SELECT :session, player.id, role.fantasy_role
                FROM auction_sessions auction
                JOIN players player ON player.active=TRUE
                JOIN player_registrations registration ON registration.player_id=player.id
                     AND registration.season_id=auction.season_id
                     AND registration.registration_status='ACTIVE'
                JOIN season_clubs season_club ON season_club.season_id=auction.season_id
                     AND season_club.club_id=registration.club_id
                JOIN player_roles role ON role.player_id=player.id
                     AND role.season_id=auction.season_id AND role.source='FANTACALCIO'
                     AND role.fantasy_role IN ('P','D','C','A')
                WHERE auction.id=:session
                ON CONFLICT(session_id,player_id) DO NOTHING
                """).param("session",id).update();
        if (initialized == 0) throw new ConflictException("Nessun player eleggibile per la sessione");
        jdbc.sql("""
                UPDATE auction_player_states state SET availability='ACQUIRED_BY_USER',
                    version=state.version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                FROM auction_sessions auction
                JOIN fantasy_squad_players roster ON roster.squad_id=auction.squad_id
                WHERE state.session_id=:session AND auction.id=:session
                  AND state.player_id=roster.player_id
                """).param("session",id).update();
        try {
            jdbc.sql("""
                    UPDATE auction_sessions SET status='ACTIVE',player_state_initialized=TRUE,
                        version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=:id
                    """).param("id",id).update();
        } catch (DataIntegrityViolationException ex) {
            throw new ConflictException("Esiste gia' una sessione ACTIVE");
        }
        event(id,"SESSION_ACTIVATED",null,null,"{\"initializedPlayers\":"+initialized+"}");
        return find(id);
    }

    @Transactional
    public SessionResponse nominate(Long id, NominationRequest request) {
        if (request == null || request.playerId() == null || request.playerId() <= 0
                || request.currentPrice() == null || request.currentPrice() < 1)
            throw new BadRequestException("Nomination non valida");
        Map<String,Object> session=lock(id); requireStatus(session,AuctionSessionStatus.ACTIVE);
        String availability=jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT availability FROM auction_player_states
                WHERE session_id=:session AND player_id=:player FOR UPDATE
                """).param("session",id).param("player",request.playerId()).query(String.class).optional()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Player non presente nella sessione"));
        if (!"AVAILABLE".equals(availability)) throw new ConflictException("Player non disponibile");
        jdbc.sql("""
                UPDATE auction_sessions SET current_player_id=:player,current_price=:price,
                    version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=:id
                """).param("player",request.playerId()).param("price",request.currentPrice())
                .param("id",id).update();
        event(id,"NOMINATION_SET",request.playerId(),null,
                "{\"currentPrice\":"+request.currentPrice()+"}");
        return find(id);
    }

    @Transactional
    public SessionResponse complete(Long id) {
        Map<String,Object> session=lock(id); requireStatus(session,AuctionSessionStatus.ACTIVE);
        jdbc.sql("""
                UPDATE auction_sessions SET status='COMPLETED',current_player_id=NULL,current_price=NULL,
                    version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=:id
                """).param("id",id).update();
        event(id,"SESSION_COMPLETED",null,null,"{}"); return find(id);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly=true)
    public SessionResponse find(Long id) {
        return jdbc.sql(sessionSql()+" WHERE auction.id=:id").param("id",id)
                .query((rs,n)->session(rs)).optional()
                .orElseThrow(()->new ResourceNotFoundException("Sessione asta non trovata"));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly=true)
    public StateResponse state(Long id) {
        SessionResponse session=find(id);
        List<PurchaseResponse> purchases=jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT id,session_id,player_id,buyer_type,paid_price,idempotency_key,created_at
                FROM auction_purchases WHERE session_id=:id ORDER BY id
                """).param("id",id).query((rs,n)->new PurchaseResponse(rs.getLong("id"),
                        rs.getLong("session_id"),rs.getLong("player_id"),
                        AuctionBuyerType.valueOf(rs.getString("buyer_type")),
                        (Integer)rs.getObject("paid_price"),rs.getString("idempotency_key"),
                        rs.getObject("created_at",OffsetDateTime.class))).list();
        List<PlayerStateResponse> players=jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT state.player_id,player.display_name,state.fantasy_role,state.availability
                FROM auction_player_states state JOIN players player ON player.id=state.player_id
                WHERE state.session_id=:id ORDER BY state.player_id
                """).param("id",id).query((rs,n)->new PlayerStateResponse(rs.getLong("player_id"),
                        rs.getString("display_name"),rs.getString("fantasy_role"),
                        AuctionPlayerAvailability.valueOf(rs.getString("availability")))).list();
        int spent=jdbc.sql("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(purchase_price),0) FROM fantasy_squad_players WHERE squad_id=:id")
                .param("id",session.squadId()).query(Integer.class).single();
        boolean complete=session.playerStateInitialized() && players.size()==eligibleCount(session.id());
        return new StateResponse(session,spent,session.totalBudget()-spent,purchases,players,complete);
    }

    Map<String,Object> lock(Long id) {
        return jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT id,squad_id,season_id,league_teams,total_budget,defense_modifier,
                       status,player_state_initialized,current_player_id,current_price,
                       version,created_at,updated_at
                FROM auction_sessions WHERE id=:id FOR UPDATE
                """).param("id",id)
                .query().listOfRows().stream().findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(()->new ResourceNotFoundException("Sessione asta non trovata"));
    }
    void requireStatus(Map<String,Object> row,AuctionSessionStatus status){
        if(!status.name().equals(row.get("status")))throw new ConflictException("Stato sessione non compatibile");
    }
    void event(Long session,String type,Long player,String key,String details){
        jdbc.sql("""
                INSERT INTO auction_events(session_id,event_type,player_id,idempotency_key,details)
                VALUES(:session,:type,:player,:key,CAST(:details AS jsonb))
                """).param("session",session).param("type",type).param("player",player)
                .param("key",key).param("details",details).update();
    }
    private int eligibleCount(Long id){return jdbc.sql("""
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player.id) FROM auction_sessions auction
            JOIN players player ON player.active=TRUE
            JOIN player_registrations registration ON registration.player_id=player.id
                 AND registration.season_id=auction.season_id AND registration.registration_status='ACTIVE'
            JOIN season_clubs season_club ON season_club.season_id=auction.season_id
                 AND season_club.club_id=registration.club_id
            JOIN player_roles role ON role.player_id=player.id AND role.season_id=auction.season_id
                 AND role.source='FANTACALCIO' AND role.fantasy_role IN ('P','D','C','A')
            WHERE auction.id=:id
            """).param("id",id).query(Integer.class).single();}
    private String sessionSql(){return """
            SELECT auction.*,season.code FROM auction_sessions auction
            JOIN seasons season ON season.id=auction.season_id
            """;}
    private SessionResponse session(java.sql.ResultSet rs)throws java.sql.SQLException{return new SessionResponse(
            rs.getLong("id"),rs.getLong("squad_id"),rs.getString("code"),rs.getInt("league_teams"),
            rs.getInt("total_budget"),rs.getBoolean("defense_modifier"),
            AuctionSessionStatus.valueOf(rs.getString("status")),rs.getBoolean("player_state_initialized"),
            (Long)rs.getObject("current_player_id"),(Integer)rs.getObject("current_price"),rs.getLong("version"),
            rs.getObject("created_at",OffsetDateTime.class),rs.getObject("updated_at",OffsetDateTime.class));}
    private Number number(Map<String,Object> row,String key){return (Number)row.get(key);}
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\auctionstrategy\IntelligentAuctionStrategyService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstrategy;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionranking.AuctionRankingItemResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionranking.AuctionRankingResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionranking.IntelligentAuctionRankingService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;

@Service
public class IntelligentAuctionStrategyService {

    private static final Map<String, Integer> REQUIRED_SLOTS =
            Map.of(
                    "P", 3,
                    "D", 8,
                    "C", 8,
                    "A", 6
            );

    private final IntelligentAuctionRankingService rankingService;

    public IntelligentAuctionStrategyService(
            IntelligentAuctionRankingService rankingService
    ) {
        this.rankingService = rankingService;
    }

    @Transactional
    public AuctionStrategyResponse buildStrategy(
            String season,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        validateRequest(season, budget, teams);

        String normalizedSeason = season.trim();

        Map<String, BigDecimal> allocations =
                roleAllocations(defenseModifier);

        List<AuctionRoleStrategyResponse> roleStrategies =
                new ArrayList<>();

        List<String> globalWarnings =
                new ArrayList<>();

        int totalPlannedSpending = 0;

        for (String role : List.of("P", "D", "C", "A")) {
            AuctionRoleStrategyResponse roleStrategy =
                    buildRoleStrategy(
                            normalizedSeason,
                            budget,
                            teams,
                            defenseModifier,
                            role,
                            allocations.get(role)
                    );

            roleStrategies.add(roleStrategy);

            totalPlannedSpending +=
                    roleStrategy.plannedSpending();

            if (roleStrategy.primaryTargets().isEmpty()) {
                globalWarnings.add(
                        "Nessun obiettivo principale disponibile "
                                + "per il ruolo "
                                + role
                );
            }
        }

        int remainingBudget =
                budget - totalPlannedSpending;

        boolean withinBudget =
                remainingBudget >= 0;

        if (!withinBudget) {
            globalWarnings.add(
                    "Il piano supera il budget disponibile di "
                            + Math.abs(remainingBudget)
                            + " crediti"
            );
        }

        if (remainingBudget > budget * 0.20) {
            globalWarnings.add(
                    "Il piano conserva una quota elevata di budget: "
                            + "valutare un investimento maggiore "
                            + "sugli obiettivi principali"
            );
        }

        String summary =
                buildSummary(
                        budget,
                        totalPlannedSpending,
                        remainingBudget,
                        defenseModifier,
                        withinBudget
                );

        return new AuctionStrategyResponse(
                normalizedSeason,
                budget,
                teams,
                defenseModifier,
                25,
                totalPlannedSpending,
                remainingBudget,
                withinBudget,
                summary,
                List.copyOf(roleStrategies),
                List.copyOf(globalWarnings)
        );
    }

    private AuctionRoleStrategyResponse buildRoleStrategy(
            String season,
            int totalBudget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier,
            String role,
            BigDecimal allocation
    ) {
        int requiredSlots =
                REQUIRED_SLOTS.get(role);

        int allocatedBudget =
                allocation
                        .multiply(
                                BigDecimal.valueOf(totalBudget)
                        )
                        .setScale(
                                0,
                                RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                        )
                        .intValue();

        AuctionRankingResponse ranking =
                rankingService.findRanking(
                        season,
                        totalBudget,
                        teams,
                        defenseModifier,
                        role,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        true,
                        100
                );

        List<AuctionRankingItemResponse> players =
                ranking.players();

        List<AuctionStrategyPlayerResponse> primaryTargets =
                players.stream()
                        .filter(this::isPrimaryTarget)
                        .limit(primaryTargetCount(role))
                        .map(player ->
                                toStrategyPlayer(
                                        player,
                                        "OBIETTIVO PRINCIPALE"
                                )
                        )
                        .toList();

        List<AuctionStrategyPlayerResponse> alternatives =
                players.stream()
                        .filter(player ->
                                isValueAlternative(
                                        player,
                                        allocatedBudget,
                                        requiredSlots
                                )
                        )
                        .filter(player ->
                                !containsPlayer(
                                        primaryTargets,
                                        player.playerId()
                                )
                        )
                        .limit(alternativeCount(role))
                        .map(player ->
                                toStrategyPlayer(
                                        player,
                                        "ALTERNATIVA ECONOMICA"
                                )
                        )
                        .toList();

        List<AuctionStrategyPlayerResponse> bets =
                players.stream()
                        .filter(this::isHighPotentialBet)
                        .filter(player ->
                                !containsPlayer(
                                        primaryTargets,
                                        player.playerId()
                                )
                        )
                        .filter(player ->
                                !containsPlayer(
                                        alternatives,
                                        player.playerId()
                                )
                        )
                        .limit(2)
                        .map(player ->
                                toStrategyPlayer(
                                        player,
                                        "SCOMMESSA"
                                )
                        )
                        .toList();

        List<AuctionStrategyPlayerResponse> avoid =
                players.stream()
                        .filter(this::shouldAvoid)
                        .limit(3)
                        .map(player ->
                                toStrategyPlayer(
                                        player,
                                        "DA EVITARE"
                                )
                        )
                        .toList();

        int plannedSpending =
                calculatePlannedSpending(
                        allocatedBudget,
                        requiredSlots,
                        primaryTargets,
                        alternatives,
                        bets
                );

        int remainingRoleBudget =
                allocatedBudget - plannedSpending;

        List<String> warnings =
                buildRoleWarnings(
                        role,
                        requiredSlots,
                        allocatedBudget,
                        plannedSpending,
                        players,
                        primaryTargets
                );

        return new AuctionRoleStrategyResponse(
                role,
                requiredSlots,
                allocation
                        .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100))
                        .setScale(1, RoundingMode.HALF_UP),
                allocatedBudget,
                plannedSpending,
                remainingRoleBudget,
                primaryTargets,
                alternatives,
                bets,
                avoid,
                warnings
        );
    }

    private int calculatePlannedSpending(
            int allocatedBudget,
            int requiredSlots,
            List<AuctionStrategyPlayerResponse> primaryTargets,
            List<AuctionStrategyPlayerResponse> alternatives,
            List<AuctionStrategyPlayerResponse> bets
    ) {
        List<AuctionStrategyPlayerResponse> selected =
                new ArrayList<>();

        selected.addAll(primaryTargets);
        selected.addAll(alternatives);
        selected.addAll(bets);

        int spending =
                selected.stream()
                        .limit(requiredSlots)
                        .mapToInt(
                                AuctionStrategyPlayerResponse
                                        ::recommendedPrice
                        )
                        .sum();

        int selectedSlots =
                Math.min(
                        selected.size(),
                        requiredSlots
                );

        int minimumReserve =
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        requiredSlots - selectedSlots
                );

        spending += minimumReserve;

        return Math.min(
                spending,
                allocatedBudget
        );
    }

    private boolean isPrimaryTarget(
            AuctionRankingItemResponse player
    ) {
        return (
                "OBIETTIVO PRIORITARIO".equals(
                        player.finalRecommendation()
                )
                || "ACQUISTO CONSIGLIATO".equals(
                        player.finalRecommendation()
                )
        )
                && decimal(player.riskScore()) <= 60
                && decimal(player.starterProbability()) >= 60;
    }

    private boolean isValueAlternative(
            AuctionRankingItemResponse player,
            int allocatedBudget,
            int requiredSlots
    ) {
        double averageSlotBudget =
                allocatedBudget / (double) requiredSlots;

        return player.recommendedPrice()
                <= Math.max(
                        1,
                        Math.round(averageSlotBudget)
                )
                && decimal(player.riskScore()) < 70
                && !"ATTENDERE AGGIORNAMENTI".equals(
                        player.finalRecommendation()
                );
    }

    private boolean isHighPotentialBet(
            AuctionRankingItemResponse player
    ) {
        return decimal(player.potentialScore()) >= 70
                && player.recommendedPrice()
                        <= player.maximumPrice()
                && decimal(player.riskScore()) < 80
                && !"ATTENDERE AGGIORNAMENTI".equals(
                        player.finalRecommendation()
                );
    }

    private boolean shouldAvoid(
            AuctionRankingItemResponse player
    ) {
        return decimal(player.riskScore()) >= 70
                || "EVITARE O PRENDERE A BASSO COSTO".equals(
                        player.finalRecommendation()
                )
                || "ATTENDERE AGGIORNAMENTI".equals(
                        player.finalRecommendation()
                );
    }

    private AuctionStrategyPlayerResponse toStrategyPlayer(
            AuctionRankingItemResponse player,
            String category
    ) {
        return new AuctionStrategyPlayerResponse(
                player.playerId(),
                player.playerName(),
                player.club(),
                player.fantasyRole(),
                category,
                player.intelligenceScore(),
                player.potentialScore(),
                player.riskScore(),
                player.starterProbability(),
                player.minimumPrice(),
                player.recommendedPrice(),
                player.maximumPrice(),
                player.finalRecommendation(),
                player.strengths(),
                player.risks()
        );
    }

    private List<String> buildRoleWarnings(
            String role,
            int requiredSlots,
            int allocatedBudget,
            int plannedSpending,
            List<AuctionRankingItemResponse> availablePlayers,
            List<AuctionStrategyPlayerResponse> primaryTargets
    ) {
        List<String> warnings =
                new ArrayList<>();

        if (availablePlayers.size() < requiredSlots) {
            warnings.add(
                    "Disponibili soltanto "
                            + availablePlayers.size()
                            + " giocatori per "
                            + requiredSlots
                            + " slot richiesti"
            );
        }

        if (primaryTargets.isEmpty()) {
            warnings.add(
                    "Nessun profilo di prioritÃ  alta individuato"
            );
        }

        if (plannedSpending > allocatedBudget) {
            warnings.add(
                    "La spesa prevista supera il budget del ruolo"
            );
        }

        if ("D".equals(role)
                && allocatedBudget > 0
                && requiredSlots == 8) {
            warnings.add(
                    "Mantenere almeno due difensori affidabili "
                            + "per proteggere il modificatore"
            );
        }

        return List.copyOf(warnings);
    }

    private boolean containsPlayer(
            List<AuctionStrategyPlayerResponse> players,
            Long playerId
    ) {
        return players.stream()
                .anyMatch(player ->
                        player.playerId().equals(playerId)
                );
    }

    private int primaryTargetCount(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 1;
            case "D" -> 3;
            case "C" -> 3;
            case "A" -> 3;
            default -> 1;
        };
    }

    private int alternativeCount(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 2;
            case "D" -> 4;
            case "C" -> 4;
            case "A" -> 3;
            default -> 2;
        };
    }

    private Map<String, BigDecimal> roleAllocations(
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        Map<String, BigDecimal> allocations =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        allocations.put("P", BigDecimal.valueOf(0.08));

        allocations.put(
                "D",
                BigDecimal.valueOf(
                        defenseModifier
                                ? 0.22
                                : 0.17
                )
        );

        allocations.put(
                "C",
                BigDecimal.valueOf(
                        defenseModifier
                                ? 0.27
                                : 0.30
                )
        );

        allocations.put(
                "A",
                BigDecimal.valueOf(
                        defenseModifier
                                ? 0.43
                                : 0.45
                )
        );

        return allocations;
    }

    private String buildSummary(
            int budget,
            int plannedSpending,
            int remainingBudget,
            boolean defenseModifier,
            boolean withinBudget
    ) {
        String modifierText =
                defenseModifier
                        ? "con modificatore difesa"
                        : "senza modificatore difesa";

        String status =
                withinBudget
                        ? "Il piano rispetta il budget."
                        : "Il piano supera il budget.";

        return "Strategia per lega "
                + modifierText
                + ": spesa prevista "
                + plannedSpending
                + " crediti su "
                + budget
                + ", residuo previsto "
                + remainingBudget
                + ". "
                + status;
    }

    private double decimal(BigDecimal value) {
        return value == null
                ? 0
                : value.doubleValue();
    }

    private void validateRequest(
            String season,
            int budget,
            int teams
    ) {
        if (season == null || season.isBlank()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "La stagione Ã¨ obbligatoria"
            );
        }

        if (budget < 150 || budget > 1000) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Il budget deve essere compreso tra 150 e 1000"
            );
        }

        if (teams < 6 || teams > 12) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Le squadre devono essere comprese tra 6 e 12"
            );
        }
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.availability;

import java.util.List;

import jakarta.validation.Valid;

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PutMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/availabilities")
public class PlayerAvailabilityController {

    private final PlayerAvailabilityService service;

    public PlayerAvailabilityController(
            PlayerAvailabilityService service
    ) {
        this.service = service;
    }

    @GetMapping
    public List<PlayerAvailabilityResponse> findByMatchday(

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "#{@currentSeasonResolver.resolve()}")
            String season,

            @RequestParam
            int matchday,

            @RequestParam(required = false)
            String status
    ) {
        return service.findByMatchday(
                season,
                matchday,
                status
        );
    }

    @GetMapping("/players/{playerId}/history")
    public List<PlayerAvailabilityHistoryResponse> findHistory(

            @PathVariable
            Long playerId,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "#{@currentSeasonResolver.resolve()}")
            String season,

            @RequestParam(required = false)
            Integer matchday
    ) {
        return service.findHistory(
                playerId,
                season,
                matchday
        );
    }

    @PutMapping("/players/{playerId}")
    public PlayerAvailabilityResponse update(

            @PathVariable
            Long playerId,

            @Valid
            @RequestBody
            UpdatePlayerAvailabilityRequest request
    ) {
        return service.update(
                playerId,
                request
        );
    }
}
