package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.availability;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

@Service
public class PlayerAvailabilityService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public PlayerAvailabilityService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<PlayerAvailabilityResponse> findByMatchday(
            String season,
            int matchday,
            String status
    ) {
        validateSeason(season);
        validateMatchday(matchday);

        PlayerAvailabilityStatus parsedStatus =
                status == null || status.isBlank()
                        ? null
                        : PlayerAvailabilityStatus.fromValue(status);

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder("""
                SELECT
                    player.id AS player_id,
                    player.display_name,
                    club.name AS club_name,
                    season.code AS season_code,
                    availability.matchday,
                    availability.status,
                    availability.starting_probability,
                    availability.availability_probability,
                    availability.injury_description,
                    availability.expected_return_date,
                    availability.source,
                    availability.updated_at
                FROM player_availabilities availability
                JOIN players player
                    ON player.id = availability.player_id
                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = availability.season_id
                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = player.id
                    AND registration.season_id = season.id
                JOIN clubs club
                    ON club.id = registration.club_id
                WHERE season.code = :season
                  AND availability.matchday = :matchday
                """);

        if (parsedStatus != null) {
            sql.append("""
                    AND availability.status = :status
                    """);
        }

        sql.append("""
                ORDER BY
                    availability.starting_probability DESC NULLS LAST,
                    player.display_name
                """);

        var query = jdbcClient
                .sql(sql.toString())
                .param("season", season.trim())
                .param("matchday", matchday);

        if (parsedStatus != null) {
            query = query.param(
                    "status",
                    parsedStatus.name()
            );
        }

        return query
                .query((rs, rowNumber) ->
                        new PlayerAvailabilityResponse(
                                rs.getLong("player_id"),
                                rs.getString("display_name"),
                                rs.getString("club_name"),
                                rs.getString("season_code"),
                                rs.getInt("matchday"),
                                rs.getString("status"),
                                rs.getBigDecimal(
                                        "starting_probability"
                                ),
                                rs.getBigDecimal(
                                        "availability_probability"
                                ),
                                rs.getString(
                                        "injury_description"
                                ),
                                rs.getObject(
                                        "expected_return_date",
                                        LocalDate.class
                                ),
                                rs.getString("source"),
                                toInstant(
                                        rs.getObject(
                                                "updated_at",
                                                OffsetDateTime.class
                                        )
                                )
                        )
                )
                .list();
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<PlayerAvailabilityHistoryResponse> findHistory(
            Long playerId,
            String season,
            Integer matchday
    ) {
        validateSeason(season);

        if (matchday != null) {
            validateMatchday(matchday);
        }

        ensurePlayerExists(playerId);

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder("""
                SELECT
                    history.id,
                    history.availability_id,
                    history.player_id,
                    player.display_name,
                    season.code AS season_code,
                    history.matchday,
                    history.status,
                    history.starting_probability,
                    history.availability_probability,
                    history.injury_description,
                    history.expected_return_date,
                    history.source,
                    history.changed_at
                FROM player_availability_history history
                JOIN players player
                    ON player.id = history.player_id
                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = history.season_id
                WHERE history.player_id = :playerId
                  AND season.code = :season
                """);

        if (matchday != null) {
            sql.append("""
                    AND history.matchday = :matchday
                    """);
        }

        sql.append("""
                ORDER BY history.changed_at DESC, history.id DESC
                """);

        var query = jdbcClient
                .sql(sql.toString())
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("season", season.trim());

        if (matchday != null) {
            query = query.param("matchday", matchday);
        }

        return query
                .query((rs, rowNumber) ->
                        new PlayerAvailabilityHistoryResponse(
                                rs.getLong("id"),
                                rs.getLong("availability_id"),
                                rs.getLong("player_id"),
                                rs.getString("display_name"),
                                rs.getString("season_code"),
                                rs.getInt("matchday"),
                                rs.getString("status"),
                                rs.getBigDecimal(
                                        "starting_probability"
                                ),
                                rs.getBigDecimal(
                                        "availability_probability"
                                ),
                                rs.getString(
                                        "injury_description"
                                ),
                                rs.getObject(
                                        "expected_return_date",
                                        LocalDate.class
                                ),
                                rs.getString("source"),
                                toInstant(
                                        rs.getObject(
                                                "changed_at",
                                                OffsetDateTime.class
                                        )
                                )
                        )
                )
                .list();
    }

    @Transactional
    public PlayerAvailabilityResponse update(
            Long playerId,
            UpdatePlayerAvailabilityRequest request
    ) {
        validateSeason(request.season());
        validateMatchday(request.matchday());
        ensurePlayerExists(playerId);

        PlayerAvailabilityStatus status =
                PlayerAvailabilityStatus.fromValue(
                        request.status()
                );

        validateStatusData(status, request);

        Long seasonId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM seasons
                WHERE code = :season
                """)
                .param("season", request.season().trim())
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Stagione non trovata"
                        )
                );

        String source = normalizeSource(
                request.source()
        );

        BigDecimal startingProbability =
                normalizeProbability(
                        request.startingProbability(),
                        status,
                        true
                );

        BigDecimal availabilityProbability =
                normalizeProbability(
                        request.availabilityProbability(),
                        status,
                        false
                );

        String injuryDescription =
                normalizeNullableText(
                        request.injuryDescription()
                );

        Long availabilityId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_availabilities (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    matchday,
                    status,
                    starting_probability,
                    availability_probability,
                    injury_description,
                    expected_return_date,
                    source
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :matchday,
                    :status,
                    :startingProbability,
                    :availabilityProbability,
                    :injuryDescription,
                    :expectedReturnDate,
                    :source
                )
                ON CONFLICT (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    matchday
                )
                DO UPDATE SET
                    status = EXCLUDED.status,
                    starting_probability =
                        EXCLUDED.starting_probability,
                    availability_probability =
                        EXCLUDED.availability_probability,
                    injury_description =
                        EXCLUDED.injury_description,
                    expected_return_date =
                        EXCLUDED.expected_return_date,
                    source = EXCLUDED.source,
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("matchday", request.matchday())
                .param("status", status.name())
                .param(
                        "startingProbability",
                        startingProbability
                )
                .param(
                        "availabilityProbability",
                        availabilityProbability
                )
                .param(
                        "injuryDescription",
                        injuryDescription
                )
                .param(
                        "expectedReturnDate",
                        request.expectedReturnDate()
                )
                .param("source", source)
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_availability_history (
                    availability_id,
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    matchday,
                    status,
                    starting_probability,
                    availability_probability,
                    injury_description,
                    expected_return_date,
                    source
                )
                VALUES (
                    :availabilityId,
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :matchday,
                    :status,
                    :startingProbability,
                    :availabilityProbability,
                    :injuryDescription,
                    :expectedReturnDate,
                    :source
                )
                """)
                .param("availabilityId", availabilityId)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("matchday", request.matchday())
                .param("status", status.name())
                .param(
                        "startingProbability",
                        startingProbability
                )
                .param(
                        "availabilityProbability",
                        availabilityProbability
                )
                .param(
                        "injuryDescription",
                        injuryDescription
                )
                .param(
                        "expectedReturnDate",
                        request.expectedReturnDate()
                )
                .param("source", source)
                .update();

        return findByMatchday(
                request.season(),
                request.matchday(),
                null
        )
                .stream()
                .filter(item ->
                        item.playerId().equals(playerId)
                )
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "DisponibilitÃ  non trovata"
                        )
                );
    }

    private Instant toInstant(OffsetDateTime value) {
        return value == null
                ? null
                : value.toInstant();
    }

    private void ensurePlayerExists(Long playerId) {
        if (playerId == null || playerId <= 0) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "L'identificativo del giocatore non Ã¨ valido"
            );
        }

        boolean playerExists = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM players
                WHERE id = :playerId
                  AND active = TRUE
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single() > 0;

        if (!playerExists) {
            throw new ResourceNotFoundException(
                    "Giocatore non trovato"
            );
        }
    }

    private void validateStatusData(
            PlayerAvailabilityStatus status,
            UpdatePlayerAvailabilityRequest request
    ) {
        if (status == PlayerAvailabilityStatus.INJURED
                && normalizeNullableText(
                        request.injuryDescription()
                ) == null) {

            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "La descrizione dell'infortunio Ã¨ obbligatoria "
                            + "per un giocatore infortunato"
            );
        }

        if (status.preventsSelection()) {
            if (isPositive(request.startingProbability())
                    || isPositive(
                            request.availabilityProbability()
                    )) {

                throw new BadRequestException(
                        "Un giocatore indisponibile non puÃ² avere "
                                + "probabilitÃ  superiori a zero"
                );
            }
        }

        if (status == PlayerAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE
                && request.availabilityProbability() != null
                && request.availabilityProbability() < 50) {

            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Un giocatore disponibile deve avere una "
                            + "probabilitÃ  di disponibilitÃ  almeno pari a 50"
            );
        }

        if (request.expectedReturnDate() != null
                && status != PlayerAvailabilityStatus.INJURED
                && status != PlayerAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE) {

            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "La data prevista di rientro Ã¨ consentita solo "
                            + "per giocatori infortunati o indisponibili"
            );
        }
    }

    private BigDecimal normalizeProbability(
            Integer value,
            PlayerAvailabilityStatus status,
            boolean starting
    ) {
        if (status.preventsSelection()) {
            return BigDecimal.ZERO;
        }

        if (value != null) {
            return BigDecimal.valueOf(value);
        }

        if (!starting
                && status == PlayerAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE) {
            return BigDecimal.valueOf(100);
        }

        return null;
    }

    private String normalizeSource(String source) {
        if (source == null || source.isBlank()) {
            return "MANUAL";
        }

        return source.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    private String normalizeNullableText(String value) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }

        return value.trim();
    }

    private boolean isPositive(Integer value) {
        return value != null && value > 0;
    }

    private void validateSeason(String season) {
        if (season == null || season.isBlank()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "La stagione Ã¨ obbligatoria"
            );
        }
    }

    private void validateMatchday(int matchday) {
        if (matchday < 1 || matchday > 38) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "La giornata deve essere compresa tra 1 e 38"
            );
        }
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\availability\PlayerAvailabilityStatus.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.availability;

import java.util.Locale;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;

public enum PlayerAvailabilityStatus {

    AVAILABLE,
    PROBABLE,
    DOUBTFUL,
    INJURED,
    SUSPENDED,
    UNAVAILABLE;

    public static PlayerAvailabilityStatus fromValue(
            String value
    ) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Lo stato di disponibilitÃ  Ã¨ obbligatorio"
            );
        }

        try {
            return PlayerAvailabilityStatus.valueOf(
                    value.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)
            );
        }
        catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Stato di disponibilitÃ  non valido: "
                            + value
            );
        }
    }

    public boolean preventsSelection() {
        return this == INJURED
                || this == SUSPENDED
                || this == UNAVAILABLE;
    }
}

import java.time.LocalDate;

import jakarta.validation.constraints.Max;

        @NotBlank
        String season,

        @Min(1)
        @Max(38)

        @NotBlank
        String status,

        @Min(0)
        @Max(100)
        Integer startingProbability,

        @Min(0)
        @Max(100)
        Integer availabilityProbability,

        @Size(max = 255)
        String injuryDescription,

        LocalDate expectedReturnDate,

        @Pattern(
                regexp =
                    "(?i)MANUAL|FANTACALCIO|GAZZETTA|FANTAMARKT|AVERAGE"
        )
        String source
) {
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.Map;

public record B69RoleFixtureDay(
        Long clubId,
        String clubName,
        Long opponentClubId,
        String opponentClubName,
        int matchday,
        Long fixtureId,
        boolean home,
        String fixtureStatus,
        OffsetDateTime kickoffAt,
        Map<String, B69RoleMatchupScorer.MatchupResult> roleMatchups
) {

    public B69RoleFixtureDay {

        roleMatchups =
                roleMatchups == null
                        ? Map.of()
                        : Map.copyOf(roleMatchups);
    }

    public B69RoleMatchupScorer.MatchupResult matchup(
            String role
    ) {

        if (role == null) {
            return null;
        }

        return roleMatchups.get(
                role.trim().toUpperCase()
        );
    }

    public BigDecimal difficultyScore(
            String role
    ) {

        B69RoleMatchupScorer.MatchupResult result =
                matchup(role);

        return result == null
                ? null
                : result.difficultyScore();
    }

    public CalendarDifficulty difficulty(
            String role
    ) {

        B69RoleMatchupScorer.MatchupResult result =
                matchup(role);

        return result == null
                ? CalendarDifficulty.UNKNOWN
                : result.difficulty();
    }

    public boolean usable(
            String role
    ) {

        if (
                "POSTPONED".equals(fixtureStatus)
                || "CANCELLED".equals(fixtureStatus)
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        return difficulty(role)
                != CalendarDifficulty.UNKNOWN;
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\calendarintelligence\B69RoleMatchupScorer.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class B69RoleMatchupScorer {

    private static final BigDecimal ONE_HUNDRED =
            new BigDecimal("100");

    public MatchupResult score(Input input) {

        if (input == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Matchup input is required"
            );
        }

        String role =
                normalizeRole(
                        input.role()
                );

        validateRating(
                "ownAttackingRating",
                input.ownAttackingRating()
        );

        validateRating(
                "ownDefensiveRating",
                input.ownDefensiveRating()
        );

        validateRating(
                "opponentOverallRating",
                input.opponentOverallRating()
        );

        validateRating(
                "opponentAttackingRating",
                input.opponentAttackingRating()
        );

        validateRating(
                "opponentDefensiveRating",
                input.opponentDefensiveRating()
        );

        validateRating(
                "opponentHomeRating",
                input.opponentHomeRating()
        );

        validateRating(
                "opponentAwayRating",
                input.opponentAwayRating()
        );

        BigDecimal opponentVenueRating =
                input.home()
                        ? input.opponentAwayRating()
                        : input.opponentHomeRating();

        List<Signal> signals =
                switch (role) {

                    case "P" ->
                            goalkeeperSignals(
                                    input,
                                    opponentVenueRating
                            );

                    case "D" ->
                            defenderSignals(
                                    input,
                                    opponentVenueRating
                            );

                    case "C" ->
                            midfielderSignals(
                                    input,
                                    opponentVenueRating
                            );

                    case "A" ->
                            forwardSignals(
                                    input,
                                    opponentVenueRating
                            );

                    default ->
                            throw new IllegalStateException(
                                    "Unsupported role "
                                            + role
                            );
                };

        List<Signal> available =
                signals.stream()
                        .filter(signal ->
                                signal.value() != null
                        )
                        .toList();

        int maximumSignalCount =
                signals.size();

        if (available.isEmpty()) {

            return new MatchupResult(
                    role,
                    null,
                    CalendarDifficulty.UNKNOWN,
                    "NO_EVIDENCE",
                    BigDecimal.ZERO
                            .setScale(2),
                    0,
                    maximumSignalCount,
                    opponentVenueRating,
                    input.home()
            );
        }

        BigDecimal availableWeight =
                available.stream()
                        .map(Signal::weight)
                        .reduce(
                                BigDecimal.ZERO,
                                BigDecimal::add
                        );

        BigDecimal weightedTotal =
                available.stream()
                        .map(signal ->
                                signal.value()
                                        .multiply(
                                                signal.weight()
                                        )
                        )
                        .reduce(
                                BigDecimal.ZERO,
                                BigDecimal::add
                        );

        BigDecimal difficultyScore =
                weightedTotal
                        .divide(
                                availableWeight,
                                8,
                                RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                        )
                        .setScale(
                                2,
                                RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                        );

        BigDecimal evidenceCoverage =
                availableWeight
                        .multiply(
                                ONE_HUNDRED
                        )
                        .setScale(
                                2,
                                RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                        );

        return new MatchupResult(
                role,
                difficultyScore,
                CalendarDifficulty.fromScore(
                        difficultyScore
                ),
                evidenceTier(
                        evidenceCoverage
                ),
                evidenceCoverage,
                available.size(),
                maximumSignalCount,
                opponentVenueRating,
                input.home()
        );
    }

    private List<Signal> goalkeeperSignals(
            Input input,
            BigDecimal opponentVenueRating
    ) {

        return List.of(
                signal(
                        "opponentAttack",
                        "0.50",
                        input.opponentAttackingRating()
                ),
                signal(
                        "opponentVenue",
                        "0.25",
                        opponentVenueRating
                ),
                signal(
                        "opponentOverall",
                        "0.15",
                        input.opponentOverallRating()
                ),
                signal(
                        "ownDefensiveWeakness",
                        "0.10",
                        inverse(
                                input.ownDefensiveRating()
                        )
                )
        );
    }

    private List<Signal> defenderSignals(
            Input input,
            BigDecimal opponentVenueRating
    ) {

        return List.of(
                signal(
                        "opponentAttack",
                        "0.40",
                        input.opponentAttackingRating()
                ),
                signal(
                        "opponentOverall",
                        "0.20",
                        input.opponentOverallRating()
                ),
                signal(
                        "opponentVenue",
                        "0.20",
                        opponentVenueRating
                ),
                signal(
                        "ownDefensiveWeakness",
                        "0.20",
                        inverse(
                                input.ownDefensiveRating()
                        )
                )
        );
    }

    private List<Signal> midfielderSignals(
            Input input,
            BigDecimal opponentVenueRating
    ) {

        return List.of(
                signal(
                        "opponentOverall",
                        "0.30",
                        input.opponentOverallRating()
                ),
                signal(
                        "opponentDefense",
                        "0.25",
                        input.opponentDefensiveRating()
                ),
                signal(
                        "opponentAttack",
                        "0.15",
                        input.opponentAttackingRating()
                ),
                signal(
                        "opponentVenue",
                        "0.15",
                        opponentVenueRating
                ),
                signal(
                        "ownAttackingWeakness",
                        "0.15",
                        inverse(
                                input.ownAttackingRating()
                        )
                )
        );
    }

    private List<Signal> forwardSignals(
            Input input,
            BigDecimal opponentVenueRating
    ) {

        return List.of(
                signal(
                        "opponentDefense",
                        "0.45",
                        input.opponentDefensiveRating()
                ),
                signal(
                        "opponentOverall",
                        "0.20",
                        input.opponentOverallRating()
                ),
                signal(
                        "opponentVenue",
                        "0.15",
                        opponentVenueRating
                ),
                signal(
                        "ownAttackingWeakness",
                        "0.20",
                        inverse(
                                input.ownAttackingRating()
                        )
                )
        );
    }

    private Signal signal(
            String name,
            String weight,
            BigDecimal value
    ) {

        return new Signal(
                name,
                new BigDecimal(weight),
                value
        );
    }

    private BigDecimal inverse(
            BigDecimal rating
    ) {

        if (rating == null) {
            return null;
        }

        return ONE_HUNDRED.subtract(
                rating
        );
    }

    private String normalizeRole(
            String role
    ) {

        if (role == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Fantasy role is required"
            );
        }

        String normalized =
                role.trim()
                        .toUpperCase();

        if (
                !List.of(
                        "P",
                        "D",
                        "C",
                        "A"
                ).contains(normalized)
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Invalid fantasy role: "
                            + role
            );
        }

        return normalized;
    }

    private void validateRating(
            String name,
            BigDecimal rating
    ) {

        if (rating == null) {
            return;
        }

        if (
                rating.compareTo(
                        BigDecimal.ZERO
                ) < 0
                || rating.compareTo(
                        ONE_HUNDRED
                ) > 0
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    name
                            + " must be between 0 and 100"
            );
        }
    }

    private String evidenceTier(
            BigDecimal coverage
    ) {

        if (
                coverage.compareTo(
                        new BigDecimal("90")
                ) >= 0
        ) {
            return "HIGH";
        }

        if (
                coverage.compareTo(
                        new BigDecimal("70")
                ) >= 0
        ) {
            return "MEDIUM";
        }

        if (
                coverage.compareTo(
                        new BigDecimal("40")
                ) >= 0
        ) {
            return "LOW";
        }

        return "MINIMAL";
    }

    public record Input(
            String role,
            boolean home,
            BigDecimal ownAttackingRating,
            BigDecimal ownDefensiveRating,
            BigDecimal opponentOverallRating,
            BigDecimal opponentAttackingRating,
            BigDecimal opponentDefensiveRating,
            BigDecimal opponentHomeRating,
            BigDecimal opponentAwayRating
    ) {
    }

    public record MatchupResult(
            String role,
            BigDecimal difficultyScore,
            CalendarDifficulty difficulty,
            String evidenceTier,
            BigDecimal evidenceCoverage,
            int signalCount,
            int maximumSignalCount,
            BigDecimal opponentVenueRating,
            boolean home
    ) {
    }

    private record Signal(
            String name,
            BigDecimal weight,
            BigDecimal value
    ) {
    }
}

                JOIN clubs club ON club.id=registration.club_id
                JOIN season_clubs season_club ON season_club.season_id=season.id
                    AND season_club.club_id=club.id

                    AND role.source='FANTACALCIO'

                  AND player.active=TRUE
                  AND registration.registration_status='ACTIVE'
                ORDER BY player.id
                """).param("season",season).param("role",fantasyRole)

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\calendarintelligence\CalendarCombinationScorer.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class CalendarCombinationScorer {
    public CalendarCombinationResult evaluate(List<ClubFixtureProfile> profiles, int from, int horizon) {
        validate(profiles, from, horizon);
        List<ClubFixtureProfile> ordered = profiles.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparing(ClubFixtureProfile::clubId)).toList();
        int to = Math.min(38, from + horizon - 1);
        int window = to - from + 1, favorable = 0, hardOverlap = 0, complementary = 0, known = 0;
        List<Integer> missing = new ArrayList<>();
        Map<Integer, Long> preferred = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        List<Double> dailyCoverage = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int day = from; day <= to; day++) {
            List<ClubFixtureDay> fixtures = new ArrayList<>();
            for (ClubFixtureProfile profile : ordered) {
                ClubFixtureDay fixture = profile.matchdays().get(day);
                if (fixture != null && fixture.usable()) fixtures.add(fixture);
            }
            if (fixtures.size() != ordered.size()) { missing.add(day); continue; }
            known++;
            long easy = fixtures.stream().filter(f -> f.difficulty() == CalendarDifficulty.EASY).count();
            long hard = fixtures.stream().filter(f -> f.difficulty() == CalendarDifficulty.HARD).count();
            if (easy > 0) favorable++;
            if (hard == fixtures.size()) hardOverlap++;
            if (easy > 0 && hard > 0) complementary++;
            dailyCoverage.add(easy > 0 ? 1.0 : hard == fixtures.size() ? 0.0 : .5);
            if (easy == 1 && hard == fixtures.size() - 1) {
                preferred.put(day, fixtures.stream().filter(f -> f.difficulty() == CalendarDifficulty.EASY).findFirst().orElseThrow().clubId());
            }
        }
        double completeness = known * 100.0 / window;
        if (known < 2 || completeness < 60) return new CalendarCombinationResult(ids(ordered), null,
                CalendarCombinationStatus.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, bd(completeness), favorable, hardOverlap,
                known == 0 ? null : bd(hardOverlap * 100.0 / known), complementary, missing, from, to,
                Map.of(), List.of("Insufficient usable fixture window"));
        double favorableRate = favorable * 100.0 / known;
        double hardRate = hardOverlap * 100.0 / known;
        double complementRate = complementary * 100.0 / known;
        double streakRisk = longestZeroStreak(dailyCoverage) * 100.0 / known;
        double redundancyPenalty = ordered.size() == 3 ? redundantEasyDays(ordered, from, to) * 4.0 / known : 0;
        double score = favorableRate * .45 + complementRate * .25 + (100 - hardRate) * .25
                + (100 - streakRisk) * .05 - redundancyPenalty;
        CalendarCombinationStatus status = completeness == 100 ? CalendarCombinationStatus.AVAILABLE : CalendarCombinationStatus.PARTIAL;
        return new CalendarCombinationResult(ids(ordered), bd(score), status, bd(completeness), favorable,
                hardOverlap, bd(hardRate), complementary, missing, from, to, Map.copyOf(preferred),
                List.of("Favorable coverage=" + favorable, "Hard overlap=" + hardOverlap,
                        "Complementary matchdays=" + complementary, "Completeness=" + bd(completeness)));
    }

    private void validate(List<ClubFixtureProfile> profiles, int from, int horizon) {
        if (profiles == null || profiles.size() < 2 || profiles.size() > 3) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Pair or triple required");
        if (from < 1 || from > 38 || horizon < 1 || horizon > 10) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid fixture window");
        if (profiles.stream().map(ClubFixtureProfile::clubId).distinct().count() != profiles.size()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate club profile");
    }
    private int longestZeroStreak(List<Double> values) { int max=0,current=0; for(double v:values){if(v==0){current++;max=Math.max(max,current);}else current=0;} return max; }
    private int redundantEasyDays(List<ClubFixtureProfile> profiles, int from, int to) {
        int count=0; for(int d=from;d<=to;d++){int easy=0; for(var p:profiles){var f=p.matchdays().get(d);if(f!=null&&f.usable()&&f.difficulty()==CalendarDifficulty.EASY)easy++;}if(easy==profiles.size())count++;}return count;
    }
    private List<Long> ids(List<ClubFixtureProfile> profiles) { return profiles.stream().map(ClubFixtureProfile::clubId).toList(); }
    private BigDecimal bd(double value) { return BigDecimal.valueOf(Math.max(0,Math.min(100,value))).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP); }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\calendarintelligence\CalendarCombinationService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class CalendarCombinationService {
    public static final int MAX_PAIR_POOL = 30;
    public static final int MAX_TRIPLE_POOL = 18;
    private final FixtureWindowService windowService;
    private final CalendarCombinationScorer scorer;

    public CalendarCombinationService(FixtureWindowService windowService, CalendarCombinationScorer scorer) {
        this.windowService=windowService; this.scorer=scorer;
    }
    public List<CalendarCombinationResult> evaluatePairs(String season,List<Long> clubIds,int from,int horizon) {
        guard(clubIds,MAX_PAIR_POOL,"pair"); Map<Long,ClubFixtureProfile> profiles=windowService.loadClubProfiles(season,clubIds,from,horizon);
        List<Long> ids=profiles.keySet().stream().sorted().toList(); List<CalendarCombinationResult> out=new ArrayList<>();
        for(int a=0;a<ids.size();a++)for(int b=a+1;b<ids.size();b++)out.add(scorer.evaluate(List.of(profiles.get(ids.get(a)),profiles.get(ids.get(b))),from,horizon));
        return sorted(out);
    }
    public List<CalendarCombinationResult> evaluateTriples(String season,List<Long> clubIds,int from,int horizon) {
        guard(clubIds,MAX_TRIPLE_POOL,"triple"); Map<Long,ClubFixtureProfile> profiles=windowService.loadClubProfiles(season,clubIds,from,horizon);
        List<Long> ids=profiles.keySet().stream().sorted().toList(); List<CalendarCombinationResult> out=new ArrayList<>();
        for(int a=0;a<ids.size();a++)for(int b=a+1;b<ids.size();b++)for(int c=b+1;c<ids.size();c++)
            out.add(scorer.evaluate(List.of(profiles.get(ids.get(a)),profiles.get(ids.get(b)),profiles.get(ids.get(c))),from,horizon));
        return sorted(out);
    }
    private void guard(List<Long> ids,int max,String type){if(ids==null||ids.size()<2)throw new IllegalArgumentException("At least two clubs required");if(ids.stream().distinct().count()!=ids.size())throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate clubs");if(ids.size()>max)throw new IllegalArgumentException(type+" candidate pool exceeds explicit maximum "+max);}
    private List<CalendarCombinationResult> sorted(List<CalendarCombinationResult> values){return values.stream().sorted(Comparator
            .comparing(CalendarCombinationResult::calendarCombinationScore,Comparator.nullsLast(Comparator.reverseOrder()))
            .thenComparing(CalendarCombinationResult::confidence,Comparator.reverseOrder())
            .thenComparing(v->v.clubIds().toString())).toList();}
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

public enum CalendarDifficulty {
    EASY, MEDIUM, HARD, UNKNOWN;

    public static CalendarDifficulty fromScore(BigDecimal score) {
        if (score == null) return UNKNOWN;
        if (score.compareTo(BigDecimal.valueOf(50)) < 0) return EASY;
        if (score.compareTo(BigDecimal.valueOf(70)) < 0) return MEDIUM;
        return HARD;
    }
}

    }

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\calendarintelligence\FixtureWindowService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class FixtureWindowService {

    private static final double VENUE_ADVANTAGE =
            4.0;

    private static final List<String> B69_ROLES =
            List.of(
                    "P",
                    "D",
                    "C",
                    "A"
            );

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    private final B69RoleMatchupScorer roleMatchupScorer;

    public FixtureWindowService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            B69RoleMatchupScorer roleMatchupScorer
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.roleMatchupScorer = roleMatchupScorer;
    }

    /**
     * Compatibility path used by the existing calendar-combination
     * and live-auction layers.
     *
     * B69 deliberately keeps this API stable while the role-aware
     * calendar is introduced alongside it.
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Map<Long, ClubFixtureProfile> loadClubProfiles(
            String season,
            List<Long> clubIds,
            int from,
            int horizon
    ) {

        validateWindow(
                season,
                clubIds,
                from,
                horizon
        );

        if (clubIds.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }

        int to =
                Math.min(
                        38,
                        from + horizon - 1
                );

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows =
                loadRows(
                        season,
                        clubIds,
                        from,
                        to
                );

        Map<Long, String> names =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        Map<Long, Map<Integer, ClubFixtureDay>> days =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (
                Long id :
                clubIds.stream()
                        .distinct()
                        .sorted()
                        .toList()
        ) {
            days.put(
                    id,
                    new LinkedHashMap<>()
            );
        }

        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {

            Long homeId =
                    requiredNumber(
                            row,
                            "home_id"
                    ).longValue();

            Long awayId =
                    requiredNumber(
                            row,
                            "away_id"
                    ).longValue();

            if (days.containsKey(homeId)) {

                addLegacyDay(
                        row,
                        homeId,
                        string(
                                row,
                                "home_name"
                        ),
                        true,
                        days,
                        names
                );
            }

            if (days.containsKey(awayId)) {

                addLegacyDay(
                        row,
                        awayId,
                        string(
                                row,
                                "away_name"
                        ),
                        false,
                        days,
                        names
                );
            }
        }

        Map<Long, ClubFixtureProfile> result =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        days.forEach(
                (id, map) ->
                        result.put(
                                id,
                                new ClubFixtureProfile(
                                        id,
                                        names.get(id),
                                        Map.copyOf(map)
                                )
                        )
        );

        return Map.copyOf(result);
    }

    /**
     * B69 role-aware calendar window.
     *
     * One DB query loads the requested fixture window and all club
     * strength inputs. The same rows are then converted into four
     * fantasy-role matchup scores: P, D, C and A.
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Map<Long, B69RoleFixtureProfile> loadRoleAwareClubProfiles(
            String season,
            List<Long> clubIds,
            int from,
            int horizon
    ) {

        validateWindow(
                season,
                clubIds,
                from,
                horizon
        );

        if (clubIds.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }

        int to =
                Math.min(
                        38,
                        from + horizon - 1
                );

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows =
                loadRows(
                        season,
                        clubIds,
                        from,
                        to
                );

        Map<Long, String> names =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        Map<Long, Map<Integer, B69RoleFixtureDay>> days =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (
                Long id :
                clubIds.stream()
                        .distinct()
                        .sorted()
                        .toList()
        ) {
            days.put(
                    id,
                    new LinkedHashMap<>()
            );
        }

        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {

            Long homeId =
                    requiredNumber(
                            row,
                            "home_id"
                    ).longValue();

            Long awayId =
                    requiredNumber(
                            row,
                            "away_id"
                    ).longValue();

            if (days.containsKey(homeId)) {

                addRoleAwareDay(
                        row,
                        homeId,
                        string(
                                row,
                                "home_name"
                        ),
                        awayId,
                        string(
                                row,
                                "away_name"
                        ),
                        true,
                        days,
                        names
                );
            }

            if (days.containsKey(awayId)) {

                addRoleAwareDay(
                        row,
                        awayId,
                        string(
                                row,
                                "away_name"
                        ),
                        homeId,
                        string(
                                row,
                                "home_name"
                        ),
                        false,
                        days,
                        names
                );
            }
        }

        Map<Long, B69RoleFixtureProfile> result =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        days.forEach(
                (id, map) ->
                        result.put(
                                id,
                                new B69RoleFixtureProfile(
                                        id,
                                        names.get(id),
                                        Map.copyOf(map)
                                )
                        )
        );

        return Map.copyOf(result);
    }

    private List<Map<String, Object>> loadRows(
            String season,
            List<Long> clubIds,
            int from,
            int to
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    fixture.id AS fixture_id,
                    fixture.matchday,
                    fixture.kickoff_at,
                    fixture.status,

                    home.id AS home_id,
                    home.name AS home_name,

                    away.id AS away_id,
                    away.name AS away_name,

                    home_strength.overall_rating
                        AS home_overall,

                    home_strength.attacking_rating
                        AS home_attack,

                    home_strength.defensive_rating
                        AS home_defense,

                    home_strength.home_rating
                        AS home_home_rating,

                    home_strength.away_rating
                        AS home_away_rating,

                    away_strength.overall_rating
                        AS away_overall,

                    away_strength.attacking_rating
                        AS away_attack,

                    away_strength.defensive_rating
                        AS away_defense,

                    away_strength.home_rating
                        AS away_home_rating,

                    away_strength.away_rating
                        AS away_away_rating

                FROM fixtures fixture

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id =
                        fixture.season_id

                JOIN clubs home
                    ON home.id =
                        fixture.home_club_id

                JOIN clubs away
                    ON away.id =
                        fixture.away_club_id

                LEFT JOIN club_strength_ratings
                    home_strength

                    ON home_strength.club_id =
                        home.id

                    AND home_strength.season_id =
                        season.id

                LEFT JOIN club_strength_ratings
                    away_strength

                    ON away_strength.club_id =
                        away.id

                    AND away_strength.season_id =
                        season.id

                WHERE season.code =
                    :season

                  AND fixture.matchday
                    BETWEEN :from AND :to

                  AND (
                      fixture.home_club_id
                        IN (:clubIds)

                      OR fixture.away_club_id
                        IN (:clubIds)
                  )

                ORDER BY
                    fixture.matchday,
                    fixture.id
                """)
                .param(
                        "season",
                        season
                )
                .param(
                        "from",
                        from
                )
                .param(
                        "to",
                        to
                )
                .param(
                        "clubIds",
                        clubIds
                )
                .query()
                .listOfRows();
    }

    private void addLegacyDay(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            Long clubId,
            String clubName,
            boolean home,
            Map<Long, Map<Integer, ClubFixtureDay>> days,
            Map<Long, String> names
    ) {

        names.put(
                clubId,
                clubName
        );

        BigDecimal score =
                legacyDifficulty(
                        row,
                        home
                );

        int matchday =
                requiredNumber(
                        row,
                        "matchday"
                ).intValue();

        days.get(clubId)
                .put(
                        matchday,
                        new ClubFixtureDay(
                                clubId,
                                matchday,
                                requiredNumber(
                                        row,
                                        "fixture_id"
                                ).longValue(),
                                home,
                                string(
                                        row,
                                        "status"
                                ),
                                offset(
                                        row.get(
                                                "kickoff_at"
                                        )
                                ),
                                score,
                                CalendarDifficulty
                                        .fromScore(score)
                        )
                );
    }

    private void addRoleAwareDay(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            Long clubId,
            String clubName,
            Long opponentClubId,
            String opponentClubName,
            boolean home,
            Map<Long, Map<Integer, B69RoleFixtureDay>> days,
            Map<Long, String> names
    ) {

        names.put(
                clubId,
                clubName
        );

        BigDecimal ownAttack =
                decimal(
                        row,
                        home
                                ? "home_attack"
                                : "away_attack"
                );

        BigDecimal ownDefense =
                decimal(
                        row,
                        home
                                ? "home_defense"
                                : "away_defense"
                );

        BigDecimal opponentOverall =
                decimal(
                        row,
                        home
                                ? "away_overall"
                                : "home_overall"
                );

        BigDecimal opponentAttack =
                decimal(
                        row,
                        home
                                ? "away_attack"
                                : "home_attack"
                );

        BigDecimal opponentDefense =
                decimal(
                        row,
                        home
                                ? "away_defense"
                                : "home_defense"
                );

        BigDecimal opponentHome =
                decimal(
                        row,
                        home
                                ? "away_home_rating"
                                : "home_home_rating"
                );

        BigDecimal opponentAway =
                decimal(
                        row,
                        home
                                ? "away_away_rating"
                                : "home_away_rating"
                );

        Map<String, B69RoleMatchupScorer.MatchupResult>
                roleMatchups =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (String role : B69_ROLES) {

            roleMatchups.put(
                    role,
                    roleMatchupScorer.score(
                            new B69RoleMatchupScorer.Input(
                                    role,
                                    home,
                                    ownAttack,
                                    ownDefense,
                                    opponentOverall,
                                    opponentAttack,
                                    opponentDefense,
                                    opponentHome,
                                    opponentAway
                            )
                    )
            );
        }

        int matchday =
                requiredNumber(
                        row,
                        "matchday"
                ).intValue();

        days.get(clubId)
                .put(
                        matchday,
                        new B69RoleFixtureDay(
                                clubId,
                                clubName,
                                opponentClubId,
                                opponentClubName,
                                matchday,
                                requiredNumber(
                                        row,
                                        "fixture_id"
                                ).longValue(),
                                home,
                                string(
                                        row,
                                        "status"
                                ),
                                offset(
                                        row.get(
                                                "kickoff_at"
                                        )
                                ),
                                Map.copyOf(
                                        roleMatchups
                                )
                        )
                );
    }

    private BigDecimal legacyDifficulty(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            boolean home
    ) {

        String[] keys =
                home
                        ? new String[]{
                                "away_away_rating",
                                "away_overall",
                                "away_attack",
                                "home_defense"
                        }
                        : new String[]{
                                "home_home_rating",
                                "home_overall",
                                "home_attack",
                                "away_defense"
                        };

        for (String key : keys) {

            if (
                    !(row.get(key)
                            instanceof Number)
            ) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        double value =
                numberValue(
                        row,
                        keys[0]
                ) * 0.35

                + numberValue(
                        row,
                        keys[1]
                ) * 0.20

                + numberValue(
                        row,
                        keys[2]
                ) * 0.30

                + (
                        100
                        - numberValue(
                                row,
                                keys[3]
                        )
                ) * 0.15

                + (
                        home
                                ? -VENUE_ADVANTAGE
                                : VENUE_ADVANTAGE
                );

        return BigDecimal
                .valueOf(
                        Math.max(
                                0,
                                Math.min(
                                        100,
                                        value
                                )
                        )
                )
                .setScale(
                        2,
                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                );
    }

    private void validateWindow(
            String season,
            List<Long> clubIds,
            int from,
            int horizon
    ) {

        if (
                season == null
                || season.isBlank()
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Season is required"
            );
        }

        if (clubIds == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Club ids are required"
            );
        }

        if (
                from < 1
                || from > 38
                || horizon < 1
                || horizon > 10
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Invalid fixture window"
            );
        }
    }

    private BigDecimal decimal(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            String key
    ) {

        Object value =
                row.get(key);

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (value instanceof BigDecimal decimal) {
            return decimal;
        }

        if (value instanceof Number number) {

            return BigDecimal.valueOf(
                    number.doubleValue()
            );
        }

        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Unsupported numeric value for "
                        + key
                        + ": "
                        + value.getClass()
                                .getName()
        );
    }

    private Number requiredNumber(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            String key
    ) {

        Object value =
                row.get(key);

        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number;
        }

        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Required numeric value missing: "
                        + key
        );
    }

    private double numberValue(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            String key
    ) {

        return requiredNumber(
                row,
                key
        ).doubleValue();
    }

    private String string(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            String key
    ) {

        Object value =
                row.get(key);

        return value == null
                ? null
                : value.toString();
    }

    private OffsetDateTime offset(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (
                value
                instanceof OffsetDateTime result
        ) {
            return result;
        }

        if (
                value
                instanceof java.sql.Timestamp timestamp
        ) {
            return timestamp
                    .toInstant()
                    .atOffset(
                            java.time.ZoneOffset.UTC
                    );
        }

        if (
                value
                instanceof java.time.LocalDateTime localDateTime
        ) {
            return localDateTime
                    .atZone(
                            java.time.ZoneId.of(
                                    "Europe/Rome"
                            )
                    )
                    .toOffsetDateTime();
        }

        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Unsupported kickoff type: "
                        + value.getClass()
                                .getName()
        );
    }
}
