--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\development\PlayerDevelopmentAssessmentService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.development;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

@Service
public class PlayerDevelopmentAssessmentService {

    private static final BigDecimal ZERO =
            BigDecimal.ZERO.setScale(
                    2,
                    RoundingMode.HALF_UP
            );

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public PlayerDevelopmentAssessmentService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional
    public PlayerDevelopmentGenerationResponse generate(
            String targetSeasonCode
    ) {
        SeasonReference targetSeason =
                findSeason(targetSeasonCode);

        List<PlayerReference> players =
                findEligiblePlayers(targetSeason.id());

        if (players.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Nessun giocatore ufficiale disponibile "
                            + "per la stagione "
                            + targetSeasonCode
            );
        }

        int generated = 0;
        int growing = 0;
        int stable = 0;
        int declining = 0;
        int insufficient = 0;

        for (PlayerReference player : players) {
            DevelopmentCalculation calculation =
                    calculateDevelopment(
                            player,
                            targetSeason
                    );

            saveAssessment(
                    player,
                    targetSeason,
                    calculation
            );

            generated++;

            switch (calculation.trend()) {
                case "GROWING" -> growing++;
                case "STABLE" -> stable++;
                case "DECLINING" -> declining++;
                default -> insufficient++;
            }
        }

        deleteStaleAssessments(
                targetSeason.id()
        );

        return new PlayerDevelopmentGenerationResponse(
                targetSeason.code(),
                players.size(),
                generated,
                growing,
                stable,
                declining,
                insufficient,
                "COMPLETED"
        );
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public PlayerDevelopmentAssessmentResponse findByPlayer(
            Long playerId,
            String targetSeasonCode
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    assessment.player_id,
                    player.display_name,
                    target.code AS target_season,
                    older.code AS older_season,
                    latest.code AS latest_season,
                    assessment.trend,
                    assessment.growth_score,
                    assessment.decline_risk_score,
                    assessment.confidence_score,
                    assessment.appearances_change,
                    assessment.starts_change,
                    assessment.minutes_change,
                    assessment.fantasy_average_change,
                    assessment.goals_change,
                    assessment.assists_change,
                    assessment.expected_goals_change,
                    assessment.expected_assists_change,
                    assessment.analysis_summary
                FROM player_development_assessments assessment

                JOIN players player
                    ON player.id = assessment.player_id

                JOIN seasons target
                    ON target.id = assessment.target_season_id

                LEFT JOIN seasons older
                    ON older.id = assessment.older_season_id

                LEFT JOIN seasons latest
                    ON latest.id = assessment.latest_season_id

                WHERE assessment.player_id = :playerId
                  AND target.code = :targetSeasonCode
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param(
                        "targetSeasonCode",
                        targetSeasonCode
                )
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        new PlayerDevelopmentAssessmentResponse(
                                resultSet.getLong("player_id"),
                                resultSet.getString("display_name"),
                                resultSet.getString("target_season"),
                                resultSet.getString("older_season"),
                                resultSet.getString("latest_season"),
                                resultSet.getString("trend"),
                                resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                        "growth_score"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                        "decline_risk_score"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                        "confidence_score"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                        "appearances_change"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                        "starts_change"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                        "minutes_change"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                        "fantasy_average_change"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                        "goals_change"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                        "assists_change"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                        "expected_goals_change"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                        "expected_assists_change"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "analysis_summary"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Analisi evolutiva non trovata "
                                        + "per il giocatore"
                        )
                );
    }

    private DevelopmentCalculation calculateDevelopment(
            PlayerReference player,
            SeasonReference targetSeason
    ) {
        List<SeasonStatistics> history =
                findPreviousSeasonStatistics(
                        player.id(),
                        targetSeason.startYear()
                );

        if (history.size() < 2) {
            String summary =
                    "Dati storici insufficienti: servono due "
                            + "stagioni complete per stimare "
                            + "crescita o rischio di calo.";

            return DevelopmentCalculation.insufficient(
                    history,
                    summary
            );
        }

        SeasonStatistics latest = history.get(0);
        SeasonStatistics older = history.get(1);

        BigDecimal appearancesChange =
                difference(
                        latest.appearances(),
                        older.appearances()
                );

        BigDecimal startsChange =
                difference(
                        latest.starts(),
                        older.starts()
                );

        BigDecimal minutesChange =
                difference(
                        latest.minutesPlayed(),
                        older.minutesPlayed()
                );

        BigDecimal fantasyAverageChange =
                difference(
                        latest.fantasyAverage(),
                        older.fantasyAverage()
                );

        BigDecimal goalsChange =
                difference(
                        latest.goals(),
                        older.goals()
                );

        BigDecimal assistsChange =
                difference(
                        latest.assists(),
                        older.assists()
                );

        BigDecimal expectedGoalsChange =
                difference(
                        latest.expectedGoals(),
                        older.expectedGoals()
                );

        BigDecimal expectedAssistsChange =
                difference(
                        latest.expectedAssists(),
                        older.expectedAssists()
                );

        BigDecimal opportunityScore =
                clamp(
                        BigDecimal.valueOf(50)
                                .add(
                                        appearancesChange.multiply(
                                                new BigDecimal("1.20")
                                        )
                                )
                                .add(
                                        startsChange.multiply(
                                                new BigDecimal("1.50")
                                        )
                                )
                                .add(
                                        minutesChange.divide(
                                                new BigDecimal("90"),
                                                4,
                                                RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                                        )
                                )
                );

        BigDecimal performanceScore =
                clamp(
                        BigDecimal.valueOf(50)
                                .add(
                                        fantasyAverageChange.multiply(
                                                new BigDecimal("18")
                                        )
                                )
                                .add(
                                        goalsChange.multiply(
                                                new BigDecimal("2.50")
                                        )
                                )
                                .add(
                                        assistsChange.multiply(
                                                new BigDecimal("2.00")
                                        )
                                )
                );

        BigDecimal underlyingScore =
                clamp(
                        BigDecimal.valueOf(50)
                                .add(
                                        expectedGoalsChange.multiply(
                                                new BigDecimal("4.00")
                                        )
                                )
                                .add(
                                        expectedAssistsChange.multiply(
                                                new BigDecimal("4.00")
                                        )
                                )
                );

        BigDecimal growthScore =
                clamp(
                        opportunityScore.multiply(
                                new BigDecimal("0.40")
                        )
                                .add(
                                        performanceScore.multiply(
                                                new BigDecimal("0.35")
                                        )
                                )
                                .add(
                                        underlyingScore.multiply(
                                                new BigDecimal("0.25")
                                        )
                                )
                );

        BigDecimal declineRisk =
                clamp(
                        BigDecimal.valueOf(100)
                                .subtract(growthScore)
                                .add(
                                        regressionPenalty(
                                                latest
                                        )
                                )
                );

        BigDecimal confidence =
                calculateConfidence(
                        older,
                        latest
                );

        String trend =
                determineTrend(
                        growthScore,
                        declineRisk
                );

        String summary =
                buildSummary(
                        player.name(),
                        trend,
                        appearancesChange,
                        startsChange,
                        minutesChange,
                        fantasyAverageChange,
                        goalsChange,
                        assistsChange,
                        expectedGoalsChange,
                        expectedAssistsChange,
                        confidence
                );

        return new DevelopmentCalculation(
                older.seasonId(),
                older.seasonCode(),
                latest.seasonId(),
                latest.seasonCode(),
                trend,
                growthScore,
                declineRisk,
                confidence,
                appearancesChange,
                startsChange,
                minutesChange,
                fantasyAverageChange,
                goalsChange,
                assistsChange,
                expectedGoalsChange,
                expectedAssistsChange,
                summary
        );
    }

    private List<SeasonStatistics> findPreviousSeasonStatistics(
            Long playerId,
            int targetStartYear
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    season.id AS season_id,
                    season.code AS season_code,

                    AVG(statistics.appearances)
                        AS appearances,

                    AVG(statistics.starts)
                        AS starts,

                    AVG(statistics.minutes_played)
                        AS minutes_played,

                    AVG(statistics.fantasy_average)
                        FILTER (
                            WHERE statistics.fantasy_average
                                IS NOT NULL
                        )
                        AS fantasy_average,

                    AVG(statistics.goals)
                        AS goals,

                    AVG(statistics.assists)
                        AS assists,

                    AVG(statistics.expected_goals)
                        FILTER (
                            WHERE statistics.expected_goals
                                IS NOT NULL
                        )
                        AS expected_goals,

                    AVG(statistics.expected_assists)
                        FILTER (
                            WHERE statistics.expected_assists
                                IS NOT NULL
                        )
                        AS expected_assists,

                    COUNT(DISTINCT statistics.source)
                        AS sources_count

                FROM player_season_statistics statistics

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = statistics.season_id

                WHERE statistics.player_id = :playerId
                  AND season.start_year < :targetStartYear

                GROUP BY
                    season.id,
                    season.code,
                    season.start_year

                ORDER BY season.start_year DESC

                LIMIT 2
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param(
                        "targetStartYear",
                        targetStartYear
                )
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        new SeasonStatistics(
                                resultSet.getLong("season_id"),
                                resultSet.getString("season_code"),
                                safeDecimal(
                                        resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                                "appearances"
                                        )
                                ),
                                safeDecimal(
                                        resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                                "starts"
                                        )
                                ),
                                safeDecimal(
                                        resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                                "minutes_played"
                                        )
                                ),
                                safeDecimal(
                                        resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                                "fantasy_average"
                                        )
                                ),
                                safeDecimal(
                                        resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                                "goals"
                                        )
                                ),
                                safeDecimal(
                                        resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                                "assists"
                                        )
                                ),
                                safeDecimal(
                                        resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                                "expected_goals"
                                        )
                                ),
                                safeDecimal(
                                        resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                                "expected_assists"
                                        )
                                ),
                                resultSet.getInt("sources_count")
                        )
                )
                .list();
    }

    private BigDecimal regressionPenalty(
            SeasonStatistics latest
    ) {
        BigDecimal actualBonus =
                latest.goals()
                        .add(latest.assists());

        BigDecimal expectedBonus =
                latest.expectedGoals()
                        .add(latest.expectedAssists());

        BigDecimal overPerformance =
                actualBonus.subtract(expectedBonus);

        if (overPerformance.compareTo(
                new BigDecimal("3")
        ) <= 0) {
            return ZERO;
        }

        return overPerformance
                .subtract(new BigDecimal("3"))
                .multiply(new BigDecimal("2.50"));
    }

    private BigDecimal calculateConfidence(
            SeasonStatistics older,
            SeasonStatistics latest
    ) {
        BigDecimal sourceComponent =
                BigDecimal.valueOf(
                        Math.min(
                                3,
                                older.sourcesCount()
                        )
                                + Math.min(
                                        3,
                                        latest.sourcesCount()
                                )
                )
                        .divide(
                                new BigDecimal("6"),
                                4,
                                RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                        )
                        .multiply(
                                new BigDecimal("45")
                        );

        BigDecimal appearancesComponent =
                older.appearances()
                        .add(latest.appearances())
                        .divide(
                                new BigDecimal("60"),
                                4,
                                RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                        )
                        .multiply(
                                new BigDecimal("55")
                        );

        return clamp(
                sourceComponent.add(
                        appearancesComponent
                )
        );
    }

    private String determineTrend(
            BigDecimal growthScore,
            BigDecimal declineRisk
    ) {
        if (growthScore.compareTo(
                new BigDecimal("62")
        ) >= 0
                && declineRisk.compareTo(
                new BigDecimal("48")
        ) <= 0) {
            return "GROWING";
        }

        if (growthScore.compareTo(
                new BigDecimal("40")
        ) < 0
                || declineRisk.compareTo(
                new BigDecimal("62")
        ) >= 0) {
            return "DECLINING";
        }

        return "STABLE";
    }

    private String buildSummary(
            String playerName,
            String trend,
            BigDecimal appearancesChange,
            BigDecimal startsChange,
            BigDecimal minutesChange,
            BigDecimal fantasyAverageChange,
            BigDecimal goalsChange,
            BigDecimal assistsChange,
            BigDecimal expectedGoalsChange,
            BigDecimal expectedAssistsChange,
            BigDecimal confidence
    ) {
        List<String> evidence =
                new ArrayList<>();

        if (minutesChange.compareTo(
                new BigDecimal("300")
        ) >= 0) {
            evidence.add(
                    "minutaggio in forte aumento"
            );
        }
        else if (minutesChange.compareTo(
                new BigDecimal("-300")
        ) <= 0) {
            evidence.add(
                    "minutaggio in diminuzione"
            );
        }

        if (startsChange.compareTo(
                new BigDecimal("4")
        ) >= 0) {
            evidence.add(
                    "maggiore continuitÃ  da titolare"
            );
        }
        else if (startsChange.compareTo(
                new BigDecimal("-4")
        ) <= 0) {
            evidence.add(
                    "meno presenze da titolare"
            );
        }

        if (fantasyAverageChange.compareTo(
                new BigDecimal("0.30")
        ) >= 0) {
            evidence.add(
                    "fantamedia in crescita"
            );
        }
        else if (fantasyAverageChange.compareTo(
                new BigDecimal("-0.30")
        ) <= 0) {
            evidence.add(
                    "fantamedia in calo"
            );
        }

        if (expectedGoalsChange
                .add(expectedAssistsChange)
                .compareTo(
                        new BigDecimal("1.50")
                ) >= 0) {
            evidence.add(
                    "occasioni offensive attese in aumento"
            );
        }
        else if (expectedGoalsChange
                .add(expectedAssistsChange)
                .compareTo(
                        new BigDecimal("-1.50")
                ) <= 0) {
            evidence.add(
                    "coinvolgimento offensivo atteso in calo"
            );
        }

        if (goalsChange
                .add(assistsChange)
                .compareTo(
                        new BigDecimal("3")
                ) >= 0) {
            evidence.add(
                    "bonus reali in aumento"
            );
        }
        else if (goalsChange
                .add(assistsChange)
                .compareTo(
                        new BigDecimal("-3")
                ) <= 0) {
            evidence.add(
                    "bonus reali in diminuzione"
            );
        }

        String evidenceText =
                evidence.isEmpty()
                        ? "andamento complessivamente regolare"
                        : String.join(
                                ", ",
                                evidence
                        );

        String conclusion =
                switch (trend) {
                    case "GROWING" ->
                            "potrebbe fare il salto di qualitÃ ";
                    case "DECLINING" ->
                            "potrebbe rendere meno rispetto "
                                    + "all'ultima stagione";
                    default ->
                            "mostra un profilo tendenzialmente stabile";
                };

        return playerName
                + " "
                + conclusion
                + ": "
                + evidenceText
                + ". AffidabilitÃ  dell'analisi "
                + confidence.setScale(
                        0,
                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                )
                + "/100.";
    }

    private void saveAssessment(
            PlayerReference player,
            SeasonReference targetSeason,
            DevelopmentCalculation calculation
    ) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_development_assessments (
                    player_id,
                    target_season_id,
                    older_season_id,
                    latest_season_id,
                    trend,
                    growth_score,
                    decline_risk_score,
                    confidence_score,
                    appearances_change,
                    starts_change,
                    minutes_change,
                    fantasy_average_change,
                    goals_change,
                    assists_change,
                    expected_goals_change,
                    expected_assists_change,
                    analysis_summary
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :targetSeasonId,
                    :olderSeasonId,
                    :latestSeasonId,
                    :trend,
                    :growthScore,
                    :declineRiskScore,
                    :confidenceScore,
                    :appearancesChange,
                    :startsChange,
                    :minutesChange,
                    :fantasyAverageChange,
                    :goalsChange,
                    :assistsChange,
                    :expectedGoalsChange,
                    :expectedAssistsChange,
                    :analysisSummary
                )
                ON CONFLICT (
                    player_id,
                    target_season_id
                )
                DO UPDATE SET
                    older_season_id =
                        EXCLUDED.older_season_id,

                    latest_season_id =
                        EXCLUDED.latest_season_id,

                    trend =
                        EXCLUDED.trend,

                    growth_score =
                        EXCLUDED.growth_score,

                    decline_risk_score =
                        EXCLUDED.decline_risk_score,

                    confidence_score =
                        EXCLUDED.confidence_score,

                    appearances_change =
                        EXCLUDED.appearances_change,

                    starts_change =
                        EXCLUDED.starts_change,

                    minutes_change =
                        EXCLUDED.minutes_change,

                    fantasy_average_change =
                        EXCLUDED.fantasy_average_change,

                    goals_change =
                        EXCLUDED.goals_change,

                    assists_change =
                        EXCLUDED.assists_change,

                    expected_goals_change =
                        EXCLUDED.expected_goals_change,

                    expected_assists_change =
                        EXCLUDED.expected_assists_change,

                    analysis_summary =
                        EXCLUDED.analysis_summary,

                    generated_at =
                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

                    updated_at =
                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                """)
                .param("playerId", player.id())
                .param(
                        "targetSeasonId",
                        targetSeason.id()
                )
                .param(
                        "olderSeasonId",
                        calculation.olderSeasonId()
                )
                .param(
                        "latestSeasonId",
                        calculation.latestSeasonId()
                )
                .param("trend", calculation.trend())
                .param(
                        "growthScore",
                        calculation.growthScore()
                )
                .param(
                        "declineRiskScore",
                        calculation.declineRiskScore()
                )
                .param(
                        "confidenceScore",
                        calculation.confidenceScore()
                )
                .param(
                        "appearancesChange",
                        calculation.appearancesChange()
                )
                .param(
                        "startsChange",
                        calculation.startsChange()
                )
                .param(
                        "minutesChange",
                        calculation.minutesChange()
                )
                .param(
                        "fantasyAverageChange",
                        calculation.fantasyAverageChange()
                )
                .param(
                        "goalsChange",
                        calculation.goalsChange()
                )
                .param(
                        "assistsChange",
                        calculation.assistsChange()
                )
                .param(
                        "expectedGoalsChange",
                        calculation.expectedGoalsChange()
                )
                .param(
                        "expectedAssistsChange",
                        calculation.expectedAssistsChange()
                )
                .param(
                        "analysisSummary",
                        calculation.analysisSummary()
                )
                .update();
    }

    private List<PlayerReference> findEligiblePlayers(
            Long targetSeasonId
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    player.id,
                    player.display_name
                FROM players player

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = player.id
                    AND registration.season_id =
                        :targetSeasonId
                    AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'

                JOIN player_reconciliation_results
                    reconciliation
                    ON reconciliation.player_id = player.id
                    AND reconciliation.season_id =
                        :targetSeasonId

                WHERE player.active = TRUE

                ORDER BY player.id
                """)
                .param(
                        "targetSeasonId",
                        targetSeasonId
                )
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        new PlayerReference(
                                resultSet.getLong("id"),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "display_name"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .list();
    }

    private void deleteStaleAssessments(
            Long targetSeasonId
    ) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                DELETE FROM player_development_assessments
                WHERE target_season_id = :targetSeasonId
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM player_reconciliation_results
                          reconciliation

                      JOIN player_registrations registration
                          ON registration.player_id =
                              reconciliation.player_id
                          AND registration.season_id =
                              reconciliation.season_id
                          AND registration.registration_status =
                              'ACTIVE'

                      WHERE reconciliation.player_id =
                              player_development_assessments.player_id
                        AND reconciliation.season_id =
                              :targetSeasonId
                  )
                """)
                .param(
                        "targetSeasonId",
                        targetSeasonId
                )
                .update();
    }

    private SeasonReference findSeason(
            String seasonCode
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    id,
                    code,
                    start_year
                FROM seasons
                WHERE code = :seasonCode
                """)
                .param("seasonCode", seasonCode)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        new SeasonReference(
                                resultSet.getLong("id"),
                                resultSet.getString("code"),
                                resultSet.getInt("start_year")
                        )
                )
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Stagione non trovata: "
                                        + seasonCode
                        )
                );
    }

    private BigDecimal difference(
            BigDecimal latest,
            BigDecimal older
    ) {
        return safeDecimal(latest)
                .subtract(safeDecimal(older))
                .setScale(
                        2,
                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                );
    }

    private BigDecimal safeDecimal(
            BigDecimal value
    ) {
        return value == null
                ? ZERO
                : value;
    }

    private BigDecimal clamp(
            BigDecimal value
    ) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(value);

        if (value.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) < 0) {
            return ZERO;
        }

        if (value.compareTo(
                BigDecimal.valueOf(100)
        ) > 0) {
            return BigDecimal.valueOf(100)
                    .setScale(
                            2,
                            RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                    );
        }

        return value.setScale(
                2,
                RoundingMode.HALF_UP
        );
    }

    private record PlayerReference(
            Long id,
            String name
    ) {
    }

    private record SeasonReference(
            Long id,
            String code,
            int startYear
    ) {
    }

    private record SeasonStatistics(
            Long seasonId,
            String seasonCode,
            BigDecimal appearances,
            BigDecimal starts,
            BigDecimal minutesPlayed,
            BigDecimal fantasyAverage,
            BigDecimal goals,
            BigDecimal assists,
            BigDecimal expectedGoals,
            BigDecimal expectedAssists,
            int sourcesCount
    ) {
    }

    private record DevelopmentCalculation(
            Long olderSeasonId,
            String olderSeasonCode,
            Long latestSeasonId,
            String latestSeasonCode,
            String trend,
            BigDecimal growthScore,
            BigDecimal declineRiskScore,
            BigDecimal confidenceScore,
            BigDecimal appearancesChange,
            BigDecimal startsChange,
            BigDecimal minutesChange,
            BigDecimal fantasyAverageChange,
            BigDecimal goalsChange,
            BigDecimal assistsChange,
            BigDecimal expectedGoalsChange,
            BigDecimal expectedAssistsChange,
            String analysisSummary
    ) {
        private static DevelopmentCalculation insufficient(
                List<SeasonStatistics> history,
                String summary
        ) {
            SeasonStatistics latest =
                    history.isEmpty()
                            ? null
                            : history.get(0);

            return new DevelopmentCalculation(
                    null,
                    null,
                    latest == null
                            ? null
                            : latest.seasonId(),
                    latest == null
                            ? null
                            : latest.seasonCode(),
                    "INSUFFICIENT_DATA",
                    ZERO,
                    ZERO,
                    ZERO,
                    null,
                    null,
                    null,
                    null,
                    null,
                    null,
                    null,
                    null,
                    summary
            );
        }
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\evaluation\PlayerEvaluationGenerationService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.evaluation;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

@Service
public class PlayerEvaluationGenerationService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public PlayerEvaluationGenerationService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional
    public PlayerEvaluationGenerationResponse generate(
            String seasonCode
    ) {
        Long seasonId = findSeasonId(seasonCode);

        int eligiblePlayers =
                countEligiblePlayers(seasonId);

        if (eligiblePlayers == 0) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Nessun giocatore ufficiale disponibile "
                            + "per la stagione "
                            + seasonCode
            );
        }

        deleteStaleEvaluations(seasonId);

        int generatedEvaluations =
                generateEvaluations(seasonId);

        return new PlayerEvaluationGenerationResponse(
                seasonCode,
                eligiblePlayers,
                generatedEvaluations,
                "COMPLETED"
        );
    }

    private Long findSeasonId(String seasonCode) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM seasons
                WHERE code = :seasonCode
                """)
                .param("seasonCode", seasonCode)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Stagione non trovata: "
                                        + seasonCode
                        )
                );
    }

    private int countEligiblePlayers(Long seasonId) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT role.player_id)
                FROM player_roles role

                JOIN player_reconciliation_results reconciliation
                    ON reconciliation.player_id = role.player_id
                    AND reconciliation.season_id = role.season_id

                JOIN players player
                    ON player.id = role.player_id
                    AND player.active = TRUE

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = role.player_id
                    AND registration.season_id = role.season_id
                    AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'

                JOIN season_clubs season_club
                    ON season_club.season_id = role.season_id
                    AND season_club.club_id = registration.club_id

                WHERE role.season_id = :seasonId
                  AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                  AND role.fantasy_role IS NOT NULL
                """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();
    }

    private void deleteStaleEvaluations(Long seasonId) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                DELETE FROM player_evaluations evaluation
                WHERE evaluation.season_id = :seasonId
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM player_reconciliation_results reconciliation

                      JOIN player_registrations registration
                          ON registration.player_id =
                              reconciliation.player_id
                          AND registration.season_id =
                              reconciliation.season_id
                          AND registration.registration_status =
                              'ACTIVE'

                      JOIN season_clubs season_club
                          ON season_club.season_id = reconciliation.season_id
                          AND season_club.club_id = registration.club_id

                      WHERE reconciliation.player_id =
                              evaluation.player_id
                        AND reconciliation.season_id =
                              evaluation.season_id
                  )
                """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .update();
    }

    private int generateEvaluations(Long seasonId) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                WITH eligible AS (
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        player.id AS player_id,
                        role.fantasy_role,

                        COALESCE(
                            market.quotation,
                            0
                        ) AS quotation,

                        COALESCE(
                            market.fantasy_market_value,
                            0
                        ) AS fantasy_market_value,

                        COALESCE(
                            reconciliation.sources_count,
                            1
                        ) AS sources_count

                    FROM players player

                    JOIN player_roles role
                        ON role.player_id = player.id
                        AND role.season_id = :seasonId
                        AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                    JOIN player_registrations registration
                        ON registration.player_id = player.id
                        AND registration.season_id = :seasonId
                        AND registration.registration_status =
                            'ACTIVE'

                    JOIN season_clubs season_club
                        ON season_club.season_id = :seasonId
                        AND season_club.club_id = registration.club_id

                    LEFT JOIN player_market_values market
                        ON market.player_id = player.id
                        AND market.season_id = :seasonId
                        AND market.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                    JOIN player_reconciliation_results
                        reconciliation
                        ON reconciliation.player_id = player.id
                        AND reconciliation.season_id = :seasonId

                    WHERE player.active = TRUE
                ),

                normalized AS (
                    SELECT
                        eligible.*,

                        GREATEST(
                            MAX(fantasy_market_value)
                                OVER (
                                    PARTITION BY fantasy_role
                                ),
                            1
                        ) AS maximum_role_fmv,

                        GREATEST(
                            MAX(quotation)
                                OVER (
                                    PARTITION BY fantasy_role
                                ),
                            1
                        ) AS maximum_role_quotation

                    FROM eligible
                ),

                scored AS (
                    SELECT
                        normalized.*,

                        LEAST(
                            100,
                            GREATEST(
                                0,
                                CASE
                                    WHEN fantasy_market_value > 0
                                    THEN
                                        fantasy_market_value
                                        * 100.0
                                        / maximum_role_fmv

                                    WHEN quotation > 0
                                    THEN
                                        quotation
                                        * 100.0
                                        / maximum_role_quotation

                                    ELSE 0
                                END
                            )
                        ) AS market_score,

                        CASE
                            WHEN sources_count >= 3 THEN 90
                            WHEN sources_count = 2 THEN 75
                            ELSE 55
                        END AS source_score

                    FROM normalized
                ),

                projections AS (
                    SELECT
                        scored.*,

                        ROUND(
                            18
                            + market_score * 0.20
                        )::INTEGER AS projected_appearances,

                        LEAST(
                            ROUND(
                                18
                                + market_score * 0.20
                            )::INTEGER,

                            ROUND(
                                (
                                    18
                                    + market_score * 0.20
                                )
                                *
                                (
                                    0.30
                                    + market_score * 0.0065
                                )
                            )::INTEGER
                        ) AS projected_starts

                    FROM scored
                )

                INSERT INTO player_evaluations (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    projected_fantasy_average,
                    projected_appearances,
                    projected_starts,
                    projected_goals,
                    projected_assists,
                    reliability_score,
                    potential_score,
                    risk_score,
                    value_score,
                    evaluation_summary
                )

                SELECT
                    player_id,
                    :seasonId,

                    ROUND(
                        CASE fantasy_role
                            WHEN 'P' THEN
                                4.80 + market_score * 0.012

                            WHEN 'D' THEN
                                5.20 + market_score * 0.014

                            WHEN 'C' THEN
                                5.30 + market_score * 0.018

                            WHEN 'A' THEN
                                5.40 + market_score * 0.022

                            ELSE
                                5.00 + market_score * 0.010
                        END,
                        2
                    ),

                    projected_appearances,
                    projected_starts,

                    CASE fantasy_role
                        WHEN 'P' THEN 0
                        WHEN 'D' THEN
                            ROUND(market_score / 25.0)::INTEGER
                        WHEN 'C' THEN
                            ROUND(market_score / 12.5)::INTEGER
                        WHEN 'A' THEN
                            ROUND(market_score / 8.3)::INTEGER
                        ELSE 0
                    END,

                    CASE fantasy_role
                        WHEN 'P' THEN 0
                        WHEN 'D' THEN
                            ROUND(market_score / 20.0)::INTEGER
                        WHEN 'C' THEN
                            ROUND(market_score / 14.0)::INTEGER
                        WHEN 'A' THEN
                            ROUND(market_score / 20.0)::INTEGER
                        ELSE 0
                    END,

                    ROUND(
                        LEAST(
                            100,
                            30
                            + market_score * 0.50
                            + source_score * 0.20
                        ),
                        2
                    ),

                    ROUND(
                        LEAST(
                            100,
                            35
                            + market_score * 0.55
                            + source_score * 0.10
                        ),
                        2
                    ),

                    ROUND(
                        LEAST(
                            100,
                            GREATEST(
                                0,
                                90
                                - market_score * 0.55
                                - source_score * 0.15
                            )
                        ),
                        2
                    ),

                    ROUND(
                        LEAST(
                            100,
                            30
                            + market_score * 0.55
                            + source_score * 0.15
                        ),
                        2
                    ),

                    CONCAT(
                        'Valutazione automatica iniziale basata su ',
                        'quotazione Fantacalcio, FVM, ruolo di listone ',
                        'e copertura delle fonti. Indice mercato ',
                        ROUND(market_score, 1),
                        '/100; fonti disponibili ',
                        sources_count,
                        '.'
                    )

                FROM projections

                ON CONFLICT (
                    player_id,
                    season_id
                )
                DO UPDATE SET
                    projected_fantasy_average =
                        EXCLUDED.projected_fantasy_average,

                    projected_appearances =
                        EXCLUDED.projected_appearances,

                    projected_starts =
                        EXCLUDED.projected_starts,

                    projected_goals =
                        EXCLUDED.projected_goals,

                    projected_assists =
                        EXCLUDED.projected_assists,

                    reliability_score =
                        EXCLUDED.reliability_score,

                    potential_score =
                        EXCLUDED.potential_score,

                    risk_score =
                        EXCLUDED.risk_score,

                    value_score =
                        EXCLUDED.value_score,

                    evaluation_summary =
                        EXCLUDED.evaluation_summary,

                    updated_at =
                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .update();
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\fixture\B69FixtureMatchupService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.B69RoleFixtureDay;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.B69RoleFixtureProfile;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.B69RoleMatchupScorer;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.CalendarDifficulty;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.FixtureWindowService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class B69FixtureMatchupService {

    private static final List<String> ROLES =
            List.of(
                    "P",
                    "D",
                    "C",
                    "A"
            );

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    private final FixtureWindowService fixtureWindowService;

    public B69FixtureMatchupService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            FixtureWindowService fixtureWindowService
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.fixtureWindowService =
                fixtureWindowService;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<B69FixtureMatchupResponse> findClubMatchups(
            String season,
            String club,
            int fromMatchday,
            int toMatchday
    ) {

        validate(
                season,
                club,
                fromMatchday,
                toMatchday
        );

        ClubIdentity clubIdentity =
                findClub(
                        season,
                        club
                );

        int horizon =
                toMatchday
                        - fromMatchday
                        + 1;

        Map<Long, B69RoleFixtureProfile> profiles =
                fixtureWindowService
                        .loadRoleAwareClubProfiles(
                                season,
                                List.of(
                                        clubIdentity.id()
                                ),
                                fromMatchday,
                                horizon
                        );

        B69RoleFixtureProfile profile =
                profiles.get(
                        clubIdentity.id()
                );

        if (profile == null) {
            return List.of();
        }

        List<B69FixtureMatchupResponse> response =
                new ArrayList<>();

        profile.matchdays()
                .values()
                .stream()
                .sorted(
                        Comparator.comparingInt(
                                B69RoleFixtureDay::matchday
                        )
                )
                .forEach(day ->
                        response.add(
                                toResponse(day)
                        )
                );

        return List.copyOf(response);
    }

    private B69FixtureMatchupResponse toResponse(
            B69RoleFixtureDay day
    ) {

        List<B69RoleDifficultyResponse> roles =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (String role : ROLES) {

            B69RoleMatchupScorer.MatchupResult matchup =
                    day.matchup(role);

            if (matchup == null) {

                roles.add(
                        new B69RoleDifficultyResponse(
                                role,
                                null,
                                "SCONOSCIUTA",
                                "NO_EVIDENCE",
                                java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO
                                        .setScale(2)
                        )
                );

                continue;
            }

            roles.add(
                    new B69RoleDifficultyResponse(
                            role,
                            matchup.difficultyScore(),
                            level(
                                    matchup.difficulty()
                            ),
                            matchup.evidenceTier(),
                            matchup.evidenceCoverage()
                    )
            );
        }

        return new B69FixtureMatchupResponse(
                day.fixtureId(),
                day.matchday(),
                day.kickoffAt(),
                day.clubId(),
                day.clubName(),
                day.opponentClubId(),
                day.opponentClubName(),
                day.home(),
                day.fixtureStatus(),
                roles
        );
    }

    private ClubIdentity findClub(
            String season,
            String club
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    club.id,
                    club.name,
                    club.slug

                FROM clubs club

                JOIN season_clubs membership
                    ON membership.club_id =
                        club.id

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id =
                        membership.season_id

                WHERE season.code =
                    :season

                  AND (
                      LOWER(club.slug) =
                        LOWER(:club)

                      OR LOWER(club.name) =
                        LOWER(:club)
                  )

                ORDER BY club.id

                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param(
                        "season",
                        season
                )
                .param(
                        "club",
                        club
                )
                .query(
                        (rs, rowNumber) ->
                                new ClubIdentity(
                                        rs.getLong(
                                                "id"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "name"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "slug"
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Club non trovato nella stagione "
                                        + season
                                        + ": "
                                        + club
                        )
                );
    }

    private String level(
            CalendarDifficulty difficulty
    ) {

        if (
                difficulty == null
                || difficulty
                    == CalendarDifficulty.UNKNOWN
        ) {
            return "SCONOSCIUTA";
        }

        return switch (difficulty) {

            case EASY ->
                    "FACILE";

            case MEDIUM ->
                    "MEDIA";

            case HARD ->
                    "DIFFICILE";

            case UNKNOWN ->
                    "SCONOSCIUTA";
        };
    }

    private void validate(
            String season,
            String club,
            int fromMatchday,
            int toMatchday
    ) {

        if (
                season == null
                || season.isBlank()
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Season is required"
            );
        }

        if (
                club == null
                || club.isBlank()
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Club is required"
            );
        }

        if (
                fromMatchday < 1
                || fromMatchday > 38
                || toMatchday < 1
                || toMatchday > 38
                || toMatchday < fromMatchday
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Invalid matchday range"
            );
        }

        if (
                toMatchday
                        - fromMatchday
                        + 1
                > 10
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Matchup window cannot exceed 10 matchdays"
            );
        }
    }

    private record ClubIdentity(
            Long id,
            String name,
            String slug
    ) {
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\fixture\FixtureDifficultyService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class FixtureDifficultyService {

    private static final double VENUE_ADVANTAGE = 4.0;

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public FixtureDifficultyService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<FixtureDifficultyResponse> findClubFixtures(
            String season,
            String club,
            int fromMatchday,
            int toMatchday
    ) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            fixture.id,
                            fixture.matchday,
                            fixture.kickoff_at,

                            home_club.name AS home_name,
                            home_club.slug AS home_slug,

                            away_club.name AS away_name,
                            away_club.slug AS away_slug,

                            home_strength.overall_rating
                                AS home_overall,

                            home_strength.attacking_rating
                                AS home_attack,

                            home_strength.defensive_rating
                                AS home_defense,

                            home_strength.home_rating
                                AS home_venue_rating,

                            away_strength.overall_rating
                                AS away_overall,

                            away_strength.attacking_rating
                                AS away_attack,

                            away_strength.defensive_rating
                                AS away_defense,

                            away_strength.away_rating
                                AS away_venue_rating

                        FROM fixtures fixture

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = fixture.season_id

                        JOIN clubs home_club
                            ON home_club.id =
                                fixture.home_club_id

                        JOIN clubs away_club
                            ON away_club.id =
                                fixture.away_club_id

                        JOIN club_strength_ratings home_strength
                            ON home_strength.club_id =
                                home_club.id
                            AND home_strength.season_id =
                                season.id

                        JOIN club_strength_ratings away_strength
                            ON away_strength.club_id =
                                away_club.id
                            AND away_strength.season_id =
                                season.id

                        WHERE season.code = :season
                          AND fixture.matchday BETWEEN
                              :fromMatchday
                              AND :toMatchday

                          AND (
                              LOWER(home_club.slug) =
                                  LOWER(:club)

                              OR LOWER(away_club.slug) =
                                  LOWER(:club)
                          )

                        ORDER BY
                            fixture.matchday,
                            fixture.id
                        """)
                        .param("season", season)
                        .param("club", club)
                        .param(
                                "fromMatchday",
                                fromMatchday
                        )
                        .param(
                                "toMatchday",
                                toMatchday
                        )
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        List<FixtureDifficultyResponse> response =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {
            boolean home =
                    row.get("home_slug")
                            .toString()
                            .equalsIgnoreCase(club);

            double difficulty = home
                    ? calculateHomeDifficulty(row)
                    : calculateAwayDifficulty(row);

            response.add(
                    new FixtureDifficultyResponse(
                            number(row, "id").longValue(),

                            number(
                                    row,
                                    "matchday"
                            ).intValue(),

                            toOffsetDateTime(
                                    row.get("kickoff_at")
                            ),

                            home
                                    ? row.get(
                                            "home_name"
                                    ).toString()
                                    : row.get(
                                            "away_name"
                                    ).toString(),

                            home
                                    ? row.get(
                                            "away_name"
                                    ).toString()
                                    : row.get(
                                            "home_name"
                                    ).toString(),

                            home,

                            decimal(difficulty),

                            difficultyLevel(difficulty)
                    )
            );
        }

        return response;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<MatchdayFixtureResponse> findMatchday(
            String season,
            int matchday
    ) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            fixture.id,
                            fixture.matchday,

                            home_club.name AS home_name,
                            away_club.name AS away_name,

                            home_strength.overall_rating
                                AS home_overall,

                            home_strength.attacking_rating
                                AS home_attack,

                            home_strength.defensive_rating
                                AS home_defense,

                            home_strength.home_rating
                                AS home_venue_rating,

                            away_strength.overall_rating
                                AS away_overall,

                            away_strength.attacking_rating
                                AS away_attack,

                            away_strength.defensive_rating
                                AS away_defense,

                            away_strength.away_rating
                                AS away_venue_rating

                        FROM fixtures fixture

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = fixture.season_id

                        JOIN clubs home_club
                            ON home_club.id =
                                fixture.home_club_id

                        JOIN clubs away_club
                            ON away_club.id =
                                fixture.away_club_id

                        JOIN club_strength_ratings home_strength
                            ON home_strength.club_id =
                                home_club.id
                            AND home_strength.season_id =
                                season.id

                        JOIN club_strength_ratings away_strength
                            ON away_strength.club_id =
                                away_club.id
                            AND away_strength.season_id =
                                season.id

                        WHERE season.code = :season
                          AND fixture.matchday = :matchday

                        ORDER BY
                            fixture.kickoff_at NULLS LAST,
                            fixture.id
                        """)
                        .param("season", season)
                        .param("matchday", matchday)
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        List<MatchdayFixtureResponse> response =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {
            double homeDifficulty =
                    calculateHomeDifficulty(row);

            double awayDifficulty =
                    calculateAwayDifficulty(row);

            response.add(
                    new MatchdayFixtureResponse(
                            number(row, "id").longValue(),

                            number(
                                    row,
                                    "matchday"
                            ).intValue(),

                            row.get(
                                    "home_name"
                            ).toString(),

                            row.get(
                                    "away_name"
                            ).toString(),

                            difficultyLevel(
                                    homeDifficulty
                            ),

                            difficultyLevel(
                                    awayDifficulty
                            )
                    )
            );
        }

        return response;
    }

    private double calculateHomeDifficulty(
            Map<String, Object> row
    ) {
        double opponentVenue =
                value(row, "away_venue_rating");

        double opponentOverall =
                value(row, "away_overall");

        double opponentAttack =
                value(row, "away_attack");

        double ownDefense =
                value(row, "home_defense");

        return clamp(
                opponentVenue * 0.35
                + opponentOverall * 0.20
                + opponentAttack * 0.30
                + (100 - ownDefense) * 0.15
                - VENUE_ADVANTAGE
        );
    }

    private double calculateAwayDifficulty(
            Map<String, Object> row
    ) {
        double opponentVenue =
                value(row, "home_venue_rating");

        double opponentOverall =
                value(row, "home_overall");

        double opponentAttack =
                value(row, "home_attack");

        double ownDefense =
                value(row, "away_defense");

        return clamp(
                opponentVenue * 0.35
                + opponentOverall * 0.20
                + opponentAttack * 0.30
                + (100 - ownDefense) * 0.15
                + VENUE_ADVANTAGE
        );
    }

    private double clamp(double value) {
        return Math.max(
                0,
                Math.min(value, 100)
        );
    }

    private String difficultyLevel(double score) {
        if (score < 50) {
            return "FACILE";
        }

        if (score < 70) {
            return "MEDIA";
        }

        return "DIFFICILE";
    }

    private BigDecimal decimal(double value) {
        return BigDecimal
                .valueOf(value)
                .setScale(
                        2,
                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                );
    }

    private Number number(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            String key
    ) {
        Object value = row.get(key);

        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number;
        }

        return 0;
    }

    private double value(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            String key
    ) {
        Object value = row.get(key);

        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number.doubleValue();
        }

        return 50.0;
    }

    private OffsetDateTime toOffsetDateTime(
            Object value
    ) {
        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (value instanceof OffsetDateTime dateTime) {
            return dateTime;
        }

        if (value instanceof java.sql.Timestamp timestamp) {
            return timestamp
                    .toInstant()
                    .atZone(
                            ZoneId.of("Europe/Rome")
                    )
                    .toOffsetDateTime();
        }

        if (value instanceof LocalDateTime dateTime) {
            return dateTime
                    .atZone(
                            ZoneId.of("Europe/Rome")
                    )
                    .toOffsetDateTime();
        }

        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Formato data non supportato: "
                        + value.getClass().getName()
        );
    }
}
