--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\ingestion\FantacalcioListoneSyncService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVFormat;
import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVPrinter;
import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.SecretSanitizer;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.importer.CsvImportPayload;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.importer.PlayerImportResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.importer.PlayerImportService;

@Service
public class FantacalcioListoneSyncService {

    static final String FEED_ID = "fantacalcio-listone-html";
    static final String SOURCE = "FANTACALCIO";

    private final FantacalcioListoneProperties properties;
    private final FantacalcioListoneClient client;
    private final FantacalcioListoneParser parser;
    private final PlayerImportService playerImportService;
    private final JdbcClient jdbc;

    public FantacalcioListoneSyncService(
            FantacalcioListoneProperties properties,
            FantacalcioListoneClient client,
            FantacalcioListoneParser parser,
            PlayerImportService playerImportService,
            JdbcClient jdbc
    ) {
        this.properties = properties;
        this.client = client;
        this.parser = parser;
        this.playerImportService = playerImportService;
        this.jdbc = jdbc;
    }

    public FantacalcioListoneSyncResponse sync(String season) {
        if (!properties.isEnabled()) {
            throw new ConflictException("Fantacalcio listone sync disabilitato");
        }

        long seasonId = seasonId(season);
        long runId = start(seasonId);

        try {
            FantacalcioListoneClient.FetchResult fetched = client.fetch();
            List<FantacalcioListoneParser.ListonePlayer> parsed =
                    parser.parse(fetched.html());

            Map<String, String> clubNamesBySlug = currentSeasonClubs(seasonId);
            byte[] csv = toCsv(parsed, clubNamesBySlug);
            String checksum = sha256(csv);

            Optional<String> previous = latestEffectiveChecksum(
                    seasonId,
                    runId
            );

            if (previous.filter(checksum::equals).isPresent()) {
                finish(
                        runId,
                        "SKIPPED_UNCHANGED",
                        fetched.httpStatus(),
                        fetched.payloadBytes(),
                        checksum,
                        null,
                        null
                );

                return response(runId, season, parsed.size());
            }

            String filename = "players-fantacalcio-" + season.replace("/", "-") + ".csv";
            PlayerImportResponse imported = playerImportService.importPayload(
                    SOURCE,
                    season,
                    new CsvImportPayload(filename, csv)
            );

            jdbc.sql("""
                    UPDATE import_batches
                    SET source_observed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    WHERE id = :id
                    """)
                    .param("id", imported.batchId())
                    .update();

            finish(
                    runId,
                    "COMPLETED",
                    fetched.httpStatus(),
                    fetched.payloadBytes(),
                    checksum,
                    imported.batchId(),
                    null
            );

            return response(runId, season, parsed.size());
        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
            finish(
                    runId,
                    "FAILED",
                    null,
                    null,
                    null,
                    null,
                    SecretSanitizer.sanitize(exception)
            );
            throw exception;
        }
    }

    private byte[] toCsv(
            List<FantacalcioListoneParser.ListonePlayer> players,
            Map<String, String> clubNamesBySlug
    ) {
        try {
            ByteArrayOutputStream output = new ByteArrayOutputStream();

            try (
                    OutputStreamWriter writer = new OutputStreamWriter(
                            output,
                            StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                    );
                    CSVPrinter printer = CSVFormat.DEFAULT.builder()
                            .setHeader(
                                    "external_id",
                                    "name",
                                    "club",
                                    "role",
                                    "quotation",
                                    "fmv",
                                    "out_of_game"
                            )
                            .get()
                            .print(writer)
            ) {
                for (FantacalcioListoneParser.ListonePlayer player : players) {
                    String club = clubNamesBySlug.get(player.clubSlug());
                    if (club == null) {
                        throw new BadRequestException(
                                "Club Fantacalcio non riconosciuto per la stagione: "
                                        + player.clubSlug()
                        );
                    }

                    printer.printRecord(
                            player.externalId(),
                            player.name(),
                            club,
                            player.role(),
                            number(player.quotation()),
                            number(player.fmv()),
                            Boolean.toString(player.outOfGame())
                    );
                }
            }

            return output.toByteArray();
        } catch (BadRequestException exception) {
            throw exception;
        } catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Conversione listone Fantacalcio in CSV fallita",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    private Object number(BigDecimal value) {
        return value == null ? "" : value.stripTrailingZeros().toPlainString();
    }

    private Map<String, String> currentSeasonClubs(long seasonId) {
        List<String> clubs = jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT club.name
                FROM season_clubs membership
                JOIN clubs club ON club.id = membership.club_id
                WHERE membership.season_id = :seasonId
                """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .query(String.class)
                .list();

        Map<String, String> result = new HashMap<>();
        for (String club : clubs) {
            result.put(slugify(club), club);
        }

        // Fantacalcio URL conventions / common aliases.
        alias(result, "inter", "Internazionale");
        alias(result, "milan", "Milan");
        alias(result, "roma", "Roma");
        alias(result, "lazio", "Lazio");

        return result;
    }

    private void alias(Map<String, String> map, String slug, String expectedName) {
        if (map.containsKey(slug)) {
            return;
        }
        map.values().stream()
                .filter(value -> value.equalsIgnoreCase(expectedName))
                .findFirst()
                .ifPresent(value -> map.put(slug, value));
    }

    static String slugify(String value) {
        String normalized = java.text.Normalizer
                .normalize(value, java.text.Normalizer.Form.NFD)
                .replaceAll("\\p{M}", "")
                .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)
                .replace("&", " ")
                .replaceAll("[^a-z0-9]+", "-")
                .replaceAll("^-+|-+$", "");
        return normalized;
    }

    private long start(long seasonId) {
        recoverStale(seasonId);
        try {
            return jdbc.sql("""
                    INSERT INTO source_ingestion_runs (
                        feed_id,
                        feed_type,
                        source,
                        season_id,
                        sanitized_url,
                        status
                    )
                    VALUES (
                        :feed,
                        'PLAYERS',
                        :source,
                        :season,
                        :url,
                        'STARTED'
                    )
                    RETURNING id
                    """)
                    .param("feed", FEED_ID)
                    .param("source", SOURCE)
                    .param("season", seasonId)
                    .param("url", properties.getUrl())
                    .query(Long.class)
                    .single();
        } catch (DataIntegrityViolationException exception) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Sync listone Fantacalcio gia' in esecuzione"
            );
        }
    }

    private void recoverStale(long seasonId) {
        jdbc.sql("""
                UPDATE source_ingestion_runs
                SET status = 'FAILED',
                    completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    error_message = 'Sync listone interrotta recuperata automaticamente'
                WHERE feed_id = :feed
                  AND season_id = :season
                  AND status = 'STARTED'
                  AND started_at <
                      CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                      - (:staleSeconds * INTERVAL '1 second')
                """)
                .param("feed", FEED_ID)
                .param("season", seasonId)
                .param(
                        "staleSeconds",
                        properties.getStaleThreshold().toSeconds()
                )
                .update();
    }

    private Optional<String> latestEffectiveChecksum(
            long seasonId,
            long runId
    ) {
        return jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT payload_sha256
                FROM source_ingestion_runs
                WHERE feed_id = :feed
                  AND season_id = :season
                  AND status IN ('COMPLETED', 'SKIPPED_UNCHANGED')
                  AND id < :runId
                ORDER BY id DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param("feed", FEED_ID)
                .param("season", seasonId)
                .param("runId", runId)
                .query(String.class)
                .optional();
    }

    private void finish(
            long runId,
            String status,
            Integer httpStatus,
            Long payloadBytes,
            String checksum,
            Long importBatchId,
            String error
    ) {
        jdbc.sql("""
                UPDATE source_ingestion_runs
                SET status = :status,
                    http_status = :httpStatus,
                    payload_bytes = :payloadBytes,
                    payload_sha256 = :checksum,
                    import_batch_id = :importBatchId,
                    error_message = :error,
                    completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE id = :runId
                """)
                .param("status", status)
                .param("httpStatus", httpStatus, java.sql.Types.INTEGER)
                .param("payloadBytes", payloadBytes, java.sql.Types.BIGINT)
                .param("checksum", checksum, java.sql.Types.VARCHAR)
                .param("importBatchId", importBatchId, java.sql.Types.BIGINT)
                .param(
                        "error",
                        error == null ? null : truncate(error, 2000),
                        java.sql.Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param("runId", runId)
                .update();
    }

    private FantacalcioListoneSyncResponse response(
            long runId,
            String season,
            int parsedPlayers
    ) {
        return jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT id,
                       status,
                       payload_sha256,
                       import_batch_id,
                       started_at,
                       completed_at
                FROM source_ingestion_runs
                WHERE id = :id
                """)
                .param("id", runId)
                .query((rs, rowNum) -> mapResponse(
                        rs,
                        season,
                        parsedPlayers
                ))
                .single();
    }

    private FantacalcioListoneSyncResponse mapResponse(
            ResultSet rs,
            String season,
            int parsedPlayers
    ) throws SQLException {
        return new FantacalcioListoneSyncResponse(
                rs.getLong("id"),
                season,
                rs.getString("status"),
                parsedPlayers,
                (Long) rs.getObject("import_batch_id"),
                rs.getString("payload_sha256"),
                rs.getObject("started_at", OffsetDateTime.class),
                rs.getObject("completed_at", OffsetDateTime.class)
        );
    }

    private long seasonId(String code) {
        return jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM seasons
                WHERE code = :code
                """)
                .param("code", code)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(
                        "Stagione non trovata: " + code
                ));
    }

    private String sha256(byte[] value) {
        try {
            return HexFormat.of().formatHex(
                    MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(value)
            );
        } catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(exception);
        }
    }

    private String truncate(String value, int max) {
        return value.length() <= max ? value : value.substring(0, max);
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\ingestion\RemoteCsvClient.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.util.Locale;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;

@Component
public class RemoteCsvClient {

    private final SourceIngestionProperties config;
    private final HttpClient client;

    public RemoteCsvClient(SourceIngestionProperties config) {
        this.config = config;
        this.client = HttpClient.newBuilder()
                .connectTimeout(config.getConnectTimeout())
                .followRedirects(HttpClient.Redirect.NEVER)
                .build();
    }

    public FetchResult fetch(String value) {
        URI uri = validate(value);
        int redirects = 0;
        try {
            while (true) {
                HttpRequest request = HttpRequest.newBuilder(uri)
                        .timeout(config.getRequestTimeout())
                        .header("User-Agent", "Fantacalcio-Intelligence-Source-Ingestion/1.0")
                        .header("Accept", "text/csv,text/plain;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.1")
                        .GET()
                        .build();
                HttpResponse<java.io.InputStream> response = client.send(
                        request,
                        HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofInputStream()
                );
                int status = response.statusCode();
                if (status >= 300 && status < 400) {
                    String location;
                    try (var ignored = response.body()) {
                        if (++redirects > config.getMaxRedirects()) {
                            throw new BadRequestException("Troppi redirect remoti");
                        }
                        location = response.headers().firstValue("location")
                                .orElseThrow(() -> new BadRequestException(
                                        "Redirect remoto senza destinazione"
                                ));
                    }
                    uri = validate(uri.resolve(location).toString());
                    continue;
                }
                if (status < 200 || status >= 300) {
                    throw new BadRequestException("Fonte remota ha risposto HTTP " + status);
                }
                String contentType = response.headers().firstValue("content-type")
                        .orElse("").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                if (contentType.startsWith("text/html")) {
                    response.body().close();
                    throw new BadRequestException("La fonte remota ha restituito HTML invece di CSV");
                }
                try (var input = response.body(); var output = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
                    byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
                    int total = 0;
                    int read;
                    while ((read = input.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                        total += read;
                        if (total > config.getMaxBytes()) {
                            throw new BadRequestException("Payload remoto supera il limite configurato");
                        }
                        output.write(buffer, 0, read);
                    }
                    if (total == 0) {
                        throw new BadRequestException("Payload remoto vuoto");
                    }
                    return new FetchResult(output.toByteArray(), status, uri, safeFilename(uri));
                }
            }
        } catch (BadRequestException exception) {
            throw exception;
        } catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException("Download remoto fallito", exception);
        }
    }

    URI validate(String value) {
        try {
            URI uri = URI.create(value);
            if (!uri.isAbsolute() || uri.getHost() == null || uri.getUserInfo() != null) {
                throw new BadRequestException("URL feed non valido");
            }
            String scheme = uri.getScheme().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (!scheme.equals("https") && !(scheme.equals("http") && config.isAllowHttp())) {
                throw new BadRequestException("Schema URL feed non consentito");
            }
            if (!config.isAllowPrivateHosts()) {
                for (InetAddress address : InetAddress.getAllByName(uri.getHost())) {
                    if (address.isAnyLocalAddress()
                            || address.isLoopbackAddress()
                            || address.isLinkLocalAddress()
                            || address.isSiteLocalAddress()) {
                        throw new BadRequestException("Host privato/locale non consentito");
                    }
                }
            }
            return uri;
        } catch (BadRequestException exception) {
            throw exception;
        } catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException("URL feed non valido", exception);
        }
    }

    public static String sanitized(URI uri) {
        try {
            return new URI(
                    uri.getScheme(), null, uri.getHost(), uri.getPort(), uri.getPath(), null, null
            ).toString();
        } catch (Exception exception) {
            return uri.getScheme() + "://" + uri.getHost();
        }
    }

    private String safeFilename(URI uri) {
        String path = uri.getPath();
        String name = path == null ? "" : path.substring(path.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
        return name.matches("[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,255}") ? name : "remote-feed.csv";
    }

    public record FetchResult(byte[] bytes, int httpStatus, URI finalUri, String filename) {}
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import java.net.URI;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.InitializingBean;
import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "app.source-ingestion")
public class SourceIngestionProperties implements InitializingBean {

    private boolean enabled;
    private boolean allowHttp;
    private boolean allowPrivateHosts;
    private Duration connectTimeout = Duration.ofSeconds(5);
    private Duration requestTimeout = Duration.ofSeconds(20);
    private Duration staleThreshold = Duration.ofHours(2);
    private int maxBytes = 5_000_000;
    private int maxRedirects = 3;
    private List<Feed> feeds = new ArrayList<>();

    @Override
    public void afterPropertiesSet() {
        validateEnabledConfiguration();
    }

    public void validateEnabledConfiguration() {
        if (staleThreshold == null || staleThreshold.isZero() || staleThreshold.isNegative()) {
            throw invalid("stale-threshold deve essere maggiore di zero");
        }
        if (!enabled) {
            return;
        }
        if (maxBytes <= 0) {
            throw invalid("max-bytes deve essere maggiore di zero");
        }
        if (maxRedirects < 0) {
            throw invalid("max-redirects non puÃ² essere negativo");
        }
        if (connectTimeout == null || connectTimeout.isZero() || connectTimeout.isNegative()) {
            throw invalid("connect-timeout deve essere maggiore di zero");
        }
        if (requestTimeout == null || requestTimeout.isZero() || requestTimeout.isNegative()) {
            throw invalid("request-timeout deve essere maggiore di zero");
        }

        List<Feed> enabledFeeds = feeds.stream().filter(Feed::isEnabled).toList();
        if (enabledFeeds.isEmpty()) {
            throw invalid("Ã¨ richiesto almeno un feed abilitato");
        }

        Set<String> ids = new HashSet<>();
        for (Feed feed : enabledFeeds) {
            requireText(feed.id, "id");
            String normalizedId = feed.id.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (!ids.add(normalizedId)) {
                throw invalid("id feed duplicato: " + feed.id.trim());
            }
            requireText(feed.type, "type");
            try {
                SourceFeedType.valueOf(feed.type.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {
                throw invalid("tipo feed non valido: " + feed.type);
            }
            requireText(feed.source, "source");
            requireText(feed.season, "season");
            requireText(feed.url, "url");
            validateUrlSyntax(feed.url);
            if (feed.filename != null
                    && (feed.filename.isBlank()
                    || !feed.filename.matches("[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,255}"))) {
                throw invalid("filename feed non sicuro");
            }
        }
    }

    private void validateUrlSyntax(String value) {
        try {
            URI uri = URI.create(value);
            if (!uri.isAbsolute() || uri.getHost() == null || uri.getUserInfo() != null) {
                throw invalid("URL feed non valido");
            }
            String scheme = uri.getScheme().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (!scheme.equals("https") && !(scheme.equals("http") && allowHttp)) {
                throw invalid("schema URL feed non consentito");
            }
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {
            if (exception.getMessage() != null
                    && exception.getMessage().startsWith("Configurazione source ingestion non valida:")) {
                throw exception;
            }
            throw invalid("URL feed non valido");
        }
    }

    private void requireText(String value, String field) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            throw invalid("campo feed " + field + " mancante");
        }
    }

    private IllegalStateException invalid(String detail) {
        return new IllegalStateException("Configurazione source ingestion non valida: " + detail);
    }

    public boolean isEnabled() {
        return enabled;
    }

    public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
        this.enabled = enabled;
    }

    public boolean isAllowHttp() {
        return allowHttp;
    }

    public void setAllowHttp(boolean allowHttp) {
        this.allowHttp = allowHttp;
    }

    public boolean isAllowPrivateHosts() {
        return allowPrivateHosts;
    }

    public void setAllowPrivateHosts(boolean allowPrivateHosts) {
        this.allowPrivateHosts = allowPrivateHosts;
    }

    public Duration getConnectTimeout() {
        return connectTimeout;
    }

    public void setConnectTimeout(Duration connectTimeout) {
        this.connectTimeout = connectTimeout;
    }

    public Duration getRequestTimeout() {
        return requestTimeout;
    }

    public void setRequestTimeout(Duration requestTimeout) {
        this.requestTimeout = requestTimeout;
    }

    public Duration getStaleThreshold() {
        return staleThreshold;
    }

    public void setStaleThreshold(Duration staleThreshold) {
        this.staleThreshold = staleThreshold;
    }

    public int getMaxBytes() {

    }

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\ingestion\SourceIngestionService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import java.net.URI;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.regex.MatchResult;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.SecretSanitizer;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture.importer.FixtureImportService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.importer.CsvImportPayload;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.importer.PlayerImportService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.statistics.importer.PlayerStatisticsImportService;

@Service
public class SourceIngestionService {

    private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(SourceIngestionService.class);
    private static final Pattern AUTHORIZATION = Pattern.compile(
            "(?i)\\bauthorization\\s*[:=]\\s*[^\\r\\n]*"
    );
    private static final Pattern POSTGRESQL_JDBC_URL = Pattern.compile(
            "(?i)\\bjdbc:postgresql://[^\\s,;]+"
    );
    private static final Pattern HTTP_URL = Pattern.compile(
            "(?i)\\bhttps?://[^\\s,;]+"
    );
    private static final Pattern SENSITIVE_VALUE = Pattern.compile(
            "(?i)\\b(password|passwd|pwd|token|api[_-]?key|apikey|secret)"
                    + "(\\s*[:=]\\s*)(?:\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*'|[^\\s,;]+)"
    );

    private final SourceIngestionProperties config;
    private final RemoteCsvClient remote;
    private final JdbcClient jdbc;
    private final PlayerImportService players;
    private final PlayerStatisticsImportService statistics;
    private final FixtureImportService fixtures;

    public SourceIngestionService(
            SourceIngestionProperties config,
            RemoteCsvClient remote,
            JdbcClient jdbc,
            PlayerImportService players,
            PlayerStatisticsImportService statistics,
            FixtureImportService fixtures
    ) {
        this.config = config;
        this.remote = remote;
        this.jdbc = jdbc;
        this.players = players;
        this.statistics = statistics;
        this.fixtures = fixtures;
    }

    public List<SourceIngestionResponse> ingestAll(String season) {
        requireEnabled();
        List<SourceIngestionProperties.Feed> feeds = config.getFeeds().stream()
                .filter(SourceIngestionProperties.Feed::isEnabled)
                .filter(feed -> season.equals(feed.getSeason()))
                .toList();
        if (feeds.isEmpty()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Nessun feed abilitato configurato per la stagione richiesta"
            );
        }
        return feeds.stream().map(this::ingest).toList();
    }

    public SourceIngestionResponse ingestOne(String id) {
        requireEnabled();
        return ingest(findFeed(id));
    }

    public List<SourceIngestionResponse> latest(String season) {
        return jdbc.sql(baseSelect() + """
                JOIN seasons season ON season.id = run.season_id
                WHERE season.code = :season
                  AND run.id IN (
                      SELECT MAX(r.id)
                      FROM source_ingestion_runs r
                      WHERE r.season_id = season.id
                      GROUP BY r.feed_id
                  )
                ORDER BY run.feed_id
                """)
                .param("season", season)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) -> map(
                        resultSet,
                        isRequired(resultSet.getString("feed_id"))
                ))
                .list();
    }

    private SourceIngestionResponse ingest(SourceIngestionProperties.Feed feed) {
        validateFeed(feed);
        long seasonId = seasonId(feed.getSeason());
        long runId = start(feed, seasonId);
        try {
            RemoteCsvClient.FetchResult fetched = remote.fetch(feed.getUrl());
            String checksum = sha256(fetched.bytes());
            Optional<String> effectiveChecksum = latestEffectiveChecksum(
                    feed.getId(), seasonId, runId
            );
            if (effectiveChecksum.filter(checksum::equals).isPresent()) {
                finish(
                        runId,
                        "SKIPPED_UNCHANGED",
                        fetched.httpStatus(),
                        (long) fetched.bytes().length,
                        checksum,
                        null,
                        null
                );
                return find(runId, feed.isRequired());
            }

            String filename = feed.getFilename() == null || feed.getFilename().isBlank()
                    ? fetched.filename()
                    : feed.getFilename();
            CsvImportPayload payload = new CsvImportPayload(filename, fetched.bytes());
            SourceFeedType feedType = type(feed);
            long batchId = importPayload(feedType, feed, payload);
            observe(feedType, batchId);
            finish(
                    runId,
                    "COMPLETED",
                    fetched.httpStatus(),
                    (long) fetched.bytes().length,
                    checksum,
                    batchId,
                    null
            );
            LOG.info(
                    "Source ingestion feed={} source={} season={} status=COMPLETED "
                            + "bytes={} checksum={} batch={}",
                    feed.getId(),
                    feed.getSource(),
                    feed.getSeason(),
                    fetched.bytes().length,
                    checksum.substring(0, 12),
                    batchId
            );
            return find(runId, feed.isRequired());
        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
            finish(runId, "FAILED", null, null, null, null, safe(exception));
            LOG.warn(
                    "Source ingestion feed={} source={} season={} status=FAILED",
                    feed.getId(),
                    feed.getSource(),
                    feed.getSeason()
            );
            return find(runId, feed.isRequired());
        }
    }

    private Optional<String> latestEffectiveChecksum(String feedId, long seasonId, long runId) {
        return jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT payload_sha256
                FROM source_ingestion_runs
                WHERE feed_id = :feed
                  AND season_id = :season
                  AND status IN ('COMPLETED', 'SKIPPED_UNCHANGED')
                  AND id < :run
                ORDER BY id DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param("feed", feedId)
                .param("season", seasonId)
                .param("run", runId)
                .query(String.class)
                .optional();
    }

    private long importPayload(
            SourceFeedType feedType,
            SourceIngestionProperties.Feed feed,
            CsvImportPayload payload
    ) {
        return switch (feedType) {
            case PLAYERS -> players.importPayload(
                    feed.getSource(), feed.getSeason(), payload
            ).batchId();
            case STATISTICS -> statistics.importPayload(
                    feed.getSource(), feed.getSeason(), payload
            ).batchId();
            case FIXTURES -> fixtures.importPayload(
                    feed.getSource(), feed.getSeason(), payload
            ).batchId();
        };
    }

    long start(SourceIngestionProperties.Feed feed, long seasonId) {
        jdbc.sql("""
                UPDATE source_ingestion_runs
                SET status = 'FAILED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    error_message = 'Ingestion interrotta recuperata automaticamente'
                WHERE feed_id = :feed AND season_id = :season
                  AND status = 'STARTED'
                  AND started_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (:staleSeconds * INTERVAL '1 second')
                """)
                .param("feed", feed.getId())
                .param("season", seasonId)
                .param("staleSeconds", config.getStaleThreshold().toSeconds())
                .update();
        try {
            return jdbc.sql("""
                    INSERT INTO source_ingestion_runs (
                        feed_id, feed_type, source, season_id, sanitized_url, status
                    )
                    VALUES (:id, :type, :source, :season, :url, 'STARTED')
                    RETURNING id
                    """)
                    .param("id", feed.getId())
                    .param("type", type(feed).name())
                    .param("source", feed.getSource().trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT))
                    .param("season", seasonId)
                    .param("url", RemoteCsvClient.sanitized(remote.validate(feed.getUrl())))
                    .query(Long.class)
                    .single();
        } catch (DataIntegrityViolationException exception) {
            throw new ConflictException("Ingestion feed giÃ  in esecuzione");
        }
    }

    private void finish(
            long id,
            String status,
            Integer httpStatus,
            Long payloadBytes,
            String checksum,
            Long batchId,
            String error
    ) {
        jdbc.sql("""
                UPDATE source_ingestion_runs
                SET status = :status,
                    http_status = :http,
                    payload_bytes = :bytes,
                    payload_sha256 = :sha,
                    import_batch_id = :batch,
                    error_message = :error,
                    completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE id = :id
                """)
                .param("status", status)
                .param("http", httpStatus)
                .param("bytes", payloadBytes)
                .param("sha", checksum)
                .param("batch", batchId)
                .param("error", error)
                .param("id", id)
                .update();
    }

    private void observe(SourceFeedType feedType, long batchId) {
        String table = switch (feedType) {
            case PLAYERS -> "import_batches";
            case STATISTICS -> "player_statistics_import_batches";
            case FIXTURES -> "fixture_import_batches";
        };
        jdbc.sql("UPDATE " + table + " SET source_observed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = :id")
                .param("id", batchId)
                .update();
    }

    private SourceIngestionResponse find(long id, boolean required) {
        return jdbc.sql(baseSelect() + """
                JOIN seasons season ON season.id = run.season_id
                WHERE run.id = :id
                """)
                .param("id", id)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) -> map(resultSet, required))
                .single();
    }

    private String baseSelect() {
        return """
                SELECT run.*, season.code AS season_code
                FROM source_ingestion_runs run
                """;
    }

    private SourceIngestionResponse map(ResultSet resultSet, boolean required) throws SQLException {
        return new SourceIngestionResponse(
                resultSet.getLong("id"),
                resultSet.getString("feed_id"),
                resultSet.getString("feed_type"),
                resultSet.getString("source"),
                resultSet.getString("season_code"),
                resultSet.getString("status"),
                (Integer) resultSet.getObject("http_status"),
                (Long) resultSet.getObject("payload_bytes"),
                resultSet.getString("payload_sha256"),
                (Long) resultSet.getObject("import_batch_id"),
                resultSet.getString("error_message"),
                resultSet.getObject("started_at", OffsetDateTime.class),
                resultSet.getObject("completed_at", OffsetDateTime.class),
                required
        );
    }

    private long seasonId(String code) {
        return jdbc.sql("SELECT id FROM seasons WHERE code = :code")
                .param("code", code)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(
                        "Stagione non trovata: " + code
                ));
    }

    private SourceIngestionProperties.Feed findFeed(String id) {
        return config.getFeeds().stream()
                .filter(feed -> feed.isEnabled() && feed.getId().equals(id))
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(
                        "Feed configurato non trovato"
                ));
    }

    private boolean isRequired(String id) {
        return config.getFeeds().stream()
                .filter(feed -> id.equals(feed.getId()))
                .findFirst()
                .map(SourceIngestionProperties.Feed::isRequired)
                .orElse(false);
    }

    private void requireEnabled() {
        if (!config.isEnabled()) {
            throw new ConflictException("Source ingestion disabilitata");
        }
    }

    private void validateFeed(SourceIngestionProperties.Feed feed) {
        if (feed.getId() == null
                || feed.getId().isBlank()
                || feed.getSource() == null
                || feed.getSeason() == null
                || feed.getUrl() == null
                || feed.getType() == null) {
            throw new BadRequestException("Configurazione feed incompleta");
        }
        type(feed);
    }

    private SourceFeedType type(SourceIngestionProperties.Feed feed) {
        try {
            return SourceFeedType.valueOf(feed.getType().trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
        } catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException("Tipo feed non valido");
        }
    }

    private String sha256(byte[] bytes) {
        try {
            return HexFormat.of().formatHex(
                    MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes)
            );
        } catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(exception);
        }
    }

    static String safe(Throwable exception) {
        return SecretSanitizer.sanitize(exception);
    }

    private static String sanitizeHttpUrl(MatchResult match) {
        try {
            return RemoteCsvClient.sanitized(URI.create(match.group()));
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) {
            return "[REDACTED]";
        }
    }
}

@Component
public class IntelligenceCatalogPolicy {

    public IntelligenceCatalogPolicy(CatalogReadinessService readinessService) {
        this.readinessService = readinessService;
    }

    public void assertReadable(String season, boolean currentSeason) {

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\intelligence\PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculator.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.intelligence;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculator {

    public static final String MODEL_VERSION = "1.0";
    private static final BigDecimal ONE_HUNDRED = BigDecimal.valueOf(100);

    public CalculatedProfile calculate(SeasonData current, SeasonData previous) {
        BigDecimal completeness = completeness(current);
        String confidence = confidence(completeness);
        return new CalculatedProfile(
                completeness,
                confidence,
                starter(current, confidence),
                reliability(current, confidence),
                bonus(current, confidence),
                malus(current, confidence),
                unavailable("Servono voti partita-per-partita; le medie stagionali non misurano la varianza"),
                trend(current, previous, confidence)
        );
    }

    private ProfileScore starter(SeasonData d, String confidence) {
        if (d.appearances() == null || d.appearances() == 0
                || d.starts() == null || d.minutes() == null) {
            return unavailable("Presenze, titolaritÃ  e minuti sono necessari");
        }
        BigDecimal starts = ratio(d.starts(), d.appearances(), 100);
        BigDecimal minutesShare = clamp(ratio(d.minutes(), d.appearances() * 90, 100));
        BigDecimal score = weighted(starts, 70, minutesShare, 30);
        return score(score, confidence,
                Map.of("startPercentage", starts, "minutesShare", minutesShare),
                List.of(d.starts() + " partenze su " + d.appearances() + " presenze",
                        d.minutes() + " minuti giocati"));
    }

    private ProfileScore reliability(SeasonData d, String confidence) {
        if (d.appearances() == null && d.minutes() == null) {
            return unavailable("Presenze o minuti sono necessari");
        }
        BigDecimal appearances = d.appearances() == null ? null
                : clamp(ratio(d.appearances(), 38, 100));
        BigDecimal minutes = d.minutes() == null ? null
                : clamp(ratio(d.minutes(), 3420, 100));
        BigDecimal score = averageWeighted(appearances, 60, minutes, 40);
        Map<String, BigDecimal> components = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (appearances != null) components.put("appearanceCoverage", appearances);
        if (minutes != null) components.put("minutesCoverage", minutes);
        return score(score, confidence, components,
                List.of("Copertura stagionale basata su presenze e minuti disponibili"));
    }

    private ProfileScore bonus(SeasonData d, String confidence) {
        if (d.minutes() == null || d.minutes() == 0
                || (d.goals() == null && d.assists() == null)) {
            return unavailable("Minuti e almeno una metrica offensiva sono necessari");
        }
        double goalBenchmark = switch (d.role()) {
            case "P" -> 0.04; case "D" -> 0.12; case "C" -> 0.25; default -> 0.50;
        };
        double assistBenchmark = switch (d.role()) {
            case "P" -> 0.02; case "D" -> 0.12; case "C" -> 0.25; default -> 0.20;
        };
        BigDecimal goalsPer90 = d.goals() == null ? null : per90(d.goals(), d.minutes());
        BigDecimal assistsPer90 = d.assists() == null ? null : per90(d.assists(), d.minutes());
        BigDecimal goalComponent = goalsPer90 == null ? null
                : clamp(goalsPer90.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100 / goalBenchmark)));
        BigDecimal assistComponent = assistsPer90 == null ? null
                : clamp(assistsPer90.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100 / assistBenchmark)));
        BigDecimal result = averageWeighted(goalComponent, 65, assistComponent, 35);
        Map<String, BigDecimal> components = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (goalsPer90 != null) components.put("goalsPer90", goalsPer90);
        if (assistsPer90 != null) components.put("assistsPer90", assistsPer90);
        return score(result, confidence, components,
                List.of("Soglie offensive normalizzate per il ruolo " + d.role()));
    }

    private ProfileScore malus(SeasonData d, String confidence) {
        if (d.appearances() == null || d.appearances() == 0
                || (d.yellowCards() == null && d.redCards() == null && d.penaltiesMissed() == null)) {
            return unavailable("Presenze e almeno una metrica disciplinare sono necessari");
        }
        BigDecimal yellow = d.yellowCards() == null ? null
                : clamp(ratio(d.yellowCards(), d.appearances(), 100).divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(.30), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP));
        BigDecimal red = d.redCards() == null ? null
                : clamp(ratio(d.redCards(), d.appearances(), 100).divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(.08), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP));
        BigDecimal missed = d.penaltiesMissed() == null ? null
                : clamp(ratio(d.penaltiesMissed(), d.appearances(), 100).divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(.05), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP));
        BigDecimal result = averageWeighted(yellow, 45, red, 35, missed, 20);
        Map<String, BigDecimal> components = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (yellow != null) components.put("yellowCardRisk", yellow);
        if (red != null) components.put("redCardRisk", red);
        if (missed != null) components.put("penaltyMissRisk", missed);
        return score(result, confidence, components, List.of("Rischio per presenza, non totale grezzo"));
    }

    private ProfileScore trend(SeasonData current, SeasonData previous, String confidence) {
        if (previous == null) return unavailable("Una sola stagione disponibile: nessuna penalizzazione applicata");
        BigDecimal currentMetric = trendMetric(current);
        BigDecimal previousMetric = trendMetric(previous);
        if (currentMetric == null || previousMetric == null) {
            return unavailable("Metriche comparabili insufficienti tra le stagioni");
        }
        BigDecimal delta = currentMetric.subtract(previousMetric);
        BigDecimal result = clamp(BigDecimal.valueOf(50).add(delta.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(25))));
        return score(result, confidence, Map.of("seasonDelta", delta.setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)),
                List.of("Confronto con la stagione " + previous.season()));
    }

    private BigDecimal trendMetric(SeasonData d) {
        if (d.fantasyAverage() != null) return d.fantasyAverage();
        if (d.minutes() == null || d.minutes() == 0) return null;
        int bonus = (d.goals() == null ? 0 : d.goals()) + (d.assists() == null ? 0 : d.assists());
        return per90(bonus, d.minutes());
    }

    private BigDecimal completeness(SeasonData d) {
        Object[] fields = {d.appearances(), d.starts(), d.minutes(), d.goals(), d.assists(),
                d.yellowCards(), d.redCards(), d.penaltiesMissed(), d.averageRating(), d.fantasyAverage()};
        int present = 0;
        for (Object field : fields) if (field != null) present++;
        return BigDecimal.valueOf(present * 10L).setScale(2);
    }

    private String confidence(BigDecimal completeness) {
        if (completeness.compareTo(BigDecimal.valueOf(80)) >= 0) return "HIGH";
        if (completeness.compareTo(BigDecimal.valueOf(50)) >= 0) return "MEDIUM";
        return "LOW";
    }

    private ProfileScore unavailable(String limitation) {
        return new ProfileScore(null, "UNAVAILABLE", Map.of(), List.of(), List.of(limitation));
    }

    private ProfileScore score(BigDecimal value, String confidence, Map<String, BigDecimal> components,
            List<String> reasons) {
        return new ProfileScore(clamp(value), confidence, Map.copyOf(components), List.copyOf(reasons), List.of());
    }

    private BigDecimal per90(int value, int minutes) { return ratio(value * 90, minutes, 1); }
    private BigDecimal ratio(int numerator, int denominator, int multiplier) {
        return BigDecimal.valueOf(numerator).multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(multiplier))
                .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(denominator), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }
    private BigDecimal weighted(BigDecimal a, int aw, BigDecimal b, int bw) {
        return a.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(aw)).add(b.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(bw)))
                .divide(ONE_HUNDRED, 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }
    private BigDecimal averageWeighted(BigDecimal a, int aw, BigDecimal b, int bw) {
        return averageWeighted(new BigDecimal[] {a, b}, new int[] {aw, bw});
    }
    private BigDecimal averageWeighted(BigDecimal a, int aw, BigDecimal b, int bw,
            BigDecimal c, int cw) {
        return averageWeighted(new BigDecimal[] {a, b, c}, new int[] {aw, bw, cw});
    }
    private BigDecimal averageWeighted(BigDecimal[] values, int[] weightValues) {
        BigDecimal total = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        int weights = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
            BigDecimal value = values[i];
            int weight = weightValues[i];
            if (value != null) { total = total.add(value.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(weight))); weights += weight; }
        }
        return weights == 0 ? null : total.divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(weights), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }
    private BigDecimal clamp(BigDecimal value) {
        if (value == null) return null;
        return value.max(BigDecimal.ZERO).min(ONE_HUNDRED).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    public record SeasonData(String season, String role, Integer appearances, Integer starts, Integer minutes,
            Integer goals, Integer assists, Integer yellowCards, Integer redCards, Integer penaltiesMissed,
            BigDecimal averageRating, BigDecimal fantasyAverage) {}
    public record CalculatedProfile(BigDecimal completeness, String confidence, ProfileScore starter,
            ProfileScore reliability, ProfileScore bonus, ProfileScore malus, ProfileScore consistency,
            ProfileScore trend) {}
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\intelligence\PlayerIntelligenceProfileService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.intelligence;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.intelligence.PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculator.CalculatedProfile;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.intelligence.PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculator.SeasonData;

@Service
public class PlayerIntelligenceProfileService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final IntelligenceCatalogPolicy catalogPolicy;
    private final PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculator calculator;

    public PlayerIntelligenceProfileService(JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            IntelligenceCatalogPolicy catalogPolicy,
            PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculator calculator) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.catalogPolicy = catalogPolicy;
        this.calculator = calculator;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public PlayerIntelligenceProfileResponse find(Long playerId, String season) {
        SeasonRef seasonRef = findSeason(season);
        catalogPolicy.assertReadable(season, seasonRef.current());
        Map<String, Object> player = findOperationalPlayer(playerId, seasonRef.id());
        List<SeasonData> history = loadHistory(playerId, seasonRef.startYear());
        SeasonData current = history.stream().filter(item -> season.equals(item.season())).findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(
                        "Statistiche non disponibili per il giocatore e la stagione"));
        SeasonData previous = history.stream().filter(item -> !season.equals(item.season())).findFirst().orElse(null);
        CalculatedProfile result = calculator.calculate(current, previous);
        return new PlayerIntelligenceProfileResponse(playerId, player.get("display_name").toString(), season,
                player.get("fantasy_role").toString(), PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculator.MODEL_VERSION,
                result.completeness(), result.confidence(), result.starter(), result.reliability(), result.bonus(),
                result.malus(), result.consistency(), result.trend());
    }

    private SeasonRef findSeason(String code) {
        if (code == null || code.isBlank()) throw new ResourceNotFoundException("Stagione non trovata");
        return jdbcClient.sql("SELECT id, start_year, current_season FROM seasons WHERE code = :code")
                .param("code", code.trim()).query((rs, row) -> new SeasonRef(rs.getLong("id"),
                        rs.getInt("start_year"), rs.getBoolean("current_season"))).optional()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Stagione non trovata: " + code));
    }

    private Map<String, Object> findOperationalPlayer(Long playerId, long seasonId) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT player.display_name, role.fantasy_role
                FROM player_reconciliation_results result
                JOIN players player ON player.id = result.player_id AND player.active = TRUE
                JOIN player_registrations registration ON registration.player_id = player.id
                    AND registration.season_id = result.season_id AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'
                JOIN season_clubs season_club ON season_club.season_id = result.season_id
                    AND season_club.club_id = registration.club_id
                JOIN player_roles role ON role.player_id = player.id AND role.season_id = result.season_id
                    AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                WHERE result.player_id = :playerId AND result.season_id = :seasonId
                  AND result.sources_count >= 2
                """).param("playerId", playerId).param("seasonId", seasonId).query().listOfRows().stream().findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(
                        "Giocatore non appartenente al catalogo operativo della stagione"));
    }

    List<SeasonData> loadHistory(Long playerId, int targetStartYear) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT season.code, role.fantasy_role,
                    COALESCE(MAX(stats.appearances) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FBREF'),
                             MAX(stats.appearances) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTACALCIO'),
                             MAX(stats.appearances) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'GAZZETTA'),
                             MAX(stats.appearances) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTAMARKT')) AS appearances,
                    COALESCE(MAX(stats.starts) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FBREF'),
                             MAX(stats.starts) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTACALCIO'),
                             MAX(stats.starts) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'GAZZETTA'),
                             MAX(stats.starts) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTAMARKT')) AS starts,
                    COALESCE(MAX(stats.minutes_played) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FBREF'),
                             MAX(stats.minutes_played) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTACALCIO'),
                             MAX(stats.minutes_played) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'GAZZETTA'),
                             MAX(stats.minutes_played) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTAMARKT')) AS minutes,
                    COALESCE(MAX(stats.goals) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FBREF'),
                             MAX(stats.goals) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTACALCIO'),
                             MAX(stats.goals) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'GAZZETTA'),
                             MAX(stats.goals) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTAMARKT')) AS goals,
                    COALESCE(MAX(stats.assists) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FBREF'),
                             MAX(stats.assists) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTACALCIO'),
                             MAX(stats.assists) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'GAZZETTA'),
                             MAX(stats.assists) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTAMARKT')) AS assists,
                    COALESCE(MAX(stats.yellow_cards) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FBREF'),
                             MAX(stats.yellow_cards) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTACALCIO'),
                             MAX(stats.yellow_cards) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'GAZZETTA'),
                             MAX(stats.yellow_cards) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTAMARKT')) AS yellow_cards,
                    COALESCE(MAX(stats.red_cards) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FBREF'),
                             MAX(stats.red_cards) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTACALCIO'),
                             MAX(stats.red_cards) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'GAZZETTA'),
                             MAX(stats.red_cards) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTAMARKT')) AS red_cards,
                    COALESCE(MAX(stats.penalties_missed) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FBREF'),
                             MAX(stats.penalties_missed) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTACALCIO'),
                             MAX(stats.penalties_missed) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'GAZZETTA'),
                             MAX(stats.penalties_missed) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTAMARKT')) AS penalties_missed,
                    COALESCE(MAX(stats.average_rating) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTACALCIO'),
                             MAX(stats.average_rating) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'GAZZETTA')) AS average_rating,
                    COALESCE(MAX(stats.fantasy_average) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'FANTACALCIO'),
                             MAX(stats.fantasy_average) FILTER (WHERE stats.source = 'GAZZETTA')) AS fantasy_average
                FROM player_season_statistics stats
                JOIN seasons season ON season.id = stats.season_id
                LEFT JOIN player_roles role ON role.player_id = stats.player_id
                    AND role.season_id = stats.season_id AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                WHERE stats.player_id = :playerId AND season.start_year <= :targetStartYear
                GROUP BY season.id, season.code, season.start_year, role.fantasy_role
                ORDER BY season.start_year DESC
                """).param("playerId", playerId).param("targetStartYear", targetStartYear)
                .query((rs, row) -> new SeasonData(rs.getString("code"), rs.getString("fantasy_role"),
                        rs.getObject("appearances", Integer.class), rs.getObject("starts", Integer.class),
                        rs.getObject("minutes", Integer.class), rs.getObject("goals", Integer.class),
                        rs.getObject("assists", Integer.class), rs.getObject("yellow_cards", Integer.class),
                        rs.getObject("red_cards", Integer.class), rs.getObject("penalties_missed", Integer.class),
                        rs.getBigDecimal("average_rating"), rs.getBigDecimal("fantasy_average"))).list();
    }

    private record SeasonRef(long id, int startYear, boolean current) {}
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.intelligence;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction.AuctionPriceResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction.AuctionApiPriceService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

@Service
public class PlayerIntelligenceService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final AuctionApiPriceService auctionPriceService;

    public PlayerIntelligenceService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            AuctionApiPriceService auctionPriceService
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.auctionPriceService = auctionPriceService;
    }

    @Transactional
    public PlayerIntelligenceResponse findByPlayer(
            Long playerId,
            String season,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        validateRequest(
                playerId,
                season,
                budget,
                teams
        );

        AuctionPriceResponse auction =
                auctionPriceService.calculate(
                        playerId,
                        season.trim(),
                        budget,
                        teams,
                        defenseModifier
                );

        return findByPlayer(
                playerId,
                season,
                budget,
                teams,
                defenseModifier,
                auction
        );
    }

    /**
     * Builds the intelligence profile with a price from a B51 market that
     * was already calculated by a batch consumer.
     */
    public PlayerIntelligenceResponse findByPlayer(
            Long playerId,
            String season,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier,
            AuctionPriceResponse auction
    ) {
        validateRequest(playerId, season, budget, teams);

        if (auction == null || !playerId.equals(auction.playerId())) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Prezzo asta B51 mancante o non coerente"
            );
        }

        Map<String, Object> data =
                findIntelligenceData(
                        playerId,
                        season.trim()
                );

        List<String> strengths =
                buildStrengths(data);

        List<String> risks =
                buildRisks(data);

        String finalRecommendation =
                calculateFinalRecommendation(
                        auction,
                        data,
                        risks
                );

        String summary =
                buildSummary(
                        data,
                        auction,
                        finalRecommendation
                );

        boolean foreignScoutingAvailable =
                data.get("scouting_recommendation") != null;

        return new PlayerIntelligenceResponse(
                longValue(data, "player_id"),
                stringValue(data, "display_name"),
                stringValue(data, "club_name"),
                stringValue(data, "season_code"),
                stringValue(data, "fantasy_role"),
                stringValue(data, "real_position"),
                stringValue(data, "tactical_role"),

                decimalValue(
                        data,
                        "projected_fantasy_average"
                ),
                integerValue(
                        data,
                        "projected_appearances"
                ),
                integerValue(
                        data,
                        "projected_starts"
                ),
                integerValue(data, "projected_goals"),
                integerValue(data, "projected_assists"),
                decimalValue(data, "reliability_score"),
                decimalValue(data, "potential_score"),
                decimalValue(data, "risk_score"),
                decimalValue(data, "value_score"),
                decimalValue(data, "starter_probability"),
                booleanValue(data, "penalty_taker"),
                booleanValue(data, "set_piece_taker"),

                stringValue(data, "development_trend"),
                decimalValue(data, "growth_score"),
                decimalValue(
                        data,
                        "decline_risk_score"
                ),
                decimalValue(
                        data,
                        "development_confidence"
                ),
                stringValue(
                        data,
                        "development_summary"
                ),

                foreignScoutingAvailable,
                stringValue(data, "previous_club"),
                stringValue(data, "previous_league"),
                stringValue(
                        data,
                        "previous_country_code"
                ),
                decimalValue(data, "adaptation_score"),
                stringValue(
                        data,
                        "scouting_recommendation"
                ),
                stringValue(data, "scouting_summary"),

                integerValue(
                        data,
                        "availability_matchday"
                ),
                stringValue(data, "availability_status"),
                decimalValue(
                        data,
                        "availability_probability"
                ),

                auction.minimumPrice(),

                auction.budgetPercentage(),

        );
