    private Map<String, Object> findIntelligenceData(
            Long playerId,
            String season
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    player.id AS player_id,
                    player.display_name,
                    club.name AS club_name,
                    season.code AS season_code,

                    role.fantasy_role,

                    tactical.real_position,
                    tactical.tactical_role,
                    tactical.starter_probability,
                    tactical.penalty_taker,
                    tactical.set_piece_taker,

                    evaluation.projected_fantasy_average,
                    evaluation.projected_appearances,
                    evaluation.projected_starts,
                    evaluation.projected_goals,
                    evaluation.projected_assists,
                    evaluation.reliability_score,
                    evaluation.potential_score,
                    evaluation.risk_score,
                    evaluation.value_score,

                    development.trend
                        AS development_trend,

                    development.growth_score,

                    development.decline_risk_score,

                    development.confidence_score
                        AS development_confidence,

                    development.analysis_summary
                        AS development_summary,

                    scouting.previous_club,
                    scouting.previous_league,
                    scouting.previous_country_code,
                    scouting.adaptation_score,

                    scouting.recommendation
                        AS scouting_recommendation,

                    scouting.scouting_summary,

                    availability.matchday
                        AS availability_matchday,

                    availability.status
                        AS availability_status,

                    availability.availability_probability,

                    availability.starting_probability,

                    availability.injury_description,

                    availability.expected_return_date

                FROM players player

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = player.id
                    AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = registration.season_id

                JOIN clubs club
                    ON club.id = registration.club_id

                JOIN season_clubs season_club
                    ON season_club.season_id = season.id
                    AND season_club.club_id = club.id

                JOIN player_roles role
                    ON role.player_id = player.id
                    AND role.season_id = season.id
                    AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                LEFT JOIN player_tactical_profiles tactical
                    ON tactical.player_id = player.id
                    AND tactical.season_id = season.id

                LEFT JOIN player_evaluations evaluation
                    ON evaluation.player_id = player.id
                    AND evaluation.season_id = season.id

                LEFT JOIN player_development_assessments
                    development
                    ON development.player_id = player.id
                    AND development.target_season_id =
                        season.id

                LEFT JOIN foreign_player_scouting_reports
                    scouting
                    ON scouting.player_id = player.id
                    AND scouting.season_id = season.id

                LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                    SELECT
                        player_availability.matchday,
                        player_availability.status,
                        player_availability
                            .availability_probability,
                        player_availability
                            .starting_probability,
                        player_availability
                            .injury_description,
                        player_availability
                            .expected_return_date

                    FROM player_availabilities
                        player_availability

                    WHERE player_availability.player_id =
                        player.id

                      AND player_availability.season_id =
                        season.id

                    ORDER BY
                        player_availability.matchday DESC,
                        player_availability.updated_at DESC

                    LIMIT 1
                ) availability ON TRUE

                WHERE player.id = :playerId
                  AND player.active = TRUE
                  AND season.code = :season
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("season", season)
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .stream()
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Giocatore non trovato o non "
                                        + "registrato nella stagione"
                        )
                );
    }

    private List<String> buildStrengths(
            Map<String, Object> data
    ) {
        List<String> strengths = new ArrayList<>();

        if (atLeast(data, "reliability_score", 75)) {
            strengths.add("Alta affidabilitÃ ");
        }

        if (atLeast(data, "potential_score", 80)) {
            strengths.add("Potenziale elevato");
        }

        if (atLeast(data, "value_score", 75)) {
            strengths.add("Buon rapporto qualitÃ -prezzo");
        }

        if (atLeast(data, "starter_probability", 75)) {
            strengths.add("Elevata probabilitÃ  di titolaritÃ ");
        }

        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(
                booleanValue(data, "penalty_taker")
        )) {
            strengths.add("Possibile rigorista");
        }

        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(
                booleanValue(data, "set_piece_taker")
        )) {
            strengths.add("Possibile battitore di piazzati");
        }

        String trend =
                stringValue(data, "development_trend");

        if ("GROWING".equals(trend)) {
            strengths.add("Profilo in crescita");
        }

        String scouting =
                stringValue(
                        data,
                        "scouting_recommendation"
                );

        if ("HIGH_PRIORITY".equals(scouting)
                || "RECOMMENDED".equals(scouting)) {
            strengths.add(
                    "Scouting estero positivo"
            );
        }

        if (strengths.isEmpty()) {
            strengths.add(
                    "Profilo equilibrato da valutare nel contesto"
            );
        }

        return List.copyOf(strengths);
    }

    private List<String> buildRisks(
            Map<String, Object> data
    ) {
        List<String> risks = new ArrayList<>();

        if (atLeast(data, "risk_score", 60)) {
            risks.add("Rischio tecnico elevato");
        }

        if (below(data, "starter_probability", 55)) {
            risks.add("TitolaritÃ  incerta");
        }

        if ("DECLINING".equals(
                stringValue(
                        data,
                        "development_trend"
                )
        )) {
            risks.add("Possibile rendimento in calo");
        }

        String availability =
                stringValue(
                        data,
                        "availability_status"
                );

        if ("INJURED".equals(availability)) {
            risks.add("Giocatore attualmente infortunato");
        }
        else if ("SUSPENDED".equals(availability)) {
            risks.add("Giocatore squalificato");
        }
        else if ("UNAVAILABLE".equals(availability)) {
            risks.add("Giocatore indisponibile");
        }
        else if ("DOUBTFUL".equals(availability)) {
            risks.add("DisponibilitÃ  in dubbio");
        }

        String scouting =
                stringValue(
                        data,
                        "scouting_recommendation"
                );

        if ("HIGH_RISK".equals(scouting)) {
            risks.add(
                    "Elevato rischio di adattamento alla Serie A"
            );
        }

        return List.copyOf(risks);
    }

    private String calculateFinalRecommendation(
            AuctionPriceResponse auction,
            Map<String, Object> data,
            List<String> risks
    ) {
        double score =
                auction.calculationScore()
                        .doubleValue();

        String availability =
                stringValue(
                        data,
                        "availability_status"
                );

        if ("INJURED".equals(availability)
                || "UNAVAILABLE".equals(availability)) {
            return "ATTENDERE AGGIORNAMENTI";
        }

        if (score >= 85 && risks.size() <= 1) {
            return "OBIETTIVO PRIORITARIO";
        }

        if (score >= 70 && risks.size() <= 2) {
            return "ACQUISTO CONSIGLIATO";
        }

        if (score >= 55) {
            return "ACQUISTARE SOLO AL PREZZO GIUSTO";
        }

        return "EVITARE O PRENDERE A BASSO COSTO";
    }

    private String buildSummary(
            Map<String, Object> data,
            AuctionPriceResponse auction,
            String finalRecommendation
    ) {
        String playerName =
                stringValue(data, "display_name");

        String club =
                stringValue(data, "club_name");

        String role =
                stringValue(data, "fantasy_role");

        String realPosition =
                stringValue(data, "real_position");

        String positionText =
                realPosition == null
                        ? ""
                        : ", impiegato realmente come "
                                + realPosition;

        return playerName
                + " gioca nel "
                + club
                + " ed Ã¨ listato "
                + role
                + positionText
                + ". Prezzo consigliato "
                + auction.recommendedPrice()
                + " crediti, con intervallo "
                + auction.minimumPrice()
                + "-"
                + auction.maximumPrice()
                + ". Valutazione finale: "
                + finalRecommendation
                + ".";
    }

    private boolean atLeast(
            Map<String, Object> data,
            String key,
            double threshold
    ) {
        BigDecimal value = decimalValue(data, key);

        return value != null
                && value.doubleValue() >= threshold;
    }

    private boolean below(
            Map<String, Object> data,
            String key,
            double threshold
    ) {
        BigDecimal value = decimalValue(data, key);

        return value != null
                && value.doubleValue() < threshold;
    }

    private String stringValue(
            Map<String, Object> data,
            String key
    ) {
        Object value = data.get(key);

        return value == null
                ? null
                : value.toString();
    }

    private Long longValue(
            Map<String, Object> data,
            String key
    ) {
        Object value = data.get(key);

        return value instanceof Number number
                ? number.longValue()
                : null;
    }

    private Integer integerValue(
            Map<String, Object> data,
            String key
    ) {
        Object value = data.get(key);

        return value instanceof Number number
                ? number.intValue()
                : null;
    }

    private BigDecimal decimalValue(
            Map<String, Object> data,
            String key
    ) {
        Object value = data.get(key);

        if (value instanceof BigDecimal decimal) {
            return decimal;
        }

        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return BigDecimal.valueOf(
                    number.doubleValue()
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    private Boolean booleanValue(
            Map<String, Object> data,
            String key
    ) {
        Object value = data.get(key);

        return value instanceof Boolean booleanValue
                ? booleanValue
                : null;
    }

    private java.time.LocalDate localDateValue(
            Map<String, Object> data,
            String key
    ) {
        Object value = data.get(key);

        return value instanceof java.time.LocalDate localDate
                ? localDate
                : null;
    }

    private void validateRequest(
            Long playerId,
            String season,
            int budget,
            int teams
    ) {
        if (playerId == null || playerId <= 0) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "L'identificativo del giocatore non Ã¨ valido"
            );
        }

        if (season == null || season.isBlank()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "La stagione Ã¨ obbligatoria"
            );
        }

        if (budget < 150 || budget > 1000) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Il budget deve essere compreso tra 150 e 1000"
            );
        }

        if (teams < 6 || teams > 12) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Le squadre devono essere comprese tra 6 e 12"
            );
        }
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\league\LeagueConfigurationService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.league;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class LeagueConfigurationService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public LeagueConfigurationService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public LeagueConfigurationResponse findActive() {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    league.id,
                    league.name,
                    season.code AS season,
                    league.teams_count,
                    league.total_budget,
                    league.goalkeepers_count,
                    league.defenders_count,
                    league.midfielders_count,
                    league.forwards_count,
                    league.max_substitutions,
                    league.defense_modifier,
                    league.captain_bonus,
                    league.vote_source,
                    league.active

                FROM league_configurations league

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = league.season_id

                WHERE league.active = TRUE

                ORDER BY league.id DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .query((rs, rowNumber) ->
                        new LeagueConfigurationResponse(
                                rs.getLong("id"),
                                rs.getString("name"),
                                rs.getString("season"),
                                rs.getInt("teams_count"),
                                rs.getInt("total_budget"),
                                rs.getInt("goalkeepers_count"),
                                rs.getInt("defenders_count"),
                                rs.getInt("midfielders_count"),
                                rs.getInt("forwards_count"),
                                rs.getInt("max_substitutions"),
                                rs.getBoolean("defense_modifier"),
                                rs.getBoolean("captain_bonus"),
                                rs.getString("vote_source"),
                                rs.getBoolean("active")
                        )
                )
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new IllegalStateException(
                                "Configurazione lega non trovata"
                        )
                );
    }

    @Transactional
    public LeagueConfigurationResponse update(
            UpdateLeagueConfigurationRequest request
    ) {
        Long seasonId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM seasons
                WHERE code = :season
                """)
                .param("season", request.season())
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Stagione non trovata"
                        )
                );

        Long configurationId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM league_configurations
                WHERE active = TRUE
                ORDER BY id DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new IllegalStateException(
                                "Configurazione lega non trovata"
                        )
                );

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE league_configurations
                SET
                    name = :name,
                    season_id = :seasonId,
                    teams_count = :teamsCount,
                    total_budget = :totalBudget,
                    goalkeepers_count = :goalkeepersCount,
                    defenders_count = :defendersCount,
                    midfielders_count = :midfieldersCount,
                    forwards_count = :forwardsCount,
                    max_substitutions = :maxSubstitutions,
                    defense_modifier = :defenseModifier,
                    captain_bonus = :captainBonus,
                    vote_source = :voteSource,
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE id = :configurationId
                """)
                .param("name", request.name())
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("teamsCount", request.teamsCount())
                .param("totalBudget", request.totalBudget())
                .param(
                        "goalkeepersCount",
                        request.goalkeepersCount()
                )
                .param(
                        "defendersCount",
                        request.defendersCount()
                )
                .param(
                        "midfieldersCount",
                        request.midfieldersCount()
                )
                .param(
                        "forwardsCount",
                        request.forwardsCount()
                )
                .param(
                        "maxSubstitutions",
                        request.maxSubstitutions()
                )
                .param(
                        "defenseModifier",
                        request.defenseModifier()
                )
                .param(
                        "captainBonus",
                        request.captainBonus()
                )
                .param(
                        "voteSource",
                        request.voteSource()
                )
                .param(
                        "configurationId",
                        configurationId
                )
                .update();

        return findActive();
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\lineup\B68LineupScorer.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.lineup;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

/**
 * B68 lineup scoring core.
 *
 * Principles:
 * - only real available signals are used;
 * - a missing signal is omitted, never converted to zero or a neutral 50;
 * - availability can make a player operationally unusable;
 * - fixture difficulty already contains home/away context, therefore no
 *   additional home bonus is applied here;
 * - confidence describes evidence quality and does not artificially
 *   increase or decrease the football score.
 */
@Component
public class B68LineupScorer {

    private static final double PERFORMANCE_WEIGHT = 0.45;
    private static final double STARTING_WEIGHT = 0.25;
    private static final double AVAILABILITY_WEIGHT = 0.20;
    private static final double FIXTURE_WEIGHT = 0.10;

    public ScoreResult score(Input input) {

        if (input == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Input B68 obbligatorio"
            );
        }

        String role = normalizeRole(input.role());

        validatePercentage(
                input.fantasyAverageRolePercentile(),
                "fantasyAverageRolePercentile"
        );

        validatePercentage(
                input.usageRolePercentile(),
                "usageRolePercentile"
        );

        validatePercentage(
                input.goalRateRolePercentile(),
                "goalRateRolePercentile"
        );

        validatePercentage(
                input.assistRateRolePercentile(),
                "assistRateRolePercentile"
        );

        validatePercentage(
                decimal(input.startingProbability()),
                "startingProbability"
        );

        validatePercentage(
                decimal(input.availabilityProbability()),
                "availabilityProbability"
        );

        validatePercentage(
                decimal(input.fixtureDifficulty()),
                "fixtureDifficulty"
        );

        validatePercentage(
                decimal(input.dataConfidenceScore()),
                "dataConfidenceScore"
        );

        if (input.historySeasonsAvailable() < 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "historySeasonsAvailable non puÃ² essere negativo"
            );
        }

        String availabilityStatus =
                normalizeAvailabilityStatus(
                        input.availabilityStatus()
                );

        List<Double> performanceSignals =
                performanceSignals(
                        role,
                        input
                );

        Double performanceScore =
                medianOrNull(
                        performanceSignals
                );

        Double startingProbability =
                decimal(
                        input.startingProbability()
                );

        Double availabilityProbability =
                decimal(
                        input.availabilityProbability()
                );

        Double fixtureDifficulty =
                decimal(
                        input.fixtureDifficulty()
                );

        Double fixtureScore =
                fixtureDifficulty == null
                        ? null
                        : 100.0 - fixtureDifficulty;

        boolean hardUnavailable =
                isHardUnavailable(
                        availabilityStatus
                );

        int domainSignalCount = 0;

        if (performanceScore != null) {
            domainSignalCount++;
        }

        if (startingProbability != null) {
            domainSignalCount++;
        }

        if (availabilityProbability != null) {
            domainSignalCount++;
        }

        if (fixtureScore != null) {
            domainSignalCount++;
        }

        BigDecimal confidence =
                confidence(
                        performanceScore,
                        input.dataConfidenceScore(),
                        startingProbability,
                        availabilityProbability,
                        fixtureScore
                );

        String evidenceTier =
                evidenceTier(
                        performanceSignals.size(),
                        input.dataConfidenceScore(),
                        startingProbability,
                        availabilityProbability,
                        fixtureScore,
                        domainSignalCount
                );

        if (hardUnavailable) {
            return new ScoreResult(
                    BigDecimal.ZERO.setScale(2),
                    roundNullable(performanceScore),
                    roundNullable(fixtureScore),
                    roundNullable(startingProbability),
                    roundNullable(availabilityProbability),
                    performanceSignals.size(),
                    domainSignalCount,
                    evidenceTier,
                    confidence,
                    false,
                    exclusionReason(availabilityStatus)
            );
        }

        Double selectionScore =
                weightedAvailableScore(
                        performanceScore,
                        startingProbability,
                        availabilityProbability,
                        fixtureScore
                );

        return new ScoreResult(
                roundNullable(selectionScore),
                roundNullable(performanceScore),
                roundNullable(fixtureScore),
                roundNullable(startingProbability),
                roundNullable(availabilityProbability),
                performanceSignals.size(),
                domainSignalCount,
                evidenceTier,
                confidence,
                selectionScore != null,
                selectionScore == null
                        ? "Nessun segnale reale disponibile"
                        : null
        );
    }

    private List<Double> performanceSignals(
            String role,
            Input input
    ) {

        List<Double> signals =
                new ArrayList<>();

        addIfPresent(
                signals,
                input.fantasyAverageRolePercentile()
        );

        addIfPresent(
                signals,
                input.usageRolePercentile()
        );

        /*
         * For goalkeepers B66 does not expose role-normalized
         * goalkeeper-specific goal/assist performance indicators.
         * Therefore only fantasy average and usage are admitted.
         */
        if (!"P".equals(role)) {

            addIfPresent(
                    signals,
                    input.goalRateRolePercentile()
            );

            addIfPresent(
                    signals,
                    input.assistRateRolePercentile()
            );
        }

        return signals;
    }

    private Double weightedAvailableScore(
            Double performanceScore,
            Double startingProbability,
            Double availabilityProbability,
            Double fixtureScore
    ) {

        double weightedTotal = 0;
        double availableWeight = 0;

        if (performanceScore != null) {
            weightedTotal +=
                    performanceScore
                            * PERFORMANCE_WEIGHT;

            availableWeight +=
                    PERFORMANCE_WEIGHT;
        }

        if (startingProbability != null) {
            weightedTotal +=
                    startingProbability
                            * STARTING_WEIGHT;

            availableWeight +=
                    STARTING_WEIGHT;
        }

        if (availabilityProbability != null) {
            weightedTotal +=
                    availabilityProbability
                            * AVAILABILITY_WEIGHT;

            availableWeight +=
                    AVAILABILITY_WEIGHT;
        }

        if (fixtureScore != null) {
            weightedTotal +=
                    fixtureScore
                            * FIXTURE_WEIGHT;

            availableWeight +=
                    FIXTURE_WEIGHT;
        }

        if (availableWeight == 0) {
            return null;
        }

        return weightedTotal / availableWeight;
    }

    private BigDecimal confidence(
            Double performanceScore,
            BigDecimal dataConfidenceScore,
            Double startingProbability,
            Double availabilityProbability,
            Double fixtureScore
    ) {

        double value = 0;

        if (performanceScore != null) {
            Double performanceConfidence =
                    decimal(
                            dataConfidenceScore
                    );

            if (performanceConfidence != null) {
                value +=
                        performanceConfidence
                                * PERFORMANCE_WEIGHT;
            }
        }

        if (startingProbability != null) {
            value += 100 * STARTING_WEIGHT;
        }

        if (availabilityProbability != null) {
            value += 100 * AVAILABILITY_WEIGHT;
        }

        if (fixtureScore != null) {
            value += 100 * FIXTURE_WEIGHT;
        }

        return round(value);
    }

    private String evidenceTier(
            int performanceSignalCount,
            BigDecimal dataConfidenceScore,
            Double startingProbability,
            Double availabilityProbability,
            Double fixtureScore,
            int domainSignalCount
    ) {

        double historicalConfidence =
                dataConfidenceScore == null
                        ? 0
                        : dataConfidenceScore
                                .doubleValue();

        if (
                historicalConfidence >= 80
                && performanceSignalCount >= 3
                && startingProbability != null
                && availabilityProbability != null
                && fixtureScore != null
        ) {
            return "HIGH";
        }

        if (
                historicalConfidence >= 70
                && performanceSignalCount >= 1
                && fixtureScore != null
                && (
                        startingProbability != null
                        || availabilityProbability != null
                )
        ) {
            return "MEDIUM";
        }

        if (domainSignalCount >= 2) {
            return "LOW";
        }

        if (domainSignalCount == 1) {
            return "MINIMAL";
        }

        return "NO_EVIDENCE";
    }

    private boolean isHardUnavailable(
            String status
    ) {

        return "INJURED".equals(status)
                || "SUSPENDED".equals(status)
                || "UNAVAILABLE".equals(status);
    }

    private String exclusionReason(
            String status
    ) {

        return switch (status) {

            case "INJURED" ->
                    "Giocatore escluso: infortunato";

            case "SUSPENDED" ->
                    "Giocatore escluso: squalificato";

            case "UNAVAILABLE" ->
                    "Giocatore escluso: indisponibile";

            default ->
                    "Giocatore non utilizzabile";
        };
    }

    private String normalizeAvailabilityStatus(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
                || value.isBlank()
        ) {
            return "UNKNOWN";
        }

        return value
                .trim()
                .toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    private String normalizeRole(
            String role
    ) {

        if (role == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Ruolo B68 obbligatorio"
            );
        }

        String normalized =
                role.trim()
                        .toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);

        if (
                !"P".equals(normalized)
                && !"D".equals(normalized)
                && !"C".equals(normalized)
                && !"A".equals(normalized)
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Ruolo B68 non valido: "
                            + role
            );
        }

        return normalized;
    }

    private void validatePercentage(
            Double value,
            String field
    ) {

        if (value == null) {
            return;
        }

        if (
                !Double.isFinite(value)
                || value < 0
                || value > 100
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    field
                            + " deve essere compreso tra 0 e 100"
            );
        }
    }

    private void addIfPresent(
            List<Double> values,
            Double value
    ) {

        if (value != null) {
            values.add(value);
        }
    }

    private Double medianOrNull(
            List<Double> values
    ) {

        if (values.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        List<Double> ordered =
                values.stream()
                        .sorted(
                                Comparator.naturalOrder()
                        )
                        .toList();

        int size = ordered.size();

        if (size % 2 == 1) {
            return ordered.get(
                    size / 2
            );
        }

        return (
                ordered.get(
                        size / 2 - 1
                )
                + ordered.get(
                        size / 2
                )
        ) / 2.0;
    }

    private Double decimal(
            BigDecimal value
    ) {

        return value == null
                ? null
                : value.doubleValue();
    }

    private BigDecimal roundNullable(
            Double value
    ) {

        return value == null
                ? null
                : round(value);
    }

    private BigDecimal round(
            double value
    ) {

        return BigDecimal
                .valueOf(value)
                .setScale(
                        2,
                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                );
    }

    public record Input(
            String role,
            Double fantasyAverageRolePercentile,
            Double usageRolePercentile,
            Double goalRateRolePercentile,
            Double assistRateRolePercentile,
            BigDecimal startingProbability,
            BigDecimal availabilityProbability,
            String availabilityStatus,
            BigDecimal fixtureDifficulty,
            BigDecimal dataConfidenceScore,
            int historySeasonsAvailable
    ) {
    }

    public record ScoreResult(
            BigDecimal selectionScore,
            BigDecimal performanceScore,
            BigDecimal fixtureScore,
            BigDecimal startingProbability,
            BigDecimal availabilityProbability,
            int performanceSignalCount,
            int domainSignalCount,
            String evidenceTier,
            BigDecimal confidence,
            boolean actionable,
            String exclusionReason
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.lineup;

import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/lineups")
public class RecommendedLineupController {

    private final RecommendedLineupService service;

    public RecommendedLineupController(
            RecommendedLineupService service
    ) {
        this.service = service;
    }

    @GetMapping("/recommended")
    public RecommendedLineupResponse recommend(

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "#{@currentSeasonResolver.resolve()}")
            String season,

            @RequestParam
            int matchday,

            @RequestParam(required = false)
            Long squadId,

            @RequestParam(
                    required = false,
                    defaultValue = ""
            )
            String unavailablePlayerIds,

            Authentication authentication
    ) {
        return service.recommend(
                season,
                matchday,
                squadId,
                unavailablePlayerIds,
                authentication.getName(),
                isAdmin(authentication)
        );
    }

    private boolean isAdmin(Authentication authentication) {
        return authentication.getAuthorities().stream()
                .anyMatch(authority -> "ROLE_ADMIN".equals(authority.getAuthority()));
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.lineup;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

@Service
public class RecommendedLineupService {

    private static final String PERFORMANCE_VERSION =
            "B66_FEATURES_V3";

    private static final List<Formation> FORMATIONS =
            List.of(
                    new Formation("3-4-3", 3, 4, 3),
                    new Formation("3-5-2", 3, 5, 2),
                    new Formation("4-3-3", 4, 3, 3),
