                    new Formation("4-5-1", 4, 5, 1),
                    new Formation("5-3-2", 5, 3, 2),
                    new Formation("5-4-1", 5, 4, 1)
            );

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final B69FixtureMatchupService matchupService;
    private final B68LineupScorer lineupScorer;

    public RecommendedLineupService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            B69FixtureMatchupService matchupService,
            B68LineupScorer lineupScorer
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.matchupService = matchupService;
        this.lineupScorer = lineupScorer;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public RecommendedLineupResponse recommend(
            String season,
            int matchday,
            String unavailablePlayerIds
    ) {
        return recommend(
                season,
                matchday,
                null,
                unavailablePlayerIds
        );
    }

    /**
     * Ownership-aware HTTP path: the squad is always resolved for the
     * authenticated principal (or an administrator) and never for another
     * owner. This is the only path used by RecommendedLineupController.
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public RecommendedLineupResponse recommend(
            String season,
            int matchday,
            Long requestedSquadId,
            String unavailablePlayerIds,
            String username,
            boolean administrator
    ) {

        Long squadId =
                resolveSquadId(
                        season,
                        requestedSquadId,
                        username,
                        administrator
                );

        return buildRecommendation(
                season,
                matchday,
                squadId,
                unavailablePlayerIds
        );
    }

    /**
     * Compatibility path for internal callers and backend tests.
     * It deliberately does NOT enforce ownership: it is not reachable
     * through the HTTP controller anymore.
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public RecommendedLineupResponse recommend(
            String season,
            int matchday,
            Long requestedSquadId,
            String unavailablePlayerIds
    ) {

        Long squadId =
                resolveSquadId(
                        season,
                        requestedSquadId
                );

        return buildRecommendation(
                season,
                matchday,
                squadId,
                unavailablePlayerIds
        );
    }

    private RecommendedLineupResponse buildRecommendation(
            String season,
            int matchday,
            Long squadId,
            String unavailablePlayerIds
    ) {

        if (matchday < 1 || matchday > 38) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "La giornata deve essere compresa tra 1 e 38"
            );
        }

        List<PlayerCandidate> candidates =
                loadCandidates(
                        season,
                        matchday,
                        squadId
                );

        FormationResult bestResult =
                FORMATIONS.stream()
                        .map(formation ->
                                evaluateFormation(
                                        formation,
                                        candidates
                                )
                        )
                        .max(
                                Comparator
                                        .comparingInt(
                                                FormationResult::
                                                        selectedPlayers
                                        )
                                        .thenComparing(
                                                FormationResult::
                                                        totalScore
                                        )
                        )
                        .orElseThrow();

        List<LineupPlayerResponse> starters =
                bestResult.selected()
                        .stream()
                        .sorted(
                                candidateRoleComparator()
                        )
                        .map(this::toResponse)
                        .toList();

        List<Long> starterIds =
                bestResult.selected()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                PlayerCandidate::playerId
                        )
                        .toList();

        List<LineupPlayerResponse> bench =
                createSmartBench(
                        candidates,
                        starterIds
                );

        List<Long> simulatedUnavailableIds =
                parseUnavailablePlayerIds(
                        unavailablePlayerIds
                );

        int maxSubstitutions =
                loadMaxSubstitutions(
                        squadId
                );

        List<LineupSubstitutionResponse> substitutions =
                createAutomaticSubstitutions(
                        starters,
                        bench,
                        simulatedUnavailableIds,
                        maxSubstitutions
                );

        Map<String, LineupRoleSummaryResponse> roles =
                createRoleSummary(
                        bestResult.formation(),
                        bestResult.selected()
                );

        int missingPlayers =
                11 - bestResult.selectedPlayers();

        List<String> warnings =
                new ArrayList<>();

        long unavailableStarters =
                starters.stream()
                        .filter(starter ->
                                simulatedUnavailableIds.contains(
                                        starter.playerId()
                                )
                        )
                        .count();

        if (
                unavailableStarters
                        > substitutions.size()
        ) {

            if (
                    substitutions.size()
                            >= maxSubstitutions
            ) {
                warnings.add(
                        "Limite massimo di "
                                + maxSubstitutions
                                + " sostituzioni raggiunto."
                );
            } else {
                warnings.add(
                        "Una o pi\u00F9 assenze non possono essere coperte: " + "nessuna riserva valida disponibile."
                );
            }
        }

        if (missingPlayers > 0) {
            warnings.add(
                    "Rosa incompleta: mancano "
                            + missingPlayers
                            + " giocatori per completare gli 11."
            );
        }

        long noEvidencePlayers =
                candidates.stream()
                        .filter(candidate ->
                                !candidate.actionable()
                        )
                        .filter(candidate ->
                                !isHardUnavailable(
                                        candidate.availabilityStatus()
                                )
                        )
                        .count();

        if (noEvidencePlayers > 0) {
            warnings.add(
                    noEvidencePlayers
                            + " giocatori non sono classificabili "
                            + "per insufficienza di evidenza reale."
            );
        }

        appendRoleWarning(
                warnings,
                roles,
                "P",
                "portieri"
        );

        appendRoleWarning(
                warnings,
                roles,
                "D",
                "difensori"
        );

        appendRoleWarning(
                warnings,
                roles,
                "C",
                "centrocampisti"
        );

        appendRoleWarning(
                warnings,
                roles,
                "A",
                "attaccanti"
        );

        BigDecimal formationScore =
                bestResult.selected().isEmpty()
                        ? BigDecimal.ZERO
                                .setScale(2)
                        : bestResult.totalScore()
                                .divide(
                                        BigDecimal.valueOf(
                                                bestResult
                                                        .selectedPlayers()
                                        ),
                                        2,
                                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                                );

        return new RecommendedLineupResponse(
                season,
                matchday,
                squadId,
                bestResult.formation().name(),
                missingPlayers == 0,
                bestResult.selectedPlayers(),
                missingPlayers,
                formationScore,
                roles,
                starters,
                bench,
                maxSubstitutions,
                substitutions.size(),
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        maxSubstitutions
                                - substitutions.size()
                ),
                substitutions,
                List.copyOf(warnings)
        );
    }

    private Long resolveSquadId(
            String season,
            Long requestedSquadId
    ) {

        if (requestedSquadId != null) {

            return jdbcClient.sql("""
                    SELECT squad.id

                    FROM fantasy_squads squad

                    WHERE squad.id = :squadId
                      AND squad.active = TRUE

                      AND EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1

                          FROM fantasy_squad_players squad_player

                          JOIN seasons season
                              ON season.id =
                                  squad_player.season_id

                          WHERE squad_player.squad_id =
                                  squad.id

                            AND season.code = :season
                      )
                    """)
                    .param(
                            "squadId",
                            requestedSquadId
                    )
                    .param(
                            "season",
                            season
                    )
                    .query(Long.class)
                    .optional()
                    .orElseThrow(() ->
                            new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                    "Rosa attiva non trovata: "
                                            + requestedSquadId
                                            + " per la stagione "
                                            + season
                            )
                    );
        }

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT squad.id

                FROM fantasy_squads squad

                WHERE squad.active = TRUE

                  AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1

                      FROM fantasy_squad_players squad_player

                      JOIN seasons season
                          ON season.id =
                              squad_player.season_id

                      WHERE squad_player.squad_id =
                              squad.id

                        AND season.code = :season
                  )

                ORDER BY squad.id
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param(
                        "season",
                        season
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Nessuna rosa attiva trovata "
                                        + "per la stagione "
                                        + season
                        )
                );
    }

    /**
     * Ownership-aware squad resolution used by the HTTP path:
     * a requested squadId must belong to the authenticated principal,
     * and without squadId only the principal's own active squad is used.
     * Administrators may resolve any squad, mirroring SquadService.
     */
    private Long resolveSquadId(
            String season,
            Long requestedSquadId,
            String username,
            boolean administrator
    ) {

        if (requestedSquadId != null) {

            return jdbcClient.sql("""
                    SELECT squad.id

                    FROM fantasy_squads squad

                    WHERE squad.id = :squadId
                      AND squad.active = TRUE

                      AND (
                          :administrator = TRUE
                          OR LOWER(squad.owner_username)
                             = LOWER(:username)
                      )

                      AND EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1

                          FROM fantasy_squad_players squad_player

                          JOIN seasons season
                              ON season.id =
                                  squad_player.season_id

                          WHERE squad_player.squad_id =
                                  squad.id

                            AND season.code = :season
                      )
                    """)
                    .param(
                            "squadId",
                            requestedSquadId
                    )
                    .param(
                            "username",
                            username
                    )
                    .param(
                            "administrator",
                            administrator
                    )
                    .param(
                            "season",
                            season
                    )
                    .query(Long.class)
                    .optional()
                    .orElseThrow(() ->
                            new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                    "Rosa attiva non trovata: "
                                            + requestedSquadId
                                            + " per la stagione "
                                            + season
                            )
                    );
        }

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT squad.id

                FROM fantasy_squads squad

                WHERE squad.active = TRUE

                  AND (
                      :administrator = TRUE
                      OR LOWER(squad.owner_username)
                         = LOWER(:username)
                  )

                  AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1

                      FROM fantasy_squad_players squad_player

                      JOIN seasons season
                          ON season.id =
                              squad_player.season_id

                      WHERE squad_player.squad_id =
                              squad.id

                        AND season.code = :season
                  )

                ORDER BY squad.id
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param(
                        "username",
                        username
                )
                .param(
                        "administrator",
                        administrator
                )
                .param(
                        "season",
                        season
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Nessuna rosa attiva trovata "
                                        + "per la stagione "
                                        + season
                        )
                );
    }

    private List<PlayerCandidate> loadCandidates(
            String season,
            int matchday,
            Long squadId
    ) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            player.id AS player_id,
                            player.display_name,
                            club.name AS club_name,
                            club.slug AS club_slug,
                            squad_player.fantasy_role,

                            performance.history_seasons_available,
                            performance.data_confidence_score,

                            (
                                performance.feature_values
                                    ->> 'fantasy_average_role_percentile'
                            )::double precision
                                AS fantasy_average_role_percentile,

                            (
                                performance.feature_values
                                    ->> 'usage_role_percentile'
                            )::double precision
                                AS usage_role_percentile,

                            (
                                performance.feature_values
                                    ->> 'goal_rate_role_percentile'
                            )::double precision
                                AS goal_rate_role_percentile,

                            (
                                performance.feature_values
                                    ->> 'assist_rate_role_percentile'
                            )::double precision
                                AS assist_rate_role_percentile,

                            availability.status
                                AS availability_status,

                            availability.starting_probability
                                AS starting_probability,

                            availability.availability_probability
                                AS availability_probability

                        FROM fantasy_squad_players squad_player

                        JOIN fantasy_squads squad
                            ON squad.id =
                                squad_player.squad_id

                        JOIN players player
                            ON player.id =
                                squad_player.player_id

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id =
                                squad_player.season_id

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id =
                                player.id

                            AND registration.season_id =
                                season.id

                            AND registration.registration_status =
                                'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN clubs club
                            ON club.id =
                                registration.club_id

                        LEFT JOIN player_performance_feature_profiles
                            performance

                            ON performance.player_id =
                                player.id

                            AND performance.reference_season_id =
                                season.id

                            AND performance.algorithm_version =
                                :performanceVersion

                        LEFT JOIN player_availabilities availability
                            ON availability.player_id =
                                player.id

                            AND availability.season_id =
                                season.id

                            AND availability.matchday =
                                :matchday

                        WHERE squad.active = TRUE

                          AND player.active = TRUE

                          AND season.code = :season

                          AND squad.id = :squadId

                        ORDER BY player.display_name
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "performanceVersion",
                                PERFORMANCE_VERSION
                        )
                        .param(
                                "season",
                                season
                        )
                        .param(
                                "matchday",
                                matchday
                        )
                        .param(
                                "squadId",
                                squadId
                        )
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        List<PlayerCandidate> candidates =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {

            String clubSlug =
                    stringValue(
                            row.get("club_slug")
                    );

            String fantasyRole =
                    stringValue(
                            row.get("fantasy_role")
                    );

            B69FixtureMatchupResponse fixture =
                    matchupService
                            .findClubMatchups(
                                    season,
                                    clubSlug,
                                    matchday,
                                    matchday
                            )
                            .stream()
                            .findFirst()
                            .orElse(null);

            B69RoleDifficultyResponse roleMatchup =
                    fixture == null
                            ? null
                            : fixture.roles()
                                    .stream()
                                    .filter(role ->
                                            fantasyRole.equals(
                                                    role.role()
                                            )
                                    )
                                    .findFirst()
                                    .orElse(null);

            BigDecimal fixtureDifficulty =
                    roleMatchup == null
                            ? null
                            : roleMatchup
                                    .difficultyScore();

            BigDecimal startingProbability =
                    decimalOrNull(
                            row.get(
                                    "starting_probability"
                            )
                    );

            BigDecimal availabilityProbability =
                    decimalOrNull(
                            row.get(
                                    "availability_probability"
                            )
                    );

            String availabilityStatus =
                    stringValue(
                            row.get(
                                    "availability_status"
                            )
                    );

            if (
                    availabilityStatus == null
                    || availabilityStatus.isBlank()
            ) {
                availabilityStatus = "UNKNOWN";
            }

            BigDecimal confidence =
                    decimalOrNull(
                            row.get(
                                    "data_confidence_score"
                            )
                    );

            Integer historySeasons =
                    integerOrNull(
                            row.get(
                                    "history_seasons_available"
                            )
                    );

            B68LineupScorer.ScoreResult score =
                    lineupScorer.score(
                            new B68LineupScorer.Input(
                                    fantasyRole,
                                    doubleOrNull(
                                            row.get(
                                                    "fantasy_average_role_percentile"
                                            )
                                    ),
                                    doubleOrNull(
                                            row.get(
                                                    "usage_role_percentile"
                                            )
                                    ),
                                    doubleOrNull(
                                            row.get(
                                                    "goal_rate_role_percentile"
                                            )
                                    ),
                                    doubleOrNull(
                                            row.get(
                                                    "assist_rate_role_percentile"
                                            )
                                    ),
                                    startingProbability,
                                    availabilityProbability,
                                    availabilityStatus,
                                    fixtureDifficulty,
                                    confidence,
                                    historySeasons == null
                                            ? 0
                                            : historySeasons
                            )
                    );

            String reason =
                    createReason(
                            availabilityStatus,
                            score,
                            fixture,
                            roleMatchup,
                            historySeasons
                    );

            candidates.add(
                    new PlayerCandidate(
                            ((Number) row.get(
                                    "player_id"
                            )).longValue(),

                            stringValue(
                                    row.get(
                                            "display_name"
                                    )
                            ),

                            stringValue(
                                    row.get(
                                            "club_name"
                                    )
                            ),

                            stringValue(
                                    row.get(
                                            "fantasy_role"
                                    )
                            ),

                            fixture == null
                                    ? "Partita non disponibile"
                                    : fixture.opponent(),

                            fixture != null
                                    && fixture.home(),

                            fixtureDifficulty,

                            score.selectionScore(),

                            reason,

                            availabilityStatus,

                            score.actionable(),

                            score.evidenceTier(),

                            score.confidence()
                    )
            );
        }

        return candidates;
    }

    private FormationResult evaluateFormation(
            Formation formation,
            List<PlayerCandidate> candidates
    ) {

        List<PlayerCandidate> selected =
                new ArrayList<>();

        selected.addAll(
                selectByRole(
                        candidates,
                        "P",
                        1
                )
        );

        selected.addAll(
                selectByRole(
                        candidates,
                        "D",
                        formation.defenders()
                )
        );

        selected.addAll(
                selectByRole(
                        candidates,
                        "C",
                        formation.midfielders()
                )
        );

        selected.addAll(
                selectByRole(
                        candidates,
                        "A",
                        formation.forwards()
                )
        );

        BigDecimal totalScore =
                selected.stream()
                        .map(
                                PlayerCandidate::
                                        selectionScore
                        )
                        .reduce(
                                BigDecimal.ZERO,
                                BigDecimal::add
                        );

        return new FormationResult(
                formation,
                selected,
                selected.size(),
                totalScore
        );
    }

    private List<PlayerCandidate> selectByRole(
            List<PlayerCandidate> candidates,
            String role,
            int maximum
    ) {

        return candidates.stream()
                .filter(candidate ->
                        role.equals(
                                candidate.role()
                        )
                )
                .filter(
                        PlayerCandidate::actionable
                )
                .filter(candidate ->
                        !isHardUnavailable(
                                candidate
                                        .availabilityStatus()
                        )
                )
                .filter(candidate ->
                        candidate.selectionScore()
                                != null
                )
                .sorted(
                        Comparator
                                .comparing(
                                        PlayerCandidate::
                                                selectionScore
                                )
                                .reversed()
                                .thenComparing(
                                        PlayerCandidate::
                                                playerId
                                )
                )
                .limit(maximum)
                .toList();
    }

    private int loadMaxSubstitutions(
            Long squadId
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT league.max_substitutions

                FROM fantasy_squads squad

                JOIN league_configurations league
                    ON league.id =
                        squad.league_configuration_id

                WHERE squad.id = :squadId
                """)
                .param(
                        "squadId",
                        squadId
                )
                .query(Integer.class)
                .optional()
                .orElse(3);
    }

    private List<Long> parseUnavailablePlayerIds(
            String unavailablePlayerIds
    ) {

        if (
                unavailablePlayerIds == null
                || unavailablePlayerIds.isBlank()
        ) {
            return List.of();
        }

        try {
            return List.of(
                    unavailablePlayerIds.split(",")
            )
                    .stream()
                    .map(String::trim)
                    .filter(value ->
                            !value.isBlank()
                    )
                    .map(Long::valueOf)
                    .distinct()
                    .toList();

        } catch (NumberFormatException exception) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "unavailablePlayerIds deve contenere "
                            + "solo ID numerici separati da virgole"
            );
        }
    }

    private List<LineupSubstitutionResponse>
            createAutomaticSubstitutions(
                    List<LineupPlayerResponse> starters,
                    List<LineupPlayerResponse> bench,
                    List<Long> simulatedUnavailableIds,
                    int maxSubstitutions
            ) {

        List<LineupSubstitutionResponse> substitutions =
                new ArrayList<>();

        List<Long> usedBenchPlayerIds =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (LineupPlayerResponse starter : starters) {

            if (
                    substitutions.size()
                            >= maxSubstitutions
            ) {
                break;
            }

            if (
                    !requiresSubstitution(
                            starter,
                            simulatedUnavailableIds
                    )
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            LineupPlayerResponse replacement =
                    bench.stream()
                            .filter(candidate ->
                                    candidate.role()
                                            .equals(
                                                    starter.role()
                                            )
                            )
                            .filter(
                                    this::
                                            isUsableSubstitute
                            )
                            .filter(candidate ->
                                    !usedBenchPlayerIds
                                            .contains(
                                                    candidate
                                                            .playerId()
                                            )
                            )
                            .findFirst()
                            .orElse(null);

            if (replacement == null) {
                continue;
            }

            usedBenchPlayerIds.add(
                    replacement.playerId()
            );

            substitutions.add(
                    new LineupSubstitutionResponse(
                            starter,
                            replacement,
                            simulatedUnavailableIds
                                    .contains(
                                            starter.playerId()
                                    )
                                    ? "Sostituzione automatica: "
                                            + "assenza simulata"
                                    : "Sostituzione automatica "
                                            + "per stato "
                                            + starter
                                                    .availabilityStatus()
                    )
            );
        }

        return substitutions;
    }

    private boolean requiresSubstitution(
            LineupPlayerResponse player,
            List<Long> simulatedUnavailableIds
    ) {

        return simulatedUnavailableIds
                .contains(
                        player.playerId()
                )
                || isHardUnavailable(
                        player.availabilityStatus()
                );
    }

    private boolean isUsableSubstitute(
            LineupPlayerResponse player
    ) {

        return !isHardUnavailable(
                player.availabilityStatus()
        )
                && player.selectionScore() != null;
    }

    private boolean isHardUnavailable(
            String status
    ) {

        return "INJURED".equals(status)
                || "SUSPENDED".equals(status)
                || "UNAVAILABLE".equals(status);
    }

    private List<LineupPlayerResponse> createSmartBench(
            List<PlayerCandidate> candidates,
            List<Long> starterIds
    ) {

        List<PlayerCandidate> reserves =
                candidates.stream()
                        .filter(candidate ->
                                !starterIds.contains(
                                        candidate.playerId()
                                )
                        )
                        .toList();

        List<PlayerCandidate> orderedBench =
                new ArrayList<>();

        addBenchPlayersByRole(
                orderedBench,
                reserves,
                "P"
        );

        addBenchPlayersByRole(
                orderedBench,
                reserves,
                "D"
        );

        addBenchPlayersByRole(
                orderedBench,
                reserves,
                "C"
        );

        addBenchPlayersByRole(
                orderedBench,
                reserves,
                "A"
        );

        return orderedBench.stream()
                .map(this::toResponse)
                .toList();
    }

    private void addBenchPlayersByRole(
            List<PlayerCandidate> bench,
            List<PlayerCandidate> reserves,
            String role
    ) {

        reserves.stream()
                .filter(candidate ->
                        role.equals(
                                candidate.role()
                        )
                )
                .sorted(
                        Comparator
                                .comparingInt(
                                        this::
                                                availabilityPriority
                                )
                                .thenComparing(
                                        candidate ->
                                                candidate
                                                        .selectionScore()
                                                        == null
                                                        ? BigDecimal
                                                                .valueOf(-1)
                                                        : candidate
                                                                .selectionScore(),
                                        Comparator
                                                .reverseOrder()
                                )
                                .thenComparing(
                                        PlayerCandidate::
                                                playerId
                                )
                )
                .forEach(
                        bench::add
                );
    }

    private int availabilityPriority(
            PlayerCandidate candidate
    ) {

        return switch (
                candidate.availabilityStatus()
        ) {
            case "AVAILABLE", "PROBABLE" -> 1;
            case "DOUBTFUL" -> 2;
            case "UNKNOWN" -> 3;
            case "INJURED" -> 4;
            case "SUSPENDED" -> 5;
            case "UNAVAILABLE" -> 6;
            default -> 7;
        };
    }

    private Map<String, LineupRoleSummaryResponse>
            createRoleSummary(
                    Formation formation,
                    List<PlayerCandidate> selected
            ) {

        Map<String, LineupRoleSummaryResponse> roles =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        roles.put(
                "P",
                summary(
                        selected,
                        "P",
                        1
                )
        );

        roles.put(
                "D",
                summary(
                        selected,
                        "D",
                        formation.defenders()
                )
        );

        roles.put(
                "C",
                summary(
                        selected,
                        "C",
                        formation.midfielders()
                )
        );

        roles.put(
                "A",
                summary(
                        selected,
                        "A",
                        formation.forwards()
                )
        );

        return roles;
    }

    private LineupRoleSummaryResponse summary(
            List<PlayerCandidate> selected,
            String role,
            int required
    ) {

        int current =
                (int) selected.stream()
                        .filter(candidate ->
                                role.equals(
                                        candidate.role()
                                )
                        )
                        .count();

        return new LineupRoleSummaryResponse(
                required,
                current,
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        required - current
                )
        );
    }

    private void appendRoleWarning(
            List<String> warnings,
            Map<String, LineupRoleSummaryResponse> roles,
            String role,
            String roleName
    ) {

        LineupRoleSummaryResponse summary =
                roles.get(role);

        if (summary.missing() > 0) {
            warnings.add(
                    "Mancano "
                            + summary.missing()
                            + " "
                            + roleName
                            + "."
            );
        }
    }

    private Comparator<PlayerCandidate>
            candidateRoleComparator() {

        return Comparator
                .comparingInt(
                        (PlayerCandidate player) ->
                                roleOrder(
                                        player.role()
                                )
                )
                .thenComparing(
                        PlayerCandidate::
                                selectionScore,
                        Comparator.reverseOrder()
                )
                .thenComparing(
                        PlayerCandidate::
                                playerId
                );
    }

    private int roleOrder(
            String role
    ) {

        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 1;
            case "D" -> 2;
            case "C" -> 3;
            case "A" -> 4;
            default -> 5;
        };
    }

    private LineupPlayerResponse toResponse(
            PlayerCandidate candidate
    ) {

        return new LineupPlayerResponse(
                candidate.playerId(),
                candidate.playerName(),
                candidate.club(),
                candidate.role(),
                candidate.opponent(),
                candidate.home(),
                candidate.fixtureDifficulty(),
                candidate.selectionScore(),
                candidate.availabilityStatus(),
                candidate.reason()
        );
    }

    private String createReason(
            String availabilityStatus,
            B68LineupScorer.ScoreResult score,
            B69FixtureMatchupResponse fixture,
            B69RoleDifficultyResponse roleMatchup,
            Integer historySeasons
    ) {

        List<String> evidence =
                new ArrayList<>();

        evidence.add(
                "stato "
                        + availabilityStatus
        );

        if (
                score.performanceScore()
                        != null
        ) {
            evidence.add(
                    "performance B66 "
                            + score
                                    .performanceScore()
                            + "/100"
            );
        }

        if (
                score.startingProbability()
                        != null
        ) {
            evidence.add(
                    "titolarit\u00E0 "
                            + score
                                    .startingProbability()
                            + "%"
            );
        }

        if (
                score.availabilityProbability()
                        != null
        ) {
            evidence.add(
                    "disponibilit\u00E0 "
                            + score
                                    .availabilityProbability()
                            + "%"
            );
        }

        if (fixture != null) {

            evidence.add(
                    "avversario "
                            + fixture.opponent()
            );

            evidence.add(
                    "difficolt\u00E0 "
                            + (
                                    roleMatchup == null
                                            || roleMatchup.difficultyScore()
                                                    == null
                                            ? "non disponibile"
                                            : roleMatchup.difficultyScore()
                                                    + "/100"
                            )
            );

            evidence.add(
                    fixture.home()
                            ? "casa"
                            : "trasferta"
            );
        }

        evidence.add(
                "evidenza "
                        + score.evidenceTier()
        );

        evidence.add(
                "confidence "
                        + score.confidence()
                        + "/100"
        );

        if (historySeasons != null) {
            evidence.add(
                    "storico "
                            + historySeasons
                            + " stagioni"
            );
        }

        if (
                score.exclusionReason()
                        != null
        ) {
            evidence.add(
                    score.exclusionReason()
            );
        }

        return String.join(
                ", ",
                evidence
        ) + ".";
    }

    private BigDecimal decimalOrNull(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (value instanceof BigDecimal decimal) {
            return decimal;
        }

        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return BigDecimal.valueOf(
                    number.doubleValue()
            );
        }

        return new BigDecimal(
                value.toString()
        );
    }

    private Double doubleOrNull(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number.doubleValue();
        }

        return Double.valueOf(
                value.toString()
        );
    }

    private Integer integerOrNull(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number.intValue();
        }

        return Integer.valueOf(
                value.toString()
        );
    }

    private String stringValue(
            Object value
    ) {

        return value == null
                ? null
                : value.toString();
    }

    private record Formation(
            String name,
            int defenders,
            int midfielders,
            int forwards
    ) {
    }

    private record FormationResult(
            Formation formation,
            List<PlayerCandidate> selected,
            int selectedPlayers,
            BigDecimal totalScore
    ) {
    }

    private record PlayerCandidate(
            Long playerId,
            String playerName,
            String club,
            String role,
            String opponent,
            boolean home,
            BigDecimal fixtureDifficulty,
            BigDecimal selectionScore,
            String reason,
            String availabilityStatus,
            boolean actionable,
            String evidenceTier,
            BigDecimal confidence
    ) {
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\liveauction\LiveAuctionAlternativeService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction;

import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class LiveAuctionAlternativeService {
    private final LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy policy;

    public LiveAuctionAlternativeService(LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy policy) {
        this.policy = policy;
    }

    public Optional<LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation> dominantAlternative(
            LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation current, int currentBid,
            List<LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation> alternatives) {
        return alternatives.stream()
                .filter(candidate -> contextFit(current, candidate))
                .filter(candidate -> candidate.target().b51RecommendedPrice() <= candidate.target().targetPrice())
                .filter(candidate -> policy.alternativeSaving(
                        candidate.target().b51RecommendedPrice(), currentBid))
                .filter(candidate -> policy.comparableEvidence(evidence(candidate), evidence(current)))
                .sorted(Comparator
                        .comparing((LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation c) -> c.target().fitScore()).reversed()
                        .thenComparing((LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation c) -> calendarScore(c), Comparator.reverseOrder())
                        .thenComparing(c -> c.target().b51RecommendedPrice())
                        .thenComparing((LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation c) -> evidence(c), Comparator.reverseOrder())
                        .thenComparing(c -> c.target().playerId()))
                .findFirst();
    }

    private boolean contextFit(LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation current,
            LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation alternative) {
        int fitDelta = alternative.target().fitScore().compareTo(current.target().fitScore());
        if ("P".equals(current.target().role()) && fitDelta < 0) {
            boolean closeFit = alternative.target().fitScore().doubleValue()
                    >= current.target().fitScore().doubleValue()
                            - LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy.GOALKEEPER_MAX_FIT_COMPENSATION;
            boolean materiallyBetterCalendar = calendarScore(alternative) >= calendarScore(current)
                    + LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy.GOALKEEPER_CALENDAR_IMPROVEMENT;
            if (!(closeFit && materiallyBetterCalendar)) return false;
        } else if (fitDelta < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        if ("A".equals(current.target().role()) && current.calendar() != null
                && alternative.calendar() != null
                && alternative.calendar().hardOverlapCount() > current.calendar().hardOverlapCount()) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private double calendarScore(LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation candidate) {
        return candidate.calendar() == null || candidate.calendar().calendarCombinationScore() == null
                ? -1 : candidate.calendar().calendarCombinationScore().doubleValue();
    }

    private int evidence(LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation candidate) {
        return candidate.strategic() == null ? 0 : candidate.strategic().evidenceCompleteness().intValue();
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\liveauction\LiveAuctionBudgetGuard.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.DynamicBudgetResponse;

@Component
public class LiveAuctionBudgetGuard {
    public Result evaluate(int bid, int remainingBudget, DynamicBudgetResponse budget) {
        int after = remainingBudget - bid;
        int remainingAfterPurchase = Math.max(0,
                budget.slotsRemainingByRole().values().stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).sum() - 1);
        boolean completionSafe = after >= remainingAfterPurchase;
        boolean roleSafe = bid <= budget.contextualMaximumBid();
        return new Result(after, remainingAfterPurchase, completionSafe && roleSafe,
                !completionSafe ? "BID_BREAKS_COMPLETION_RESERVE"
                        : !roleSafe ? "BID_EXCEEDS_B54_CONTEXTUAL_MAX" : "BUDGET_SAFE");
    }

    public record Result(int budgetAfterBid, int minimumCompletionReserve,
            boolean sustainable, String reason) { }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\liveauction\LiveAuctionCalendarBatchService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.CalendarCandidateService.CalendarPlayerCandidate;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.CalendarCombinationResult;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.CalendarCombinationScorer;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.ClubFixtureProfile;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.FixtureWindowService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.BoughtPlayerRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.SquadTargetResponse;

@Service
public class LiveAuctionCalendarBatchService {
    private final FixtureWindowService windowService;
    private final CalendarCombinationScorer scorer;

    public LiveAuctionCalendarBatchService(FixtureWindowService windowService,
            CalendarCombinationScorer scorer) {
        this.windowService = windowService;
        this.scorer = scorer;
    }

    public Map<Long, CalendarCombinationResult> evaluate(String season, int from, int horizon,
            List<SquadTargetResponse> targets, List<CalendarPlayerCandidate> activeCandidates,
            List<BoughtPlayerRequest> boughtPlayers, String role) {
        Map<Long, CalendarPlayerCandidate> active = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        activeCandidates.forEach(candidate -> active.put(candidate.playerId(), candidate));
        List<Long> ownedClubIds = boughtPlayers.stream()
                .filter(player -> role.equalsIgnoreCase(player.role()))
                .map(BoughtPlayerRequest::playerId).map(active::get).filter(java.util.Objects::nonNull)
                .map(CalendarPlayerCandidate::clubId).distinct().sorted().limit(2).toList();
        if (ownedClubIds.isEmpty()) return Map.of();

        List<Long> clubIds = new ArrayList<>(ownedClubIds);
        targets.stream().map(SquadTargetResponse::playerId).map(active::get)
                .filter(java.util.Objects::nonNull).map(CalendarPlayerCandidate::clubId)
                .filter(id -> !clubIds.contains(id)).forEach(clubIds::add);
        Map<Long, ClubFixtureProfile> profiles = windowService.loadClubProfiles(season, clubIds, from, horizon);
        Map<Long, CalendarCombinationResult> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (SquadTargetResponse target : targets) {
            CalendarPlayerCandidate candidate = active.get(target.playerId());
            if (candidate == null || ownedClubIds.contains(candidate.clubId())) continue;
            List<Long> combination = new ArrayList<>();
            combination.add(candidate.clubId());
            ownedClubIds.stream().filter(id -> !id.equals(candidate.clubId()))
                    .limit(2).forEach(combination::add);
            if (combination.size() < 2) continue;
            List<ClubFixtureProfile> candidateProfiles = combination.stream().map(profiles::get)
                    .filter(java.util.Objects::nonNull).toList();
            if (candidateProfiles.size() == combination.size()) {
                result.put(target.playerId(), scorer.evaluate(candidateProfiles, from, horizon));
            }
        }
        return Map.copyOf(result);
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\liveauction\LiveAuctionDecisionEngine.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.CalendarCombinationResult;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.DynamicBudgetResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence.StrategicIntelligenceProfile;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence.StrategicSignal;

@Component
public class LiveAuctionDecisionEngine {
    private final LiveAuctionBudgetGuard budgetGuard;
    private final LiveAuctionAlternativeService alternativeService;
    private final LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy policy;

    public LiveAuctionDecisionEngine(LiveAuctionBudgetGuard budgetGuard,
            LiveAuctionAlternativeService alternativeService,
            LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy policy) {
        this.budgetGuard = budgetGuard;
        this.alternativeService = alternativeService;
        this.policy = policy;
    }

    public LiveAuctionDecisionResponse decide(LiveAuctionDecisionRequest request,
            DynamicBudgetResponse budget, List<String> missingProfileNeeds,
            LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation current,
            List<LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation> alternatives) {
        int bid = request.proposedBid();
        var target = current.target();
        var safety = budgetGuard.evaluate(bid, request.remainingBudget(), budget);
        LiveAuctionPriceZone zone = zone(bid, target.targetPrice(), target.contextualMaxPrice());
        boolean alternativeAllowed = Boolean.TRUE.equals(request.availabilityComplete());
        Optional<LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation> dominant = safety.sustainable() && alternativeAllowed
                ? alternativeService.dominantAlternative(current, bid, alternatives)
                : Optional.empty();

        List<String> reasons = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> missing = new ArrayList<>();
        LiveAuctionAction action;

        // Explicit precedence: budget safety, B54 max, roster/alternative, price,
        // strategic/calendar support. Evidence never overrides a stop condition.
        if (!safety.sustainable()) {
            action = LiveAuctionAction.LASCIA;
            reasons.add(safety.reason());
        } else if (bid >= target.contextualMaxPrice()) {
            action = LiveAuctionAction.LASCIA;
            reasons.add("CURRENT_BID_AT_OR_ABOVE_B54_CONTEXTUAL_MAX");
        } else if (bid >= Math.max(1, target.contextualMaxPrice()
                - LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy.CONTEXTUAL_MAX_STOP_DISTANCE)) {
            action = LiveAuctionAction.FERMATI;
            reasons.add("CURRENT_BID_ONE_CREDIT_FROM_B54_CONTEXTUAL_MAX");
        } else if (dominant.isPresent()) {
            action = LiveAuctionAction.ALTERNATIVA_MIGLIORE;
            reasons.add("REAL_AVAILABLE_ALTERNATIVE_DOMINATES_ON_FIT_AND_AFFORDABILITY");
        } else if (bid <= target.targetPrice()) {
            if (policy.immediateBuy(bid, target.targetPrice(), target.fitScore())) {
                action = LiveAuctionAction.ACQUISTA_ORA;
                reasons.add("DEEP_VALUE_ZONE_WITH_STRONG_B54_FIT");
            } else {
                action = LiveAuctionAction.RILANCIA;
                reasons.add("WITHIN_B54_TARGET_AND_BUDGET_SAFE");
            }
        } else if (policy.cautionFit(target.fitScore()) && strategicSupport(current.strategic())) {
            action = LiveAuctionAction.RILANCIA;
            reasons.add("SELECTIVE_CAUTION_ZONE_BID_SUPPORTED_BY_FIT_AND_B56");
        } else {
            action = LiveAuctionAction.OSSERVA;
            reasons.add("CAUTION_ZONE_WITHOUT_ENOUGH_SUPPORT_FOR_A_STRONG_CALL");
        }

        if (current.strategic() == null) missing.add("B56_STRATEGIC_PROFILE");
        else missing.addAll(current.strategic().missingCriticalInputs());
        if (request.currentMatchday() == null) missing.add("CURRENT_MATCHDAY_FOR_B57");
        else if (current.calendar() == null) missing.add("B57_CALENDAR_COMPLEMENT");
        if (current.strategic() == null) warnings.add("B56 evidence unavailable; it was not converted to zero");
        if (current.calendar() == null) warnings.add("B57 evidence unavailable; budget/FIT decision remains valid");
        if (!alternativeAllowed) warnings.add("Disponibilita globale alternative non certificata");

        BigDecimal confidence = confidence(current, request.currentMatchday() != null, !alternatives.isEmpty());
        LiveAuctionEvidenceStatus evidence = confidence.doubleValue()
                >= LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy.AVAILABLE_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD
                ? LiveAuctionEvidenceStatus.AVAILABLE
                : confidence.doubleValue() >= LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy.PARTIAL_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD
                        ? LiveAuctionEvidenceStatus.PARTIAL
                : LiveAuctionEvidenceStatus.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE;
        if (action == LiveAuctionAction.OSSERVA && evidence == LiveAuctionEvidenceStatus.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE) {
            action = LiveAuctionAction.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE;
        }

        int remainingSlots = budget.slotsRemainingByRole().values().stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).sum();
        var budgetSummary = new LiveAuctionDecisionResponse.BudgetSummary(
                safety.minimumCompletionReserve(), budget.futureBudgetProtected(),
                budget.currentRoleMinimumReserve(), budget.currentRoleBudgetAvailable(),
                remainingSlots, safety.sustainable());
        var fit = new LiveAuctionDecisionResponse.FitSummary(target.fitScore(), target.profileCategory(),
                List.copyOf(missingProfileNeeds), target.reasons());

        return new LiveAuctionDecisionResponse(action, target.playerId(), target.playerName(), target.role(),
                request.currentPrice(), bid, bid, bid,
                target.b51RecommendedPrice(), target.targetPrice(), target.contextualMaxPrice(), zone,
                request.remainingBudget(), safety.budgetAfterBid(), budgetSummary, fit,
                strategic(current.strategic()), calendar(current.calendar(), request), alternativeAllowed,
                alternativeAllowed,
                alternative(dominant), confidence, evidence, List.copyOf(reasons),
                List.copyOf(warnings), missing.stream().distinct().toList());
    }

    public LiveAuctionPriceZone zone(int bid, int target, int maximum) {
        if (bid <= target) return LiveAuctionPriceZone.VALUE_ZONE;
        if (bid < maximum) return LiveAuctionPriceZone.CAUTION_ZONE;
        return LiveAuctionPriceZone.STOP_ZONE;
    }

    private boolean strategicSupport(StrategicIntelligenceProfile profile) {
        if (profile == null) return false;
        return List.of(profile.bonusOpportunity(), profile.roleAdvantage(), profile.aerialThreat())
                .stream().anyMatch(signal -> policy.strategicSupport(signal.score(), signal.status().name()));
    }

    private BigDecimal confidence(LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation current,
            boolean matchdaySupplied, boolean alternativesAvailable) {
        BigDecimal b54 = current.target().confidence();
        BigDecimal b56 = current.strategic() == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO
                : current.strategic().evidenceCompleteness();
        BigDecimal b57 = current.calendar() == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO
                : current.calendar().confidence();
        return policy.confidence(b54, b56, b57, alternativesAvailable, matchdaySupplied)
                .setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    private LiveAuctionDecisionResponse.StrategicSummary strategic(StrategicIntelligenceProfile profile) {
        if (profile == null) return new LiveAuctionDecisionResponse.StrategicSummary(Map.of(), bd(0),
                List.of("B56_STRATEGIC_PROFILE"));
        Map<String, LiveAuctionDecisionResponse.SignalSummary> signals = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        signals.put("BONUS_OPPORTUNITY", signal(profile.bonusOpportunity()));
        signals.put("ROLE_ADVANTAGE", signal(profile.roleAdvantage()));
        signals.put("AERIAL_THREAT", signal(profile.aerialThreat()));
        signals.put("UPSIDE", signal(profile.upside()));
        return new LiveAuctionDecisionResponse.StrategicSummary(Map.copyOf(signals),
                profile.evidenceCompleteness(), profile.missingCriticalInputs());
    }

    private LiveAuctionDecisionResponse.SignalSummary signal(StrategicSignal signal) {
        return new LiveAuctionDecisionResponse.SignalSummary(signal.score(), signal.status().name(),
                signal.confidence(), signal.category());
    }

    private LiveAuctionDecisionResponse.CalendarSummary calendar(CalendarCombinationResult calendar,
            LiveAuctionDecisionRequest request) {
        if (calendar == null) return new LiveAuctionDecisionResponse.CalendarSummary(null,
                "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE", bd(0), request.currentMatchday(), request.calendarHorizon(), null);
        return new LiveAuctionDecisionResponse.CalendarSummary(calendar.calendarCombinationScore(),
                calendar.status().name(), calendar.confidence(), calendar.fromMatchday(),
                request.calendarHorizon(), calendar.hardOverlapCount());
    }

    private LiveAuctionDecisionResponse.AlternativeSummary alternative(
            Optional<LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation> candidate) {
        return candidate.map(value -> new LiveAuctionDecisionResponse.AlternativeSummary(
                value.target().playerId(), value.target().playerName(), value.target().b51RecommendedPrice(),
                value.target().targetPrice(), value.target().fitScore(),
                "Fit non inferiore, prezzo B51 almeno "
                        + LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy.ALTERNATIVE_MINIMUM_SAVING
                        + " crediti sotto il proposed bid ed evidence comparabile"))
                .orElse(null);
    }

    private BigDecimal bd(double value) {
        return BigDecimal.valueOf(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, value))).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\liveauction\LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy {
    public static final BigDecimal IMMEDIATE_BUY_TARGET_RATIO = new BigDecimal("0.75");
    public static final int STRONG_FIT_THRESHOLD = 65;
    public static final int CAUTION_FIT_THRESHOLD = 70;
    public static final int STRATEGIC_SUPPORT_THRESHOLD = 65;
    public static final int CONTEXTUAL_MAX_STOP_DISTANCE = 1;
    public static final int ALTERNATIVE_MINIMUM_SAVING = 5;
    public static final int ALTERNATIVE_EVIDENCE_TOLERANCE = 25;
    public static final int GOALKEEPER_MAX_FIT_COMPENSATION = 5;
    public static final int GOALKEEPER_CALENDAR_IMPROVEMENT = 10;
    public static final int AVAILABLE_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD = 75;
    public static final int PARTIAL_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD = 40;
    public static final BigDecimal B54_CONFIDENCE_WEIGHT = new BigDecimal("0.55");
    public static final BigDecimal B56_CONFIDENCE_WEIGHT = new BigDecimal("0.20");
    public static final BigDecimal B57_CONFIDENCE_WEIGHT = new BigDecimal("0.15");
    public static final BigDecimal ALTERNATIVE_CONFIDENCE_WEIGHT = new BigDecimal("0.10");
    public static final int MISSING_MATCHDAY_CONFIDENCE_CAP = 75;

    public boolean immediateBuy(int proposedBid, int targetPrice, BigDecimal fit) {
        return BigDecimal.valueOf(proposedBid).compareTo(
                BigDecimal.valueOf(targetPrice).multiply(IMMEDIATE_BUY_TARGET_RATIO)) <= 0
                && fit.compareTo(BigDecimal.valueOf(STRONG_FIT_THRESHOLD)) >= 0;
    }

    public boolean cautionFit(BigDecimal fit) {
        return fit.compareTo(BigDecimal.valueOf(CAUTION_FIT_THRESHOLD)) >= 0;
    }

    public boolean strategicSupport(BigDecimal score, String status) {
        return score != null && score.compareTo(BigDecimal.valueOf(STRATEGIC_SUPPORT_THRESHOLD)) >= 0
                && "AVAILABLE".equals(status);
    }

    public boolean alternativeSaving(int alternativePrice, int proposedBid) {
        return alternativePrice + ALTERNATIVE_MINIMUM_SAVING <= proposedBid;
    }

    public boolean comparableEvidence(int alternativeEvidence, int currentEvidence) {
        return alternativeEvidence + ALTERNATIVE_EVIDENCE_TOLERANCE >= currentEvidence;
    }

    public BigDecimal confidence(BigDecimal b54, BigDecimal b56, BigDecimal b57,
            boolean alternativesAvailable, boolean matchdaySupplied) {
        BigDecimal value = b54.multiply(B54_CONFIDENCE_WEIGHT)
                .add(b56.multiply(B56_CONFIDENCE_WEIGHT))
                .add(b57.multiply(B57_CONFIDENCE_WEIGHT))
                .add(BigDecimal.valueOf(alternativesAvailable ? 100 : 50)
                        .multiply(ALTERNATIVE_CONFIDENCE_WEIGHT));
        return !matchdaySupplied && value.compareTo(BigDecimal.valueOf(MISSING_MATCHDAY_CONFIDENCE_CAP)) > 0
                ? BigDecimal.valueOf(MISSING_MATCHDAY_CONFIDENCE_CAP) : value;
    }
}
