--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\liveauction\LiveAuctionDecisionService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.CalendarCandidateService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.CalendarCandidateService.CalendarPlayerCandidate;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.CalendarCombinationResult;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction.LiveAuctionPlayerContextService.PlayerContext;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.BoughtPlayerRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.SquadConstructionRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.SquadConstructionResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.SquadConstructionService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.SquadTargetResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence.StrategicIntelligenceProfile;

@Service
public class LiveAuctionDecisionService {
    private static final int MAX_ALTERNATIVES = 20;
    private final LiveAuctionPlayerContextService playerContextService;
    private final SquadConstructionService squadConstructionService;
    private final CalendarCandidateService candidateService;
    private final LiveAuctionStrategicBatchService strategicBatchService;
    private final LiveAuctionCalendarBatchService calendarBatchService;
    private final LiveAuctionDecisionEngine decisionEngine;

    public LiveAuctionDecisionService(LiveAuctionPlayerContextService playerContextService,
            SquadConstructionService squadConstructionService,
            CalendarCandidateService candidateService,
            LiveAuctionStrategicBatchService strategicBatchService,
            LiveAuctionCalendarBatchService calendarBatchService,
            LiveAuctionDecisionEngine decisionEngine) {
        this.playerContextService = playerContextService;
        this.squadConstructionService = squadConstructionService;
        this.candidateService = candidateService;
        this.strategicBatchService = strategicBatchService;
        this.calendarBatchService = calendarBatchService;
        this.decisionEngine = decisionEngine;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public LiveAuctionDecisionResponse decide(LiveAuctionDecisionRequest request) {
        validate(request);
        request = canonical(request);
        String season = request.season().trim();
        String role = request.currentRole().trim().toUpperCase();
        PlayerContext currentPlayer = playerContextService.load(request.currentPlayerId(), season);
        if (!currentPlayer.active() || !currentPlayer.registrationActive() || !currentPlayer.clubActive()) {
            throw new BadRequestException("Il giocatore corrente non e' attivo nella stagione richiesta");
        }
        if (!role.equals(currentPlayer.role())) {
            throw new BadRequestException("Il ruolo corrente non coincide con il ruolo Fantacalcio del giocatore");
        }

        List<BoughtPlayerRequest> bought = request.playersAlreadyBought() == null
                ? List.of() : List.copyOf(request.playersAlreadyBought());
        SquadConstructionResponse construction = squadConstructionService.evaluate(new SquadConstructionRequest(
                season, request.leagueTeams(), request.totalBudget(), request.remainingBudget(),
                Boolean.TRUE.equals(request.defenseModifier()), role, request.rosterSlots(), bought, 100));
        Map<Long, SquadTargetResponse> targets = allTargets(construction);
        SquadTargetResponse current = targets.get(request.currentPlayerId());
        if (current == null) return insufficient(request, currentPlayer);

        Set<Long> excluded = new HashSet<>(request.excludedPlayerIds() == null
                ? List.of() : request.excludedPlayerIds());
        excluded.addAll(request.unavailablePlayerIds());
        bought.forEach(player -> excluded.add(player.playerId()));
        excluded.add(request.currentPlayerId());
        int limit = request.alternativeLimit() == null ? 10
                : Math.min(MAX_ALTERNATIVES, Math.max(1, request.alternativeLimit()));
        List<SquadTargetResponse> alternatives = targets.values().stream()
                .filter(target -> !excluded.contains(target.playerId()))
                .sorted(java.util.Comparator.comparing(SquadTargetResponse::auctionPriorityScore).reversed()
                        .thenComparing(SquadTargetResponse::playerId))
                .limit(limit).toList();
        List<SquadTargetResponse> evaluatedTargets = new ArrayList<>();
        evaluatedTargets.add(current);
        evaluatedTargets.addAll(alternatives);

        // One active-candidate query, one B56 observation batch and, when requested,
        // one B57 fixture-window batch for current player plus shortlisted alternatives.
        List<CalendarPlayerCandidate> active = candidateService.loadActive(season, role);
        Map<Long, StrategicIntelligenceProfile> strategic = strategicBatchService.load(season, evaluatedTargets);
        Map<Long, CalendarCombinationResult> calendars = request.currentMatchday() == null ? Map.of()
                : calendarBatchService.evaluate(season, request.currentMatchday(), horizon(request),
                        evaluatedTargets, active, bought, role);
        LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation currentEvaluation = evaluation(current, strategic, calendars);
        List<LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation> alternativeEvaluations = alternatives.stream()
                .map(target -> evaluation(target, strategic, calendars)).toList();
        return decisionEngine.decide(request, construction.budget(), construction.missingProfileNeeds(),
                currentEvaluation, alternativeEvaluations);
    }

    void validate(LiveAuctionDecisionRequest request) {
        if (request == null) throw new BadRequestException("Il contesto live e' obbligatorio");
        if (request.season() == null || request.season().isBlank())
            throw new BadRequestException("season e' obbligatoria");
        if (request.leagueTeams() == null || request.leagueTeams() < 6 || request.leagueTeams() > 12)
            throw new BadRequestException("leagueTeams deve essere compreso tra 6 e 12");
        if (request.totalBudget() == null || request.totalBudget() < 150 || request.totalBudget() > 1000)
            throw new BadRequestException("totalBudget deve essere compreso tra 150 e 1000");
        if (request.remainingBudget() == null || request.remainingBudget() < 0
                || request.remainingBudget() > request.totalBudget())
            throw new BadRequestException("remainingBudget non coerente");
        if (request.defenseModifier() == null)
            throw new BadRequestException("defenseModifier e' obbligatorio");
        if (request.currentRole() == null || !List.of("P", "D", "C", "A")
                .contains(request.currentRole().trim().toUpperCase()))
            throw new BadRequestException("currentRole deve essere P, D, C oppure A");
        int proposedBid = effectiveBid(request);
        if (request.currentPrice() != null && request.currentPrice() < 1)
            throw new BadRequestException("currentPrice deve essere almeno 1");
        if (request.currentPrice() != null && proposedBid < request.currentPrice())
            throw new BadRequestException("proposedBid non puo' essere inferiore a currentPrice");
        if (request.currentPlayerId() == null || request.currentPlayerId() <= 0)
            throw new BadRequestException("currentPlayerId non valido");
        if (proposedBid > request.remainingBudget())
            throw new BadRequestException("proposedBid supera il budget residuo");
        if (request.calendarHorizon() != null
                && (request.calendarHorizon() < 1 || request.calendarHorizon() > 10))
            throw new BadRequestException("calendarHorizon deve essere compreso tra 1 e 10");
        if (request.currentMatchday() != null
                && (request.currentMatchday() < 1 || request.currentMatchday() > 38))
            throw new BadRequestException("currentMatchday deve essere compreso tra 1 e 38");
        List<BoughtPlayerRequest> bought = request.playersAlreadyBought() == null
                ? List.of() : request.playersAlreadyBought();
        Set<Long> ids = new HashSet<>();
        int spent = 0;
        for (BoughtPlayerRequest player : bought) {
            if (player.playerId() == null || player.playerId() <= 0 || !ids.add(player.playerId()))
                throw new BadRequestException("La rosa contiene playerId nulli o duplicati");
            if (player.pricePaid() < 1) throw new BadRequestException("Ogni prezzo pagato deve essere almeno 1");
            spent += player.pricePaid();
        }
        if (request.totalBudget() - spent != request.remainingBudget())
            throw new BadRequestException("Budget residuo incoerente con i prezzi pagati");
        if (ids.contains(request.currentPlayerId()))
            throw new BadRequestException("Il giocatore corrente e' gia' stato acquistato");
        validateIds("excludedPlayerIds", request.excludedPlayerIds(), request.currentPlayerId(), ids, false);
        validateIds("unavailablePlayerIds", request.unavailablePlayerIds(), request.currentPlayerId(), ids, true);
    }

    int effectiveBid(LiveAuctionDecisionRequest request) {
        if (request.proposedBid() != null && request.currentBid() != null
                && !request.proposedBid().equals(request.currentBid())) {
            throw new BadRequestException("proposedBid e currentBid legacy sono in conflitto");
        }
        Integer bid = request.proposedBid() != null ? request.proposedBid() : request.currentBid();
        if (bid == null || bid < 1) throw new BadRequestException("proposedBid deve essere almeno 1");
        return bid;
    }

    private LiveAuctionDecisionRequest canonical(LiveAuctionDecisionRequest request) {
        return new LiveAuctionDecisionRequest(request.season(), request.leagueTeams(),
                request.totalBudget(), request.remainingBudget(), request.defenseModifier(),
                request.currentRole(), request.currentPlayerId(), request.currentPrice(),
                effectiveBid(request), request.currentBid(), request.rosterSlots(),
                request.playersAlreadyBought(), request.currentMatchday(), request.calendarHorizon(),
                request.alternativeLimit(), safeIds(request.excludedPlayerIds()),
                safeIds(request.unavailablePlayerIds()), Boolean.TRUE.equals(request.availabilityComplete()));
    }

    private void validateIds(String field, List<Long> values, Long currentPlayerId,
            Set<Long> bought, boolean rejectBoughtOverlap) {
        Set<Long> unique = new HashSet<>();
        for (Long id : safeIds(values)) {
            if (id == null || id <= 0 || !unique.add(id))
                throw new BadRequestException(field + " deve contenere ID positivi e unici");
            if (id.equals(currentPlayerId))
                throw new BadRequestException("Il giocatore corrente non puo' essere " + field);
            if (rejectBoughtOverlap && bought.contains(id))
                throw new BadRequestException("Un player comprato dall'utente non puo' essere unavailable");
        }
    }

    private List<Long> safeIds(List<Long> values) { return values == null ? List.of() : values; }

    private Map<Long, SquadTargetResponse> allTargets(SquadConstructionResponse response) {
        Map<Long, SquadTargetResponse> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        response.recommendedTargets().forEach(target -> result.put(target.playerId(), target));
        return result;
    }

    private LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation evaluation(SquadTargetResponse target,
            Map<Long, StrategicIntelligenceProfile> strategic,
            Map<Long, CalendarCombinationResult> calendar) {
        return new LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation(target, strategic.get(target.playerId()),
                calendar.get(target.playerId()));
    }

    private int horizon(LiveAuctionDecisionRequest request) {
        return request.calendarHorizon() == null ? 5 : request.calendarHorizon();
    }

    private LiveAuctionDecisionResponse insufficient(LiveAuctionDecisionRequest request,
            PlayerContext player) {
        int bid = request.proposedBid();
        boolean availability = Boolean.TRUE.equals(request.availabilityComplete());
        return new LiveAuctionDecisionResponse(LiveAuctionAction.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE,
                request.currentPlayerId(), null, player.role(), request.currentPrice(), bid, bid, bid,
                null, null, null, null,
                request.remainingBudget(), request.remainingBudget() - bid, null, null,
                new LiveAuctionDecisionResponse.StrategicSummary(Map.of(), BigDecimal.ZERO,
                        List.of("B51_OR_B54_CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE")),
                new LiveAuctionDecisionResponse.CalendarSummary(null, "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE",
                        BigDecimal.ZERO, request.currentMatchday(), request.calendarHorizon(), null),
                availability, availability, null, BigDecimal.ZERO.setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP),
                LiveAuctionEvidenceStatus.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE,
                List.of("B51_OR_B54_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED_FOR_DECISION"), List.of(),
                List.of("B51_RECOMMENDED_PRICE", "B54_TARGET_CONTEXT"));
    }

}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

@Service
public class LiveAuctionPlayerContextService {
    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public LiveAuctionPlayerContextService(JdbcClient jdbcClient) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public PlayerContext load(Long playerId, String season) {
        boolean exists = jdbcClient.sql("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM players WHERE id=:id)")
                .param("id", playerId).query(Boolean.class).single();
        if (!exists) throw new ResourceNotFoundException("Giocatore non trovato");
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT player.active player_active,
                       registration.registration_status='ACTIVE' registration_active,
                       season_club.club_id IS NOT NULL club_active, role.fantasy_role
                FROM players player
                LEFT JOIN seasons season ON season.code=:season
                LEFT JOIN player_registrations registration
                       ON registration.player_id=player.id AND registration.season_id=season.id
                LEFT JOIN clubs club ON club.id=registration.club_id
                LEFT JOIN season_clubs season_club ON season_club.season_id=season.id
                       AND season_club.club_id=registration.club_id
                LEFT JOIN player_roles role ON role.player_id=player.id AND role.season_id=season.id
                       AND role.source='FANTACALCIO'
                WHERE player.id=:id
                """).param("season", season).param("id", playerId)
                .query((rs, n) -> new PlayerContext(rs.getBoolean("player_active"),
                        rs.getBoolean("registration_active"), rs.getBoolean("club_active"),
                        rs.getString("fantasy_role"))).optional()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new BadRequestException("Stagione o registrazione non coerente"));
    }

    public record PlayerContext(boolean active, boolean registrationActive,
            boolean clubActive, String role) { }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.SquadTargetResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategic.RealPosition;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence.AerialThreatInput;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence.BonusOpportunityInput;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence.RoleAdvantageInput;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence.StrategicIntelligenceProfile;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence.StrategicIntelligenceService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence.StrategicProfileInput;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence.UpsideInput;

@Service
public class LiveAuctionStrategicBatchService {
    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final StrategicIntelligenceService intelligenceService;

    public LiveAuctionStrategicBatchService(JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            StrategicIntelligenceService intelligenceService) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.intelligenceService = intelligenceService;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Map<Long, StrategicIntelligenceProfile> load(String season,
            List<SquadTargetResponse> candidates) {
        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return Map.of();
        List<Long> ids = candidates.stream().map(SquadTargetResponse::playerId).distinct().toList();
        List<Row> rows = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT o.player_id, o.source, o.confidence_score, o.real_position_normalized,
                       o.penalty_hierarchy, o.direct_free_kick_hierarchy,
                       o.indirect_free_kick_hierarchy, o.corner_hierarchy, o.set_piece_shared,
                       o.shots, o.expected_goals, o.expected_assists, o.touches_in_box,
                       o.key_passes, o.aerial_duels, o.aerial_duels_won, o.headed_shots,
                       o.headed_goals, o.headed_expected_goals, o.offensive_box_touches,
                       o.set_piece_box_presence, o.corner_target_frequency, o.starts,
                       o.minutes_played, o.starter_probability,
                       evaluation.potential_score, evaluation.reliability_score, evaluation.risk_score
                FROM player_strategic_data_observations o
                JOIN seasons season ON season.id=o.season_id AND season.code=:season
                LEFT JOIN player_evaluations evaluation
                       ON evaluation.player_id=o.player_id AND evaluation.season_id=season.id
                WHERE o.player_id IN (:ids)
                ORDER BY o.player_id, o.source, o.observed_at DESC NULLS LAST, o.id
                """).param("season", season).param("ids", ids).query((rs, n) -> new Row(
                        rs.getLong("player_id"), rs.getString("source"), rs.getBigDecimal("confidence_score"),
                        position(rs.getString("real_position_normalized")), rs.getString("penalty_hierarchy"),
                        rs.getString("direct_free_kick_hierarchy"), rs.getString("indirect_free_kick_hierarchy"),
                        rs.getString("corner_hierarchy"), (Boolean) rs.getObject("set_piece_shared"),
                        integer(rs.getObject("shots")), rs.getBigDecimal("expected_goals"),
                        rs.getBigDecimal("expected_assists"), integer(rs.getObject("touches_in_box")),
                        integer(rs.getObject("key_passes")), integer(rs.getObject("aerial_duels")),
                        integer(rs.getObject("aerial_duels_won")), integer(rs.getObject("headed_shots")),
                        integer(rs.getObject("headed_goals")), rs.getBigDecimal("headed_expected_goals"),
                        integer(rs.getObject("offensive_box_touches")), rs.getBigDecimal("set_piece_box_presence"),
                        rs.getBigDecimal("corner_target_frequency"), integer(rs.getObject("starts")),
                        integer(rs.getObject("minutes_played")), rs.getBigDecimal("starter_probability"),
                        rs.getBigDecimal("potential_score"), rs.getBigDecimal("reliability_score"),
                        rs.getBigDecimal("risk_score"))).list();
        Map<Long, List<Row>> grouped = rows.stream().collect(Collectors.groupingBy(Row::playerId,
                LinkedHashMap::new, Collectors.toList()));
        Map<Long, SquadTargetResponse> targets = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
                SquadTargetResponse::playerId, Function.identity(), (a, b) -> a, LinkedHashMap::new));
        Map<Long, StrategicIntelligenceProfile> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        grouped.forEach((id, observations) -> result.put(id,
                intelligenceService.calculate(input(season, targets.get(id), observations))));
        return Map.copyOf(result);
    }

    private StrategicProfileInput input(String season, SquadTargetResponse target, List<Row> rows) {
        boolean conflict = conflict(rows);
        List<String> sources = rows.stream().map(Row::source).distinct().toList();
        Row r = rows.getFirst();
        Integer minutes = value(rows, Row::minutes);
        BigDecimal shots90 = rate(value(rows, Row::shots), minutes);
        BigDecimal xg90 = rate(value(rows, Row::expectedGoals), minutes);
        BigDecimal xa90 = rate(value(rows, Row::expectedAssists), minutes);
        BigDecimal confidence = average(rows, Row::confidence);
        var bonus = new BonusOpportunityInput(value(rows, Row::penaltyHierarchy),
                value(rows, Row::directFreeKickHierarchy), value(rows, Row::indirectFreeKickHierarchy),
                value(rows, Row::cornerHierarchy), value(rows, Row::setPieceShared), xg90, xa90, shots90,
                value(rows, Row::touchesInBox), value(rows, Row::keyPasses), minutes,
                average(rows, Row::starterProbability), confidence, sources, conflict);
        var role = new RoleAdvantageInput(target.role(), value(rows, Row::position), confidence,
                minutes, value(rows, Row::starts), null, sources, conflict);
        var aerial = new AerialThreatInput(value(rows, Row::headedShots), value(rows, Row::headedGoals),
                value(rows, Row::headedExpectedGoals), value(rows, Row::offensiveBoxTouches),
                average(rows, Row::setPieceBoxPresence), average(rows, Row::cornerTargetFrequency),
                value(rows, Row::aerialDuels), value(rows, Row::aerialDuelsWon), minutes, confidence,
                sources, conflict);
        var upside = new UpsideInput(r.potential(), r.reliability(), r.risk(),
                average(rows, Row::starterProbability),
                BigDecimal.valueOf(target.targetPrice() - target.b51RecommendedPrice()),
                null, null, true, sources);
        return new StrategicProfileInput(target.playerId(), season, target.role(), bonus, role, aerial, upside);
    }

    private boolean conflict(List<Row> rows) {
        return differs(rows, Row::position) || differs(rows, Row::penaltyHierarchy)
                || differs(rows, Row::directFreeKickHierarchy) || differs(rows, Row::cornerHierarchy);
    }

    private <T> boolean differs(List<Row> rows, Function<Row, T> field) {
        return rows.stream().map(field).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().limit(2).count() > 1;
    }

    private <T> T value(List<Row> rows, Function<Row, T> field) {
        List<T> values = rows.stream().map(field).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().limit(2).toList();
        return values.size() == 1 ? values.getFirst() : null;
    }

    private BigDecimal average(List<Row> rows, Function<Row, BigDecimal> field) {
        List<BigDecimal> values = rows.stream().map(field).filter(Objects::nonNull).toList();
        if (values.isEmpty()) return null;
        return values.stream().reduce(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal::add)
                .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(values.size()), 2, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    private BigDecimal rate(Integer total, Integer minutes) {
        return total == null || minutes == null || minutes <= 0 ? null : BigDecimal.valueOf(total).multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(90))
                .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(minutes), 4, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    private BigDecimal rate(BigDecimal total, Integer minutes) {
        return total == null || minutes == null || minutes <= 0 ? null : total.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(90))
                .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(minutes), 4, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    private static Integer integer(Object value) { return value instanceof Number n ? n.intValue() : null; }
    private static RealPosition position(String value) { return value == null ? null : RealPosition.valueOf(value); }

    private record Row(Long playerId, String source, BigDecimal confidence, RealPosition position,
            String penaltyHierarchy, String directFreeKickHierarchy, String indirectFreeKickHierarchy,
            String cornerHierarchy, Boolean setPieceShared, Integer shots, BigDecimal expectedGoals,
            BigDecimal expectedAssists, Integer touchesInBox, Integer keyPasses, Integer aerialDuels,
            Integer aerialDuelsWon, Integer headedShots, Integer headedGoals, BigDecimal headedExpectedGoals,
            Integer offensiveBoxTouches, BigDecimal setPieceBoxPresence, BigDecimal cornerTargetFrequency,
            Integer starts, Integer minutes, BigDecimal starterProbability, BigDecimal potential,
            BigDecimal reliability, BigDecimal risk) { }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\pairing\PlayerPairingService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.pairing;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction.AuctionPriceResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction.AuctionApiPriceService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture.FixtureDifficultyResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture.FixtureDifficultyService;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class PlayerPairingService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final AuctionApiPriceService auctionPriceService;
    private final FixtureDifficultyService fixtureDifficultyService;

    public PlayerPairingService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            AuctionApiPriceService auctionPriceService,
            FixtureDifficultyService fixtureDifficultyService
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.auctionPriceService = auctionPriceService;
        this.fixtureDifficultyService = fixtureDifficultyService;
    }

    @Transactional
    public List<PlayerPairingResponse> findPairings(
            String season,
            String role,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier,
            int fromMatchday,
            int toMatchday,
            int limit
    ) {
        validateMatchdays(fromMatchday, toMatchday);

        String normalizedRole =
                role.trim().toUpperCase();

        if (!List.of("P", "D", "C", "A")
                .contains(normalizedRole)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Ruolo non valido"
            );
        }

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    player.id,
                    player.display_name,
                    club.name AS club_name,
                    club.slug AS club_slug

                FROM players player

                JOIN player_reconciliation_results reconciliation
                    ON reconciliation.player_id = player.id

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = reconciliation.season_id

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = player.id
                    AND registration.season_id = season.id

                JOIN clubs club
                    ON club.id = registration.club_id

                JOIN season_clubs season_club
                    ON season_club.season_id = season.id
                    AND season_club.club_id = club.id

                JOIN player_roles role
                    ON role.player_id = player.id
                    AND role.season_id = season.id
                    AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                WHERE season.code = :season
                  AND player.active = TRUE
                  AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'
                  AND role.fantasy_role = :role

                ORDER BY player.display_name
                """)
                .param("season", season)
                .param("role", normalizedRole)
                .query()
                .listOfRows();

        if (rows.isEmpty()) {
            return List.of();
        }

        Map<Long, AuctionPriceResponse> pricesByPlayer =
                auctionPriceService.calculateAll(
                                season,
                                budget,
                                teams,
                                defenseModifier
                        )
                        .stream()
                        .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                                AuctionPriceResponse::playerId,
                                Function.identity()
                        ));

        List<PairingCandidate> candidates =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {
            Long playerId =
                    ((Number) row.get("id")).longValue();

            AuctionPriceResponse auction =
                    pricesByPlayer.get(playerId);

            // B51 does not invent a price when market evidence is missing.
            if (auction == null) {
                continue;
            }

            String clubSlug =
                    row.get("club_slug").toString();

            List<FixtureDifficultyResponse> fixtures =
                    fixtureDifficultyService.findClubFixtures(
                            season,
                            clubSlug,
                            fromMatchday,
                            toMatchday
                    );

            double averageDifficulty = fixtures
                    .stream()
                    .mapToDouble(fixture ->
                            fixture.difficultyScore()
                                    .doubleValue()
                    )
                    .average()
                    .orElse(60);

            candidates.add(
                    new PairingCandidate(
                            playerId,
                            row.get("display_name").toString(),
                            row.get("club_name").toString(),
                            normalizedRole,
                            auction.recommendedPrice(),
                            auction.calculationScore(),
                            averageDifficulty,
                            fixtures
                    )
            );
        }

        List<PlayerPairingResponse> pairings =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (int first = 0;
             first < candidates.size();
             first++) {

            for (int second = first + 1;
                 second < candidates.size();
                 second++) {

                PairingCandidate firstPlayer =
                        candidates.get(first);

                PairingCandidate secondPlayer =
                        candidates.get(second);

                pairings.add(
                        createPairing(
                                firstPlayer,
                                secondPlayer,
                                fromMatchday,
                                toMatchday
                        )
                );
            }
        }

        pairings.sort(
                Comparator
                        .comparing(
                                PlayerPairingResponse::pairingScore
                        )
                        .reversed()
                        .thenComparing(
                                PlayerPairingResponse::
                                        combinedRecommendedPrice
                        )
        );

        int safeLimit =
                Math.min(Math.max(limit, 1), 100);

        List<PlayerPairingResponse> response =
                new ArrayList<>();

        int position = 1;

        for (PlayerPairingResponse pairing :
                pairings.stream()
                        .limit(safeLimit)
                        .toList()) {

            response.add(
                    new PlayerPairingResponse(
                            position,
                            pairing.firstPlayer(),
                            pairing.secondPlayer(),
                            pairing.combinedRecommendedPrice(),
                            pairing.pairingScore(),
                            pairing.recommendation(),
                            pairing.explanation()
                    )
            );

            position++;
        }

        return response;
    }

    private PlayerPairingResponse createPairing(
            PairingCandidate first,
            PairingCandidate second,
            int fromMatchday,
            int toMatchday
    ) {
        double playerQuality =
                (
                    first.evaluationScore().doubleValue()
                    + second.evaluationScore().doubleValue()
                ) / 2;

        double averageDifficulty =
                (
                    first.averageDifficulty()
                    + second.averageDifficulty()
                ) / 2;

        double fixtureQuality =
                100 - averageDifficulty;

        double alternationScore =
                calculateAlternationScore(
                        first,
                        second,
                        fromMatchday,
                        toMatchday
                );

        double priceEfficiency =
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        100 - (
                            (
                                first.recommendedPrice()
                                + second.recommendedPrice()
                            ) / 4.0
                        )
                );

        double finalScore =
                playerQuality * 0.45
                + fixtureQuality * 0.25
                + alternationScore * 0.20
                + priceEfficiency * 0.10;

        finalScore = Math.max(
                0,
                Math.min(finalScore, 100)
        );

        BigDecimal score = BigDecimal
                .valueOf(finalScore)
                .setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);

        String recommendation;

        if (finalScore >= 80) {
            recommendation = "ABBINAMENTO ECCELLENTE";
        } else if (finalScore >= 65) {
            recommendation = "ABBINAMENTO CONSIGLIATO";
        } else if (finalScore >= 50) {
            recommendation = "ABBINAMENTO DISCRETO";
        } else {
            recommendation = "ABBINAMENTO RISCHIOSO";
        }

        String explanation =
                "Valore medio "
                + round(playerQuality)
                + "/100, difficoltÃ  calendario "
                + round(averageDifficulty)
                + "/100 e complementaritÃ  "
                + round(alternationScore)
                + "/100.";

        return new PlayerPairingResponse(
                0,
                toResponse(first),
                toResponse(second),
                first.recommendedPrice()
                        + second.recommendedPrice(),
                score,
                recommendation,
                explanation
        );
    }

    private double calculateAlternationScore(
            PairingCandidate first,
            PairingCandidate second,
            int fromMatchday,
            int toMatchday
    ) {
        int analyzedMatchdays = 0;
        double total = 0;

        for (int matchday = fromMatchday;
             matchday <= toMatchday;
             matchday++) {

            Double firstDifficulty =
                    difficultyForMatchday(
                            first.fixtures(),
                            matchday
                    );

            Double secondDifficulty =
                    difficultyForMatchday(
                            second.fixtures(),
                            matchday
                    );

            if (firstDifficulty == null
                    || secondDifficulty == null) {
                continue;
            }

            double bestDifficulty =
                    Math.min(
                            firstDifficulty,
                            secondDifficulty
                    );

            double difference =
                    Math.abs(
                            firstDifficulty
                            - secondDifficulty
                    );

            double matchdayScore =
                    (100 - bestDifficulty) * 0.70
                    + Math.min(difference, 100) * 0.30;

            total += matchdayScore;
            analyzedMatchdays++;
        }

        if (analyzedMatchdays == 0) {
            return 50;
        }

        return total / analyzedMatchdays;
    }

    private Double difficultyForMatchday(
            List<FixtureDifficultyResponse> fixtures,
            int matchday
    ) {
        return fixtures.stream()
                .filter(fixture ->
                        fixture.matchday() == matchday
                )
                .map(fixture ->
                        fixture.difficultyScore()
                                .doubleValue()
                )
                .findFirst()
                .orElse(null);
    }

    private PairingPlayerResponse toResponse(
            PairingCandidate candidate
    ) {
        return new PairingPlayerResponse(
                candidate.playerId(),
                candidate.playerName(),
                candidate.club(),
                candidate.role(),
                candidate.recommendedPrice(),
                candidate.evaluationScore(),
                BigDecimal
                        .valueOf(
                                candidate.averageDifficulty()
                        )
                        .setScale(
                                2,
                                RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                        )
        );
    }

    private void validateMatchdays(
            int fromMatchday,
            int toMatchday
    ) {
        if (fromMatchday < 1
                || toMatchday > 38
                || fromMatchday > toMatchday) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Intervallo giornate non valido"
            );
        }
    }

    private String round(double value) {
        return BigDecimal
                .valueOf(value)
                .setScale(1, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)
                .toString();
    }

    private record PairingCandidate(
            Long playerId,
            String playerName,
            String club,
            String role,
            int recommendedPrice,
            BigDecimal evaluationScore,
            double averageDifficulty,
            List<FixtureDifficultyResponse> fixtures
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.player;

import java.time.LocalDate;

import jakarta.persistence.*;

@Entity
@Table(
    name = "players",
    indexes = {
        @Index(
            name = "idx_players_normalized_name",
            columnList = "normalized_name"
        )
    }
)
public class Player {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "first_name", length = 100)
    private String firstName;

    @Column(name = "last_name", nullable = false, length = 100)
    private String lastName;

    @Column(name = "display_name", nullable = false, length = 150)
    private String displayName;

    @Column(name = "normalized_name", nullable = false, length = 150)
    private String normalizedName;

    @Column(name = "birth_date")
    private LocalDate birthDate;

    @Column(name = "nationality_code", length = 2)
    private String nationalityCode;

    @Column(name = "preferred_foot", length = 10)
    private String preferredFoot;

    @Column(name = "height_cm")
    private Short heightCm;

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private boolean active;

    @Column(name = "created_at", nullable = false)
    private OffsetDateTime createdAt;

    @Column(name = "updated_at", nullable = false)
    private OffsetDateTime updatedAt;

    protected Player() {
    }

    public Long getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public String getFirstName() {
        return firstName;
    }

    public String getLastName() {
        return lastName;
    }

    public String getDisplayName() {
        return displayName;
    }

    public String getNormalizedName() {
        return normalizedName;
    }

    public LocalDate getBirthDate() {
        return birthDate;
    }

    public String getNationalityCode() {
        return nationalityCode;
    }

    public String getPreferredFoot() {
        return preferredFoot;
    }

    public Short getHeightCm() {
        return heightCm;
    }

    public boolean isActive() {
        return active;
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\player\PlayerCatalogService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.player;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.namedparam.NamedParameterJdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.PageResponse;

@Service
public class PlayerCatalogService {

    private final NamedParameterJdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;

    public PlayerCatalogService(
            NamedParameterJdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate
    ) {
        this.jdbcTemplate = jdbcTemplate;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public PageResponse<PlayerCatalogResponse> findPlayers(
            String season,
            String search,
            String club,
            String role,
            int page,
            int size
    ) {
        int safePage = Math.max(page, 0);
        int safeSize = Math.min(Math.max(size, 1), 100);
        int offset = safePage * safeSize;

        StringBuilder where = new StringBuilder("""
                WHERE s.code = :season
                  AND p.active = TRUE
                  AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'
                  AND role_fantacalcio.fantasy_role IS NOT NULL
                """);

        Map<String, Object> params = new HashMap<>();
        params.put("season", season);
        params.put("limit", safeSize);
        params.put("offset", offset);

        if (search != null && !search.isBlank()) {
            where.append("""
                    AND (
                        LOWER(p.display_name) LIKE :search
                        OR p.normalized_name LIKE :search
                    )
                    """);

            params.put(
                    "search",
                    "%" + search.trim().toLowerCase() + "%"
            );
        }

        if (club != null && !club.isBlank()) {
            where.append("""
                    AND (
                        LOWER(c.name) = :club
                        OR LOWER(c.slug) = :club
                    )
                    """);

            params.put(
                    "club",
                    club.trim().toLowerCase()
            );
        }

        if (role != null && !role.isBlank()) {
            where.append("""
                    AND EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM player_roles filter_role
                        WHERE filter_role.player_id = p.id
                          AND filter_role.season_id = s.id
                          AND filter_role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                          AND filter_role.fantasy_role = :role
                    )
                    """);

            params.put(
                    "role",
                    role.trim().toUpperCase()
            );
        }

        String joins = """
                FROM players p

                INNER JOIN player_reconciliation_results r
                    ON r.player_id = p.id

                INNER JOIN seasons s
                    ON s.id = r.season_id

                INNER JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = p.id
                    AND registration.season_id = s.id

                INNER JOIN clubs c
                    ON c.id = registration.club_id

                INNER JOIN season_clubs season_club
                    ON season_club.season_id = s.id
                    AND season_club.club_id = c.id

                LEFT JOIN player_roles role_fantacalcio
                    ON role_fantacalcio.player_id = p.id
                    AND role_fantacalcio.season_id = s.id
                    AND role_fantacalcio.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                LEFT JOIN player_roles role_gazzetta
                    ON role_gazzetta.player_id = p.id
                    AND role_gazzetta.season_id = s.id
                    AND role_gazzetta.source = 'GAZZETTA'

                LEFT JOIN player_roles role_fantamarkt
                    ON role_fantamarkt.player_id = p.id
                    AND role_fantamarkt.season_id = s.id
                    AND role_fantamarkt.source = 'FANTAMARKT'
                """;

        String dataSql = """
                SELECT
                    p.id,
                    p.display_name,
                    c.name AS club_name,
                    c.slug AS club_slug,
                    role_fantacalcio.fantasy_role
                        AS fantacalcio_role,
                    role_gazzetta.fantasy_role
                        AS gazzetta_role,
                    role_fantamarkt.fantasy_role
                        AS fantamarkt_role,
                    r.sources_count
                """
                + joins
                + where
                + """
                ORDER BY p.display_name ASC
                LIMIT :limit
                OFFSET :offset
                """;

        List<PlayerCatalogResponse> players =
                jdbcTemplate.query(
                        dataSql,
                        params,
                        (resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                                new PlayerCatalogResponse(
                                        resultSet.getLong("id"),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "display_name"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "club_name"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "club_slug"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "fantacalcio_role"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "gazzetta_role"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "fantamarkt_role"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getInt(
                                                "sources_count"
                                        )
                                )
                );

        String countSql = """
                SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
                """
                + joins
                + where;

        Long total = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                countSql,
                params,
                Long.class
        );

        long totalElements = total == null ? 0 : total;

        int totalPages = (int) Math.ceil(
                (double) totalElements / safeSize
        );

        return new PageResponse<>(
                players,
                safePage,
                safeSize,
                totalElements,
                totalPages
        );
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.player;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class PlayerDetailService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public PlayerDetailService(JdbcClient jdbcClient) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public PlayerDetailResponse findById(
            Long playerId,
            String seasonCode
    ) {
        Map<String, Object> player = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    p.id,
                    p.display_name,
                    c.name AS club_name,
                    c.slug AS club_slug,
                    s.id AS season_id
                FROM players p
                JOIN player_registrations pr
                    ON pr.player_id = p.id
                JOIN seasons s
                    ON s.id = pr.season_id
                JOIN clubs c
                    ON c.id = pr.club_id
                WHERE p.id = :playerId
                  AND s.code = :seasonCode
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonCode", seasonCode)
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .stream()
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Giocatore non trovato"
                        )
                );

        Long seasonId = ((Number) player.get("season_id"))
                .longValue();

        Map<String, String> roles = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT source, fantasy_role
                FROM player_roles
                WHERE player_id = :playerId
                  AND season_id = :seasonId
                ORDER BY source
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .forEach(row ->
                        roles.put(
                                row.get("source").toString(),
                                row.get("fantasy_role").toString()
                        )
                );

        PlayerTacticalProfileResponse tacticalProfile =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            real_position,
                            secondary_position,
                            tactical_role,
                            attacking_involvement,
                            defensive_involvement,
                            set_piece_taker,
                            penalty_taker,
                            corner_taker,
                            free_kick_taker,
                            projected_starter,
                            starter_probability,
                            competition_level,
                            tactical_notes
                        FROM player_tactical_profiles
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND season_id = :seasonId
                        """)
                        .param("playerId", playerId)
                        .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                        .query((rs, rowNum) ->
                                new PlayerTacticalProfileResponse(
                                        rs.getString("real_position"),
                                        rs.getString("secondary_position"),
                                        rs.getString("tactical_role"),
                                        rs.getBigDecimal("attacking_involvement"),
                                        rs.getBigDecimal("defensive_involvement"),
                                        rs.getBoolean("set_piece_taker"),
                                        rs.getBoolean("penalty_taker"),
                                        rs.getBoolean("corner_taker"),
                                        rs.getBoolean("free_kick_taker"),
                                        rs.getBoolean("projected_starter"),
                                        rs.getBigDecimal("starter_probability"),
                                        rs.getString("competition_level"),
                                        rs.getString("tactical_notes")
                                )
                        )
                        .optional()
                        .orElse(null);

        ClubTacticalResponse clubTactics =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            coach.full_name,
                            tactics.primary_formation,
                            tactics.secondary_formation,
                            tactics.playing_style,
                            tactics.defensive_line,
                            tactics.pressing_level
                        FROM player_registrations pr
                        JOIN club_season_tactics tactics
                            ON tactics.club_id = pr.club_id
                            AND tactics.season_id = pr.season_id
                        LEFT JOIN coaches coach
                            ON coach.id = tactics.coach_id
                        WHERE pr.player_id = :playerId
                          AND pr.season_id = :seasonId
                        """)
                        .param("playerId", playerId)
                        .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                        .query((rs, rowNum) ->
                                new ClubTacticalResponse(
                                        rs.getString("full_name"),
                                        rs.getString("primary_formation"),
                                        rs.getString("secondary_formation"),
                                        rs.getString("playing_style"),
                                        rs.getString("defensive_line"),
                                        rs.getString("pressing_level")
                                )
                        )
                        .optional()
                        .orElse(null);

        PlayerEvaluationResponse evaluation =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            projected_fantasy_average,
                            projected_appearances,
                            projected_starts,
                            projected_goals,
                            projected_assists,
                            reliability_score,
                            potential_score,
                            risk_score,
                            value_score,
                            evaluation_summary
                        FROM player_evaluations
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND season_id = :seasonId
                        """)
                        .param("playerId", playerId)
                        .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                        .query((rs, rowNum) ->
                                new PlayerEvaluationResponse(
                                        rs.getBigDecimal("projected_fantasy_average"),
                                        (Integer) rs.getObject("projected_appearances"),
                                        (Integer) rs.getObject("projected_starts"),
                                        (Integer) rs.getObject("projected_goals"),
                                        (Integer) rs.getObject("projected_assists"),
                                        rs.getBigDecimal("reliability_score"),
                                        rs.getBigDecimal("potential_score"),
                                        rs.getBigDecimal("risk_score"),
                                        rs.getBigDecimal("value_score"),
                                        rs.getString("evaluation_summary")
                                )
                        )
                        .optional()
                        .orElse(null);

        List<PlayerSeasonStatisticsResponse> statistics =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            s.code,
                            stats.source,
                            stats.source_external_id,
                            club.name AS club_name,
                            (SELECT STRING_AGG(history.club_name, '|' ORDER BY history.source_order)
                             FROM player_season_statistics_clubs history
                             WHERE history.statistics_id = stats.id) AS historical_clubs,
                            stats.appearances,
                            stats.starts,
                            stats.minutes_played,
                            stats.average_rating,
                            stats.fantasy_average,
                            stats.goals,
                            stats.assists,
                            stats.penalties_taken,
                            stats.penalties_scored,
                            stats.penalties_missed,
                            stats.yellow_cards,
                            stats.red_cards,
                            stats.clean_sheets,
                            stats.goals_conceded,
                            stats.saves,
                            stats.penalties_saved,
                            stats.expected_goals,
                            stats.expected_assists,
                            CASE WHEN stats.minutes_played > 0 AND stats.goals IS NOT NULL
                                THEN ROUND(stats.goals * 90.0 / stats.minutes_played, 2) END AS goals_per_90,
                            CASE WHEN stats.minutes_played > 0 AND stats.assists IS NOT NULL
                                THEN ROUND(stats.assists * 90.0 / stats.minutes_played, 2) END AS assists_per_90,
                            CASE WHEN stats.appearances > 0 AND stats.minutes_played IS NOT NULL
                                THEN ROUND(stats.minutes_played * 1.0 / stats.appearances, 2) END AS minutes_per_appearance,
                            CASE WHEN stats.appearances > 0 AND stats.starts IS NOT NULL
                                THEN ROUND(stats.starts * 100.0 / stats.appearances, 2) END AS start_percentage,
                            stats.imported_at,
                            stats.source_updated_at,
                            stats.import_batch_id
                        FROM player_season_statistics stats
                        JOIN seasons s
                            ON s.id = stats.season_id
                        LEFT JOIN clubs club
                            ON club.id = stats.club_id
                        WHERE stats.player_id = :playerId
                        ORDER BY s.start_year DESC, stats.source
                        LIMIT 10
                        """)
                        .param("playerId", playerId)
                        .query((rs, rowNum) ->
                                new PlayerSeasonStatisticsResponse(
                                        rs.getString("code"),
                                        rs.getString("source"),
                                        rs.getString("source_external_id"),
                                        rs.getString("club_name"),
                                        splitHistoricalClubs(rs.getString("historical_clubs")),
                                        rs.getObject("appearances", Integer.class),
                                        rs.getObject("starts", Integer.class),
                                        rs.getObject("minutes_played", Integer.class),
                                        rs.getBigDecimal("average_rating"),
                                        rs.getBigDecimal("fantasy_average"),
                                        rs.getObject("goals", Integer.class),
                                        rs.getObject("assists", Integer.class),
                                        rs.getObject("penalties_taken", Integer.class),
                                        rs.getObject("penalties_scored", Integer.class),
                                        rs.getObject("penalties_missed", Integer.class),
                                        rs.getObject("yellow_cards", Integer.class),
                                        rs.getObject("red_cards", Integer.class),
                                        rs.getObject("clean_sheets", Integer.class),
                                        rs.getObject("goals_conceded", Integer.class),
                                        rs.getObject("saves", Integer.class),
                                        rs.getObject("penalties_saved", Integer.class),
                                        rs.getBigDecimal("expected_goals"),
                                        rs.getBigDecimal("expected_assists"),
                                        rs.getBigDecimal("goals_per_90"),
                                        rs.getBigDecimal("assists_per_90"),
                                        rs.getBigDecimal("minutes_per_appearance"),
                                        rs.getBigDecimal("start_percentage"),
                                        rs.getObject("imported_at", java.time.OffsetDateTime.class),
                                        rs.getObject("source_updated_at", java.time.OffsetDateTime.class),
                                        rs.getObject("import_batch_id", Long.class)
                                )
                        )
                        .list();

        return new PlayerDetailResponse(
                ((Number) player.get("id")).longValue(),
                player.get("display_name").toString(),
                player.get("club_name").toString(),
                player.get("club_slug").toString(),
                roles,
                tacticalProfile,
                clubTactics,
                evaluation,
                statistics
        );
    }

    private List<String> splitHistoricalClubs(String value) {
        return value == null || value.isBlank()
                ? List.of()
                : List.of(value.split("\\|"));
    }
}

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

@RestController

            PlayerReconciliationService service
    ) {

    @PostMapping("/players")

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\reconciliation\PlayerReconciliationService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.reconciliation;

import java.sql.Types;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.reconciliation.identity.PlayerIdentityResolutionService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.reconciliation.identity.ResolvedPlayerIdentity;

@Service
public class PlayerReconciliationService {

    private static final String FANTACALCIO = "FANTACALCIO";
    private static final String GAZZETTA = "GAZZETTA";
    private static final String FANTAMARKT = "FANTAMARKT";

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final PlayerIdentityResolutionService identityResolutionService;

    public PlayerReconciliationService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            PlayerIdentityResolutionService identityResolutionService
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.identityResolutionService = identityResolutionService;
    }

    @Transactional
    public ReconciliationResponse reconcile(
            String seasonCode
    ) {

        Long seasonId =
                findSeasonId(seasonCode);

        BatchSnapshot fantacalcioBatch =
                latestBatch(
                        seasonId,
                        FANTACALCIO
                );

        BatchSnapshot gazzettaBatch =
                latestBatch(
                        seasonId,
                        GAZZETTA
                );

        Optional<BatchSnapshot> fantamarktBatch =
                latestOptionalProductionBatch(
                        seasonId,
                        FANTAMARKT
                );

        markReconciliationStarted(
                fantacalcioBatch.id()
        );

        markReconciliationStarted(
                gazzettaBatch.id()
        );

        fantamarktBatch.ifPresent(batch ->
                markReconciliationStarted(
                        batch.id()
                )
        );

        List<ResolvedPlayerIdentity> identities =
                identityResolutionService.resolve(
                        fantacalcioBatch.id(),
                        gazzettaBatch.id(),
                        fantamarktBatch
                                .map(BatchSnapshot::id)
                                .orElse(null)
                );

        /*
         * Fantacalcio is the authoritative operational catalog
         * during the transfer market.
         *
         * Secondary sources enrich and confirm identity/data,
         * but they do not decide whether a current Fantacalcio
         * player can exist in the operational catalog.
         */
        List<ResolvedPlayerIdentity> catalogIdentities =
                identities.stream()
                        .filter(identity ->
                                isNotBlank(
                                        identity
                                                .fantacalcioName()
                                )
                        )
                        .toList();

        /*
         * Kept for API backward compatibility.
         *
         * Single-source Fantacalcio players are no longer
         * excluded from the operational catalog. Their lack of
         * secondary confirmation remains visible through the
         * reconciliation preview / enrichment workflow.
         */
        int excludedSingleSourcePlayers = 0;

        int matchedPlayers = 0;
        int matchedWithThreeSources = 0;
        int matchedWithTwoSources = 0;
        int createdPlayers = 0;
        int updatedPlayers = 0;

        int fantacalcioReconciledRows = 0;
        int gazzettaReconciledRows = 0;
        int fantamarktReconciledRows = 0;

        /*
         * Rebuild the official current catalog transactionally.
         */
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                DELETE FROM player_reconciliation_results
                WHERE season_id = :seasonId
                """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .update();

        /*
         * Operational lifecycle follows the latest Fantacalcio
         * listone snapshot.
         *
         * A player that was ACTIVE but is no longer present in
         * the latest snapshot becomes INACTIVE.
         *
         * No player/history/source mapping is deleted.
         *
         * If the player appears again in a later Fantacalcio
         * snapshot, saveRegistration(...) below reactivates him.
         */
        deactivatePlayersMissingFromLatestFantacalcio(
                seasonId,
                fantacalcioBatch.id()
        );

        for (ResolvedPlayerIdentity identity
                : catalogIdentities) {

            /*
             * Fantacalcio is authoritative by default.
             *
             * A durable, explicitly verified EXCLUDED review is
             * the controlled exception: it means that this player
             * has already been manually verified as not belonging
             * to the operational Serie A catalog even if the
             * Fantacalcio snapshot is temporarily stale.
             */
            if (isExplicitlyExcluded(
                    seasonId,
                    identity.fantacalcioExternalId()
            )) {

                findMappedPlayerId(
                        FANTACALCIO,
                        identity.fantacalcioExternalId()
                ).ifPresent(playerId ->
                        deactivateRegistration(
                                playerId,
                                seasonId
                        )
                );

                continue;
            }

            String displayName =
                    firstNonBlank(
                            identity.fantacalcioName(),
                            identity.gazzettaName(),
                            identity.fantamarktName()
                    );

            Optional<Long> existingPlayerId =
                    findExistingPlayerId(
                            identity
                    );

            Long playerId;

            if (existingPlayerId.isPresent()) {

                playerId =
                        existingPlayerId.get();

                updatePlayer(
                        playerId,
                        displayName,
                        identity.normalizedName()
                );

                updatedPlayers++;

            } else {

                playerId =
                        createPlayer(
                                displayName,
                                identity.normalizedName()
                        );

                createdPlayers++;
            }

            /*
             * Source mappings are identity information.
             * They are saved independently from club resolution.
             */
            saveSourceIfPresent(
                    playerId,
                    seasonId,
                    FANTACALCIO,
                    identity.fantacalcioExternalId(),
                    identity.fantacalcioName(),
                    identity.fantacalcioRole()
            );

            saveMarketValue(
                    playerId,
                    seasonId,
                    FANTACALCIO,
                    identity.fantacalcioQuotation(),
                    identity.fantacalcioFmv()
            );

            saveSourceIfPresent(
                    playerId,
                    seasonId,
                    GAZZETTA,
                    identity.gazzettaExternalId(),
                    identity.gazzettaName(),
                    identity.gazzettaRole()
            );

            saveSourceIfPresent(
                    playerId,
                    seasonId,
                    FANTAMARKT,
                    identity.fantamarktExternalId(),
                    identity.fantamarktName(),
                    identity.fantamarktRole()
            );

            /*
             * Fantacalcio marks players that are still visible in
             * the listone but no longer play in Serie A with the
             * semantic out-of-game marker.
             *
             * They remain historically stored with their mappings,
             * roles and market data, but must not be part of the
             * current operational catalog.
             *
             * TransferDetectionService separately creates a
             * DETECTED exit claim. Official evidence is still
             * required before assigning a definitive transfer
             * lifecycle such as RELEASED.
             */
            if (isFantacalcioOutOfGame(
                    fantacalcioBatch.id(),
                    identity.fantacalcioExternalId()
            )) {

                deactivateRegistration(
                        playerId,
                        seasonId
                );

                continue;
            }

            ClubResolution clubResolution =
                    resolveCurrentClub(
                            playerId,
                            seasonId,
                            identity,
                            fantacalcioBatch
                                    .sourceObservedAt()
                    );

            /*
             * An official and sufficiently recent exit from
             * Serie A wins over an older Fantacalcio snapshot.
             *
             * The player remains stored historically but is no
             * longer included in the current official catalog.
             */
            if (clubResolution.leftSerieA()) {

                preserveReleasedRegistration(
                        playerId,
                        seasonId
                );

                continue;
            }

            saveRegistration(
                    playerId,
                    clubResolution.clubId(),
                    seasonId
            );

            saveReconciliationResult(
                    seasonId,
                    playerId,
                    identity,
                    clubResolution
            );

            matchedPlayers++;

            if (identity.sourcesCount() == 3) {
                matchedWithThreeSources++;
            } else if (identity.sourcesCount() == 2) {
                matchedWithTwoSources++;
            }

            fantacalcioReconciledRows++;

            if (isNotBlank(
                    identity.gazzettaName()
            )) {
                gazzettaReconciledRows++;
            }

            if (isNotBlank(
                    identity.fantamarktName()
            )) {
                fantamarktReconciledRows++;
            }
        }

        markReconciliationCompleted(
                fantacalcioBatch.id(),
                fantacalcioReconciledRows
        );

        markReconciliationCompleted(
                gazzettaBatch.id(),
                gazzettaReconciledRows
        );

        if (fantamarktBatch.isPresent()) {
            markReconciliationCompleted(
                    fantamarktBatch.get().id(),
                    fantamarktReconciledRows
            );
        }

        return new ReconciliationResponse(
                seasonCode,
                fantacalcioBatch.id(),
                gazzettaBatch.id(),
                fantamarktBatch
                        .map(BatchSnapshot::id)
                        .orElse(0L),
                matchedPlayers,
                matchedWithThreeSources,
                matchedWithTwoSources,
                excludedSingleSourcePlayers,
                createdPlayers,
                updatedPlayers,
                "COMPLETED"
        );
    }

    private boolean isFantacalcioOutOfGame(
            Long fantacalcioBatchId,
            String fantacalcioExternalId
    ) {

        if (!isNotBlank(fantacalcioExternalId)) {
            return false;
        }

        Boolean outOfGame =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1
                            FROM player_import_rows
                            WHERE batch_id = :batchId
                              AND external_id =
                                  :fantacalcioExternalId
                              AND valid = TRUE
                              AND LOWER(
                                    COALESCE(
                                        raw_data ->> 'out_of_game',
                                        'false'
                                    )
                                  ) = 'true'
                        )
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "batchId",
                                fantacalcioBatchId
                        )
                        .param(
                                "fantacalcioExternalId",
                                fantacalcioExternalId
                        )
                        .query(Boolean.class)
                        .single();

        return Boolean.TRUE.equals(outOfGame);
    }
    private boolean isExplicitlyExcluded(
            Long seasonId,
            String fantacalcioExternalId
    ) {

        if (!isNotBlank(fantacalcioExternalId)) {
            return false;
        }

        Integer count =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM reconciliation_review_items
                        WHERE season_id = :seasonId
                          AND fantacalcio_external_id =
                              :fantacalcioExternalId
                          AND review_status = 'EXCLUDED'
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "seasonId",
                                seasonId
                        )
                        .param(
                                "fantacalcioExternalId",
                                fantacalcioExternalId
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        return count > 0;
    }
