    private int deactivatePlayersMissingFromLatestFantacalcio(
            Long seasonId,
            Long fantacalcioBatchId
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE player_registrations registration

                SET registration_status = 'INACTIVE',
                    left_at = NULL,
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

                WHERE registration.season_id = :seasonId
                  AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'

                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1

                      FROM player_source_mappings mapping

                      JOIN player_import_rows import_row
                        ON import_row.batch_id =
                           :fantacalcioBatchId

                       AND import_row.valid = TRUE

                       AND import_row.external_id =
                           mapping.external_id

                      WHERE mapping.player_id =
                            registration.player_id

                        AND mapping.source =
                            'FANTACALCIO'
                  )
                """)
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .param(
                        "fantacalcioBatchId",
                        fantacalcioBatchId
                )
                .update();
    }
    private ClubResolution resolveCurrentClub(
            Long playerId,
            Long seasonId,
            ResolvedPlayerIdentity identity,
            OffsetDateTime fantacalcioObservedAt
    ) {

        Optional<OfficialTransferClaim> officialClaim =
                findLatestOfficialTransferClaim(
                        playerId,
                        seasonId
                );

        if (officialClaim.isPresent()) {

            OfficialTransferClaim claim =
                    officialClaim.get();

            OffsetDateTime officialTimestamp =
                    firstNonNull(
                            claim.sourcePublishedAt(),
                            claim.verifiedAt(),
                            claim.observedAt()
                    );

            /*
             * If we have trustworthy temporal provenance for
             * Fantacalcio and that snapshot is strictly newer,
             * Fantacalcio becomes the current source again.
             *
             * For legacy imports sourceObservedAt is NULL:
             * in that case an official verified event wins.
             */
            boolean fantacalcioIsNewer =
                    fantacalcioObservedAt != null
                            && officialTimestamp != null
                            && officialTimestamp.isBefore(
                                    fantacalcioObservedAt
                            );

            if (!fantacalcioIsNewer) {

                if (claim.toClubId() == null) {

                    return new ClubResolution(
                            null,
                            null,
                            null,
                            claim.source(),
                            claim.verifiedAt(),
                            true
                    );
                }

                return new ClubResolution(
                        claim.toClubId(),
                        claim.toClubName(),
                        normalizeClub(
                                claim.toClubName()
                        ),
                        claim.source(),
                        claim.verifiedAt(),
                        false
                );
            }
        }

        Long fantacalcioClubId =
                findClubId(
                        identity.fantacalcioClub()
                );

        return new ClubResolution(
                fantacalcioClubId,
                identity.fantacalcioClub(),
                firstNonBlank(
                        identity
                                .fantacalcioNormalizedClub(),
                        normalizeClub(
                                identity.fantacalcioClub()
                        )
                ),
                FANTACALCIO,
                null,
                false
        );
    }

    private Optional<OfficialTransferClaim>
            findLatestOfficialTransferClaim(
                    Long playerId,
                    Long seasonId
            ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    claim.to_club_id,
                    target_club.name AS to_club_name,
                    claim.source,
                    claim.source_published_at,
                    claim.observed_at,
                    claim.verified_at

                FROM player_transfer_claims claim

                LEFT JOIN clubs target_club
                    ON target_club.id =
                       claim.to_club_id

                WHERE claim.player_id = :playerId
                  AND claim.season_id = :seasonId
                  AND claim.verification_status = 'OFFICIAL'
                  AND claim.source IN (
                      'FIGC',
                      'LEGA_SERIE_A',
                      'OFFICIAL_CLUB'
                  )

                ORDER BY
                    COALESCE(
                        claim.source_published_at,
                        claim.verified_at,
                        claim.observed_at
                    ) DESC,
                    claim.id DESC

                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        new OfficialTransferClaim(
                                nullableLong(
                                        resultSet,
                                        "to_club_id"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "to_club_name"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "source"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getObject(
                                        "source_published_at",
                                        OffsetDateTime.class
                                ),
                                resultSet.getObject(
                                        "observed_at",
                                        OffsetDateTime.class
                                ),
                                resultSet.getObject(
                                        "verified_at",
                                        OffsetDateTime.class
                                )
                        )
                )
                .optional();
    }

    private Optional<Long> findExistingPlayerId(
            ResolvedPlayerIdentity identity
    ) {

        Set<Long> mappedPlayerIds =
                new LinkedHashSet<>();

        findMappedPlayerId(
                FANTACALCIO,
                identity.fantacalcioExternalId()
        ).ifPresent(mappedPlayerIds::add);

        findMappedPlayerId(
                GAZZETTA,
                identity.gazzettaExternalId()
        ).ifPresent(mappedPlayerIds::add);

        findMappedPlayerId(
                FANTAMARKT,
                identity.fantamarktExternalId()
        ).ifPresent(mappedPlayerIds::add);

        if (mappedPlayerIds.size() > 1) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Le fonti risultano associate "
                            + "a giocatori diversi: "
                            + identity.normalizedName()
            );
        }

        if (mappedPlayerIds.size() == 1) {
            return mappedPlayerIds
                    .stream()
                    .findFirst();
        }

        List<Long> sameNamePlayerIds =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM players
                        WHERE normalized_name =
                              :normalizedName
                        ORDER BY id
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "normalizedName",
                                identity.normalizedName()
                        )
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .list();

        if (sameNamePlayerIds.isEmpty()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }

        if (sameNamePlayerIds.size() == 1) {
            return Optional.of(
                    sameNamePlayerIds.getFirst()
            );
        }

        /*
         * Club is deliberately NOT used here.
         * Identity and current registration are independent.
         */
        throw new ConflictException(
                "IdentitÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â  interna ambigua per il giocatore: "
                        + identity.normalizedName()
        );
    }

    private Optional<Long> findMappedPlayerId(
            String source,
            String externalId
    ) {

        if (!isNotBlank(externalId)) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT player_id
                FROM player_source_mappings
                WHERE source = :source
                  AND external_id = :externalId
                ORDER BY id
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param("source", source)
                .param("externalId", externalId)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional();
    }

    private Long findSeasonId(

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM seasons
                WHERE code = :seasonCode
                """)
                .param(

                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->

                                "Stagione non trovata: "
                                        + seasonCode
                        )
                );
    }

    private BatchSnapshot latestBatch(
            Long seasonId,
            String source
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    id,
                    COALESCE(
                        source_observed_at,
                        completed_at,
                        started_at
                    ) AS source_observed_at

                FROM import_batches

                WHERE season_id = :seasonId
                  AND source = :source
                  AND status = 'COMPLETED'
                  AND LOWER(original_filename)
                      NOT LIKE '%test%'

                ORDER BY
                    completed_at DESC,
                    id DESC

                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("source", source)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        new BatchSnapshot(
                                resultSet.getLong("id"),
                                resultSet.getObject(
                                        "source_observed_at",
                                        OffsetDateTime.class
                                )
                        )
                )
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ConflictException(
                                "Nessun import completato per "
                                        + source
                        )
                );
    }

    private Long findClubId(
            String clubName
    ) {

        if (!isNotBlank(clubName)) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Squadra Fantacalcio mancante "
                            + "durante la riconciliazione"
            );
        }

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM clubs
                WHERE LOWER(name) =
                      LOWER(:clubName)
                   OR LOWER(short_name) =
                      LOWER(:clubName)
                   OR LOWER(slug) =
                      LOWER(:clubName)
                ORDER BY id
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param("clubName", clubName)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ConflictException(
                                "Squadra non trovata: "
                                        + clubName
                        )
                );
    }

    private void saveSourceIfPresent(
            Long playerId,
            Long seasonId,
            String source,
            String externalId,
            String externalName,
            String role
    ) {

        if (!isNotBlank(externalName)) {
            return;
        }

        saveSourceMapping(
                playerId,
                source,
                externalId,
                externalName
        );

        if (isNotBlank(role)) {

            saveRole(
                    playerId,
                    seasonId,
                    source,
                    role
            );
        }
    }

    private void saveSourceMapping(
            Long playerId,
            String source,
            String externalId,
            String externalName
    ) {

        Optional<Map<String, Object>> existingMapping;

        if (isNotBlank(externalId)) {

            existingMapping =
                    findMappingByExternalId(
                            source,
                            externalId
                    );

        } else {

            existingMapping =
                    findUniqueMappingByExternalName(
                            source,
                            externalName
                    );
        }

        if (existingMapping.isPresent()) {

            Long existingPlayerId =
                    numberValue(
                            existingMapping.get(),
                            "player_id"
                    );

            if (!existingPlayerId.equals(
                    playerId
            )) {

                throw new ConflictException(
                        "Il mapping "
                                + source
                                + " ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¨ giÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â  associato "
                                + "a un altro giocatore: "
                                + externalName
                );
            }

            Long mappingId =
                    numberValue(
                            existingMapping.get(),
                            "id"
                    );

            jdbcClient.sql("""
                    UPDATE player_source_mappings
                    SET external_id = :externalId,
                        external_name = :externalName,
                        verified = TRUE,
                        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    WHERE id = :mappingId
                    """)
                    .param(
                            "externalId",
                            externalId,
                            Types.VARCHAR
                    )
                    .param(
                            "externalName",
                            externalName
                    )
                    .param(
                            "mappingId",
                            mappingId
                    )
                    .update();

            return;
        }

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_source_mappings (
                    player_id,
                    source,
                    external_id,
                    external_name,
                    verified
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :source,
                    :externalId,
                    :externalName,
                    TRUE
                )
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("source", source)
                .param(
                        "externalId",
                        externalId,
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "externalName",
                        externalName
                )
                .update();
    }

    private Optional<Map<String, Object>>
            findMappingByExternalId(
                    String source,
                    String externalId
            ) {

        if (!isNotBlank(externalId)) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id, player_id
                FROM player_source_mappings
                WHERE source = :source
                  AND external_id = :externalId
                ORDER BY id
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param("source", source)
                .param(
                        "externalId",
                        externalId
                )
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .stream()
                .findFirst();
    }

    private Optional<Map<String, Object>>
            findUniqueMappingByExternalName(
                    String source,
                    String externalName
            ) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> mappings =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT id, player_id
                        FROM player_source_mappings
                        WHERE source = :source
                          AND external_name = :externalName
                        ORDER BY id
                        LIMIT 2
                        """)
                        .param("source", source)
                        .param(
                                "externalName",
                                externalName
                        )
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        if (mappings.size() == 1) {
            return Optional.of(
                    mappings.getFirst()
            );
        }

        return Optional.empty();
    }

    private String firstNonBlank(
            String... values
    ) {

        for (String value : values) {
            if (isNotBlank(value)) {
                return value.trim();
            }
        }

        throw new ConflictException(
                "Nessun valore valido disponibile "
                        + "durante la riconciliazione"
        );
    }

    private String normalizeClub(
            String club
    ) {

        if (!isNotBlank(club)) {
            return null;
        }

        return club
                .trim()
                .toLowerCase();
    }

    @SafeVarargs
    private final <T> T firstNonNull(
            T... values
    ) {

        for (T value : values) {
            if (value != null) {
                return value;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private boolean isNotBlank(
            String value
    ) {
        return value != null
                && !value.isBlank();
    }

    private Long numberValue(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            String key
    ) {
        return ((Number) row.get(key))
                .longValue();
    }

    private Long nullableLong(
            java.sql.ResultSet resultSet,
            String column
    ) throws java.sql.SQLException {

        long value =
                resultSet.getLong(column);

        return resultSet.wasNull()
                ? null
                : value;
    }

    private record BatchSnapshot(
            long id,
            OffsetDateTime sourceObservedAt
    ) {
    }

            Long toClubId,
            String toClubName,
            String source,
            OffsetDateTime sourcePublishedAt,
            OffsetDateTime observedAt,
            OffsetDateTime verifiedAt
    ) {
    }

    private record ClubResolution(
            Long clubId,
            String clubName,
            String normalizedClubName,
            String source,
            OffsetDateTime verifiedAt,
            boolean leftSerieA
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.reconciliation.identity;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class PlayerIdentityResolutionService {

    private static final String FANTACALCIO = "FANTACALCIO";
    private static final String GAZZETTA = "GAZZETTA";
    private static final String FANTAMARKT = "FANTAMARKT";

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public PlayerIdentityResolutionService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    public List<ResolvedPlayerIdentity> resolve(
            long fantacalcioBatchId,
            long gazzettaBatchId,
            Long fantamarktBatchId
    ) {

        List<SourcePlayerRow> fantacalcioRows =
                loadRows(
                        fantacalcioBatchId,
                        FANTACALCIO
                );

        List<SourcePlayerRow> gazzettaRows =
                loadRows(
                        gazzettaBatchId,
                        GAZZETTA
                );

        List<SourcePlayerRow> fantamarktRows =
                fantamarktBatchId == null
                        ? List.of()
                        : loadRows(
                                fantamarktBatchId,
                                FANTAMARKT
                        );

        Map<String, Long> externalMappings =
                loadExternalMappings();

        Map<String, Set<Long>> verifiedAliases =
                loadVerifiedAliases();

        Map<String, String> verifiedSourceLinks =
                loadVerifiedSourceLinks();

        List<ResolvedPlayerIdentity> resolved =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (SourcePlayerRow fantacalcio
                : fantacalcioRows) {

            Long fantacalcioPlayerId =
                    mappedPlayerId(
                            externalMappings,
                            FANTACALCIO,
                            fantacalcio.externalId()
                    );

            MatchResult gazzetta =
                    findSecondaryMatch(
                            fantacalcio,
                            fantacalcioPlayerId,
                            GAZZETTA,
                            gazzettaRows,
                            fantacalcioRows,
                            externalMappings,
                            verifiedAliases,
                            verifiedSourceLinks
                    );

            MatchResult fantamarkt =
                    findSecondaryMatch(
                            fantacalcio,
                            fantacalcioPlayerId,
                            FANTAMARKT,
                            fantamarktRows,
                            fantacalcioRows,
                            externalMappings,
                            verifiedAliases,
                            verifiedSourceLinks
                    );

            int sourcesCount = 1;

            if (gazzetta.row() != null) {
                sourcesCount++;
            }

            if (fantamarkt.row() != null) {
                sourcesCount++;
            }

            String resolutionMethod =
                    strongestMethod(
                            fantacalcioPlayerId,
                            gazzetta.method(),
                            fantamarkt.method()
                    );

            resolved.add(
                    new ResolvedPlayerIdentity(
                            fantacalcio.normalizedName(),
                            sourcesCount,
                            resolutionMethod,

                            fantacalcio.externalId(),
                            fantacalcio.externalName(),
                            fantacalcio.clubName(),
                            fantacalcio.normalizedClubName(),
                            fantacalcio.fantasyRole(),
                            fantacalcio.quotation(),
                            fantacalcio.fantasyMarketValue(),

                            value(
                                    gazzetta.row(),
                                    SourcePlayerRow::externalId
                            ),
                            value(
                                    gazzetta.row(),
                                    SourcePlayerRow::externalName
                            ),
                            value(
                                    gazzetta.row(),
                                    SourcePlayerRow::clubName
                            ),
                            value(
                                    gazzetta.row(),
                                    SourcePlayerRow::fantasyRole
                            ),

                            value(
                                    fantamarkt.row(),
                                    SourcePlayerRow::externalId
                            ),
                            value(
                                    fantamarkt.row(),
                                    SourcePlayerRow::externalName
                            ),
                            value(
                                    fantamarkt.row(),
                                    SourcePlayerRow::clubName
                            ),
                            value(
                                    fantamarkt.row(),
                                    SourcePlayerRow::fantasyRole
                            )
                    )
            );
        }

        return resolved;
    }

    private MatchResult findSecondaryMatch(
            SourcePlayerRow fantacalcio,
            Long fantacalcioPlayerId,
            String secondarySource,
            List<SourcePlayerRow> secondaryRows,
            List<SourcePlayerRow> fantacalcioRows,
            Map<String, Long> externalMappings,
            Map<String, Set<Long>> verifiedAliases,
            Map<String, String> verifiedSourceLinks
    ) {

        MatchResult verifiedSourceLink =
                findVerifiedSourceLinkMatch(
                        fantacalcio,
                        secondarySource,
                        secondaryRows,
                        verifiedSourceLinks
                );

        if (verifiedSourceLink.row() != null) {
            return verifiedSourceLink;
        }

        MatchResult historical =
                findHistoricalMappingMatch(
                        fantacalcioPlayerId,
                        secondarySource,
                        secondaryRows,
                        externalMappings
                );

        if (historical.row() != null) {
            return historical;
        }

        MatchResult alias =
                findVerifiedAliasMatch(
                        fantacalcioPlayerId,
                        secondarySource,
                        secondaryRows,
                        verifiedAliases
                );

        if (alias.row() != null) {
            return alias;
        }

        List<SourcePlayerRow> exactNameCandidates =
                secondaryRows.stream()
                        .filter(row ->
                                sameText(
                                        row.normalizedName(),
                                        fantacalcio.normalizedName()
                                )
                        )
                        .filter(row ->
                                mappingDoesNotConflict(
                                        fantacalcioPlayerId,
                                        secondarySource,
                                        row,
                                        externalMappings
                                )
                        )
                        .toList();

        if (exactNameCandidates.isEmpty()) {

            MatchResult normalized =
                    findSafeNormalizedMatch(
                            fantacalcio,
                            secondaryRows,
                            fantacalcioRows
                    );

            if (normalized.row() != null) {
                return normalized;
            }

            MatchResult abbreviation =
                    findSafeUniqueAbbreviationMatch(
                            fantacalcio,
                            secondaryRows,
                            fantacalcioRows
                    );

            if (abbreviation.row() != null) {
                return abbreviation;
            }

            return MatchResult.none();
        }

        List<SourcePlayerRow> sameClubCandidates =
                exactNameCandidates.stream()
                        .filter(row ->
                                sameText(
                                        row.normalizedClubName(),
                                        fantacalcio
                                                .normalizedClubName()
                                )
                        )
                        .toList();

        if (sameClubCandidates.size() == 1) {
            return new MatchResult(
                    sameClubCandidates.getFirst(),
                    "EXACT_NAME_SAME_CLUB"
            );
        }

        if (exactNameCandidates.size() == 1) {
            return new MatchResult(
                    exactNameCandidates.getFirst(),
                    "EXACT_NAME_UNIQUE"
            );
        }

        return MatchResult.none();
    }

    private MatchResult findSafeNormalizedMatch(
            SourcePlayerRow fantacalcio,
            List<SourcePlayerRow> secondaryRows,
            List<SourcePlayerRow> fantacalcioRows
    ) {

        String normalizedWithoutInitials =
                normalizedWithoutTrailingInitials(
                        fantacalcio
                );

        if (normalizedWithoutInitials == null
                || normalizedWithoutInitials.isBlank()) {
            return MatchResult.none();
        }

        List<SourcePlayerRow> exactCandidates =
                secondaryRows.stream()
                        .filter(row ->
                                sameText(
                                        row.normalizedClubName(),
                                        fantacalcio.normalizedClubName()
                                )
                        )
                        .filter(row ->
                                sameText(
                                        row.normalizedName(),
                                        normalizedWithoutInitials
                                )
                        )
                        .toList();

        if (exactCandidates.size() != 1) {
            return MatchResult.none();
        }

        SourcePlayerRow candidate =
                exactCandidates.getFirst();

        long reverseMatches =
                fantacalcioRows.stream()
                        .filter(row ->
                                sameText(
                                        row.normalizedClubName(),
                                        fantacalcio.normalizedClubName()
                                )
                        )
                        .filter(row ->
                                sameText(
                                        normalizedWithoutTrailingInitials(
                                                row
                                        ),
                                        candidate.normalizedName()
                                )
                        )
                        .count();

        if (reverseMatches != 1) {
            return MatchResult.none();
        }

        return new MatchResult(
                candidate,
                "NORMALIZED_WITHOUT_INITIALS"
        );
    }
    private String normalizedWithoutTrailingInitials(
            SourcePlayerRow row
    ) {

        if (row == null
                || row.normalizedName() == null
                || row.normalizedName().isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }

        String normalizedName =
                row.normalizedName()
                        .trim()
                        .toLowerCase();

        int abbreviationTokens =
                trailingAbbreviationTokenCount(
                        row.externalName()
                );

        if (abbreviationTokens == 0) {
            return normalizedName;
        }

        String[] tokens =
                normalizedName.split("\\s+");

        /*
         * Never remove the complete identity.
         * If the source representation is malformed,
         * keep the original normalized name instead.
         */
        if (abbreviationTokens >= tokens.length) {
            return normalizedName;
        }

        return String.join(
                " ",
                java.util.Arrays.copyOf(
                        tokens,
                        tokens.length - abbreviationTokens
                )
        );
    }

    private int trailingAbbreviationTokenCount(
            String externalName
    ) {

        if (externalName == null
                || externalName.isBlank()) {
            return 0;
        }

        String trimmed =
                externalName.trim();

        int lastSpace =
                trimmed.lastIndexOf(' ');

        if (lastSpace < 0
                || lastSpace ==
                   trimmed.length() - 1) {
            return 0;
        }

        String suffix =
                trimmed.substring(
                        lastSpace + 1
                );

        /*
         * Examples:
         *
         * D.S. -> 2
         * F.P. -> 2
         * Mas. -> 1
         * V.   -> 1
         *
         * A normal word without the final dot is
         * never interpreted as an abbreviation.
         */
        if (!suffix.matches(
                "(?iu)[\\p{L}]{1,3}(?:\\.[\\p{L}]{1,3})*\\."
        )) {
            return 0;
        }

        int count = 0;

        for (int i = 0;
             i < suffix.length();
             i++) {

            if (suffix.charAt(i) == '.') {
                count++;
            }
        }

        return count;
    }

    private String lastNormalizedToken(
            String normalizedName
    ) {

        if (normalizedName == null
                || normalizedName.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }

        String[] tokens =
                normalizedName
                        .trim()
                        .split("\\s+");

        if (tokens.length == 0) {
            return null;
        }

        return tokens[tokens.length - 1];
    }
    private MatchResult findSafeUniqueAbbreviationMatch(
            SourcePlayerRow fantacalcio,
            List<SourcePlayerRow> secondaryRows,
            List<SourcePlayerRow> fantacalcioRows
    ) {

        String fantacalcioBaseName =
                abbreviationBaseName(
                        fantacalcio.externalName()
                );

        if (fantacalcioBaseName == null) {
            return MatchResult.none();
        }

        List<SourcePlayerRow> secondaryCandidates =
                secondaryRows.stream()
                        .filter(row ->
                                sameText(
                                        row.normalizedClubName(),
                                        fantacalcio.normalizedClubName()
                                )
                        )
                        .filter(row ->
                                sameText(
                                        abbreviationBaseName(
                                                row.externalName()
                                        ),
                                        fantacalcioBaseName
                                )
                        )
                        .toList();

        if (secondaryCandidates.size() != 1) {
            return MatchResult.none();
        }

        /*
         * Reverse uniqueness is mandatory.
         *
         * Example rejected automatically:
         *
         * Sulemana I. -> SULEMANA
         * Sulemana K. -> SULEMANA
         */
        long matchingFantacalcioPlayers =
                fantacalcioRows.stream()
                        .filter(row ->
                                sameText(
                                        row.normalizedClubName(),
                                        fantacalcio.normalizedClubName()
                                )
                        )
                        .filter(row ->
                                sameText(
                                        abbreviationBaseName(
                                                row.externalName()
                                        ),
                                        fantacalcioBaseName
                                )
                        )
                        .count();

        if (matchingFantacalcioPlayers != 1) {
            return MatchResult.none();
        }

        return new MatchResult(
                secondaryCandidates.getFirst(),
                "SAFE_UNIQUE_ABBREVIATION"
        );
    }

    private String abbreviationBaseName(
            String value
    ) {

        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }

        String trimmed =
                value.trim();

        /*
         * Only remove an explicit abbreviated suffix ending
         * with a dot:
         *
         * Ederson D.S.   -> Ederson
         * Esposito F.P.  -> Esposito
         * Pessina Mas.   -> Pessina
         *
         * A normal short surname without a dot is untouched.
         */
        String base =
                trimmed.replaceFirst(
                        "(?iu)\\s+[\\p{L}]{1,3}(?:\\.[\\p{L}]{1,3})*\\.$",
                        ""
                );

        return base.trim()
                .toLowerCase();
    }
    private MatchResult findHistoricalMappingMatch(
            Long fantacalcioPlayerId,
            String secondarySource,
            List<SourcePlayerRow> secondaryRows,
            Map<String, Long> externalMappings
    ) {

        if (fantacalcioPlayerId == null) {
            return MatchResult.none();
        }

        List<SourcePlayerRow> matches =
                secondaryRows.stream()
                        .filter(row -> {
                            Long secondaryPlayerId =
                                    mappedPlayerId(
                                            externalMappings,
                                            secondarySource,
                                            row.externalId()
                                    );

                            return fantacalcioPlayerId
                                    .equals(
                                            secondaryPlayerId
                                    );
                        })
                        .toList();

        if (matches.size() == 1) {
            return new MatchResult(
                    matches.getFirst(),
                    "HISTORICAL_MAPPING"
            );
        }

        return MatchResult.none();
    }

    private MatchResult findVerifiedAliasMatch(
            Long fantacalcioPlayerId,
            String secondarySource,
            List<SourcePlayerRow> secondaryRows,
            Map<String, Set<Long>> verifiedAliases
    ) {

        if (fantacalcioPlayerId == null) {
            return MatchResult.none();
        }

        List<SourcePlayerRow> matches =
                secondaryRows.stream()
                        .filter(row -> {
                            Set<Long> playerIds =
                                    verifiedAliases.get(
                                            aliasKey(
                                                    secondarySource,
                                                    row.normalizedName()
                                            )
                                    );

                            return playerIds != null
                                    && playerIds.size() == 1
                                    && playerIds.contains(
                                            fantacalcioPlayerId
                                    );
                        })
                        .toList();

        if (matches.size() == 1) {
            return new MatchResult(
                    matches.getFirst(),
                    "VERIFIED_ALIAS"
            );
        }

        return MatchResult.none();
    }

    private boolean mappingDoesNotConflict(
            Long fantacalcioPlayerId,
            String source,
            SourcePlayerRow secondary,
            Map<String, Long> externalMappings
    ) {

        if (fantacalcioPlayerId == null) {
            return true;
        }

        Long secondaryPlayerId =
                mappedPlayerId(
                        externalMappings,
                        source,
                        secondary.externalId()
                );

        return secondaryPlayerId == null
                || fantacalcioPlayerId.equals(
                        secondaryPlayerId
                );
    }

    private String strongestMethod(
            Long fantacalcioPlayerId,
            String first,
            String second
    ) {

        List<String> methods =
                List.of(
                        safe(first),
                        safe(second)
                );

        if (methods.contains(
                "VERIFIED_SOURCE_LINK"
        )) {
            return "VERIFIED_SOURCE_LINK";
        }

        if (methods.contains(
                "HISTORICAL_MAPPING"
        )) {
            return "HISTORICAL_MAPPING";
        }

        if (methods.contains(
                "VERIFIED_ALIAS"
        )) {
            return "VERIFIED_ALIAS";
        }

        if (methods.contains(
                "EXACT_NAME_SAME_CLUB"
        )) {
            return "EXACT_NAME_SAME_CLUB";
        }

        if (methods.contains(
                "NORMALIZED_WITHOUT_INITIALS"
        )) {
            return "NORMALIZED_WITHOUT_INITIALS";
        }

        if (methods.contains(
                "SAFE_UNIQUE_ABBREVIATION"
        )) {
            return "SAFE_UNIQUE_ABBREVIATION";
        }

        if (methods.contains(
                "UNIQUE_NORMALIZED_FINAL_TOKEN"
        )) {
            return "UNIQUE_NORMALIZED_FINAL_TOKEN";
        }

        if (methods.contains(
                "EXACT_NAME_UNIQUE"
        )) {
            return "EXACT_NAME_UNIQUE";
        }

        if (fantacalcioPlayerId != null) {
            return "EXTERNAL_ID";
        }

        return "FANTACALCIO_ONLY";
    }

    private List<SourcePlayerRow> loadRows(
            long batchId,
            String source
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    external_id,
                    external_name,
                    normalized_name,
                    club_name,
                    normalized_club_name,
                    fantasy_role,
                    quotation,
                    fantasy_market_value

                FROM player_import_rows

                WHERE batch_id = :batchId
                  AND valid = TRUE

                ORDER BY row_number, id
                """)
                .param("batchId", batchId)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        new SourcePlayerRow(
                                source,
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "external_id"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "external_name"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "normalized_name"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "club_name"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "normalized_club_name"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "fantasy_role"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                        "quotation"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                        "fantasy_market_value"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .list();
    }

    private MatchResult findVerifiedSourceLinkMatch(
            SourcePlayerRow fantacalcio,
            String secondarySource,
            List<SourcePlayerRow> secondaryRows,
            Map<String, String> verifiedSourceLinks
    ) {

        String secondaryExternalId =
                verifiedSourceLinks.get(
                        sourceLinkKey(
                                fantacalcio.externalId(),
                                secondarySource
                        )
                );

        if (secondaryExternalId == null
                || secondaryExternalId.isBlank()) {
            return MatchResult.none();
        }

        List<SourcePlayerRow> matches =
                secondaryRows.stream()
                        .filter(row ->
                                sameText(
                                        row.externalId(),
                                        secondaryExternalId
                                )
                        )
                        .toList();

        if (matches.size() != 1) {
            return MatchResult.none();
        }

        return new MatchResult(
                matches.getFirst(),
                "VERIFIED_SOURCE_LINK"
        );
    }

    private Map<String, String> loadVerifiedSourceLinks() {

        Map<String, String> links =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    fantacalcio_external_id,
                    secondary_source,
                    secondary_external_id
                FROM verified_source_identity_links
                WHERE verified = TRUE
                ORDER BY id
                """)
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .forEach(row ->
                        links.put(
                                sourceLinkKey(
                                        String.valueOf(
                                                row.get(
                                                        "fantacalcio_external_id"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        String.valueOf(
                                                row.get(
                                                        "secondary_source"
                                                )
                                        )
                                ),
                                String.valueOf(
                                        row.get(
                                                "secondary_external_id"
                                        )
                                )
                        )
                );

        return links;
    }

    private String sourceLinkKey(
            String fantacalcioExternalId,
            String secondarySource
    ) {
        return safe(fantacalcioExternalId)
                + "|"
                + safe(secondarySource).toUpperCase();
    }

    private Map<String, Long> loadExternalMappings() {

        Map<String, Long> mappings =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    source,
                    external_id,
                    player_id

                FROM player_source_mappings

                WHERE external_id IS NOT NULL
                  AND external_id <> ''
                """)
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .forEach(row -> {
                    String source =
                            String.valueOf(
                                    row.get("source")
                            );

                    String externalId =
                            String.valueOf(
                                    row.get("external_id")
                            );

                    Long playerId =
                            ((Number) row.get(
                                    "player_id"
                            )).longValue();

                    mappings.put(
                            mappingKey(
                                    source,
                                    externalId
                            ),
                            playerId
                    );
                });

        return mappings;
    }

    private Map<String, Set<Long>>
            loadVerifiedAliases() {

        Map<String, Set<Long>> aliases =
                new HashMap<>();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    source,
                    normalized_alias,
                    player_id

                FROM player_identity_aliases

                WHERE verified = TRUE
                """)
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .forEach(row -> {
                    String source =
                            String.valueOf(
                                    row.get("source")
                            );

                    String normalizedAlias =
                            String.valueOf(
                                    row.get(
                                            "normalized_alias"
                                    )
                            );

                    Long playerId =
                            ((Number) row.get(
                                    "player_id"
                            )).longValue();

                    aliases
                            .computeIfAbsent(
                                    aliasKey(
                                            source,
                                            normalizedAlias
                                    ),
                                    ignored ->
                                            new LinkedHashSet<>()
                            )
                            .add(playerId);
                });

        return aliases;
    }

    private Long mappedPlayerId(
            Map<String, Long> mappings,
            String source,
            String externalId
    ) {

        if (externalId == null
                || externalId.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }

        return mappings.get(
                mappingKey(
                        source,
                        externalId
                )
        );
    }

    private String mappingKey(
            String source,
            String externalId
    ) {
        return safe(source).toUpperCase()
                + "|"
                + safe(externalId);
    }

    private String aliasKey(
            String source,
            String normalizedAlias
    ) {
        return safe(source).toUpperCase()
                + "|"
                + safe(normalizedAlias);
    }

    private boolean sameText(
            String first,
            String second
    ) {

        if (first == null || second == null) {
            return false;
        }

        return first.trim()
                .equalsIgnoreCase(
                        second.trim()
                );
    }

    private String safe(
            String value
    ) {
        return value == null
                ? ""
                : value.trim();
    }

    private <T> String value(
            T object,
            java.util.function.Function<T, String> mapper
    ) {

        if (object == null) {
            return null;
        }

        return mapper.apply(object);
    }

    private record MatchResult(
            SourcePlayerRow row,
            String method
    ) {

        private static MatchResult none() {
            return new MatchResult(
                    null,
                    null
            );
        }
    }

    private record SourcePlayerRow(
            String source,
            String externalId,
            String externalName,
            String normalizedName,
            String clubName,
            String normalizedClubName,
            String fantasyRole,
            BigDecimal quotation,
            BigDecimal fantasyMarketValue
    ) {
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\reconciliation\preview\ReconciliationPreviewService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.reconciliation.preview;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.TreeMap;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.reconciliation.identity.PlayerIdentityResolutionService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.reconciliation.identity.ResolvedPlayerIdentity;

@Service
public class ReconciliationPreviewService {

    private static final String FANTACALCIO =
            "FANTACALCIO";

    private static final String GAZZETTA =
            "GAZZETTA";

    private static final String FANTAMARKT =
            "FANTAMARKT";

    private static final String CONFIRMED =
            "CONFIRMED";

    private static final String UNRESOLVED =
            "UNRESOLVED";

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    private final PlayerIdentityResolutionService
            identityResolutionService;

    public ReconciliationPreviewService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            PlayerIdentityResolutionService
                    identityResolutionService
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.identityResolutionService =
                identityResolutionService;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public ReconciliationPreviewResponse preview(
            long fantacalcioBatchId,
            long gazzettaBatchId,
            Long fantamarktBatchId,
            boolean onlyUnresolved
    ) {

        validateBatch(
                fantacalcioBatchId,
                FANTACALCIO
        );

        validateBatch(
                gazzettaBatchId,
                GAZZETTA
        );

        if (fantamarktBatchId != null) {
            validateBatch(
                    fantamarktBatchId,
                    FANTAMARKT
            );
        }

        List<ResolvedPlayerIdentity> identities =
                identityResolutionService.resolve(
                        fantacalcioBatchId,
                        gazzettaBatchId,
                        fantamarktBatchId
                );

        int confirmedPlayers =
                (int) identities.stream()
                        .filter(this::isConfirmed)
                        .count();

        int unresolvedPlayers =
                identities.size()
                        - confirmedPlayers;

        Map<String, Integer> methodCounts =
                buildMethodCounts(
                        identities
                );

        List<ReconciliationPreviewPlayer> players =
                identities.stream()
                        .filter(identity ->
                                !onlyUnresolved
                                        || !isConfirmed(
                                                identity
                                        )
                        )
                        .map(this::toPreviewPlayer)
                        .toList();

        return new ReconciliationPreviewResponse(
                fantacalcioBatchId,
                gazzettaBatchId,
                fantamarktBatchId,
                identities.size(),
                confirmedPlayers,
                unresolvedPlayers,
                methodCounts,
                players
        );
    }

    private boolean isConfirmed(
            ResolvedPlayerIdentity identity
    ) {
        return identity.sourcesCount() >= 2;
    }

    private Map<String, Integer> buildMethodCounts(
            List<ResolvedPlayerIdentity> identities
    ) {

        Map<String, Integer> counts =
                new TreeMap<>();

        for (ResolvedPlayerIdentity identity
                : identities) {

            String key =
                    isConfirmed(identity)
                            ? safeMethod(
                                    identity
                                            .identityResolutionMethod()
                            )
                            : UNRESOLVED;

            counts.merge(
                    key,
                    1,
                    Integer::sum
            );
        }

        return new LinkedHashMap<>(
                counts
        );
    }

    private ReconciliationPreviewPlayer
            toPreviewPlayer(
                    ResolvedPlayerIdentity identity
            ) {

        return new ReconciliationPreviewPlayer(
                isConfirmed(identity)
                        ? CONFIRMED
                        : UNRESOLVED,

                identity.identityResolutionMethod(),
                identity.sourcesCount(),

                identity.fantacalcioExternalId(),
                identity.fantacalcioName(),
                identity.fantacalcioClub(),

                identity.gazzettaExternalId(),
                identity.gazzettaName(),
                identity.gazzettaClub(),

                identity.fantamarktExternalId(),
                identity.fantamarktName(),
                identity.fantamarktClub()
        );
    }

    private void validateBatch(
            long batchId,
            String expectedSource
    ) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> batches =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            id,
                            source,
                            status

                        FROM import_batches

                        WHERE id = :batchId
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "batchId",
                                batchId
                        )
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        if (batches.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Batch non trovato: "
                            + batchId
            );
        }

        Map<String, Object> batch =
                batches.getFirst();

        String actualSource =
                String.valueOf(
                        batch.get("source")
                );

        String status =
                String.valueOf(
                        batch.get("status")
                );

        if (!expectedSource.equals(
                actualSource
        )) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Batch "
                            + batchId
                            + " atteso come "
                            + expectedSource
                            + " ma trovato "
                            + actualSource
            );
        }

        if (!"COMPLETED".equals(status)) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Batch "
                            + batchId
                            + " non completato: "
                            + status
            );
        }
    }

    private String safeMethod(
            String value
    ) {
        if (value == null
                || value.isBlank()) {
            return "UNKNOWN";
        }

        return value.trim();
    }
}

@RestController

    public ReconciliationReviewController(
            ReconciliationReviewService service
    ) {
        this.service = service;
    }

    public ReconciliationReviewSyncResponse sync(
            @RequestParam long fantacalcioBatchId,

            @RequestParam(required = false)

    ) {
        return service.sync(
                fantacalcioBatchId,
                gazzettaBatchId,
                fantamarktBatchId
        );

    ) {

                season,
                status
        );
    }
