package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.reconciliation.review;

import java.sql.Types;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.reconciliation.preview.ReconciliationPreviewPlayer;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.reconciliation.preview.ReconciliationPreviewResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.reconciliation.preview.ReconciliationPreviewService;

@Service
public class ReconciliationReviewService {

    private static final Set<String> SECONDARY_SOURCES =
            Set.of(
                    "GAZZETTA",
                    "FANTAMARKT"
            );

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final ReconciliationPreviewService previewService;

    public ReconciliationReviewService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            ReconciliationPreviewService previewService
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.previewService = previewService;
    }

    @Transactional
    public ReconciliationReviewSyncResponse sync(
            long fantacalcioBatchId,
            long gazzettaBatchId,
            Long fantamarktBatchId
    ) {

        BatchSeason batchSeason =
                validateBatchSeasons(
                        fantacalcioBatchId,
                        gazzettaBatchId,
                        fantamarktBatchId
                );

        ReconciliationPreviewResponse preview =
                previewService.preview(
                        fantacalcioBatchId,
                        gazzettaBatchId,
                        fantamarktBatchId,
                        true
                );

        int synchronizedItems = 0;

        Set<String> unresolvedFantacalcioExternalIds =
                new HashSet<>();

        for (ReconciliationPreviewPlayer player
                : preview.players()) {

            if (player.fantacalcioExternalId() == null
                    || player.fantacalcioExternalId()
                            .isBlank()) {
                continue;
            }

            unresolvedFantacalcioExternalIds.add(
                    player.fantacalcioExternalId()
            );

            synchronizedItems +=
                    upsert(
                            batchSeason.seasonId(),
                            fantacalcioBatchId,
                            gazzettaBatchId,
                            fantamarktBatchId,
                            player
                    );
        }

        autoResolveStaleOpenItems(
                batchSeason.seasonId(),
                fantacalcioBatchId,
                unresolvedFantacalcioExternalIds
        );

        int openItems =
                countStatus(
                        batchSeason.seasonCode(),
                        "OPEN"
                );

        return new ReconciliationReviewSyncResponse(
                batchSeason.seasonCode(),
                fantacalcioBatchId,
                gazzettaBatchId,
                fantamarktBatchId,
                preview.totalFantacalcioPlayers(),
                preview.unresolvedPlayers(),
                synchronizedItems,
                openItems
        );
    }

    @Transactional
    public ReconciliationReviewSyncResponse syncLatest(
            String season
    ) {

        String seasonCode =
                requireText(
                        season,
                        "Stagione obbligatoria"
                );

        long fantacalcioBatchId =
                findLatestBatch(
                        seasonCode,
                        "FANTACALCIO"
                );

        long gazzettaBatchId =
                findLatestBatch(
                        seasonCode,
                        "GAZZETTA"
                );

        Long fantamarktBatchId =
                findLatestOptionalBatch(
                        seasonCode,
                        "FANTAMARKT"
                );

        return sync(
                fantacalcioBatchId,
                gazzettaBatchId,
                fantamarktBatchId
        );
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<ReconciliationReviewItemResponse> findAll(
            String season,
            String status
    ) {

        String seasonCode =
                requireText(
                        season,
                        "Stagione obbligatoria"
                );

        String normalizedStatus =
                status == null || status.isBlank()
                        ? null
                        : status.trim().toUpperCase();

        if (normalizedStatus != null
                && !Set.of(
                        "OPEN",
                        "RESOLVED",
                        "IGNORED",
                        "EXCLUDED"
                ).contains(normalizedStatus)) {

            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Stato review non supportato: "
                            + normalizedStatus
            );
        }

        StringBuilder sql =
                new StringBuilder("""
                        SELECT
                            review.id,
                            season.code AS season,
                            review.fantacalcio_batch_id,
                            review.gazzetta_batch_id,
                            review.fantamarkt_batch_id,
                            review.fantacalcio_external_id,
                            review.fantacalcio_name,
                            review.fantacalcio_club,
                            review.gazzetta_external_id,
                            review.gazzetta_name,
                            review.gazzetta_club,
                            review.fantamarkt_external_id,
                            review.fantamarkt_name,
                            review.fantamarkt_club,
                            review.review_status,
                            review.resolution_source,
                            review.resolution_external_id,
                            review.resolution_note,
                            review.exclusion_reason,
                            review.exclusion_note,
                            review.first_seen_at,
                            review.last_seen_at,
                            review.resolved_at,
                            review.excluded_at

                        FROM reconciliation_review_items review

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = review.season_id

                        WHERE season.code = :season
                        """);

        if (normalizedStatus != null) {
            sql.append("""
                    AND review.review_status = :status
                    """);
        }

        sql.append("""
                ORDER BY
                    CASE review.review_status
                        WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 1
                        WHEN 'RESOLVED' THEN 2
                        ELSE 3
                    END,
                    review.last_seen_at DESC,
                    review.id DESC
                """);

        var query =
                jdbcClient.sql(sql.toString())
                        .param(
                                "season",
                                seasonCode
                        );

        if (normalizedStatus != null) {
            query = query.param(
                    "status",
                    normalizedStatus
            );
        }

        return query
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        mapResponse(resultSet)
                )
                .list();
    }

    @Transactional
    public ReconciliationReviewItemResponse resolveLink(
            Long reviewId,
            ReconciliationReviewResolveRequest request
    ) {

        if (request == null) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Richiesta di risoluzione mancante"
            );
        }

        String source =
                requireText(
                        request.secondarySource(),
                        "Fonte secondaria obbligatoria"
                ).toUpperCase();

        if (!SECONDARY_SOURCES.contains(source)) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Fonte secondaria non supportata: "
                            + source
            );
        }

        String externalId =
                requireText(
                        request.secondaryExternalId(),
                        "External ID secondario obbligatorio"
                );

        Map<String, Object> review =
                findReviewRow(reviewId);

        long secondaryBatchId =
                findSecondaryBatchId(
                        review,
                        source
                );

        ensureSecondaryExternalIdExists(
                secondaryBatchId,
                externalId
        );

        String fantacalcioExternalId =
                stringValue(
                        review,
                        "fantacalcio_external_id"
                );

        try {
            jdbcClient.sql("""
                    INSERT INTO verified_source_identity_links (
                        fantacalcio_external_id,
                        secondary_source,
                        secondary_external_id,
                        verification_method,
                        verified,
                        verification_note
                    )
                    VALUES (
                        :fantacalcioExternalId,
                        :secondarySource,
                        :secondaryExternalId,
                        'MANUAL_VERIFICATION',
                        TRUE,
                        :note
                    )
                    ON CONFLICT (
                        fantacalcio_external_id,
                        secondary_source
                    )
                    DO UPDATE SET
                        secondary_external_id =
                            EXCLUDED.secondary_external_id,
                        verification_method =
                            'MANUAL_VERIFICATION',
                        verified = TRUE,
                        verification_note =
                            EXCLUDED.verification_note,
                        updated_at =
                            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    """)
                    .param(
                            "fantacalcioExternalId",
                            fantacalcioExternalId
                    )
                    .param(
                            "secondarySource",
                            source
                    )
                    .param(
                            "secondaryExternalId",
                            externalId
                    )
                    .param(
                            "note",
                            request.note(),
                            Types.VARCHAR
                    )
                    .update();

        } catch (DataIntegrityViolationException exception) {

            throw new ConflictException(
                    "L'identitÃ  secondaria "
                            + source
                            + "/"
                            + externalId
                            + " risulta giÃ  collegata "
                            + "a un altro giocatore",
                    exception
            );
        }

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE reconciliation_review_items
                SET review_status = 'RESOLVED',
                    resolution_source = :source,
                    resolution_external_id = :externalId,
                    resolution_note = :note,
                    resolved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE id = :reviewId
                """)
                .param("source", source)
                .param(
                        "externalId",
                        externalId
                )
                .param(
                        "note",
                        request.note(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "reviewId",
                        reviewId
                )
                .update();

        return findById(reviewId);
    }

    @Transactional
    public ReconciliationReviewItemResponse exclude(
            Long reviewId,
            ReconciliationReviewExcludeRequest request
    ) {

        if (request == null) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Richiesta di esclusione mancante"
            );
        }

        findReviewRow(reviewId);

        String reason =
                requireText(
                        request.reason(),
                        "Motivo esclusione obbligatorio"
                ).toUpperCase();

        if (!Set.of(
                "OUT_OF_SERIE_A"
        ).contains(reason)) {

            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Motivo esclusione non supportato: "
                            + reason
            );
        }

        String note =
                requireText(
                        request.note(),
                        "Nota esclusione obbligatoria"
                );

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE reconciliation_review_items
                SET review_status = 'EXCLUDED',
                    resolution_source = NULL,
                    resolution_external_id = NULL,
                    resolution_note = NULL,
                    resolved_at = NULL,
                    exclusion_reason = :reason,
                    exclusion_note = :note,
                    excluded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE id = :reviewId
                """)
                .param("reason", reason)
                .param("note", note)
                .param("reviewId", reviewId)
                .update();

        return findById(reviewId);
    }
    @Transactional
    public ReconciliationReviewItemResponse ignore(
            Long reviewId,
            String note
    ) {

        findReviewRow(reviewId);

        String reason =
                requireText(
                        note,
                        "Motivo obbligatorio"
                );

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE reconciliation_review_items
                SET review_status = 'IGNORED',
                    resolution_source = NULL,
                    resolution_external_id = NULL,
                    resolution_note = :note,
                    resolved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE id = :reviewId
                """)
                .param("note", reason)
                .param("reviewId", reviewId)
                .update();

        return findById(reviewId);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public ReconciliationReviewItemResponse findById(
            Long reviewId
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    review.id,
                    season.code AS season,
                    review.fantacalcio_batch_id,
                    review.gazzetta_batch_id,
                    review.fantamarkt_batch_id,
                    review.fantacalcio_external_id,
                    review.fantacalcio_name,
                    review.fantacalcio_club,
                    review.gazzetta_external_id,
                    review.gazzetta_name,
                    review.gazzetta_club,
                    review.fantamarkt_external_id,
                    review.fantamarkt_name,
                    review.fantamarkt_club,
                    review.review_status,
                    review.resolution_source,
                    review.resolution_external_id,
                    review.resolution_note,
                            review.exclusion_reason,
                            review.exclusion_note,
                            review.first_seen_at,
                            review.last_seen_at,
                            review.resolved_at,
                            review.excluded_at

                FROM reconciliation_review_items review

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = review.season_id

                WHERE review.id = :reviewId
                """)
                .param("reviewId", reviewId)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        mapResponse(resultSet)
                )
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Elemento review non trovato: "
                                        + reviewId
                        )
                );
    }

    private int upsert(
            Long seasonId,
            long fantacalcioBatchId,
            long gazzettaBatchId,
            Long fantamarktBatchId,
            ReconciliationPreviewPlayer player
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO reconciliation_review_items (
                    season_id,
                    fantacalcio_batch_id,
                    gazzetta_batch_id,
                    fantamarkt_batch_id,
                    fantacalcio_external_id,
                    fantacalcio_name,
                    fantacalcio_club,
                    gazzetta_external_id,
                    gazzetta_name,
                    gazzetta_club,
                    fantamarkt_external_id,
                    fantamarkt_name,
                    fantamarkt_club,
                    review_status
                )
                VALUES (
                    :seasonId,
                    :fantacalcioBatchId,
                    :gazzettaBatchId,
                    :fantamarktBatchId,
                    :fantacalcioExternalId,
                    :fantacalcioName,
                    :fantacalcioClub,
                    :gazzettaExternalId,
                    :gazzettaName,
                    :gazzettaClub,
                    :fantamarktExternalId,
                    :fantamarktName,
                    :fantamarktClub,
                    'OPEN'
                )
                ON CONFLICT (
                    season_id,
                    fantacalcio_external_id
                )
                DO UPDATE SET
                    fantacalcio_batch_id =
                        EXCLUDED.fantacalcio_batch_id,
                    gazzetta_batch_id =
                        EXCLUDED.gazzetta_batch_id,
                    fantamarkt_batch_id =
                        EXCLUDED.fantamarkt_batch_id,
                    fantacalcio_name =
                        EXCLUDED.fantacalcio_name,
                    fantacalcio_club =
                        EXCLUDED.fantacalcio_club,
                    gazzetta_external_id =
                        EXCLUDED.gazzetta_external_id,
                    gazzetta_name =
                        EXCLUDED.gazzetta_name,
                    gazzetta_club =
                        EXCLUDED.gazzetta_club,
                    fantamarkt_external_id =
                        EXCLUDED.fantamarkt_external_id,
                    fantamarkt_name =
                        EXCLUDED.fantamarkt_name,
                    fantamarkt_club =
                        EXCLUDED.fantamarkt_club,
                    last_seen_at =
                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    updated_at =
                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    review_status =
                        CASE
                            WHEN reconciliation_review_items
                                     .review_status IN (
                                         'IGNORED',
                                         'EXCLUDED'
                                     )
                            THEN reconciliation_review_items
                                     .review_status
                            ELSE 'OPEN'
                        END,
                    resolved_at =
                        CASE
                            WHEN reconciliation_review_items
                                     .review_status = 'IGNORED'
                            THEN reconciliation_review_items
                                     .resolved_at
                            ELSE NULL
                        END
                """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param(
                        "fantacalcioBatchId",
                        fantacalcioBatchId
                )
                .param(
                        "gazzettaBatchId",
                        gazzettaBatchId
                )
                .param(
                        "fantamarktBatchId",
                        fantamarktBatchId,
                        Types.BIGINT
                )
                .param(
                        "fantacalcioExternalId",
                        player.fantacalcioExternalId()
                )
                .param(
                        "fantacalcioName",
                        player.fantacalcioName()
                )
                .param(
                        "fantacalcioClub",
                        player.fantacalcioClub(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "gazzettaExternalId",
                        player.gazzettaExternalId(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "gazzettaName",
                        player.gazzettaName(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "gazzettaClub",
                        player.gazzettaClub(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "fantamarktExternalId",
                        player.fantamarktExternalId(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "fantamarktName",
                        player.fantamarktName(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "fantamarktClub",
                        player.fantamarktClub(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .update();
    }

    private BatchSeason validateBatchSeasons(
            long fantacalcioBatchId,
            long gazzettaBatchId,
            Long fantamarktBatchId
    ) {

        BatchSeason fantacalcio =
                batchSeason(
                        fantacalcioBatchId,
                        "FANTACALCIO"
                );

        BatchSeason gazzetta =
                batchSeason(
                        gazzettaBatchId,
                        "GAZZETTA"
                );

        if (!fantacalcio.seasonId()
                .equals(gazzetta.seasonId())) {

            throw new ConflictException(
                    "I batch Fantacalcio e Gazzetta "
                            + "appartengono a stagioni diverse"
            );
        }

        if (fantamarktBatchId != null) {

            BatchSeason fantamarkt =
                    batchSeason(
                            fantamarktBatchId,
                            "FANTAMARKT"
                    );

            if (!fantacalcio.seasonId()
                    .equals(fantamarkt.seasonId())) {

                throw new ConflictException(
                        "Il batch Fantamarkt appartiene "
                                + "a una stagione diversa"
                );
            }
        }

        return fantacalcio;
    }

    private BatchSeason batchSeason(
            long batchId,
            String expectedSource
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    season.id AS season_id,
                    season.code AS season_code,
                    batch.source,
                    batch.status

                FROM import_batches batch

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = batch.season_id

                WHERE batch.id = :batchId
                """)
                .param("batchId", batchId)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        new BatchSeason(
                                resultSet.getLong(
                                        "season_id"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "season_code"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "source"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "status"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .optional()
                .map(batch -> {

                    if (!expectedSource.equals(
                            batch.source()
                    )) {
                        throw new ConflictException(
                                "Batch "
                                        + batchId
                                        + " non appartiene a "
                                        + expectedSource
                        );
                    }

                    if (!"COMPLETED".equals(
                            batch.status()
                    )) {
                        throw new ConflictException(
                                "Batch "
                                        + batchId
                                        + " non completato"
                        );
                    }

                    return batch;
                })
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Batch non trovato: "
                                        + batchId
                        )
                );
    }

    private long findLatestBatch(
            String season,
            String source
    ) {

        return findLatestOptionalBatch(
                season,
                source
        ) == null
                ? throwMissingBatch(
                        season,
                        source
                )
                : findLatestOptionalBatch(
                        season,
                        source
                );
    }

    private long throwMissingBatch(
            String season,
            String source
    ) {
        throw new ResourceNotFoundException(
                "Nessun batch COMPLETED "
                        + source
                        + " per "
                        + season
        );
    }

    private Long findLatestOptionalBatch(
            String season,
            String source
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT batch.id

                FROM import_batches batch

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = batch.season_id

                WHERE season.code = :season
                  AND batch.source = :source
                  AND batch.status = 'COMPLETED'

                ORDER BY
                    COALESCE(
                        batch.source_observed_at,
                        batch.completed_at,
                        batch.started_at
                    ) DESC,
                    batch.id DESC

                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param("season", season)
                .param("source", source)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElse(null);
    }

    private int autoResolveStaleOpenItems(
            Long seasonId,
            long fantacalcioBatchId,
            Set<String> unresolvedFantacalcioExternalIds
    ) {

        List<String> openExternalIds =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT review.fantacalcio_external_id

                        FROM reconciliation_review_items review

                        WHERE review.season_id = :seasonId
                          AND review.review_status = 'OPEN'

                          AND EXISTS (
                              SELECT 1
                              FROM player_import_rows row
                              WHERE row.batch_id = :fantacalcioBatchId
                                AND row.external_id =
                                    review.fantacalcio_external_id
                                AND row.valid = TRUE
                          )
                        """)
                        .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                        .param(
                                "fantacalcioBatchId",
                                fantacalcioBatchId
                        )
                        .query(String.class)
                        .list();

        List<String> resolvedExternalIds =
                openExternalIds.stream()
                        .filter(externalId ->
                                !unresolvedFantacalcioExternalIds
                                        .contains(externalId)
                        )
                        .toList();

        if (resolvedExternalIds.isEmpty()) {
            return 0;
        }

        int updated = 0;

        for (String externalId : resolvedExternalIds) {
            updated +=
                    jdbcClient.sql("""
                            UPDATE reconciliation_review_items
                            SET review_status = 'RESOLVED',
                                resolution_source = NULL,
                                resolution_external_id = NULL,
                                resolution_note =
                                    'AUTO_RECONCILED_AFTER_SOURCE_REFRESH',
                                resolved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                                updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                            WHERE season_id = :seasonId
                              AND fantacalcio_external_id = :externalId
                              AND review_status = 'OPEN'
                            """)
                            .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                            .param("externalId", externalId)
                            .update();
        }

        return updated;
    }


    private int countStatus(
            String season,
            String status
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT COUNT(*)

                FROM reconciliation_review_items review

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = review.season_id

                WHERE season.code = :season
                  AND review.review_status = :status
                """)
                .param("season", season)
                .param("status", status)
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();
    }

    private Map<String, Object> findReviewRow(
            Long reviewId
    ) {

        if (reviewId == null) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "reviewId obbligatorio"
            );
        }

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    id,
                    fantacalcio_external_id,
                    gazzetta_batch_id,
                    fantamarkt_batch_id,
                    review_status

                FROM reconciliation_review_items

                WHERE id = :reviewId
                """)
                .param("reviewId", reviewId)
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .stream()
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Elemento review non trovato: "
                                        + reviewId
                        )
                );
    }

    private long findSecondaryBatchId(
            Map<String, Object> review,
            String source
    ) {

        Object value =
                "GAZZETTA".equals(source)
                        ? review.get("gazzetta_batch_id")
                        : review.get("fantamarkt_batch_id");

        if (!(value instanceof Number number)) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Nessun batch "
                            + source
                            + " disponibile per questa review"
            );
        }

        return number.longValue();
    }

    private void ensureSecondaryExternalIdExists(
            long batchId,
            String externalId
    ) {

        int count =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM player_import_rows
                        WHERE batch_id = :batchId
                          AND external_id = :externalId
                          AND valid = TRUE
                        """)
                        .param("batchId", batchId)
                        .param(
                                "externalId",
                                externalId
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        if (count != 1) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "External ID secondario non trovato "
                            + "nel batch selezionato: "
                            + externalId
            );
        }
    }

    private ReconciliationReviewItemResponse mapResponse(
            java.sql.ResultSet resultSet
    ) throws java.sql.SQLException {

        long fantamarktBatch =
                resultSet.getLong(
                        "fantamarkt_batch_id"
                );

        Long fantamarktBatchId =
                resultSet.wasNull()
                        ? null
                        : fantamarktBatch;

        return new ReconciliationReviewItemResponse(
                resultSet.getLong("id"),
                resultSet.getString("season"),

                resultSet.getLong(
                        "fantacalcio_batch_id"
                ),
                resultSet.getLong(
                        "gazzetta_batch_id"
                ),
                fantamarktBatchId,

                resultSet.getString(
                        "fantacalcio_external_id"
                ),
                resultSet.getString(
                        "fantacalcio_name"
                ),
                resultSet.getString(
                        "fantacalcio_club"
                ),

                resultSet.getString(
                        "gazzetta_external_id"
                ),
                resultSet.getString(
                        "gazzetta_name"
                ),
                resultSet.getString(
                        "gazzetta_club"
                ),

                resultSet.getString(
                        "fantamarkt_external_id"
                ),
                resultSet.getString(
                        "fantamarkt_name"
                ),
                resultSet.getString(
                        "fantamarkt_club"
                ),

                resultSet.getString(
                        "review_status"
                ),

                resultSet.getString(
                        "resolution_source"
                ),
                resultSet.getString(
                        "resolution_external_id"
                ),
                resultSet.getString(
                        "resolution_note"
                ),

                resultSet.getString(
                        "exclusion_reason"
                ),
                resultSet.getString(
                        "exclusion_note"
                ),

                resultSet.getObject(
                        "first_seen_at",
                        OffsetDateTime.class
                ),
                resultSet.getObject(
                        "last_seen_at",
                        OffsetDateTime.class
                ),
                resultSet.getObject(
                        "resolved_at",
                        OffsetDateTime.class
                ),
                resultSet.getObject(
                        "excluded_at",
                        OffsetDateTime.class
                )
        );
    }

    private String stringValue(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            String key
    ) {

        Object value = row.get(key);

        return value == null
                ? null
                : value.toString();
    }

    private String requireText(
            String value,
            String message
    ) {

        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(message);
        }

        return value.trim();
    }

    private record BatchSeason(
            Long seasonId,
            String seasonCode,
            String source,
            String status
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.refresh;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnProperty;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion.AutomatedDataUpdateService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.season.CurrentSeasonResolver;

@Component
@ConditionalOnProperty(
        name = "app.data-refresh.scheduler.enabled",
        havingValue = "true"
)
public class DataRefreshScheduler {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            LoggerFactory.getLogger(DataRefreshScheduler.class);

    private final AutomatedDataUpdateService service;
    private final String configuredSeason;
    private final CurrentSeasonResolver currentSeasonResolver;

    public DataRefreshScheduler(
            AutomatedDataUpdateService service,
            CurrentSeasonResolver currentSeasonResolver,
            @Value("${app.data-refresh.scheduler.season:}")
            String configuredSeason
    ) {
        this.service = service;
        this.currentSeasonResolver = currentSeasonResolver;
        this.configuredSeason = configuredSeason;
    }

    @Scheduled(
            cron = "${app.data-refresh.scheduler.cron:0 0 0 * * *}",
            zone = "Europe/Rome"
    )
    public void refreshData() {
        try {
            String season = configuredSeason == null
                    || configuredSeason.isBlank()
                    ? currentSeasonResolver.resolve()
                    : configuredSeason.trim();

            AutomatedDataUpdateService.AutomatedUpdateResponse result =
                    service.run(season);

            DataRefreshResponse response = result.refresh();

            LOGGER.info(
                    "Aggiornamento automatico completato: "
                            + "runId={}, stagione={}, giocatori={}, "
                            + "valutazioni={}, rating={}",
                    response.id(),
                    response.season(),
                    response.reconciliationMatchedPlayers(),
                    response.generatedEvaluations(),
                    response.generatedClubRatings()
            );
        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
            LOGGER.error(
                    "Aggiornamento automatico fallito",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\refresh\DataRefreshService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.refresh;

import java.sql.Types;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.time.Duration;

import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.catalog.readiness.CatalogReadinessResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.catalog.readiness.CatalogReadinessService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.SecretSanitizer;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.evaluation.PlayerEvaluationGenerationResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.evaluation.PlayerEvaluationGenerationService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture.strength.ClubStrengthGenerationResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture.strength.ClubStrengthGenerationService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.freshness.DataFreshnessResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.freshness.DataFreshnessService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt.SelectiveIdentityEnrichmentService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.reconciliation.PlayerReconciliationService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.reconciliation.ReconciliationResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.reconciliation.review.ReconciliationReviewService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.transfer.detection.TransferDetectionService;

@Service
public class DataRefreshService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    private final PlayerReconciliationService
            reconciliationService;

    private final PlayerEvaluationGenerationService
            evaluationService;

    private final ClubStrengthGenerationService
            clubStrengthService;

    private final TransferDetectionService
            transferDetectionService;

    private final ReconciliationReviewService
            reconciliationReviewService;

    private final CatalogReadinessService
            catalogReadinessService;

    private final DataFreshnessService
            freshnessService;

    private final SelectiveIdentityEnrichmentService
            identityEnrichmentService;
    private final Duration staleThreshold;
    private final RefreshFaultInjector faultInjector;

    public DataRefreshService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            PlayerReconciliationService reconciliationService,
            PlayerEvaluationGenerationService evaluationService,
            ClubStrengthGenerationService clubStrengthService,
            TransferDetectionService transferDetectionService,
            ReconciliationReviewService reconciliationReviewService,
            CatalogReadinessService catalogReadinessService,
            DataFreshnessService freshnessService,
            SelectiveIdentityEnrichmentService identityEnrichmentService,
            RefreshFaultInjector faultInjector,
            @Value("${app.data-refresh.stale-threshold:2h}") Duration staleThreshold
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.reconciliationService =
                reconciliationService;
        this.evaluationService =
                evaluationService;
        this.clubStrengthService =
                clubStrengthService;
        this.transferDetectionService =
                transferDetectionService;
        this.reconciliationReviewService =
                reconciliationReviewService;
        this.catalogReadinessService =
                catalogReadinessService;
        this.freshnessService =
                freshnessService;
        this.identityEnrichmentService =
                identityEnrichmentService;
        this.faultInjector = faultInjector;
        if (staleThreshold == null || staleThreshold.isZero() || staleThreshold.isNegative()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("app.data-refresh.stale-threshold deve essere maggiore di zero");
        }
        this.staleThreshold = staleThreshold;
    }

    public DataRefreshResponse runManual(
            String seasonCode
    ) {
        return run(
                seasonCode,
                "MANUAL"
        );
    }

    public DataRefreshResponse runScheduled(
            String seasonCode
    ) {
        return run(
                seasonCode,
                "SCHEDULED"
        );
    }

    public DataRefreshResponse findLatest(
            String seasonCode
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    refresh.id,
                    season.code AS season,
                    refresh.trigger_type,
                    refresh.status,
                    refresh.source_freshness_status,
                    refresh.source_freshness_checked_at,
                    refresh.reconciliation_matched_players,
                    refresh.generated_evaluations,
                    refresh.generated_club_ratings,
                    refresh.started_at,
                    refresh.completed_at,
                    refresh.error_message

                FROM data_refresh_runs refresh

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id =
                        refresh.season_id

                WHERE season.code = :season

                ORDER BY
                    refresh.started_at DESC,
                    refresh.id DESC

                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param(
                        "season",
                        seasonCode
                )
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        mapResponse(resultSet)
                )
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Nessun aggiornamento trovato "
                                        + "per la stagione "
                                        + seasonCode
                        )
                );
    }

    private DataRefreshResponse run(
            String seasonCode,
            String triggerType
    ) {

        Long seasonId =
                findSeasonId(
                        seasonCode
                );

        Long refreshId =
                createRefreshRun(
                        seasonId,
                        triggerType
                );

        try {
            DataFreshnessResponse freshness =
                    freshnessService.evaluate(
                            seasonCode
                    );

            updateRefreshFreshness(
                    refreshId,
                    freshness.overallStatus()
            );

            if (freshness.blocked()) {
                throw new ConflictException(
                        "Dati sorgente non abbastanza aggiornati: "
                                + String.join(
                                        "; ",
                                        freshness.blockers()
                                )
                );
            }

            /*
             * Transfer detection MUST run against the previous
             * active registration before reconciliation applies
             * the newest Fantacalcio snapshot.
             */
            transferDetectionService.detectLatest(
                    seasonCode
            );
            faultInjector.checkpoint("AFTER_TRANSFER_DETECTION");

            ReconciliationResponse reconciliation =
                    reconciliationService.reconcile(
                            seasonCode
                    );
            faultInjector.checkpoint("AFTER_RECONCILIATION");

            /*
             * Persist unresolved identities after reconciliation
             * so an administrator has a durable review queue.
             */
            reconciliationReviewService.syncLatest(
                    seasonCode
            );
            faultInjector.checkpoint("AFTER_REVIEW_SYNC");

            /*
             * B71 production identity enrichment.
             *
             * It MUST run after reconciliation because Transfermarkt
             * discovery reads the newly reconciled operational catalog.
             *
             * Manual refreshes never initiate remote identity discovery.
             */
            if ("SCHEDULED".equals(triggerType)) {

                identityEnrichmentService.runScheduled(
                        seasonCode
                );

                faultInjector.checkpoint(
                        "AFTER_IDENTITY_ENRICHMENT"
                );
            }

            CatalogReadinessResponse readiness =
                    catalogReadinessService.evaluateLatest(
                            seasonCode
                    );

            /*
             * WARNING is allowed: unresolved identities and
             * pending transfers are expected during the market.
             *
             * BLOCKED means structural catalog corruption such
             * as reconciled players without a role or an ACTIVE
             * registration.
             */
            if (readiness.blocked()) {
                throw new ConflictException(
                        "Catalogo non pronto: "
                                + String.join(
                                        "; ",
                                        readiness.blockers()
                                )
                );
            }

            PlayerEvaluationGenerationResponse evaluations =
                    evaluationService.generate(
                            seasonCode
                    );
            faultInjector.checkpoint("AFTER_EVALUATIONS");

            ClubStrengthGenerationResponse clubRatings =
                    clubStrengthService.generate(
                            seasonCode
                    );
            faultInjector.checkpoint("AFTER_CLUB_STRENGTH");
            faultInjector.checkpoint("BEFORE_COMPLETE");

            completeRefreshRun(
                    refreshId,
                    reconciliation.matchedPlayers(),
                    evaluations.generatedEvaluations(),
                    clubRatings.generatedRatings()
            );

            return findById(refreshId);

        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {

            markRefreshRunFailed(
                    refreshId,
                    readableMessage(exception)
            );

            throw exception;
        }
    }

    private Long findSeasonId(
            String seasonCode
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM seasons
                WHERE code = :season
                """)
                .param(
                        "season",
                        seasonCode
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Stagione non trovata: "
                                        + seasonCode
                        )
                );
    }

    Long createRefreshRun(
            Long seasonId,
            String triggerType
    ) {

        recoverStaleRefresh(seasonId);
        try {
            return jdbcClient.sql("""
                    INSERT INTO data_refresh_runs (
                        season_id,
                        trigger_type,
                        status
                    )
                    VALUES (
                        :seasonId,
                        :triggerType,
                        'RUNNING'
                    )
                    RETURNING id
                    """)
                    .param(
                            "seasonId",
                            seasonId
                    )
                    .param(
                            "triggerType",
                            triggerType
                    )
                    .query(Long.class)
                    .single();

        } catch (DataIntegrityViolationException exception) {

            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Un aggiornamento dati Ã¨ giÃ  in esecuzione"
            );
        }
    }

    private void recoverStaleRefresh(Long seasonId) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE data_refresh_runs
                SET status = 'FAILED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    error_message = 'Esecuzione interrotta recuperata automaticamente'
                WHERE season_id = :seasonId
                  AND status = 'RUNNING'
                  AND started_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (:staleSeconds * INTERVAL '1 second')
                """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("staleSeconds", staleThreshold.toSeconds())
                .update();
    }

    private void updateRefreshFreshness(
            Long refreshId,
            String freshnessStatus
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE data_refresh_runs
                SET
                    source_freshness_status =
                        :freshnessStatus,

                    source_freshness_checked_at =
                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

                WHERE id = :refreshId
                """)
                .param(
                        "freshnessStatus",
                        freshnessStatus
                )
                .param(
                        "refreshId",
                        refreshId
                )
                .update();
    }

    private void completeRefreshRun(
            Long refreshId,
            int matchedPlayers,
            int generatedEvaluations,
            int generatedClubRatings
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE data_refresh_runs
                SET
                    status = 'COMPLETED',

                    reconciliation_matched_players =
                        :matchedPlayers,

                    generated_evaluations =
                        :generatedEvaluations,

                    generated_club_ratings =
                        :generatedClubRatings,

                    completed_at =
                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

                    error_message =
                        NULL

                WHERE id = :refreshId
                """)
                .param(
                        "matchedPlayers",
                        matchedPlayers
                )
                .param(
                        "generatedEvaluations",
                        generatedEvaluations
                )
                .param(
                        "generatedClubRatings",
                        generatedClubRatings
                )
                .param(
                        "refreshId",
                        refreshId
                )
                .update();
    }

    private void markRefreshRunFailed(
            Long refreshId,
            String errorMessage
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE data_refresh_runs
                SET
                    status = 'FAILED',

                    completed_at =
                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

                    error_message =
                        :errorMessage

                WHERE id = :refreshId
                """)
                .param(
                        "errorMessage",
                        truncate(
                                errorMessage,
                                2000
                        ),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "refreshId",
                        refreshId
                )
                .update();
    }

    private DataRefreshResponse findById(
            Long refreshId
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    refresh.id,
                    season.code AS season,
                    refresh.trigger_type,
                    refresh.status,
                    refresh.source_freshness_status,
                    refresh.source_freshness_checked_at,
                    refresh.reconciliation_matched_players,
                    refresh.generated_evaluations,
                    refresh.generated_club_ratings,
                    refresh.started_at,
                    refresh.completed_at,
                    refresh.error_message

                FROM data_refresh_runs refresh

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id =
                        refresh.season_id

                WHERE refresh.id = :refreshId
                """)
                .param(
                        "refreshId",
                        refreshId
                )
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        mapResponse(resultSet)
                )
                .single();
    }

    private DataRefreshResponse mapResponse(
            java.sql.ResultSet resultSet
    ) throws java.sql.SQLException {

        return new DataRefreshResponse(
                resultSet.getLong("id"),
                resultSet.getString("season"),

                resultSet.getString(
                        "trigger_type"
                ),

                resultSet.getString("status"),

                resultSet.getString(
                        "source_freshness_status"
                ),

                resultSet.getObject(
                        "source_freshness_checked_at",
                        OffsetDateTime.class
                ),

                resultSet.getInt(
                        "reconciliation_matched_players"
                ),

                resultSet.getInt(
                        "generated_evaluations"
                ),

                resultSet.getInt(
                        "generated_club_ratings"
                ),

                resultSet.getObject(
                        "started_at",
                        OffsetDateTime.class
                ),

                resultSet.getObject(
                        "completed_at",
                        OffsetDateTime.class
                ),

                resultSet.getString(
                        "error_message"
                )
        );
    }

    private String readableMessage(
            Throwable exception
    ) {

        return SecretSanitizer.sanitize(exception);
    }

    private String truncate(
            String value,
            int maximumLength
    ) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (value.length()
                <= maximumLength) {

            return value;
        }

        return value.substring(
                0,
                maximumLength
        );
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\scouting\B70ArrivalScoutingService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.scouting;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;

@Service
public class B70ArrivalScoutingService {

    private static final Set<String> ROLES =
            Set.of("P", "D", "C", "A");

    private static final Set<String> RECOMMENDATIONS =
            Set.of(
                    "HIGH_PRIORITY",
                    "RECOMMENDED",
                    "MONITOR",
                    "HIGH_RISK"
            );

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public B70ArrivalScoutingService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    public List<B70ArrivalScoutingResponse> findCurrentArrivals(
            String season,
            String recommendation,
            String role,
            String club
    ) {

        String normalizedSeason =
                requireText(
                        season,
                        "Stagione obbligatoria"
                );

        String normalizedRecommendation =
                normalizeRecommendation(
                        recommendation
                );

        String normalizedRole =
                normalizeRole(role);

        String normalizedClub =
                normalizeOptionalText(club);

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            player.id AS player_id,
                            player.display_name AS player_name,
                            club.name AS club_name,
                            fantasy_role.fantasy_role,
                            season.code AS season_code,

                            report.previous_club,
                            report.previous_league,
                            report.previous_country_code,
                            report.transfer_type,

                            report.adaptation_score,
                            report.potential_score,
                            report.risk_score,
                            report.confidence_score,

                            report.recommendation,
                            report.scouting_summary,
                            report.updated_at

                        FROM foreign_player_scouting_reports report

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = report.season_id

                        JOIN players player
                            ON player.id = report.player_id
                           AND player.active = TRUE

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id = player.id
                           AND registration.season_id = season.id
                           AND registration.registration_status =
                               'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN season_clubs membership
                            ON membership.season_id = season.id
                           AND membership.club_id =
                               registration.club_id

                        JOIN clubs club
                            ON club.id = registration.club_id

                        JOIN player_roles fantasy_role
                            ON fantasy_role.player_id = player.id
                           AND fantasy_role.season_id = season.id
                           AND fantasy_role.source =
                               'FANTACALCIO'

                        WHERE season.code = :season

                          AND (
                              CAST(:recommendation AS VARCHAR)
                                  IS NULL
                              OR report.recommendation =
                                  CAST(
                                      :recommendation
                                      AS VARCHAR
                                  )
                          )

                          AND (
                              CAST(:role AS VARCHAR) IS NULL
                              OR fantasy_role.fantasy_role =
                                  CAST(:role AS VARCHAR)
                          )

                          AND (
                              CAST(:club AS VARCHAR) IS NULL
                              OR LOWER(club.name) =
                                  LOWER(
                                      CAST(
                                          :club
                                          AS VARCHAR
                                      )
                                  )
                              OR LOWER(club.short_name) =
                                  LOWER(
                                      CAST(
                                          :club
                                          AS VARCHAR
                                      )
                                  )
                              OR LOWER(club.slug) =
                                  LOWER(
                                      CAST(
                                          :club
                                          AS VARCHAR
                                      )
                                  )
                          )

                        ORDER BY
                            CASE report.recommendation
                                WHEN 'HIGH_PRIORITY' THEN 1
                                WHEN 'RECOMMENDED' THEN 2
                                WHEN 'MONITOR' THEN 3
                                WHEN 'HIGH_RISK' THEN 4
                                ELSE 5
                            END,

                            report.potential_score DESC,
                            report.confidence_score DESC,
                            report.risk_score ASC,
                            player.id ASC
                        """)
                .param(
                        "season",
                        normalizedSeason
                )
                .param(
                        "recommendation",
                        normalizedRecommendation
                )
                .param(
                        "role",
                        normalizedRole
                )
                .param(
                        "club",
                        normalizedClub
                )
                .query(
                        (resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                                new B70ArrivalScoutingResponse(
                                        resultSet.getLong(
                                                "player_id"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "player_name"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "club_name"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "fantasy_role"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "season_code"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "previous_club"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "previous_league"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "previous_country_code"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "transfer_type"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                                "adaptation_score"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                                "potential_score"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                                "risk_score"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                                "confidence_score"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "recommendation"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "scouting_summary"
                                        ),
                                        "CONFIRMED_SERIE_A",
                                        resultSet.getObject(
                                                "updated_at",
                                                java.time.OffsetDateTime.class
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .list();
    }

    private String normalizeRecommendation(
            String recommendation
    ) {

        String normalized =
                normalizeOptionalText(
                        recommendation
                );

        if (normalized == null) {
            return null;
        }

        normalized =
                normalized
                        .toUpperCase(
                                Locale.ROOT
                        );

        if (!RECOMMENDATIONS.contains(normalized)) {

            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Raccomandazione scouting non valida: "
                            + recommendation
            );
        }

        return normalized;
    }

    private String normalizeRole(
            String role
    ) {

        String normalized =
                normalizeOptionalText(role);

        if (normalized == null) {
            return null;
        }

        normalized =
                normalized
                        .toUpperCase(
                                Locale.ROOT
                        );

        if (!ROLES.contains(normalized)) {

            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Ruolo non valido: "
                            + role
            );
        }

        return normalized;
    }

    private String requireText(
            String value,
            String message
    ) {

        if (
            value == null
            || value.isBlank()
        ) {

            throw new BadRequestException(
                    message
            );
        }

        return value.trim();
    }

    private String normalizeOptionalText(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
            value == null
            || value.isBlank()
        ) {
            return null;
        }

        return value.trim();
    }
}
