package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.scouting;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;

@Service
public class B70NewListoneArrivalService {

    private static final Set<String> ROLES =
            Set.of("P", "D", "C", "A");

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public B70NewListoneArrivalService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    public List<B70NewListoneArrivalResponse> findNewEntries(
            String season,
            String role,
            String club
    ) {

        String normalizedSeason =
                requireText(
                        season,
                        "Stagione obbligatoria"
                );

        String normalizedRole =
                normalizeRole(role);

        String normalizedClub =
                normalizeOptionalText(club);

        List<BatchSnapshot> batches =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            batch.id,
                            COALESCE(
                                batch.source_observed_at,
                                batch.completed_at,
                                batch.started_at
                            ) AS observed_at
                        FROM import_batches batch
                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = batch.season_id
                        WHERE season.code = :season
                          AND batch.source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                          AND batch.status = 'COMPLETED'
                        ORDER BY
                            COALESCE(
                                batch.source_observed_at,
                                batch.completed_at,
                                batch.started_at
                            ) DESC,
                            batch.id DESC
                        LIMIT 2
                        """)
                .param(
                        "season",
                        normalizedSeason
                )
                .query(
                        (resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                                new BatchSnapshot(
                                        resultSet.getLong("id"),
                                        resultSet.getObject(
                                                "observed_at",
                                                java.time.OffsetDateTime.class
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .list();

        /*
         * With no previous snapshot there is no evidence that an
         * entry is new. Never classify the whole current listone
         * as newly arrived.
         */
        if (batches.size() < 2) {
            return List.of();
        }

        BatchSnapshot current =
                batches.get(0);

        BatchSnapshot previous =
                batches.get(1);

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                            player.id AS player_id,
                            player.display_name AS player_name,
                            club.name AS club_name,
                            fantasy_role.fantasy_role,
                            season.code AS season_code,
                            current_row.external_id,

                            EXISTS (
                                SELECT 1
                                FROM player_registration_events event
                                WHERE event.player_id = player.id
                                  AND event.season_id = season.id
                                  AND event.event_type =
                                      'TRANSFER_IN_SERIE_A'
                            ) AS official_transfer_event_present

                        FROM player_import_rows current_row

                        JOIN import_batches current_batch
                            ON current_batch.id =
                               current_row.batch_id

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id =
                               current_batch.season_id

                        JOIN player_source_mappings mapping
                            ON mapping.source =
                               'FANTACALCIO'
                           AND mapping.external_id =
                               current_row.external_id
                           AND mapping.verified = TRUE

                        JOIN players player
                            ON player.id = mapping.player_id
                           AND player.active = TRUE

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id =
                               player.id
                           AND registration.season_id =
                               season.id
                           AND registration.registration_status =
                               'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN season_clubs membership
                            ON membership.season_id =
                               season.id
                           AND membership.club_id =
                               registration.club_id

                        JOIN clubs club
                            ON club.id =
                               registration.club_id

                        JOIN player_roles fantasy_role
                            ON fantasy_role.player_id =
                               player.id
                           AND fantasy_role.season_id =
                               season.id
                           AND fantasy_role.source =
                               'FANTACALCIO'

                        WHERE current_row.batch_id =
                              :currentBatchId

                          AND current_row.valid = TRUE

                          AND current_row.external_id
                              IS NOT NULL

                          AND BTRIM(
                              current_row.external_id
                          ) <> ''

                          AND LOWER(
                              COALESCE(
                                  current_row.raw_data
                                      ->> 'out_of_game',
                                  'false'
                              )
                          ) <> 'true'

                          AND NOT EXISTS (
                              SELECT 1
                              FROM player_import_rows previous_row
                              WHERE previous_row.batch_id =
                                    :previousBatchId
                                AND previous_row.valid = TRUE
                                AND previous_row.external_id =
                                    current_row.external_id
                          )

                          AND NOT EXISTS (
                              SELECT 1
                              FROM foreign_player_scouting_reports report
                              WHERE report.player_id =
                                    player.id
                                AND report.season_id =
                                    season.id
                          )

                          AND (
                              CAST(:role AS VARCHAR) IS NULL
                              OR fantasy_role.fantasy_role =
                                  CAST(:role AS VARCHAR)
                          )

                          AND (
                              CAST(:club AS VARCHAR) IS NULL
                              OR LOWER(club.name) =
                                  LOWER(
                                      CAST(
                                          :club AS VARCHAR
                                      )
                                  )
                              OR LOWER(club.short_name) =
                                  LOWER(
                                      CAST(
                                          :club AS VARCHAR
                                      )
                                  )
                              OR LOWER(club.slug) =
                                  LOWER(
                                      CAST(
                                          :club AS VARCHAR
                                      )
                                  )
                          )

                        ORDER BY
                            player.id ASC
                        """)
                .param(
                        "currentBatchId",
                        current.id()
                )
                .param(
                        "previousBatchId",
                        previous.id()
                )
                .param(
                        "role",
                        normalizedRole
                )
                .param(
                        "club",
                        normalizedClub
                )
                .query(
                        (resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                                new B70NewListoneArrivalResponse(
                                        resultSet.getLong(
                                                "player_id"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "player_name"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "club_name"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "fantasy_role"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "season_code"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "external_id"
                                        ),
                                        current.id(),
                                        previous.id(),
                                        current.observedAt(),
                                        "NEW_FANTACALCIO_LISTONE_ENTRY",
                                        resultSet.getBoolean(
                                                "official_transfer_event_present"
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .list();
    }

    private String normalizeRole(
            String role
    ) {

        String normalized =
                normalizeOptionalText(role);

        if (normalized == null) {
            return null;
        }

        normalized =
                normalized.toUpperCase(
                        Locale.ROOT
                );

        if (!ROLES.contains(normalized)) {

            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Ruolo non valido: "
                            + role
            );
        }

        return normalized;
    }

    private String requireText(
            String value,
            String message
    ) {

        if (
            value == null
            || value.isBlank()
        ) {

            throw new BadRequestException(
                    message
            );
        }

        return value.trim();
    }

    private String normalizeOptionalText(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
            value == null
            || value.isBlank()
        ) {
            return null;
        }

        return value.trim();
    }

    private record BatchSnapshot(
            Long id,
            java.time.OffsetDateTime observedAt
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.scouting;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;

@Service
public class B70PendingScoutingArrivalService {

    private static final Set<String> ROLES =
            Set.of("P", "D", "C", "A");

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public B70PendingScoutingArrivalService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    public List<B70PendingScoutingArrivalResponse> findPending(
            String season,
            String role,
            String club
    ) {

        String normalizedSeason =
                requireText(
                        season,
                        "Stagione obbligatoria"
                );

        String normalizedRole =
                normalizeRole(role);

        String normalizedClub =
                normalizeOptionalText(club);

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            player.id AS player_id,
                            player.display_name AS player_name,
                            club.name AS club_name,
                            fantasy_role.fantasy_role,
                            season.code AS season_code,

                            event.effective_at,
                            event.transfer_claim_id,
                            event.source AS transfer_source,
                            event.source_reference,
                            event.created_at AS detected_at

                        FROM player_registration_events event

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = event.season_id

                        JOIN players player
                            ON player.id = event.player_id
                           AND player.active = TRUE

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id = player.id
                           AND registration.season_id = season.id
                           AND registration.registration_status =
                               'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN season_clubs membership
                            ON membership.season_id = season.id
                           AND membership.club_id =
                               registration.club_id

                        JOIN clubs club
                            ON club.id = registration.club_id

                        JOIN player_roles fantasy_role
                            ON fantasy_role.player_id = player.id
                           AND fantasy_role.season_id = season.id
                           AND fantasy_role.source =
                               'FANTACALCIO'

                        WHERE season.code = :season

                          AND event.event_type =
                              'TRANSFER_IN_SERIE_A'

                          AND NOT EXISTS (
                              SELECT 1
                              FROM foreign_player_scouting_reports report
                              WHERE report.player_id = player.id
                                AND report.season_id = season.id
                          )

                          AND (
                              CAST(:role AS VARCHAR) IS NULL
                              OR fantasy_role.fantasy_role =
                                  CAST(:role AS VARCHAR)
                          )

                          AND (
                              CAST(:club AS VARCHAR) IS NULL
                              OR LOWER(club.name) =
                                  LOWER(
                                      CAST(
                                          :club
                                          AS VARCHAR
                                      )
                                  )
                              OR LOWER(club.short_name) =
                                  LOWER(
                                      CAST(
                                          :club
                                          AS VARCHAR
                                      )
                                  )
                              OR LOWER(club.slug) =
                                  LOWER(
                                      CAST(
                                          :club
                                          AS VARCHAR
                                      )
                                  )
                          )

                        ORDER BY
                            event.effective_at DESC,
                            event.created_at DESC,
                            player.id ASC
                        """)
                .param(
                        "season",
                        normalizedSeason
                )
                .param(
                        "role",
                        normalizedRole
                )
                .param(
                        "club",
                        normalizedClub
                )
                .query(
                        (resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                                new B70PendingScoutingArrivalResponse(
                                        resultSet.getLong(
                                                "player_id"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "player_name"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "club_name"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "fantasy_role"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "season_code"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getObject(
                                                "effective_at",
                                                java.time.LocalDate.class
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getLong(
                                                "transfer_claim_id"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "transfer_source"
                                        ),
                                        resultSet.getString(
                                                "source_reference"
                                        ),
                                        "SCOUTING_REQUIRED",
                                        resultSet.getObject(
                                                "detected_at",
                                                java.time.OffsetDateTime.class
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .list();
    }

    private String normalizeRole(
            String role
    ) {

        String normalized =
                normalizeOptionalText(role);

        if (normalized == null) {
            return null;
        }

        normalized =
                normalized.toUpperCase(
                        Locale.ROOT
                );

        if (!ROLES.contains(normalized)) {

            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Ruolo non valido: "
                            + role
            );
        }

        return normalized;
    }

    private String requireText(
            String value,
            String message
    ) {

        if (
            value == null
            || value.isBlank()
        ) {

            throw new BadRequestException(
                    message
            );
        }

        return value.trim();
    }

    private String normalizeOptionalText(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
            value == null
            || value.isBlank()
        ) {
            return null;
        }

        return value.trim();
    }
}

        );

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.scouting;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

@Service
public class ForeignPlayerScoutingService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public ForeignPlayerScoutingService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional
    public ForeignPlayerScoutingResponse upsert(
            Long playerId,
            UpsertForeignPlayerScoutingRequest request
    ) {
        validatePlayerId(playerId);

        String seasonCode =
                normalizeRequired(
                        request.season(),
                        "La stagione Ã¨ obbligatoria"
                );

        String previousClub =
                normalizeRequired(
                        request.previousClub(),
                        "Il club precedente Ã¨ obbligatorio"
                );

        String previousLeague =
                normalizeRequired(
                        request.previousLeague(),
                        "Il campionato precedente Ã¨ obbligatorio"
                );

        String previousCountryCode =
                normalizeCountryCode(
                        request.previousCountryCode()
                );

        String transferType =
                normalizeTransferType(
                        request.transferType()
                );

        PlayerSeasonReference reference =
                findRegisteredPlayer(
                        playerId,
                        seasonCode
                );

        String recommendation =
                calculateRecommendation(
                        request.adaptationScore(),
                        request.potentialScore(),
                        request.riskScore(),
                        request.confidenceScore()
                );

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO foreign_player_scouting_reports (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    previous_club,
                    previous_league,
                    previous_country_code,
                    transfer_type,
                    adaptation_score,
                    potential_score,
                    risk_score,
                    confidence_score,
                    recommendation,
                    scouting_summary
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :previousClub,
                    :previousLeague,
                    :previousCountryCode,
                    :transferType,
                    :adaptationScore,
                    :potentialScore,
                    :riskScore,
                    :confidenceScore,
                    :recommendation,
                    :scoutingSummary
                )
                ON CONFLICT (
                    player_id,
                    season_id
                )
                DO UPDATE SET
                    previous_club =
                        EXCLUDED.previous_club,

                    previous_league =
                        EXCLUDED.previous_league,

                    previous_country_code =
                        EXCLUDED.previous_country_code,

                    transfer_type =
                        EXCLUDED.transfer_type,

                    adaptation_score =
                        EXCLUDED.adaptation_score,

                    potential_score =
                        EXCLUDED.potential_score,

                    risk_score =
                        EXCLUDED.risk_score,

                    confidence_score =
                        EXCLUDED.confidence_score,

                    recommendation =
                        EXCLUDED.recommendation,

                    scouting_summary =
                        EXCLUDED.scouting_summary,

                    updated_at =
                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", reference.seasonId())
                .param("previousClub", previousClub)
                .param("previousLeague", previousLeague)
                .param(
                        "previousCountryCode",
                        previousCountryCode
                )
                .param("transferType", transferType)
                .param(
                        "adaptationScore",
                        request.adaptationScore()
                )
                .param(
                        "potentialScore",
                        request.potentialScore()
                )
                .param("riskScore", request.riskScore())
                .param(
                        "confidenceScore",
                        request.confidenceScore()
                )
                .param(
                        "recommendation",
                        recommendation
                )
                .param(
                        "scoutingSummary",
                        request.scoutingSummary().trim()
                )
                .update();

        return findByPlayer(
                playerId,
                seasonCode
        );
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<ForeignPlayerScoutingResponse> findAll(
            String season,
            String recommendation
    ) {
        String seasonCode =
                normalizeRequired(
                        season,
                        "La stagione Ã¨ obbligatoria"
                );

        String parsedRecommendation =
                recommendation == null
                        || recommendation.isBlank()
                        ? null
                        : normalizeRecommendation(
                                recommendation
                        );

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder("""
                SELECT
                    report.player_id,
                    player.display_name,
                    club.name AS current_club,
                    role.fantasy_role,
                    season.code AS season_code,
                    report.previous_club,
                    report.previous_league,
                    report.previous_country_code,
                    report.transfer_type,
                    report.adaptation_score,
                    report.potential_score,
                    report.risk_score,
                    report.confidence_score,
                    report.recommendation,
                    report.scouting_summary,
                    report.updated_at

                FROM foreign_player_scouting_reports report

                JOIN players player
                    ON player.id = report.player_id

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = report.season_id

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id =
                        report.player_id
                    AND registration.season_id =
                        report.season_id
                    AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'

                JOIN clubs club
                    ON club.id = registration.club_id

                LEFT JOIN player_roles role
                    ON role.player_id = report.player_id
                    AND role.season_id = report.season_id
                    AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                WHERE season.code = :season
                  AND player.active = TRUE
                """);

        if (parsedRecommendation != null) {
            sql.append("""
                    AND report.recommendation =
                        :recommendation
                    """);
        }

        sql.append("""
                ORDER BY
                    report.potential_score DESC,
                    report.adaptation_score DESC,
                    report.risk_score,
                    player.display_name
                """);

        var query =
                jdbcClient.sql(sql.toString())
                        .param("season", seasonCode);

        if (parsedRecommendation != null) {
            query = query.param(
                    "recommendation",
                    parsedRecommendation
            );
        }

        return query
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        mapResponse(resultSet)
                )
                .list();
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public ForeignPlayerScoutingResponse findByPlayer(
            Long playerId,
            String season
    ) {
        validatePlayerId(playerId);

        String seasonCode =
                normalizeRequired(
                        season,
                        "La stagione Ã¨ obbligatoria"
                );

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    report.player_id,
                    player.display_name,
                    club.name AS current_club,
                    role.fantasy_role,
                    season.code AS season_code,
                    report.previous_club,
                    report.previous_league,
                    report.previous_country_code,
                    report.transfer_type,
                    report.adaptation_score,
                    report.potential_score,
                    report.risk_score,
                    report.confidence_score,
                    report.recommendation,
                    report.scouting_summary,
                    report.updated_at

                FROM foreign_player_scouting_reports report

                JOIN players player
                    ON player.id = report.player_id

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = report.season_id

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id =
                        report.player_id
                    AND registration.season_id =
                        report.season_id
                    AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'

                JOIN clubs club
                    ON club.id = registration.club_id

                LEFT JOIN player_roles role
                    ON role.player_id = report.player_id
                    AND role.season_id = report.season_id
                    AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                WHERE report.player_id = :playerId
                  AND season.code = :season
                  AND player.active = TRUE
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("season", seasonCode)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        mapResponse(resultSet)
                )
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Scouting del giocatore non trovato"
                        )
                );
    }

    private PlayerSeasonReference findRegisteredPlayer(
            Long playerId,
            String season
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    season.id AS season_id,
                    player.display_name

                FROM players player

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = player.id
                    AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = registration.season_id

                WHERE player.id = :playerId
                  AND player.active = TRUE
                  AND season.code = :season
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("season", season)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        new PlayerSeasonReference(
                                resultSet.getLong(
                                        "season_id"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "display_name"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Giocatore non registrato in Serie A "
                                        + "per la stagione indicata"
                        )
                );
    }

    private ForeignPlayerScoutingResponse mapResponse(
            java.sql.ResultSet resultSet
    ) throws java.sql.SQLException {
        OffsetDateTime updatedAt =
                resultSet.getObject(
                        "updated_at",
                        OffsetDateTime.class
                );

        return new ForeignPlayerScoutingResponse(
                resultSet.getLong("player_id"),
                resultSet.getString("display_name"),
                resultSet.getString("current_club"),
                resultSet.getString("fantasy_role"),
                resultSet.getString("season_code"),
                resultSet.getString("previous_club"),
                resultSet.getString("previous_league"),
                resultSet.getString(
                        "previous_country_code"
                ),
                resultSet.getString("transfer_type"),
                resultSet.getBigDecimal("adaptation_score"),
                resultSet.getBigDecimal("potential_score"),
                resultSet.getBigDecimal("risk_score"),
                resultSet.getBigDecimal("confidence_score"),
                resultSet.getString("recommendation"),
                resultSet.getString("scouting_summary"),
                updatedAt == null
                        ? null
                        : updatedAt.toInstant()
        );
    }

    private String calculateRecommendation(
            int adaptation,
            int potential,
            int risk,
            int confidence
    ) {
        BigDecimal score =
                BigDecimal.valueOf(adaptation)
                        .multiply(
                                new BigDecimal("0.30")
                        )
                        .add(
                                BigDecimal.valueOf(potential)
                                        .multiply(
                                                new BigDecimal(
                                                        "0.35"
                                                )
                                        )
                        )
                        .add(
                                BigDecimal.valueOf(100 - risk)
                                        .multiply(
                                                new BigDecimal(
                                                        "0.20"
                                                )
                                        )
                        )
                        .add(
                                BigDecimal.valueOf(confidence)
                                        .multiply(
                                                new BigDecimal(
                                                        "0.15"
                                                )
                                        )
                        );

        if (score.compareTo(
                new BigDecimal("80")
        ) >= 0
                && risk <= 45
                && confidence >= 60) {
            return "HIGH_PRIORITY";
        }

        if (score.compareTo(
                new BigDecimal("67")
        ) >= 0
                && risk <= 60) {
            return "RECOMMENDED";
        }

        if (score.compareTo(
                new BigDecimal("50")
        ) >= 0) {
            return "MONITOR";
        }

        return "HIGH_RISK";
    }

    private String normalizeCountryCode(
            String countryCode
    ) {
        String normalized =
                normalizeRequired(
                        countryCode,
                        "Il paese di provenienza Ã¨ obbligatorio"
                )
                        .toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);

        if (!normalized.matches("[A-Z]{2}")) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Il codice paese deve contenere due lettere"
            );
        }

        if ("IT".equals(normalized)) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Lo scouting estero non puÃ² avere "
                            + "l'Italia come paese di provenienza"
            );
        }

        return normalized;
    }

    private String normalizeTransferType(
            String transferType
    ) {
        String normalized =
                normalizeRequired(
                        transferType,
                        "La tipologia di trasferimento Ã¨ obbligatoria"
                )
                        .toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);

        if (!List.of(
                "PERMANENT",
                "LOAN",
                "FREE_AGENT",
                "RETURN_FROM_LOAN"
        ).contains(normalized)) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Tipologia di trasferimento non valida: "
                            + transferType
            );
        }

        return normalized;
    }

    private String normalizeRecommendation(
            String recommendation
    ) {
        String normalized =
                recommendation.trim()
                        .toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);

        if (!List.of(
                "HIGH_PRIORITY",
                "RECOMMENDED",
                "MONITOR",
                "HIGH_RISK"
        ).contains(normalized)) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Raccomandazione scouting non valida: "
                            + recommendation
            );
        }

        return normalized;
    }

    private String normalizeRequired(
            String value,
            String errorMessage
    ) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(errorMessage);
        }

        return value.trim();
    }

    private void validatePlayerId(Long playerId) {
        if (playerId == null || playerId <= 0) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "L'identificativo del giocatore non Ã¨ valido"
            );
        }
    }

    private record PlayerSeasonReference(
            Long seasonId,
            String playerName
    ) {
    }
}

        @Min(0)
        @Max(100)
        int confidenceScore,

        @NotBlank
        @Size(max = 2000)

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.season;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component("currentSeasonResolver")
public class CurrentSeasonResolver {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public CurrentSeasonResolver(JdbcClient jdbcClient) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    public String resolve() {
        var seasons = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT code FROM seasons
                WHERE current_season = TRUE
                ORDER BY id
                """).query(String.class).list();
        if (seasons.size() != 1) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Deve esistere esattamente una stagione corrente; trovate: " + seasons.size()
            );
        }
        return seasons.getFirst();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.season;

import java.time.OffsetDateTime;

import jakarta.persistence.*;

@Entity
@Table(name = "seasons")
public class Season {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @Column(nullable = false, unique = true, length = 9)
    private String code;

    @Column(name = "start_year", nullable = false)
    private Short startYear;

    @Column(name = "end_year", nullable = false)
    private Short endYear;

    @Column(name = "current_season", nullable = false)
    private boolean currentSeason;

    @Column(name = "created_at", nullable = false)
    private OffsetDateTime createdAt;

    protected Season() {
    }

    public Long getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public String getCode() {
        return code;
    }

    public Short getStartYear() {
        return startYear;
    }

    public Short getEndYear() {
        return endYear;
    }

    public boolean isCurrentSeason() {
        return currentSeason;
    }

    public OffsetDateTime getCreatedAt() {
        return createdAt;
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.season;

import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class SeasonService {

    private final SeasonRepository seasonRepository;

    public SeasonService(SeasonRepository seasonRepository) {
        this.seasonRepository = seasonRepository;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<SeasonResponse> findAll() {
        return seasonRepository
                .findAllByOrderByStartYearDesc()
                .stream()
                .map(SeasonResponse::from)
                .toList();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squad;

import jakarta.validation.Valid;

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/squad")
public class SquadController {

    private final SquadService squadService;

    public SquadController(SquadService squadService) {
        this.squadService = squadService;
    }

    @GetMapping
    public SquadResponse findActiveSquad(Authentication authentication) {
        return squadService.findActiveSquad(authentication.getName(), isAdmin(authentication));
    }

    @PostMapping("/players")
    public SquadResponse addPlayer(
            @Valid
            @RequestBody
            AddSquadPlayerRequest request,
            Authentication authentication
    ) {
        SquadResponse squad = squadService.findActiveSquad(authentication.getName(), isAdmin(authentication));
        return squadService.addPlayer(squad.id(), request);
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/players/{playerId}")
    public SquadResponse removePlayer(
            @PathVariable Long playerId,
            Authentication authentication
    ) {
        SquadResponse squad = squadService.findActiveSquad(authentication.getName(), isAdmin(authentication));
        return squadService.removePlayer(squad.id(), playerId);
    }

    @PatchMapping("/players/{playerId}")
    public SquadResponse updatePlayerPrice(
            @PathVariable Long playerId,
            @Valid @RequestBody UpdateSquadPlayerPriceRequest request,
            Authentication authentication
    ) {
        SquadResponse squad = squadService.findActiveSquad(authentication.getName(), isAdmin(authentication));
        return squadService.updatePlayerPrice(squad.id(), playerId, request);
    }

    private boolean isAdmin(Authentication authentication) {
        return authentication.getAuthorities().stream()
                .anyMatch(authority -> "ROLE_ADMIN".equals(authority.getAuthority()));
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\main\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\squad\SquadService.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squad;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

@Service
public class SquadService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public SquadService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public SquadResponse findActiveSquad() {
        Map<String, Object> squad =
                findActiveSquadRow();

        return buildSquadResponse(squad);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public SquadResponse findSquad(
            Long squadId
    ) {
        return buildSquadResponse(
                findSquadRow(squadId)
        );
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<SquadSummaryResponse> findSquads(
            String season,
            String username,
            boolean administrator
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    squad.id,
                    squad.name,
                    squad.initial_budget,
                    squad.active,

                    season.code AS season,

                    league.goalkeepers_count
                        + league.defenders_count
                        + league.midfielders_count
                        + league.forwards_count
                            AS maximum_players,

                    COUNT(squad_player.id)
                        AS total_players,

                    COALESCE(
                        SUM(squad_player.purchase_price),
                        0
                    ) AS spent_budget

                FROM fantasy_squads squad

                JOIN league_configurations league
                    ON league.id =
                        squad.league_configuration_id

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id =
                        league.season_id

                LEFT JOIN fantasy_squad_players squad_player
                    ON squad_player.squad_id =
                        squad.id

                WHERE season.code = :season
                  AND (:administrator = TRUE OR LOWER(squad.owner_username) = LOWER(:username))

                GROUP BY
                    squad.id,
                    squad.name,
                    squad.initial_budget,
                    squad.active,
                    season.code,
                    league.goalkeepers_count,
                    league.defenders_count,
                    league.midfielders_count,
                    league.forwards_count

                ORDER BY
                    squad.active DESC,
                    squad.id
                """)
                .param("season", season)
                .param("username", username)
                .param("administrator", administrator)
                .query((rs, rowNumber) -> {
                    int initialBudget =
                            rs.getInt(
                                    "initial_budget"
                            );

                    int spentBudget =
                            rs.getInt(
                                    "spent_budget"
                            );

                    return new SquadSummaryResponse(
                            rs.getLong("id"),
                            rs.getString("name"),
                            rs.getString("season"),
                            initialBudget,
                            spentBudget,
                            initialBudget - spentBudget,
                            rs.getInt(
                                    "total_players"
                            ),
                            rs.getInt(
                                    "maximum_players"
                            ),
                            rs.getBoolean("active")
                    );
                })
                .list();
    }

    /** Internal compatibility path; HTTP callers always use the ownership-aware overload. */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<SquadSummaryResponse> findSquads(String season) {
        return findSquads(season, "", true);
    }

    @Transactional
    public SquadResponse createSquad(CreateSquadRequest request, String ownerUsername) {
        Map<String, Object> league = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id, total_budget
                FROM league_configurations
                WHERE id = :leagueId
                """)
                .param("leagueId", request.leagueConfigurationId())
                .query().listOfRows().stream().findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(
                        "Configurazione lega non trovata: " + request.leagueConfigurationId()
                ));

        if (request.active()) {
            jdbcClient.sql("""
                    UPDATE fantasy_squads
                    SET active = FALSE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    WHERE active = TRUE AND LOWER(owner_username) = LOWER(:owner)
                    """)
                    .param("owner", ownerUsername)
                    .update();
        }

        Long squadId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO fantasy_squads (
                    league_configuration_id, name, initial_budget, active, owner_username
                ) VALUES (:leagueId, :name, :budget, :active, :owner)
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param("leagueId", request.leagueConfigurationId())
                .param("name", request.name().trim())
                .param("budget", number(league, "total_budget").intValue())
                .param("active", request.active())
                .param("owner", ownerUsername)
                .query(Long.class).single();
        return findSquad(squadId);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public SquadResponse findActiveSquad(String username, boolean administrator) {
        return buildSquadResponse(findActiveSquadRow(username, administrator));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public SquadResponse findSquad(Long squadId, String username, boolean administrator) {
        assertAccess(squadId, username, administrator);
        return findSquad(squadId);
    }

    @Transactional
    public SquadResponse addPlayer(
            AddSquadPlayerRequest request
    ) {
        Map<String, Object> squad =
                findActiveSquadRow();

        Long squadId =
                number(squad, "id").longValue();

        return addPlayer(
                squadId,
                request
        );
    }

    @Transactional
    public SquadResponse addPlayer(
            Long squadId,
            AddSquadPlayerRequest request
    ) {
        lockSquad(squadId);
        Map<String, Object> squad =
                findSquadRow(squadId);

        Long seasonId =
                number(
                        squad,
                        "season_id"
                ).longValue();

        int initialBudget =
                number(
                        squad,
                        "initial_budget"
                ).intValue();

        ensurePlayerNotAlreadyPresent(
                squadId,
                request.playerId()
        );

        Map<String, Object> player =
                findEligiblePlayer(
                        request.playerId(),
                        seasonId
                );

        String role =
                player.get(
                        "fantasy_role"
                ).toString();

        ensureRoleHasSpace(
                squad,
                squadId,
                role
        );

        int remainingBudget =
                initialBudget
                        - calculateSpentBudget(
                                squadId
                        );

        if (
                request.purchasePrice()
                        > remainingBudget
        ) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Budget insufficiente"
            );
        }

        int emptySlotsAfterPurchase =
                calculateRemainingSlots(
                        squad
                ) - 1;

        int budgetAfterPurchase =
                remainingBudget
                        - request.purchasePrice();

        if (
                budgetAfterPurchase
                        < emptySlotsAfterPurchase
        ) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Devi conservare almeno un credito "
                            + "per ogni posto ancora libero"
            );
        }

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO fantasy_squad_players (
                    squad_id,
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    fantasy_role,
                    purchase_price
                )
                VALUES (
                    :squadId,
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :role,
                    :purchasePrice
                )
                """)
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        request.playerId()
                )
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("role", role)
                .param(
                        "purchasePrice",
                        request.purchasePrice()
                )
                .update();

        return findSquad(squadId);
    }

    @Transactional
    public SquadResponse removePlayer(
            Long playerId
    ) {
        Map<String, Object> squad =
                findActiveSquadRow();

        Long squadId =
                number(squad, "id")
                        .longValue();

        return removePlayer(
                squadId,
                playerId
        );
    }

    @Transactional
    public SquadResponse removePlayer(
            Long squadId,
            Long playerId
    ) {
        lockSquad(squadId);
        findSquadRow(squadId);

        int deleted =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        DELETE FROM fantasy_squad_players
                        WHERE squad_id = :squadId
                          AND player_id = :playerId
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "squadId",
                                squadId
                        )
                        .param(
                                "playerId",
                                playerId
                        )
                        .update();

        if (deleted == 0) {
            throw new ResourceNotFoundException(
                    "Giocatore non presente nella rosa"
            );
        }

        return findSquad(squadId);
    }

    @Transactional
    public SquadResponse updatePlayerPrice(
            Long squadId,
            Long playerId,
            UpdateSquadPlayerPriceRequest request
    ) {
        lockSquad(squadId);
        Map<String, Object> squad = findSquadRow(squadId);

        int currentPrice = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT purchase_price
                FROM fantasy_squad_players
                WHERE squad_id = :squadId
                  AND player_id = :playerId
                """)
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .query(Integer.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(
                        "Giocatore non presente nella rosa"
                ));

        int initialBudget = number(squad, "initial_budget").intValue();
        int spentWithoutPlayer = calculateSpentBudget(squadId) - currentPrice;
        int budgetAfterUpdate = initialBudget - spentWithoutPlayer - request.purchasePrice();

        if (budgetAfterUpdate < 0) {
            throw new ConflictException("Budget insufficiente");
        }

        int emptySlots = calculateRemainingSlots(squad);
        if (budgetAfterUpdate < emptySlots) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Devi conservare almeno un credito per ogni posto ancora libero"
            );
        }

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE fantasy_squad_players
                SET purchase_price = :purchasePrice
                WHERE squad_id = :squadId
                  AND player_id = :playerId
                """)
                .param("purchasePrice", request.purchasePrice())
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .update();

        return findSquad(squadId);
    }

    private SquadResponse buildSquadResponse(
            Map<String, Object> squad
    ) {
        Long squadId =
                number(squad, "id")
                        .longValue();

        int initialBudget =
                number(
                        squad,
                        "initial_budget"
                ).intValue();

        List<SquadPlayerResponse> players =
                findSquadPlayers(squadId);

        int spentBudget =
                players.stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                SquadPlayerResponse::
                                        purchasePrice
                        )
                        .sum();

        int maxGoalkeepers =
                number(
                        squad,
                        "goalkeepers_count"
                ).intValue();

        int maxDefenders =
                number(
                        squad,
                        "defenders_count"
                ).intValue();

        int maxMidfielders =
                number(
                        squad,
                        "midfielders_count"
                ).intValue();

        int maxForwards =
                number(
                        squad,
                        "forwards_count"
                ).intValue();

        Map<String, SquadRoleSummaryResponse> roles =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        roles.put(
                "P",
                roleSummary(
                        countRole(players, "P"),
                        maxGoalkeepers
                )
        );

        roles.put(
                "D",
                roleSummary(
                        countRole(players, "D"),
                        maxDefenders
                )
        );

        roles.put(
                "C",
                roleSummary(
                        countRole(players, "C"),
                        maxMidfielders
                )
        );

        roles.put(
                "A",
                roleSummary(
                        countRole(players, "A"),
                        maxForwards
                )
        );

        int maximumPlayers =
                maxGoalkeepers
                        + maxDefenders
                        + maxMidfielders
                        + maxForwards;

        return new SquadResponse(
                squadId,
                squad.get("name").toString(),
                squad.get("season").toString(),
                initialBudget,
                spentBudget,
                initialBudget - spentBudget,
                players.size(),
                maximumPlayers,
                roles,
                players
        );
    }

    private List<SquadPlayerResponse> findSquadPlayers(
            Long squadId
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    squad_player.id,
                    player.id AS player_id,
                    player.display_name,
                    club.name AS club_name,
                    squad_player.fantasy_role,
                    squad_player.purchase_price

                FROM fantasy_squad_players squad_player

                JOIN players player
                    ON player.id =
                        squad_player.player_id

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND registration.season_id =
                        squad_player.season_id

                JOIN clubs club
                    ON club.id =
                        registration.club_id

                WHERE squad_player.squad_id =
                        :squadId

                ORDER BY
                    CASE squad_player.fantasy_role
                        WHEN 'P' THEN 1
                        WHEN 'D' THEN 2
                        WHEN 'C' THEN 3
                        WHEN 'A' THEN 4
                        ELSE 5
                    END,
                    player.display_name
                """)
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .query((rs, rowNumber) ->
                        new SquadPlayerResponse(
                                rs.getLong("id"),
                                rs.getLong(
                                        "player_id"
                                ),
                                rs.getString(
                                        "display_name"
                                ),
                                rs.getString(
                                        "club_name"
                                ),
                                rs.getString(
                                        "fantasy_role"
                                ),
                                rs.getInt(
                                        "purchase_price"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .list();
    }

    private Map<String, Object> findEligiblePlayer(
            Long playerId,
            Long seasonId
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    player.id,
                    player.display_name,
                    role.fantasy_role

                FROM players player

                JOIN player_roles role
                    ON role.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND role.season_id =
                        :seasonId
                    AND role.source =
                        'FANTACALCIO'

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND registration.season_id =
                        :seasonId

                JOIN player_reconciliation_results reconciliation
                    ON reconciliation.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND reconciliation.season_id =
                        :seasonId

                WHERE player.id = :playerId
                  AND player.active = TRUE
                  AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'
                """)
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        playerId
                )
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .stream()
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Giocatore non disponibile "
                                        + "per la stagione della rosa"
                        )
                );
    }

    private void ensurePlayerNotAlreadyPresent(
            Long squadId,
            Long playerId
    ) {
        boolean alreadyPresent =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM fantasy_squad_players
                        WHERE squad_id = :squadId
                          AND player_id = :playerId
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "squadId",
                                squadId
                        )
                        .param(
                                "playerId",
                                playerId
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single() > 0;

        if (alreadyPresent) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Giocatore giÃ  presente nella rosa"
            );
        }
    }

    private void ensureRoleHasSpace(
            Map<String, Object> squad,
            Long squadId,
            String role
    ) {
        int maximum =
                switch (role) {
                    case "P" ->
                            number(
                                    squad,
                                    "goalkeepers_count"
                            ).intValue();

                    case "D" ->
                            number(
                                    squad,
                                    "defenders_count"
                            ).intValue();

                    case "C" ->
                            number(
                                    squad,
                                    "midfielders_count"
                            ).intValue();

                    case "A" ->
                            number(
                                    squad,
                                    "forwards_count"
                            ).intValue();

                    default ->
                            throw new ConflictException(
                                    "Ruolo non valido"
                            );
                };

        int current =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM fantasy_squad_players
                        WHERE squad_id = :squadId
                          AND fantasy_role = :role
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "squadId",
                                squadId
                        )
                        .param("role", role)
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        if (current >= maximum) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Limite giocatori raggiunto "
                            + "per il ruolo "
                            + role
            );
        }
    }

    private int calculateSpentBudget(
            Long squadId
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT COALESCE(
                    SUM(purchase_price),
                    0
                )
                FROM fantasy_squad_players
                WHERE squad_id = :squadId
                """)
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();
    }

    private Map<String, Object> findActiveSquadRow() {
        return jdbcClient.sql(
                baseSquadQuery()
                        + """
                        WHERE squad.active = TRUE
                        ORDER BY squad.id DESC
                        LIMIT 1
                        """
                )
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .stream()
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Rosa attiva non trovata"
                        )
                );
    }

    private Map<String, Object> findActiveSquadRow(String username, boolean administrator) {
        return jdbcClient.sql(baseSquadQuery() + """
                WHERE squad.active = TRUE
                  AND (:administrator = TRUE OR LOWER(squad.owner_username) = LOWER(:username))
                ORDER BY squad.id DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param("username", username)
                .param("administrator", administrator)
                .query().listOfRows().stream().findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Rosa attiva non trovata"));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public void assertAccess(Long squadId, String username, boolean administrator) {
        if (administrator) {
            findSquadRow(squadId);
            return;
        }
        boolean allowed = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fantasy_squads
                WHERE id = :squadId AND LOWER(owner_username) = LOWER(:username)
                """)
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .param("username", username)
                .query(Integer.class).single() > 0;
        if (!allowed) {
            throw new ResourceNotFoundException("Rosa non trovata: " + squadId);
        }
    }

    private void lockSquad(Long squadId) {
        jdbcClient.sql("SELECT id FROM fantasy_squads WHERE id = :squadId FOR UPDATE")
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Rosa non trovata: " + squadId));
    }

    private Map<String, Object> findSquadRow(
            Long squadId
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql(
                baseSquadQuery()
                        + """
                        WHERE squad.id = :squadId
                        """
                )
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .stream()
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Rosa non trovata: "
                                        + squadId
                        )
                );
    }

    private String baseSquadQuery() {
        return """
                SELECT
                    squad.id,
                    squad.name,
                    squad.initial_budget,
                    squad.active,

                    league.goalkeepers_count,
                    league.defenders_count,
                    league.midfielders_count,
                    league.forwards_count,

                    season.id AS season_id,
                    season.code AS season

                FROM fantasy_squads squad

                JOIN league_configurations league
                    ON league.id =
                        squad.league_configuration_id

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id =
                        league.season_id
                """;
    }

    private int calculateRemainingSlots(
            Map<String, Object> squad
    ) {
        Long squadId =
                number(squad, "id")
                        .longValue();

        int maximumPlayers =
                number(
                        squad,
                        "goalkeepers_count"
                ).intValue()
                + number(
                        squad,
                        "defenders_count"
                ).intValue()
                + number(
                        squad,
                        "midfielders_count"
                ).intValue()
                + number(
                        squad,
                        "forwards_count"
                ).intValue();

        int currentPlayers =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM fantasy_squad_players
                        WHERE squad_id = :squadId
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "squadId",
                                squadId
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        return maximumPlayers
                - currentPlayers;
    }

    private int countRole(
            List<SquadPlayerResponse> players,
            String role
    ) {
        return (int) players.stream()
                .filter(player ->
                        role.equals(
                                player.role()
                        )
                )
                .count();
    }

    private SquadRoleSummaryResponse roleSummary(
            int current,
            int maximum
    ) {
        return new SquadRoleSummaryResponse(
                current,
                maximum,
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        maximum - current
                )
        );
    }

    private Number number(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            String key
    ) {
        Object value = row.get(key);

        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number;
        }

        throw new IllegalStateException(
                "Valore numerico mancante: "
                        + key
        );
    }
}
