    @BeforeEach
    void prepareIsolatedB67Dataset() {

        Long seasonId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM seasons
                        WHERE code = :seasonCode
                        """)
                .param("seasonCode", SEASON)
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();

        /*
         * B67 depends on an ACTIVE B66 algorithm.
         *
         * This is test-only data and the whole test is transactional:
         * Spring rolls it back automatically after every test.
         */
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO player_performance_algorithms (
                            version,
                            reference_season_id,
                            status,
                            model_decision
                        )
                        VALUES (
                            :version,
                            :seasonId,
                            'ACTIVE',
                            'COMPONENT_FEATURES_ONLY'
                        )
                        ON CONFLICT (version)
                        DO UPDATE SET
                            reference_season_id = EXCLUDED.reference_season_id,
                            status = 'ACTIVE',
                            model_decision = 'COMPONENT_FEATURES_ONLY'
                        """)
                .param("version", B66_VERSION)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .update();

        /*
         * The common test catalogue already contains players,
         * registrations and INTERNAL roles.
         *
         * B67 deliberately accepts only the authoritative
         * FANTACALCIO fantasy role, so derive that role from the
         * existing deterministic test role.
         */
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO player_roles (
                            player_id,
                            season_id,
                            source,
                            fantasy_role,
                            tactical_role,
                            primary_role
                        )
                        SELECT
                            role.player_id,
                            role.season_id,
                            'FANTACALCIO',
                            role.fantasy_role,
                            role.tactical_role,
                            TRUE
                        FROM player_roles role
                        WHERE role.season_id = :seasonId
                          AND role.source = 'INTERNAL'
                        ON CONFLICT (
                            player_id,
                            season_id,
                            source
                        )
                        DO UPDATE SET
                            fantasy_role = EXCLUDED.fantasy_role,
                            tactical_role = EXCLUDED.tactical_role,
                            primary_role = TRUE
                        """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .update();

        /*
         * Pick one deterministic player to exercise B67's
         * certified NO_HISTORY -> MARKET_ONLY policy.
         */
        marketOnlyPlayerId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT MIN(player.id)
                        FROM players player
                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id = player.id
                           AND registration.season_id = :seasonId
                           AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'
                        JOIN player_roles role
                            ON role.player_id = player.id
                           AND role.season_id = :seasonId
                           AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                        JOIN season_clubs season_club
                            ON season_club.season_id = :seasonId
                           AND season_club.club_id = registration.club_id
                        WHERE player.active = TRUE
                        """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();

        assertThat(marketOnlyPlayerId)
                .isNotNull();

        /*
         * Deterministic B66 feature profiles.
         *
         * No invented production data is involved:
         * these rows exist exclusively inside the rollback-only
         * test transaction and exercise B67's actual DB contract.
         */
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO player_performance_feature_profiles (
                            player_id,
                            reference_season_id,
                            current_club_id,
                            role_code,
                            algorithm_version,
                            history_seasons_available,
                            latest_history_season,
                            source_mix,
                            small_sample,
                            data_confidence_score,
                            input_fingerprint,
                            feature_values,
                            evidence
                        )
                        SELECT
                            player.id,
                            :seasonId,
                            registration.club_id,
                            role.fantasy_role,
                            :algorithmVersion,

                            CASE
                                WHEN player.id = :marketOnlyPlayerId
                                    THEN 0
                                ELSE 1
                            END,

                            CASE
                                WHEN player.id = :marketOnlyPlayerId
                                    THEN NULL
                                ELSE '2025/2026'
                            END,

                            CASE
                                WHEN player.id = :marketOnlyPlayerId
                                    THEN 'NO_HISTORY'
                                ELSE 'ONE_SEASON_ONLY'
                            END,

                            CASE
                                WHEN player.id = :marketOnlyPlayerId
                                    THEN TRUE
                                ELSE FALSE
                            END,

                            CASE
                                WHEN player.id = :marketOnlyPlayerId
                                    THEN 0
                                ELSE 80
                            END,

                            repeat(
                                CASE
                                    WHEN player.id = :marketOnlyPlayerId
                                        THEN 'a'
                                    ELSE 'b'
                                END,
                                64
                            ),

                            CASE
                                WHEN player.id = :marketOnlyPlayerId
                                    THEN jsonb_build_object(
                                        'fantasy_average_role_percentile', NULL,
                                        'usage_role_percentile', NULL,
                                        'goal_rate_role_percentile', NULL,
                                        'assist_rate_role_percentile', NULL
                                    )
                                ELSE jsonb_build_object(
                                    'fantasy_average_role_percentile',
                                        ((player.id * 17) % 101),
                                    'usage_role_percentile',
                                        ((player.id * 23) % 101),
                                    'goal_rate_role_percentile',
                                        ((player.id * 31) % 101),
                                    'assist_rate_role_percentile',
                                        ((player.id * 43) % 101)
                                )
                            END,

                            jsonb_build_object(
                                'test_dataset', TRUE,
                                'purpose', 'B67 isolated integration test'
                            )

                        FROM players player

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id = player.id
                           AND registration.season_id = :seasonId
                           AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN player_roles role
                            ON role.player_id = player.id
                           AND role.season_id = :seasonId
                           AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                        JOIN season_clubs season_club
                            ON season_club.season_id = :seasonId
                           AND season_club.club_id = registration.club_id

                        WHERE player.active = TRUE

                        ON CONFLICT (
                            player_id,
                            reference_season_id,
                            algorithm_version
                        )
                        DO UPDATE SET
                            current_club_id = EXCLUDED.current_club_id,
                            role_code = EXCLUDED.role_code,
                            history_seasons_available =
                                EXCLUDED.history_seasons_available,
                            latest_history_season =
                                EXCLUDED.latest_history_season,
                            source_mix = EXCLUDED.source_mix,
                            small_sample = EXCLUDED.small_sample,
                            data_confidence_score =
                                EXCLUDED.data_confidence_score,
                            input_fingerprint =
                                EXCLUDED.input_fingerprint,
                            feature_values =
                                EXCLUDED.feature_values,
                            evidence =
                                EXCLUDED.evidence
                        """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("algorithmVersion", B66_VERSION)
                .param("marketOnlyPlayerId", marketOnlyPlayerId)
                .update();

        /*
         * Fantacalcio market evidence is deterministic as well.
         *
         * It gives every test player genuine market signals while
         * the selected NO_HISTORY player has no performance signals.
         */
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO player_market_values (
                            player_id,
                            season_id,
                            source,
                            quotation,
                            fantasy_market_value
                        )
                        SELECT
                            player.id,
                            :seasonId,
                            'FANTACALCIO',

                        FROM players player
                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id = player.id
                           AND registration.season_id = :seasonId
                           AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'

                            ON role.player_id = player.id
                           AND role.season_id = :seasonId

                        WHERE player.active = TRUE
                        ON CONFLICT (

                            season_id,
                            source
                        )

                            fantasy_market_value =
                                EXCLUDED.fantasy_market_value
                        """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .update();

        expectedOperationalPlayers = jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM seasons season

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.season_id = season.id
                           AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN players player
                            ON player.id = registration.player_id
                           AND player.active = TRUE

                        JOIN season_clubs season_club
                            ON season_club.season_id = season.id
                           AND season_club.club_id =

                        JOIN player_roles role
                            ON role.player_id = player.id
                           AND role.season_id = season.id
                           AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                        JOIN player_performance_feature_profiles performance
                            ON performance.player_id = player.id
                           AND performance.reference_season_id =
                               season.id
                           AND performance.algorithm_version =
                               :algorithmVersion

                        WHERE season.code = :seasonCode
                        """)
                .param("algorithmVersion", B66_VERSION)
                .param("seasonCode", SEASON)
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();

        assertThat(expectedOperationalPlayers)
                .isGreaterThan(0);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldGenerateAndPersistOperationalB67MarketIdempotently() {

        List<B67AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult>
                calculated =
                modelService.calculateAll(
                        SEASON,
                        1000,
                        8,
                        false
                );

        assertThat(calculated)
                .hasSize(expectedOperationalPlayers);

        Set<String> roles = calculated
                .stream()
                .map(
                        B67AuctionPriceModelService
                                .AuctionPriceModelResult
                                ::role
                )
                .collect(Collectors.toSet());

        assertThat(roles)
                .containsExactlyInAnyOrder(
                        "P",
                        "D",
                        "C",
                        "A"
                );

        assertThat(calculated)
                .allSatisfy(result -> {

                    assertThat(result.pricingStatus())
                            .isEqualTo("PRICED");

                    assertThat(result.minimumPrice())
                            .isNotNull()
                            .isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(1);

                    assertThat(result.recommendedPrice())
                            .isNotNull()
                            .isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(
                                    result.minimumPrice()
                            );

                    assertThat(result.maximumPrice())
                            .isNotNull()
                            .isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(
                                    result.recommendedPrice()
                            );

                    assertThat(result.auctionScore())
                            .isNotNull()
                            .isBetween(
                                    0.0,
                                    100.0
                            );
                });

        B67AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult
                marketOnly =
                calculated
                        .stream()
                        .filter(result ->
                                result.playerId()
                                        .equals(
                                                marketOnlyPlayerId
                                        )
                        )
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElseThrow();

        assertThat(marketOnly.historySeasonsAvailable())
                .isZero();

        assertThat(marketOnly.dataConfidenceScore())
                .isZero();

        assertThat(marketOnly.performanceSignalCount())
                .isZero();

        assertThat(marketOnly.evidenceTier())
                .isEqualTo("MARKET_ONLY");

        assertThat(marketOnly.quotation())
                .isNotNull()
                .isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(1.0);

        assertThat(marketOnly.fantasyMarketValue())
                .isNotNull()
                .isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(1.0);

        assertThat(marketOnly.pricingStatus())
                .isEqualTo("PRICED");

        B67AuctionPricePersistenceService.PersistResult first =
                persistenceService.generateAndPersist(
                        SEASON,
                        1000,
                        8,
                        false
                );

        assertThat(first.calculatedProfiles())
                .isEqualTo(expectedOperationalPlayers);

        assertThat(
                first.insertedProfiles()
                        + first.unchangedProfiles()
        ).isEqualTo(expectedOperationalPlayers);

        B67AuctionPricePersistenceService.PersistResult second =
                persistenceService.generateAndPersist(
                        SEASON,
                        1000,
                        8,
                        false
                );

        assertThat(second.calculatedProfiles())
                .isEqualTo(expectedOperationalPlayers);

        assertThat(second.insertedProfiles())
                .isZero();

        assertThat(second.unchangedProfiles())
                .isEqualTo(expectedOperationalPlayers);

        Integer persisted = jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_price_profiles
                        WHERE algorithm_version =
                            :algorithmVersion
                          AND league_teams = 8
                          AND total_budget = 1000
                          AND defense_modifier = FALSE
                        """)
                .param(
                        "algorithmVersion",
                        B67_VERSION
                )
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();

        assertThat(persisted)
                .isEqualTo(expectedOperationalPlayers);

        Integer priced = jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_price_profiles
                        WHERE algorithm_version =
                            :algorithmVersion
                          AND league_teams = 8
                          AND total_budget = 1000
                          AND defense_modifier = FALSE
                          AND pricing_status = 'PRICED'
                        """)
                .param(
                        "algorithmVersion",
                        B67_VERSION
                )
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();

        assertThat(priced)
                .isEqualTo(expectedOperationalPlayers);

        Integer distinctPlayers = jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_id)
                        FROM auction_price_profiles
                        WHERE algorithm_version =
                            :algorithmVersion
                          AND league_teams = 8
                          AND total_budget = 1000
                          AND defense_modifier = FALSE
                        """)
                .param(
                        "algorithmVersion",
                        B67_VERSION
                )
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();

        assertThat(distinctPlayers)
                .isEqualTo(expectedOperationalPlayers);

        Integer invalidPriceStates = jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_price_profiles
                        WHERE algorithm_version =
                            :algorithmVersion
                          AND league_teams = 8
                          AND total_budget = 1000
                          AND defense_modifier = FALSE
                          AND (
                              pricing_status <> 'PRICED'
                              OR minimum_price IS NULL
                              OR recommended_price IS NULL
                              OR maximum_price IS NULL
                              OR minimum_price < 1
                              OR recommended_price < minimum_price
                              OR maximum_price < recommended_price
                          )
                        """)
                .param(
                        "algorithmVersion",
                        B67_VERSION
                )
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();

        assertThat(invalidPriceStates)
                .isZero();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldSupportAllLeagueConfigurationBoundaries() {

        List<B67AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult>
                minimumLeague =
                modelService.calculateAll(
                        SEASON,
                        150,
                        6,
                        false
                );

        assertThat(minimumLeague)
                .hasSize(expectedOperationalPlayers);

        List<B67AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult>
                maximumLeague =
                modelService.calculateAll(
                        SEASON,
                        1000,
                        12,
                        false
                );

        assertThat(maximumLeague)
                .hasSize(expectedOperationalPlayers);

        List<B67AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult>
                modifierOn =
                modelService.calculateAll(
                        SEASON,
                        1000,
                        8,
                        true
                );

        assertThat(modifierOn)
                .hasSize(expectedOperationalPlayers);

        long defenseTotalNoModifier =
                modelService.calculateAll(
                                SEASON,
                                1000,
                                8,
                                false
                        )
                        .stream()
                        .filter(result ->
                                "D".equals(
                                        result.role()
                                )
                        )
                        .mapToLong(
                                B67AuctionPriceModelService
                                        .AuctionPriceModelResult
                                        ::recommendedPrice
                        )
                        .sum();

        long defenseTotalModifier =
                modifierOn
                        .stream()
                        .filter(result ->
                                "D".equals(
                                        result.role()
                                )
                        )
                        .mapToLong(
                                B67AuctionPriceModelService
                                        .AuctionPriceModelResult
                                        ::recommendedPrice
                        )
                        .sum();

        assertThat(defenseTotalModifier)
                .isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(
                        defenseTotalNoModifier
                );
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class B67AuctionValueScorerTest {

    private final B67AuctionValueScorer scorer =
            new B67AuctionValueScorer();

    @Test
    void shouldCombineMarketAndPerformanceAsEqualDomains() {

        B67AuctionValueScorer.ScoreResult result =
                scorer.score(
                        "A",

                        100.0,
                        100.0,

                        0.0,
                        0.0,
                        0.0,
                        100.0
                );

        /*
         * Market median = 100.
         * Performance median = 0.
         *
         * Equal domain combination = 50.
         *
         * A flat median over all six signals would incorrectly
         * produce 0 and would overweight historical feature count.
         */
        assertThat(
                result.auctionValueScore()
        ).isEqualTo(50.0);

        assertThat(
                result.performanceSignalCount()
        ).isEqualTo(4);

        assertThat(
                result.totalSignalCount()
        ).isEqualTo(6);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldUseMedianInsidePerformanceDomain() {

        B67AuctionValueScorer.ScoreResult result =
                scorer.score(
                        "C",

                        null,
                        null,

                        90.0,
                        70.0,
                        50.0,
                        30.0
                );

        assertThat(
                result.auctionValueScore()
        ).isEqualTo(60.0);

        assertThat(
                result.performanceSignalCount()
        ).isEqualTo(4);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldKeepUnknownNullInsteadOfTurningItIntoZero() {

        B67AuctionValueScorer.ScoreResult result =
                scorer.score(
                        "D",

                        40.0,
                        20.0,

                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null
                );

        assertThat(
                result.auctionValueScore()
        ).isEqualTo(30.0);

        assertThat(
                result.performanceSignalCount()
        ).isZero();

        assertThat(
                result.totalSignalCount()
        ).isEqualTo(2);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldAllowMarketOnlyGoalkeeperLikePenev() {

        B67AuctionValueScorer.ScoreResult result =
                scorer.score(
                        "P",

                        10.0,
                        10.0,

                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null
                );

        assertThat(
                result.auctionValueScore()
        ).isEqualTo(10.0);

        assertThat(
                result.performanceSignalCount()
        ).isZero();
    }

    @Test
    void goalkeeperShouldIgnoreGoalAndAssistSignals() {

        B67AuctionValueScorer.ScoreResult result =
                scorer.score(
                        "P",

                        60.0,
                        40.0,

                        null,
                        null,

                        100.0,
                        100.0
                );

        assertThat(
                result.auctionValueScore()
        ).isEqualTo(50.0);

        assertThat(
                result.performanceSignalCount()
        ).isZero();
    }

    @Test
    void zeroMustRemainRealEvidence() {

        B67AuctionValueScorer.ScoreResult result =
                scorer.score(
                        "C",

                        0.0,
                        0.0,

                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null
                );

        assertThat(
                result.auctionValueScore()
        ).isZero();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReturnNullOnlyWhenEveryEvidenceSignalIsMissing() {

        B67AuctionValueScorer.ScoreResult result =
                scorer.score(
                        "A",

                        null,
                        null,

                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null
                );

        assertThat(
                result.auctionValueScore()
        ).isNull();

        assertThat(
                result.totalSignalCount()
        ).isZero();
    }
}

    private void prepareEligiblePlayers() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> players =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                            player.id AS player_id,
                            season.id AS season_id,
                            role.fantasy_role,
                            role.tactical_role

                        FROM players player

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id = player.id
                            AND registration.registration_status =
                                'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = registration.season_id

                        JOIN player_roles role
                            ON role.player_id = player.id
                            AND role.season_id = season.id

                        WHERE player.active = TRUE
                          AND season.code = '2026/2027'

                        ORDER BY player.id
                        """)
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        assertThat(players)
                .isNotEmpty();

        for (Map<String, Object> player : players) {
            Long playerId =
                    ((Number) player.get("player_id"))
                            .longValue();

            Long seasonId =
                    ((Number) player.get("season_id"))
                            .longValue();

            String fantasyRole =
                    player.get("fantasy_role")
                            .toString();

            Object tacticalRole =
                    player.get("tactical_role");

            jdbcClient.sql("""
                    INSERT INTO player_roles (
                        player_id,
                        season_id,
                        source,
                        fantasy_role,
                        tactical_role,
                        primary_role,
                        valid_from
                    )
                    VALUES (
                        :playerId,
                        :seasonId,
                        'FANTACALCIO',
                        :fantasyRole,
                        :tacticalRole,
                        TRUE,
                        DATE '2026-07-01'
                    )
                    ON CONFLICT (
                        player_id,
                        season_id,
                        source
                    )
                    DO UPDATE SET
                        fantasy_role =
                            EXCLUDED.fantasy_role,

                        tactical_role =
                            EXCLUDED.tactical_role,

                        primary_role = TRUE,

                        valid_from =
                            EXCLUDED.valid_from
                    """)
                    .param("playerId", playerId)
                    .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                    .param(
                            "fantasyRole",
                            fantasyRole
                    )
                    .param(
                            "tacticalRole",
                            tacticalRole
                    )
                    .update();
        }
    }

    private PlayerData findPlayerNotInSquad() {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    player.id AS player_id,
                    season.id AS season_id,
                    role.fantasy_role

                FROM players player

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = player.id
                    AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = registration.season_id

                JOIN player_roles role
                    ON role.player_id = player.id
                    AND role.season_id = season.id
                    AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                WHERE player.active = TRUE
                  AND season.code = '2026/2027'

                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM fantasy_squad_players squad_player
                      WHERE squad_player.squad_id = :squadId
                        AND squad_player.player_id = player.id
                  )

                ORDER BY player.id
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .query((rs, rowNumber) ->
                        new PlayerData(
                                rs.getLong(
                                        "player_id"
                                ),
                                rs.getLong(
                                        "season_id"
                                ),
                                rs.getString(
                                        "fantasy_role"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .single();
    }

    private List<PlayerData> findPlayersByRole(
            String role,
            int limit
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    player.id AS player_id,
                    season.id AS season_id,
                    player_role.fantasy_role

                FROM players player

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = player.id
                    AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = registration.season_id

                JOIN player_roles player_role
                    ON player_role.player_id = player.id
                    AND player_role.season_id = season.id
                    AND player_role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                WHERE player.active = TRUE
                  AND season.code = '2026/2027'
                  AND player_role.fantasy_role = :role

                ORDER BY player.id
                LIMIT :limit
                """)
                .param("role", role)
                .param("limit", limit)
                .query((rs, rowNumber) ->
                        new PlayerData(
                                rs.getLong(
                                        "player_id"
                                ),
                                rs.getLong(
                                        "season_id"
                                ),
                                rs.getString(
                                        "fantasy_role"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .list();
    }

    private void insertPurchase(
            PlayerData player,
            int purchasePrice
    ) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO fantasy_squad_players (
                    squad_id,
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    fantasy_role,
                    purchase_price
                )
                VALUES (
                    :squadId,
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :role,
                    :purchasePrice
                )
                """)
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        player.playerId()
                )
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        player.seasonId()
                )
                .param(
                        "role",
                        player.role()
                )
                .param(
                        "purchasePrice",
                        purchasePrice
                )
                .update();
    }

    private LiveAuctionRoleStrategyResponse findRole(
            LiveAuctionStrategyResponse response,
            String role
    ) {
        return response.roles()
                .stream()
                .filter(item ->
                        role.equals(item.role())
                )
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow();
    }

    private List<LiveAuctionTargetResponse> allTargets(
            LiveAuctionStrategyResponse response
    ) {
        return response.roles()
                .stream()
                .flatMap(role ->
                        role.targets().stream()
                )
                .toList();
    }

    private record PlayerData(
            Long playerId,
            Long seasonId,
            String role
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionranking;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyBoolean;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyInt;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyString;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.times;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito.MockitoBean;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction.AuctionApiPriceService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction.AuctionPriceResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class AuctionRankingServiceTest {

    @Autowired
    private IntelligentAuctionRankingService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    @MockitoBean
    private AuctionApiPriceService auctionPriceService;

    @BeforeEach
    void configureB51Market() {
        when(auctionPriceService.calculateAll(
                anyString(), anyInt(), anyInt(), anyBoolean()
        )).thenAnswer(invocation -> {
            String season = invocation.getArgument(0);
            int budget = invocation.getArgument(1);
            int teams = invocation.getArgument(2);
            boolean modifier = invocation.getArgument(3);

            return jdbcClient.sql("""
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        player.id,
                        player.display_name,
                        club.name AS club_name,
                        role.fantasy_role
                    FROM players player
                    JOIN player_registrations registration
                      ON registration.player_id = player.id
                     AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'
                    JOIN seasons season
                      ON season.id = registration.season_id
                    JOIN clubs club
                      ON club.id = registration.club_id
                    JOIN player_roles role
                      ON role.player_id = player.id
                     AND role.season_id = season.id
                     AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                    WHERE player.active = TRUE
                      AND season.code = :season
                    ORDER BY player.id
                    """)
                    .param("season", season)
                    .query()
                    .listOfRows()
                    .stream()
                    .map(row -> {
                        long id = ((Number) row.get("id")).longValue();
                        int recommended = (int) (id % 40) + 1;
                        BigDecimal score = BigDecimal.valueOf(100 - id % 50);

                        return new AuctionPriceResponse(
                                id,
                                row.get("display_name").toString(),
                                row.get("club_name").toString(),
                                row.get("fantasy_role").toString(),
                                teams,
                                budget,
                                modifier,
                                Math.max(1, recommended - 2),
                                recommended,
                                recommended + 2,
                                BigDecimal.valueOf(recommended)
                                        .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100))
                                        .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(budget)),
                                score,
                                "PRICED",
                                "B51 test price"
                        );
                    })
                    .toList();
        });
    }

    @Test
    void shouldBuildRankingOrderedByScore() {
        prepareEligiblePlayers();

        AuctionRankingResponse response =
                service.findRanking(
                        "2026/2027",
                        1000,
                        8,
                        true,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        false,
                        20
                );

        assertThat(response.season())
                .isEqualTo("2026/2027");

        assertThat(response.budget())
                .isEqualTo(1000);

        assertThat(response.teams())
                .isEqualTo(8);

        assertThat(response.players())
                .isNotEmpty();

        assertThat(response.totalPlayers())
                .isEqualTo(response.players().size());

        assertThat(response.players().getFirst().position())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        for (int index = 0;
                index < response.players().size();
                index++) {

            assertThat(
                    response.players().get(index).position()
            )
                    .isEqualTo(index + 1);
        }

        List<java.math.BigDecimal> scores =
                response.players()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                AuctionRankingItemResponse
                                        ::intelligenceScore
                        )
                        .toList();

        assertThat(scores)
                .isSortedAccordingTo(
                        java.util.Comparator.reverseOrder()
                );

        verify(auctionPriceService, times(1))
                .calculateAll("2026/2027", 1000, 8, true);
    }

    private List<Long> prepareEligiblePlayers() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> players =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                            player.id AS player_id,
                            season.id AS season_id,
                            role.fantasy_role,
                            role.tactical_role

                        FROM players player

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id = player.id
                            AND registration.registration_status =
                                'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = registration.season_id

                        JOIN player_roles role
                            ON role.player_id = player.id
                            AND role.season_id = season.id


                        WHERE player.active = TRUE
                          AND season.code = '2026/2027'

                        ORDER BY player.id
                        LIMIT 5
                        """)
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        assertThat(players)
                .isNotEmpty();

        for (Map<String, Object> player : players) {
            Long playerId =
                    ((Number) player.get("player_id"))
                            .longValue();

            Long seasonId =
                    ((Number) player.get("season_id"))
                            .longValue();

            String fantasyRole =
                    player.get("fantasy_role")
                            .toString();

            Object tacticalRole =
                    player.get("tactical_role");

            jdbcClient.sql("""
                    INSERT INTO player_roles (
                        player_id,
                        season_id,
                        source,
                        fantasy_role,
                        tactical_role,
                        primary_role,
                        valid_from
                    )
                    VALUES (
                        :playerId,
                        :seasonId,
                        'FANTACALCIO',
                        :fantasyRole,
                        :tacticalRole,
                        TRUE,
                        DATE '2026-07-01'
                    )
                    ON CONFLICT (
                        player_id,
                        season_id,
                        source
                    )
                    DO UPDATE SET
                        fantasy_role =
                            EXCLUDED.fantasy_role,

                        tactical_role =
                            EXCLUDED.tactical_role,

                        primary_role = TRUE,

                        valid_from =
                            EXCLUDED.valid_from
                    """)
                    .param("playerId", playerId)
                    .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                    .param("fantasyRole", fantasyRole)
                    .param("tacticalRole", tacticalRole)
                    .update();
        }

        return players.stream()
                .map(player ->
                        ((Number) player.get("player_id"))
                                .longValue()
                )
                .toList();
    }
    private String findExistingRole() {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT role.fantasy_role

                FROM player_roles role

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = role.season_id

                WHERE season.code = '2026/2027'
                  AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                ORDER BY role.player_id
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .query(String.class)
                .single();
    }

    private String findExistingClub() {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT club.name

                FROM players player

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = player.id
                    AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = registration.season_id

                JOIN clubs club
                    ON club.id = registration.club_id

                JOIN player_roles role
                    ON role.player_id = player.id
                    AND role.season_id = season.id
                    AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                WHERE player.active = TRUE
                  AND season.code = '2026/2027'

                ORDER BY player.id
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .query(String.class)
                .single();
    }

    private void insertUnavailableStatus(Long playerId) {
        Long seasonId =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM seasons
                        WHERE code = '2026/2027'
                        """)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_availabilities (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    matchday,
                    status,
                    starting_probability,
                    availability_probability,
                    injury_description,
                    source
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    10,
                    'INJURED',
                    0,
                    0,
                    'Problema muscolare',
                    'MANUAL'
                )
                ON CONFLICT (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    matchday
                )
                DO UPDATE SET
                    status = 'INJURED',
                    starting_probability = 0,
                    availability_probability = 0,
                    injury_description =
                        'Problema muscolare',
                    source = 'MANUAL',
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .update();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.mockito.ArgumentCaptor;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito.MockitoBean;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.*;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction.LiveAuctionDecisionRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction.LiveAuctionDecisionResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction.LiveAuctionDecisionService;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class AuctionContextAdapterIntegrationTest {
    @Autowired AuctionStateService state;
    @Autowired AuctionPurchaseService purchases;
    @Autowired AuctionContextAdapter adapter;
    @Autowired JdbcClient jdbc;
    @MockitoBean LiveAuctionDecisionService b58;
    Long sandboxSquad;
    @BeforeEach void fixture(){B59TestFixture.addFantacalcioRoles(jdbc);sandboxSquad=B59TestFixture.createSquad(jdbc);}

    @Test
    void buildsCertifiedB58ContextWithExactRosterUnavailableAndCurrentPrice(){
        var session=state.activate(state.create(new CreateSessionRequest(squadId())).id());
        Long other=available(session.id());
        purchases.purchase(session.id(),new PurchaseRequest(other,AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,null,"other"));
        Long current=available(session.id());
        state.nominate(session.id(),new NominationRequest(current,7));
        when(b58.decide(any())).thenReturn(org.mockito.Mockito.mock(LiveAuctionDecisionResponse.class));

        adapter.decide(session.id(),new SessionDecisionRequest(9,null,null,10));

        ArgumentCaptor<LiveAuctionDecisionRequest> captor=ArgumentCaptor.forClass(LiveAuctionDecisionRequest.class);
        verify(b58).decide(captor.capture());
        var context=captor.getValue();
        assertThat(context.currentPlayerId()).isEqualTo(current);
        assertThat(context.currentPrice()).isEqualTo(7);
        assertThat(context.proposedBid()).isEqualTo(9);
        assertThat(context.availabilityComplete()).isTrue();
        assertThat(context.unavailablePlayerIds()).containsExactly(other);
        int spent=context.playersAlreadyBought().stream().mapToInt(p->p.pricePaid()).sum();
        assertThat(context.remainingBudget()).isEqualTo(context.totalBudget()-spent);
    }
    private Long squadId(){return sandboxSquad;}
    private Long available(Long session){return jdbc.sql("SELECT player_id FROM auction_player_states WHERE session_id=:s AND availability='AVAILABLE' ORDER BY player_id LIMIT 1").param("s",session).query(Long.class).single();}
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.Future;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.CreateSessionRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.PurchaseRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.PurchaseResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;

@SpringBootTest
class AuctionIdempotencyConcurrencyIntegrationTest {

    @Autowired
    AuctionStateService state;

    @Autowired
    AuctionPurchaseService purchases;

    @Autowired
    JdbcClient jdbc;

    Long sessionId;
    Long playerId;
    Long squadId;

    List<Long> fixtureRolePlayers = List.of();

    @BeforeEach
    void setup() {

        cleanup();

        fixtureRolePlayers =
                B59TestFixture.addFantacalcioRoles(jdbc);

        squadId =
                B59TestFixture.createSquad(jdbc);

        sessionId =
                state.activate(
                        state.create(
                                new CreateSessionRequest(squadId),
                                "idempotency-owner"
                        ).id()
                ).id();

        playerId =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT player_id
                        FROM auction_player_states
                        WHERE session_id = :session
                          AND availability = 'AVAILABLE'
                        ORDER BY player_id
                        LIMIT 1
                        """)
                        .param("session", sessionId)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();
    }

    @AfterEach
    void tearDown() {

        cleanup();

        if (squadId != null) {
            jdbc.sql("""
                    DELETE FROM fantasy_squads
                    WHERE id = :id
                    """)
                    .param("id", squadId)
                    .update();
        }

        if (!fixtureRolePlayers.isEmpty()) {
            jdbc.sql("""
                    DELETE FROM player_roles
                    WHERE source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                      AND player_id IN (:ids)
                    """)
                    .param("ids", fixtureRolePlayers)
                    .update();
        }
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentSameIdempotencySamePayloadProducesSinglePurchase() throws Exception {

        PurchaseRequest request =
                new PurchaseRequest(
                        playerId,
                        AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,
                        null,
                        "same-key"
                );

        var ready = new CountDownLatch(2);
        var start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        var executor =
                Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);

        List<Future<Object>> futures =
                new ArrayList<>();

        futures.add(
                executor.submit(
                        () -> run(
                                ready,
                                start,
                                request
                        )
                )
        );

        futures.add(
                executor.submit(
                        () -> run(
                                ready,
                                start,
                                request
                        )
                )
        );

        ready.await();
        start.countDown();

        int success = 0;
        int conflict = 0;

        for (Future<Object> future : futures) {

            Object result =
                    future.get();

            if (result instanceof PurchaseResponse) {
                success++;
            }

            if (result instanceof ConflictException) {
                conflict++;
            }
        }

        executor.shutdown();

        assertThat(success + conflict)
                .isEqualTo(2);

        assertThat(success)
                .isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_purchases
                        WHERE session_id = :session
                          AND idempotency_key = 'same-key'
                        """)
                        .param("session", sessionId)
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single()
        )
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_purchases
                        WHERE session_id = :session
                          AND player_id = :player
                        """)
                        .param("session", sessionId)
                        .param("player", playerId)
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single()
        )
                .isEqualTo(1);
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentSameIdempotencyDifferentPayloadAllowsOnlyOneStoredPayload() throws Exception {

        PurchaseRequest first =
                new PurchaseRequest(
                        playerId,
                        AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,
                        null,
                        "shared-key"
                );

        PurchaseRequest second =
                new PurchaseRequest(
                        playerId,
                        AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,
                        2,
                        "shared-key"
                );

        var ready = new CountDownLatch(2);
        var start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        var executor =
                Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);

        List<Future<Object>> futures =
                List.of(
                        executor.submit(
                                () -> run(
                                        ready,
                                        start,
                                        first
                                )
                        ),
                        executor.submit(
                                () -> run(
                                        ready,
                                        start,
                                        second
                                )
                        )
                );

        ready.await();
        start.countDown();

        int success = 0;
        int conflict = 0;

        for (Future<Object> future : futures) {

            Object result =
                    future.get();

            if (result instanceof PurchaseResponse) {
                success++;
            }

            if (result instanceof ConflictException) {
                conflict++;
            }
        }

        executor.shutdown();

        assertThat(success)
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(conflict)
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_purchases
                        WHERE session_id = :session
                          AND idempotency_key = 'shared-key'
                        """)
                        .param("session", sessionId)
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single()
        )
                .isEqualTo(1);
    }

    private Object run(
            CountDownLatch ready,
            CountDownLatch start,
            PurchaseRequest request
    ) {

        try {

            ready.countDown();
            start.await();

            return purchases.purchase(
                    sessionId,
                    request
            );

        } catch (ConflictException exception) {

            return exception;

        } catch (Exception exception) {

            return exception;
        }
    }

    private void cleanup() {

        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM auction_events")
                .update();

        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM auction_purchases")
                .update();

        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM auction_player_states")
                .update();

        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM auction_sessions")
                .update();
    }
}

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;

@SpringBootTest
class AuctionPurchaseConcurrencyIntegrationTest {
    @Autowired AuctionStateService state;
    @Autowired AuctionPurchaseService purchases;
    @Autowired JdbcClient jdbc;
    Long sessionId; Long playerId; Long squadId; List<Long> fixtureRolePlayers=List.of();

    @BeforeEach void setup(){cleanup();fixtureRolePlayers=B59TestFixture.addFantacalcioRoles(jdbc);squadId=B59TestFixture.createSquad(jdbc);
        sessionId=state.activate(state.create(new CreateSessionRequest(squadId)).id()).id();
        playerId=jdbc.sql("SELECT player_id FROM auction_player_states WHERE session_id=:s AND availability='AVAILABLE' ORDER BY player_id LIMIT 1").param("s",sessionId).query(Long.class).single();}
    @AfterEach void tearDown(){cleanup();if(squadId!=null)jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM fantasy_squads WHERE id=:s").param("s",squadId).update();
        if(!fixtureRolePlayers.isEmpty())jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM player_roles WHERE source='FANTACALCIO' AND player_id IN (:ids)").param("ids",fixtureRolePlayers).update();}

    @Test void realConcurrentUserVersusOtherAllowsExactlyOneWinner()throws Exception{
        var ready=new CountDownLatch(2);var start=new CountDownLatch(1);
        var executor=Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);List<Future<Object>> futures=new ArrayList<>();
        futures.add(executor.submit(()->run(ready,start,new PurchaseRequest(playerId,AuctionBuyerType.USER,1,"race-user"))));
        futures.add(executor.submit(()->run(ready,start,new PurchaseRequest(playerId,AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,null,"race-other"))));
        ready.await();start.countDown();int success=0,conflict=0;
        for(Future<Object> future:futures){Object value=future.get();if(value instanceof PurchaseResponse)success++;if(value instanceof ConflictException)conflict++;}
        executor.shutdown();
        assertThat(success).isEqualTo(1);assertThat(conflict).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(jdbc.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auction_purchases WHERE session_id=:s AND player_id=:p")
                .param("s",sessionId).param("p",playerId).query(Integer.class).single()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(jdbc.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fantasy_squad_players WHERE squad_id=:s AND player_id=:p")
                .param("s",squadId).param("p",playerId).query(Integer.class).single()).isLessThanOrEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(state.state(sessionId).remainingBudget()).isNotNegative();
    }
    private Object run(CountDownLatch ready,CountDownLatch start,PurchaseRequest request){try{ready.countDown();start.await();return purchases.purchase(sessionId,request);}catch(ConflictException ex){return ex;}catch(Exception ex){return ex;}}
    private void cleanup(){jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM auction_events").update();jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM auction_purchases").update();jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM auction_player_states").update();jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM auction_sessions").update();}
}

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class AuctionSessionActiveOwnershipIntegrationTest {

    @Autowired
    AuctionStateService state;

    @Autowired
    JdbcClient jdbc;

    Long squadOne;
    Long squadTwo;
    Long squadThree;

    @BeforeEach
    void fixture() {

        B59TestFixture.addFantacalcioRoles(jdbc);

        squadOne = B59TestFixture.createSquad(jdbc);
        squadTwo = B59TestFixture.createSquad(jdbc);
        squadThree = B59TestFixture.createSquad(jdbc);
    }

    @Test
    void differentOwnersCanHaveActiveSessionsAtSameTime() {

        var first =
                state.create(
                        new CreateSessionRequest(squadOne),
                        "owner-a"
                );

        var second =
                state.create(
                        new CreateSessionRequest(squadTwo),
                        "owner-b"
                );

        var firstActive = state.activate(first.id());
        var secondActive = state.activate(second.id());

        assertThat(firstActive.status())
                .isEqualTo(AuctionSessionStatus.ACTIVE);

        assertThat(secondActive.status())
                .isEqualTo(AuctionSessionStatus.ACTIVE);

        int activeCount =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_sessions
                        WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
                          AND owner_username IN ('owner-a', 'owner-b')
                        """)
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(activeCount)
                .isEqualTo(2);
    }

    @Test
    void sameOwnerCannotHaveTwoActiveSessions() {

        var first =
                state.create(
                        new CreateSessionRequest(squadOne),
                        "owner-a"
                );

        var second =
                state.create(
                        new CreateSessionRequest(squadTwo),
                        "owner-a"
                );

        state.activate(first.id());

        assertThatThrownBy(
                () -> state.activate(second.id())
        )
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "sessione ACTIVE"
                );

        /*
         * Non eseguire altre query qui:
         * PostgreSQL invalida la transazione corrente dopo
         * la violazione del unique constraint.
         *
         * Il vincolo DB Ã¨ precisamente ciÃ² che questo test
         * vuole certificare.
         */
    }

    @Test
    void sameSquadCannotHaveTwoActiveSessionsEvenWithDifferentOwners() {

        var first =
                state.create(
                        new CreateSessionRequest(squadThree),
                        "owner-a"
                );

        var second =
                state.create(
                        new CreateSessionRequest(squadThree),
                        "owner-b"
                );

        state.activate(first.id());

        assertThatThrownBy(
                () -> state.activate(second.id())
        )
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "sessione ACTIVE"
                );

        /*
         * Anche qui nessuna query successiva al constraint
         * violation nella stessa transazione PostgreSQL.
         */
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.CreateSessionRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.PurchaseRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class AuctionStateLifecycleIntegrationTest {
    @Autowired AuctionStateService state;
    @Autowired AuctionPurchaseService purchases;
    @Autowired JdbcClient jdbc;
    Long sandboxSquad;

    @BeforeEach void fixture(){B59TestFixture.addFantacalcioRoles(jdbc);sandboxSquad=B59TestFixture.createSquad(jdbc);}

    @Test
    void createsInitializesOnlyEligiblePlayersAndCompletesWithoutHistoryLoss(){
        var created=state.create(new CreateSessionRequest(squadId()));
        assertThat(created.status()).isEqualTo(AuctionSessionStatus.DRAFT);
        assertThat(created.season()).isEqualTo("2026/2027");
        assertThatThrownBy(()->purchases.purchase(created.id(),new PurchaseRequest(
                eligibleNotOwned(),AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,null,"draft-key")))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);

        var active=state.activate(created.id());
        var snapshot=state.state(created.id());
        assertThat(active.status()).isEqualTo(AuctionSessionStatus.ACTIVE);
        assertThat(snapshot.availabilityComplete()).isTrue();
        assertThat(snapshot.players()).isNotEmpty().allSatisfy(player->
                assertThat(isEligible(player.playerId(),active.season())).isTrue());
        assertThat(snapshot.players()).extracting(AuctionStateDtos.PlayerStateResponse::playerId)
                .doesNotHaveDuplicates();

        var completed=state.complete(created.id());
        assertThat(completed.status()).isEqualTo(AuctionSessionStatus.COMPLETED);
        assertThat(state.state(created.id()).players()).hasSameSizeAs(snapshot.players());
        assertThatThrownBy(()->purchases.purchase(created.id(),new PurchaseRequest(
                eligibleNotOwned(),AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,null,"completed-key")))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void initializationExcludesActiveRegistrationAtNonMemberClub(){
        Long excluded=eligibleNotOwned();
        jdbc.sql("""
                DELETE FROM season_clubs membership
                USING seasons season, player_registrations registration
                WHERE season.code='2026/2027' AND membership.season_id=season.id
                  AND registration.player_id=:player AND registration.season_id=season.id
                  AND membership.club_id=registration.club_id
                """).param("player",excluded).update();

        var session=activated();

        assertThat(state.state(session.id()).players())
                .extracting(AuctionStateDtos.PlayerStateResponse::playerId)
                .doesNotContain(excluded);
    }

    @Test
    void otherPurchaseIsIdempotentAndNeverChangesUserBudgetOrRoster(){
        var session=activated();
        Long player=availablePlayer(session.id(),null);
        var before=state.state(session.id());
        var request=new PurchaseRequest(player,AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,null,"other-idempotent");
        var first=purchases.purchase(session.id(),request);
        var retry=purchases.purchase(session.id(),request);
        var after=state.state(session.id());
        assertThat(retry).isEqualTo(first);
        assertThat(after.remainingBudget()).isEqualTo(before.remainingBudget());
        assertThat(after.spentBudget()).isEqualTo(before.spentBudget());
        assertThat(after.purchases()).hasSize(1);
        assertThat(after.players()).filteredOn(p->p.playerId().equals(player)).singleElement()
                .extracting(AuctionStateDtos.PlayerStateResponse::availability)
                .isEqualTo(AuctionPlayerAvailability.ACQUIRED_BY_OTHER);
        assertThatThrownBy(()->purchases.purchase(session.id(),new PurchaseRequest(
                player,AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,2,"other-idempotent")))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class).hasMessageContaining("payload diverso");
    }

    @Test
    void userPurchaseUpdatesAuthoritativeRosterExactlyOnceAndPreservesReserve(){
        var session=activated();
        Long player=availablePlayer(session.id(),"role-open");
        int before=state.state(session.id()).remainingBudget();
        var request=new PurchaseRequest(player,AuctionBuyerType.USER,1,"user-idempotent");
        var first=purchases.purchase(session.id(),request);
        var retry=purchases.purchase(session.id(),request);
        var after=state.state(session.id());
        assertThat(retry.id()).isEqualTo(first.id());
        assertThat(after.remainingBudget()).isEqualTo(before-1);
        assertThat(jdbc.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fantasy_squad_players WHERE squad_id=:s AND player_id=:p")
                .param("s",session.squadId()).param("p",player).query(Integer.class).single()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(after.purchases()).hasSize(1);
        assertThat(after.players()).filteredOn(p->p.playerId().equals(player)).singleElement()
                .extracting(AuctionStateDtos.PlayerStateResponse::availability)
                .isEqualTo(AuctionPlayerAvailability.ACQUIRED_BY_USER);
    }

    @Test
    void duplicatePlayerPurchaseConflictsAndDoesNotPartiallyMutate(){
        var session=activated(); Long player=availablePlayer(session.id(),null);
        purchases.purchase(session.id(),new PurchaseRequest(player,AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,3,"winner"));
        assertThatThrownBy(()->purchases.purchase(session.id(),new PurchaseRequest(
                player,AuctionBuyerType.USER,1,"loser"))).isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
        assertThat(state.state(session.id()).purchases()).hasSize(1);
        assertThat(jdbc.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fantasy_squad_players WHERE squad_id=:s AND player_id=:p")
                .param("s",session.squadId()).param("p",player).query(Integer.class).single()).isZero();
    }

    @Test
    void unsafeUserPurchaseRollsBackPurchaseRosterAndAvailability(){
        var session=activated();Long player=availablePlayer(session.id(),"role-open");
        assertThatThrownBy(()->purchases.purchase(session.id(),new PurchaseRequest(
                player,AuctionBuyerType.USER,session.totalBudget()+1,"unsafe")))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
        assertThat(state.state(session.id()).purchases()).isEmpty();
        assertThat(jdbc.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fantasy_squad_players WHERE squad_id=:s AND player_id=:p")
                .param("s",session.squadId()).param("p",player).query(Integer.class).single()).isZero();
        assertThat(state.state(session.id()).players()).filteredOn(p->p.playerId().equals(player)).singleElement()
                .extracting(AuctionStateDtos.PlayerStateResponse::availability)
                .isEqualTo(AuctionPlayerAvailability.AVAILABLE);
    }

    @Test
    void purchaseRecheckRejectsPlayerWhoseClubLeavesSeasonAfterInitialization(){
        var session=activated();Long player=availablePlayer(session.id(),null);
        jdbc.sql("""
                DELETE FROM season_clubs membership
                USING auction_sessions auction, player_registrations registration
                WHERE auction.id=:session AND membership.season_id=auction.season_id
                  AND registration.player_id=:player AND registration.season_id=auction.season_id
                  AND membership.club_id=registration.club_id
                """).param("session",session.id()).param("player",player).update();

        assertThatThrownBy(()->purchases.purchase(session.id(),new PurchaseRequest(
                player,AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,null,"membership-removed")))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
        assertThat(state.state(session.id()).purchases()).isEmpty();
        assertThat(state.state(session.id()).players()).filteredOn(p->p.playerId().equals(player)).singleElement()
                .extracting(AuctionStateDtos.PlayerStateResponse::availability)
                .isEqualTo(AuctionPlayerAvailability.AVAILABLE);
    }

    private AuctionStateDtos.SessionResponse activated(){var created=state.create(new CreateSessionRequest(squadId()));return state.activate(created.id());}
    private Long squadId(){return sandboxSquad;}
    private Long eligibleNotOwned(){return jdbc.sql("""
            SELECT p.id FROM players p JOIN player_registrations r ON r.player_id=p.id
            JOIN seasons s ON s.id=r.season_id AND s.code='2026/2027'
            JOIN season_clubs sc ON sc.season_id=s.id AND sc.club_id=r.club_id
            JOIN player_roles pr ON pr.player_id=p.id AND pr.season_id=s.id AND pr.source='FANTACALCIO'
            WHERE p.active=TRUE AND r.registration_status='ACTIVE'
            ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 1
            """).query(Long.class).single();}
    private Long availablePlayer(Long session,String mode){return jdbc.sql("""
            SELECT state.player_id FROM auction_player_states state
            JOIN auction_sessions auction ON auction.id=state.session_id
            JOIN fantasy_squads squad ON squad.id=auction.squad_id
            JOIN league_configurations league ON league.id=squad.league_configuration_id
            WHERE state.session_id=:session AND state.availability='AVAILABLE'
              AND (:open=FALSE OR
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fantasy_squad_players f WHERE f.squad_id=squad.id
                 AND f.fantasy_role=state.fantasy_role) < CASE state.fantasy_role
                 WHEN 'P' THEN league.goalkeepers_count WHEN 'D' THEN league.defenders_count
                 WHEN 'C' THEN league.midfielders_count ELSE league.forwards_count END)
            ORDER BY state.player_id LIMIT 1
            """).param("session",session).param("open",mode!=null).query(Long.class).single();}
    private boolean isEligible(Long player,String season){return jdbc.sql("""
            SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM players p JOIN player_registrations r ON r.player_id=p.id
            JOIN seasons s ON s.id=r.season_id
            JOIN season_clubs sc ON sc.season_id=s.id AND sc.club_id=r.club_id
            JOIN player_roles pr ON pr.player_id=p.id AND pr.season_id=s.id AND pr.source='FANTACALCIO'
            WHERE p.id=:p AND s.code=:s AND p.active=TRUE
              AND r.registration_status='ACTIVE' AND pr.fantasy_role IN ('P','D','C','A'))
            """).param("p",player).param("s",season).query(Boolean.class).single();}
}

import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;

                JOIN season_clubs season_club ON season_club.season_id=internal.season_id
                     AND season_club.club_id=registration.club_id

                WHERE internal.source='INTERNAL'

                  AND internal.player_id IN (:ids)
                ON CONFLICT(player_id,season_id,source) DO NOTHING
                """).param("ids",missing).update();

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstrategy;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyBoolean;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyInt;
