--- FILE: backend\src\test\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\config\UserBootstrapProvisioningIntegrationTest.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.config;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.DefaultApplicationArguments;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;

@SpringBootTest
class UserBootstrapProvisioningIntegrationTest {

    @Autowired JdbcClient jdbc;
    @Autowired PasswordEncoder encoder;
    @Autowired UserProvisioningService provisioning;

    @BeforeEach
    void cleanup() {
        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM app_users WHERE username LIKE 'corrective-%'").update();
    }

    @Test
    void bootstrapDoesNotOverwritePasswordAndFailsOnRoleMismatch() {
        SecurityUserBootstrap first = new SecurityUserBootstrap(jdbc, encoder,
                "corrective-admin", "initial-admin-password", "corrective-user", "initial-user-password");
        first.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments());
        String hash = hash("corrective-user");

        SecurityUserBootstrap retry = new SecurityUserBootstrap(jdbc, encoder,
                "corrective-admin", "changed-admin-password", "corrective-user", "changed-user-password");
        retry.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments());
        assertThat(hash("corrective-user")).isEqualTo(hash);
        assertThat(encoder.matches("initial-user-password", hash)).isTrue();

        jdbc.sql("UPDATE app_users SET role='ADMIN' WHERE username='corrective-user'").update();
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> retry.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments()))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalStateException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("Ruolo bootstrap incoerente");
    }

    @Test
    void provisioningHashesPasswordAndRejectsCaseInsensitiveUsernameOrEmail() {
        provisioning.create(new ProvisionUserRequest("corrective-alpha", "alpha@example.test",
                "a-secure-password", "USER", true));
        assertThat(encoder.matches("a-secure-password", hash("corrective-alpha"))).isTrue();

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> provisioning.create(new ProvisionUserRequest(
                "CORRECTIVE-ALPHA", "other@example.test", "another-password", "USER", true)))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> provisioning.create(new ProvisionUserRequest(
                "corrective-beta", "ALPHA@example.test", "another-password", "USER", true)))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
    }

    private String hash(String username) {
        return jdbc.sql("SELECT password_hash FROM app_users WHERE username=:username")
                .param("username", username).query(String.class).single();
    }
}

    private TestContext createOfficialPlayer(
            String displayName,
            String normalizedName
    ) {
        Long targetSeasonId =
                findSeasonId("2026/2027");

        Long olderSeasonId =
                findSeasonId("2024/2025");

        Long latestSeasonId =
                findSeasonId("2025/2026");

        Long clubId =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM clubs
                        ORDER BY id
                        LIMIT 1
                        """)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        Long playerId =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO players (
                            last_name,
                            display_name,
                            normalized_name,
                            active
                        )
                        VALUES (
                            :displayName,
                            :displayName,
                            :normalizedName,
                            TRUE
                        )
                        RETURNING id
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "displayName",
                                displayName
                        )
                        .param(
                                "normalizedName",
                                normalizedName
                        )
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_registrations (
                    player_id,
                    club_id,
                    season_id,
                    registration_status
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :clubId,
                    :seasonId,
                    'ACTIVE'
                )
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("clubId", clubId)
                .param("seasonId", targetSeasonId)
                .update();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_reconciliation_results (
                    season_id,
                    player_id,
                    normalized_name,
                    normalized_club_name,
                    sources_count
                )
                VALUES (
                    :seasonId,
                    :playerId,
                    :normalizedName,
                    'development test club',
                    3
                )
                """)
                .param("seasonId", targetSeasonId)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param(
                        "normalizedName",
                        normalizedName
                )
                .update();

        return new TestContext(
                playerId,
                clubId,
                olderSeasonId,
                latestSeasonId
        );
    }

    private void createStatistics(
            Long playerId,
            Long clubId,
            Long seasonId,
            int appearances,
            int starts,
            int minutesPlayed,
            String fantasyAverage,
            int goals,
            int assists,
            String expectedGoals,
            String expectedAssists
    ) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_season_statistics (
                    player_id,
                    club_id,
                    season_id,
                    source,
                    appearances,
                    starts,
                    minutes_played,
                    fantasy_average,
                    goals,
                    assists,
                    expected_goals,
                    expected_assists
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :clubId,
                    :seasonId,
                    'FANTACALCIO',
                    :appearances,
                    :starts,
                    :minutesPlayed,
                    :fantasyAverage,
                    :goals,
                    :assists,
                    :expectedGoals,
                    :expectedAssists
                )
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("clubId", clubId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("appearances", appearances)
                .param("starts", starts)
                .param(
                        "minutesPlayed",
                        minutesPlayed
                )
                .param(
                        "fantasyAverage",
                        new BigDecimal(fantasyAverage)
                )
                .param("goals", goals)
                .param("assists", assists)
                .param(
                        "expectedGoals",
                        new BigDecimal(expectedGoals)
                )
                .param(
                        "expectedAssists",
                        new BigDecimal(expectedAssists)
                )
                .update();
    }

    private Long findSeasonId(String seasonCode) {

                FROM seasons

                """)
                .param("seasonCode", seasonCode)

    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.evaluation;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class PlayerEvaluationGenerationServiceTest {

    @Autowired
    private PlayerEvaluationGenerationService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    @Test
    void shouldGenerateDifferentEvaluationsFromMarketValues() {

        Long seasonId = findSeasonId();
        Long clubId = findClubId();
        addMembership(seasonId, clubId);

        Long premiumPlayerId = createPlayer(
                "Valutazione Test Premium",
                "valutazione test premium"
        );

        Long budgetPlayerId = createPlayer(
                "Valutazione Test Budget",
                "valutazione test budget"
        );

        createRegistration(
                premiumPlayerId,
                clubId,
                seasonId
        );

        createRegistration(
                budgetPlayerId,
                clubId,
                seasonId
        );

        createRole(
                premiumPlayerId,
                seasonId,
                "A"
        );

        createRole(
                budgetPlayerId,
                seasonId,
                "A"
        );

        createReconciliation(
                premiumPlayerId,
                seasonId,
                "valutazione test premium",
                "club test",
                2
        );

        createReconciliation(
                budgetPlayerId,
                seasonId,
                "valutazione test budget",
                "club test",
                2
        );

        createMarketValue(
                premiumPlayerId,
                seasonId,
                new BigDecimal("45"),
                new BigDecimal("320")
        );

        createMarketValue(
                budgetPlayerId,
                seasonId,
                new BigDecimal("5"),
                new BigDecimal("20")
        );

        PlayerEvaluationGenerationResponse response =
                service.generate("2024/2025");

        assertThat(response.status())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(response.generatedEvaluations())
                .isEqualTo(response.eligiblePlayers());

        EvaluationScores premium =
                findEvaluation(premiumPlayerId);

        EvaluationScores budget =
                findEvaluation(budgetPlayerId);

        assertThat(premium.valueScore())
                .isGreaterThan(budget.valueScore());

        assertThat(premium.reliabilityScore())
                .isGreaterThan(
                        budget.reliabilityScore()
                );

        assertThat(premium.riskScore())
                .isLessThan(budget.riskScore());

        assertThat(premium.projectedGoals())
                .isGreaterThan(
                        budget.projectedGoals()
                );

        assertThat(premium.summary())
                .contains(
                        "Valutazione automatica iniziale"
                );
    }

                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->

                                        "reliability_score"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                        "risk_score"
                                ),

                                        "value_score"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getInt(
                                        "projected_goals"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(

                                )
                        )

                .single();

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class B69FixtureMatchupServiceTest {

    @Autowired
    private B69FixtureMatchupService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    private String clubSlug;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {

        Long seasonId =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM seasons
                        WHERE code = '2026/2027'
                        """)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        List<Club> clubs =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            club.id,
                            club.slug

                        FROM clubs club

                        JOIN season_clubs membership
                            ON membership.club_id =
                                club.id

                        WHERE membership.season_id =
                            :seasonId

                          AND club.active = TRUE

                        ORDER BY club.id

                        LIMIT 2
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "seasonId",
                                seasonId
                        )
                        .query(
                                (rs, rowNumber) ->
                                        new Club(
                                                rs.getLong("id"),
                                                rs.getString("slug")
                                        )
                        )
                        .list();

        assertThat(clubs)
                .hasSize(2);

        Club home =
                clubs.get(0);

        Club away =
                clubs.get(1);

        clubSlug =
                home.slug();

        strength(
                seasonId,
                home.id(),
                65,
                70,
                68,
                72,
                61
        );

        strength(
                seasonId,
                away.id(),
                58,
                55,
                52,
                63,
                51
        );

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO fixtures (
                    season_id,
                    matchday,
                    home_club_id,
                    away_club_id,
                    status
                )
                VALUES (
                    :seasonId,
                    1,
                    :home,
                    :away,
                    'SCHEDULED'
                )

                ON CONFLICT (
                    season_id,
                    matchday,
                    home_club_id,
                    away_club_id
                )

                DO UPDATE SET
                    status = 'SCHEDULED'
                """)
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .param(
                        "home",
                        home.id()
                )
                .param(
                        "away",
                        away.id()
                )
                .update();
    }

    @Test
    void returnsRoleAwareFixtureForEveryFantasyRole() {

        List<B69FixtureMatchupResponse> result =
                service.findClubMatchups(
                        "2026/2027",
                        clubSlug,
                        1,
                        1
                );

        assertThat(result)
                .hasSize(1);

        B69FixtureMatchupResponse fixture =
                result.getFirst();

        assertThat(fixture.home())
                .isTrue();

        assertThat(fixture.roles())
                .extracting(
                        B69RoleDifficultyResponse::role
                )
                .containsExactly(
                        "P",
                        "D",
                        "C",
                        "A"
                );

        assertThat(fixture.roles())
                .allSatisfy(role -> {

                    assertThat(
                            role.difficultyScore()
                    ).isNotNull();

                    assertThat(
                            role.difficultyLevel()
                    )
                            .isIn(
                                    "FACILE",
                                    "MEDIA",
                                    "DIFFICILE"
                            );

                    assertThat(
                            role.evidenceCoverage()
                    )
                            .isEqualByComparingTo(
                                    "100.00"
                            );

                    assertThat(
                            role.evidenceTier()
                    )
                            .isEqualTo(
                                    "HIGH"
                            );
                });
    }

    @Test
    void acceptsClubNameAsWellAsSlug() {

        String name =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT name
                        FROM clubs
                        WHERE slug = :slug
                        """)
                        .param(

                                clubSlug

                        1
                )
        )

                        it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException.class
                );
    }

    @Test
    void moreThanTenMatchdaysAreRejected() {

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.findClubMatchups(
                        "2026/2027",
                        clubSlug,
                        1,
                        11
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        IllegalArgumentException.class
                )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "cannot exceed 10"
                );
    }

    private void strength(
            Long seasonId,
            Long clubId,
            int overall,
            int attack,
            int defense,
            int home,
            int away
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO club_strength_ratings (
                    club_id,
                    season_id,
                    overall_rating,
                    attacking_rating,
                    defensive_rating,
                    home_rating,
                    away_rating
                )
                VALUES (
                    :clubId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :overall,
                    :attack,
                    :defense,
                    :home,
                    :away
                )

                ON CONFLICT (
                    club_id,
                    season_id
                )

                DO UPDATE SET
                    overall_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.overall_rating,

                    attacking_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.attacking_rating,

                    defensive_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.defensive_rating,

                    home_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.home_rating,

                    away_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.away_rating
                """)
                .param("clubId", clubId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("overall", overall)
                .param("attack", attack)
                .param("defense", defense)
                .param("home", home)
                .param("away", away)
                .update();
    }

            Long id,
            String slug
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture.importer;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.mock.web.MockMultipartFile;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class FixtureImportServiceTest {

    @Autowired
    private FixtureImportService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    @Test
    void shouldImportValidFixtureAndRejectUnknownClub() {
        String csv = """
                matchday,home_club,away_club,kickoff_at,status,home_goals,away_goals
                10,Inter,Napoli,2026-10-31T20:45:00+01:00,SCHEDULED,,
                11,Inter,Club Inesistente,2026-11-07T20:45:00+01:00,SCHEDULED,,
                """;

        MockMultipartFile file =
                new MockMultipartFile(
                        "file",
                        "fixtures-test.csv",
                        "text/csv",
                        csv.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                );

        FixtureImportResponse response =
                service.importCsv(
                        "LEGA_SERIE_A",
                        "2026/2027",
                        file
                );

        assertThat(response.status())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(response.totalRows())
                .isEqualTo(2);

        assertThat(response.validRows())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(response.invalidRows())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(response.importedFixtures())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        Integer importedFixtureCount =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM fixtures fixture

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = fixture.season_id

                        JOIN clubs home_club
                            ON home_club.id =
                                fixture.home_club_id

                        JOIN clubs away_club
                            ON away_club.id =
                                fixture.away_club_id

                        WHERE season.code = '2026/2027'
                          AND fixture.matchday = 10
                          AND home_club.slug = 'inter'
                          AND away_club.slug = 'napoli'
                        """)
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(importedFixtureCount)
                .isEqualTo(1);

        Integer invalidRowCount =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM fixture_import_rows
                        WHERE batch_id = :batchId
                          AND valid = FALSE
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "batchId",
                                response.batchId()
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(invalidRowCount)
                .isEqualTo(1);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectGloballyExistingClubOutsideRequestedSeason() {
        Long seasonId = jdbcClient.sql("SELECT id FROM seasons WHERE code='2026/2027'")
                .query(Long.class).single();
        Long napoliId = jdbcClient.sql("SELECT id FROM clubs WHERE slug='napoli'")
                .query(Long.class).single();
        jdbcClient.sql("DELETE FROM season_clubs WHERE season_id=:season AND club_id=:club")
                .param("season", seasonId).param("club", napoliId).update();

        MockMultipartFile file = new MockMultipartFile("file", "season-membership.csv", "text/csv", """
                matchday,home_club,away_club
                12,Inter,Napoli
                """.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));

        FixtureImportResponse response = service.importCsv("LEGA_SERIE_A", "2026/2027", file);

        assertThat(response.validRows()).isZero();
        assertThat(response.invalidRows()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(response.importedFixtures()).isZero();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture.strength;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class ClubStrengthGenerationServiceTest {

    @Autowired
    private ClubStrengthGenerationService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    @Test
    void shouldGenerateDifferentRatingsFromPlayerQuality() {

        Long seasonId = findSeasonId();

        List<Long> clubIds = findTwoClubIds();

        clubIds.forEach(clubId -> jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO season_clubs(season_id,club_id) VALUES(:seasonId,:clubId)
                ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
                """).param("seasonId",seasonId).param("clubId",clubId).update());

        Long strongClubId = clubIds.get(0);
        Long weakClubId = clubIds.get(1);

        createEligiblePlayer(
                seasonId,
                strongClubId,
                "Rating Test Strong Attacker",
                "rating test strong attacker",
                "A",
                new BigDecimal("95"),
                new BigDecimal("96"),
                new BigDecimal("10"),
                new BigDecimal("94"),
                16,
                8,
                32
        );

        createEligiblePlayer(
                seasonId,
                strongClubId,
                "Rating Test Strong Goalkeeper",
                "rating test strong goalkeeper",
                "P",
                new BigDecimal("94"),
                new BigDecimal("90"),
                new BigDecimal("12"),
                new BigDecimal("88"),
                0,
                0,
                34
        );

        createEligiblePlayer(
                seasonId,
                weakClubId,
                "Rating Test Weak Attacker",
                "rating test weak attacker",
                "A",
                new BigDecimal("25"),
                new BigDecimal("28"),
                new BigDecimal("80"),
                new BigDecimal("22"),
                1,
                1,
                8
        );

        createEligiblePlayer(
                seasonId,
                weakClubId,
                "Rating Test Weak Goalkeeper",
                "rating test weak goalkeeper",
                "P",
                new BigDecimal("30"),
                new BigDecimal("24"),
                new BigDecimal("78"),
                new BigDecimal("25"),
                0,
                0,
                7
        );

        ClubStrengthGenerationResponse response =
                service.generate("2024/2025");

        assertThat(response.status())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(response.eligiblePlayers())
                .isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(4);

        assertThat(response.eligibleClubs())
                .isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(2);

        assertThat(response.generatedRatings())
                .isEqualTo(countSeasonClubs(seasonId));

        ClubRating strongRating =
                findRating(strongClubId, seasonId);

        ClubRating weakRating =
                findRating(weakClubId, seasonId);

        assertThat(strongRating.overall())
                .isGreaterThan(weakRating.overall());

        assertThat(strongRating.attack())
                .isGreaterThan(weakRating.attack());

        assertThat(strongRating.defense())
                .isGreaterThan(weakRating.defense());

        assertThat(strongRating.home())
                .isGreaterThan(strongRating.away());
    }

    private Long findSeasonId() {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM seasons
                WHERE code = '2024/2025'
                """)
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private List<Long> findTwoClubIds() {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM clubs
                WHERE active=TRUE
                ORDER BY id
                LIMIT 2
                """)
                .query(Long.class)
                .list();
    }

    private int countSeasonClubs(Long seasonId) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM season_clubs
                WHERE season_id = :seasonId
                """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();
    }

    private void createEligiblePlayer(
            Long seasonId,
            Long clubId,
            String displayName,
            String normalizedName,
            String role,
            BigDecimal reliability,
            BigDecimal potential,
            BigDecimal risk,
            BigDecimal value,
            int goals,
            int assists,
            int starts
    ) {
        Long playerId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO players (
                    last_name,
                    display_name,
                    normalized_name,
                    active
                )
                VALUES (
                    :displayName,
                    :displayName,
                    :normalizedName,
                    TRUE
                )
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param("displayName", displayName)
                .param("normalizedName", normalizedName)
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_registrations (
                    player_id,
                    club_id,
                    season_id,
                    registration_status
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :clubId,
                    :seasonId,
                    'ACTIVE'
                )
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("clubId", clubId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .update();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_roles (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    source,
                    fantasy_role,
                    primary_role
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    'FANTACALCIO',
                    :role,
                    TRUE
                )
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("role", role)
                .update();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_reconciliation_results (
                    season_id,
                    player_id,
                    normalized_name,
                    normalized_club_name,
                    sources_count
                )
                VALUES (
                    :seasonId,
                    :playerId,
                    :normalizedName,
                    'rating test club',
                    3
                )
                """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("normalizedName", normalizedName)
                .update();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_evaluations (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    projected_fantasy_average,
                    projected_appearances,
                    projected_starts,
                    projected_goals,
                    projected_assists,
                    reliability_score,
                    potential_score,
                    risk_score,
                    value_score,
                    evaluation_summary
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    6.00,
                    36,
                    :starts,
                    :goals,
                    :assists,
                    :reliability,
                    :potential,
                    :risk,
                    :value,
                    'Test generazione rating squadra'
                )
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("starts", starts)
                .param("goals", goals)
                .param("assists", assists)
                .param("reliability", reliability)
                .param("potential", potential)
                .param("risk", risk)
                .param("value", value)
                .update();
    }

    private ClubRating findRating(
            Long clubId,
            Long seasonId
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    overall_rating,
                    attacking_rating,
                    defensive_rating,
                    home_rating,
                    away_rating
                FROM club_strength_ratings
                WHERE club_id = :clubId
                  AND season_id = :seasonId
                """)
                .param("clubId", clubId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        new ClubRating(
                                resultSet.getInt(
                                        "overall_rating"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getInt(
                                        "attacking_rating"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getInt(
                                        "defensive_rating"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getInt(
                                        "home_rating"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getInt(
                                        "away_rating"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .single();
    }

    private record ClubRating(
            int overall,
            int attack,
            int defense,
            int home,
            int away
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.freshness;

import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.get;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.status;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureMockMvc;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.security.test.context.support.WithMockUser;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@SpringBootTest
@AutoConfigureMockMvc
@Transactional
class DataFreshnessControllerSecurityTest {

    @Autowired
    private MockMvc mockMvc;

    @Test
    void shouldRejectFreshnessWithoutAuthentication()
            throws Exception {

        mockMvc.perform(
                        get(
                                "/api/v1/admin/data-freshness"
                        )
                                .param(
                                        "season",
                                        "2026/2027"
                                )
                )
                .andExpect(
                        status().isUnauthorized()
                );
    }

    @Test
    @WithMockUser(
            username = "standard-user",
            roles = "USER"
    )
    void shouldRejectFreshnessForStandardUser()
            throws Exception {

        mockMvc.perform(
                        get(
                                "/api/v1/admin/data-freshness"
                        )
                                .param(
                                        "season",
                                        "2026/2027"
                                )
                )
                .andExpect(
                        status().isForbidden()
                );
    }

    @Test
    @WithMockUser(
            username = "administrator",
            roles = "ADMIN"
    )
    void shouldAllowFreshnessForAdministrator()
            throws Exception {

        prepareFreshProductionImports();

        mockMvc.perform(
                        get(
                                "/api/v1/admin/data-freshness"
                        )
                                .param(
                                        "season",
                                        "2026/2027"
                                )
                )
                .andExpect(
                        status().isOk()
                );
    }

    private void prepareFreshProductionImports() {
        for (String source :
                new String[]{
                        "FANTACALCIO",
                        "GAZZETTA",
                        "FANTAMARKT"
                }) {

            jdbcClient().sql("""
                    INSERT INTO import_batches (
                        source,
                        season_id,
                        original_filename,
                        status,
                        total_rows,
                        valid_rows,
                        invalid_rows,
                        completed_at,
                        source_observed_at
                    )

                    SELECT
                        :source,
                        season.id,
                        :filename,
                        'COMPLETED',
                        1,
                        1,
                        0,
                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

                    FROM seasons season
                    WHERE season.code = '2026/2027'
                    """)
                    .param("source", source)
                    .param(
                            "filename",
                            "security-freshness-"
                                    + source
                                    + ".csv"
                    )
                    .update();
        }
    }

    @Autowired
    private org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    private org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient jdbcClient() {
        return jdbcClient;
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\test\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\freshness\DataFreshnessServiceTest.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.freshness;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class DataFreshnessServiceTest {

    private DataFreshnessService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    private static final Instant FIXED_INSTANT =
            Instant.parse("2026-08-13T12:00:00Z");

    @BeforeEach
    void useFixedUtcClock() {
        service = new DataFreshnessService(
                jdbcClient,
                Clock.fixed(FIXED_INSTANT, ZoneOffset.UTC)
        );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReportFreshSources() {
        prepareFreshProductionImports();

        DataFreshnessResponse response =
                service.evaluate(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(
                response.overallStatus()
        ).isEqualTo("READY");

        assertThat(
                response.sources()
        )
                .extracting(
                        SourceFreshnessResponse::status
                )
                .containsOnly("FRESH");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReportWarningForAgingRequiredSource() {
        prepareFreshProductionImports();

        ageAllSourceBatches(
                "GAZZETTA",
                100
        );

        DataFreshnessResponse response =
                service.evaluate(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(
                response.overallStatus()
        ).isEqualTo("WARNING");

        assertThat(
                statusFor(
                        response,
                        "GAZZETTA"
                )
        ).isEqualTo("AGING");

        assertThat(response.blockers())
                .isEmpty();

        assertThat(response.warnings())
                .contains("GAZZETTA Ã¨ AGING: snapshot di 100 ore");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldBlockStaleRequiredSource() {
        prepareFreshProductionImports();

        ageAllSourceBatches(
                "FANTACALCIO",
                200
        );

        DataFreshnessResponse response =
                service.evaluate(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(
                response.overallStatus()
        ).isEqualTo("BLOCKED");

        assertThat(
                statusFor(
                        response,
                        "FANTACALCIO"
                )
        ).isEqualTo("STALE");

        assertThat(response.blockers())
                .contains("FANTACALCIO Ã¨ STALE: snapshot di 200 ore");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldTruncateOnlyARealSubHourAtTheBoundary() {
        prepareFreshProductionImports();

        setAllSourceBatchesObservedAt(
                "GAZZETTA",
                OffsetDateTime.ofInstant(
                        FIXED_INSTANT.minusSeconds(
                                100L * 60 * 60 - 1
                        ),
                        ZoneOffset.UTC
                )
        );

        DataFreshnessResponse response =
                service.evaluate("2026/2027");

        SourceFreshnessResponse gazzetta =
                response.sources().stream()
                        .filter(source ->
                                "GAZZETTA".equals(source.source())
                        )
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElseThrow();

        assertThat(gazzetta.ageHours()).isEqualTo(99);
        assertThat(gazzetta.status()).isEqualTo("AGING");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldOnlyWarnForStaleOptionalFantamarkt() {
        prepareFreshProductionImports();

        ageAllSourceBatches(
                "FANTAMARKT",
                500
        );

        DataFreshnessResponse response =
                service.evaluate(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(
                response.overallStatus()
        ).isEqualTo("WARNING");

        assertThat(
                statusFor(
                        response,
                        "FANTAMARKT"
                )
        ).isEqualTo("STALE");

        assertThat(response.blockers())
                .isEmpty();
    }

    private String statusFor(
            DataFreshnessResponse response,
            String source
    ) {

        return response.sources()
                .stream()
                .filter(item ->
                        source.equals(
                                item.source()
                        )
                )
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow()
                .status();
    }

    private void prepareFreshProductionImports() {
        createBatch(
                "FANTACALCIO",
                "freshness-fantacalcio.csv"
        );

        createBatch(
                "GAZZETTA",
                "freshness-gazzetta.csv"
        );

        createBatch(
                "FANTAMARKT",
                "freshness-fantamarkt.csv"
        );
    }

    private void createBatch(
            String source,
            String filename
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO import_batches (
                    source,
                    season_id,
                    original_filename,
                    status,
                    total_rows,
                    valid_rows,
                    invalid_rows,
                    completed_at,
                    source_observed_at
                )

                SELECT
                    :source,
                    season.id,
                    :filename,
                    'COMPLETED',
                    1,
                    1,
                    0,
                    :now,
                    :now

                FROM seasons season
                WHERE season.code = '2026/2027'
                """)
                .param("source", source)
                .param("filename", filename)
                .param(
                        "now",
                        OffsetDateTime.ofInstant(
                                FIXED_INSTANT,
                                ZoneOffset.UTC
                        )
                )
                .update();
    }

    private void ageAllSourceBatches(
            String source,
            int hours
    ) {

        setAllSourceBatchesObservedAt(
                source,
                OffsetDateTime.ofInstant(
                        FIXED_INSTANT.minusSeconds(
                                hours * 60L * 60
                        ),
                        ZoneOffset.UTC
                )
        );
    }

    private void setAllSourceBatchesObservedAt(
            String source,
            OffsetDateTime observedAt
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE import_batches batch
                SET
                    source_observed_at = :observedAt,
                    completed_at = :observedAt

                FROM seasons season

                WHERE season.id =
                        batch.season_id

                  AND season.code =
                        '2026/2027'

                  AND batch.source =
                        :source

                  AND batch.status =
                        'COMPLETED'

                  AND LOWER(batch.original_filename)
                        NOT LIKE '%test%'
                """)
                .param("observedAt", observedAt)
                .param("source", source)
                .update();
    }
}

                );

                                """)

                                playerId

                        .query(Integer.class)

        ).isEqualTo(5);

                        .sql("""

                                    nationality_code,
                                    height_cm,
                                    preferred_foot

                        )

                )
        ).isNull();

        ).isNull();

        ).isEqualTo(

    void missingSourceIsReportedBySeparateNonCatalogGate() {

                player(
                        "Identity Missing Test"
                );

                jdbcClient
                        .sql("""
                                INSERT INTO seasons (
                                    code,
                                    start_year,
                                    end_year,
                                    current_season
                                )
                                VALUES (

                                    2111,

                                )
                                RETURNING id
                                """)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        long clubId =
                jdbcClient
                        .sql("""
                                INSERT INTO clubs (
                                    name,
                                    short_name,
                                    slug,
                                    country_code,
                                    active
                                )
                                VALUES (
                                    'Identity Club',
                                    'Identity Club',
                                    'identity-club-2110',
                                    'IT',
                                    TRUE
                                )
                                RETURNING id
                                """)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        jdbcClient
                .sql("""
                        INSERT INTO player_registrations (
                            player_id,
                            club_id,
                            season_id,
                            registration_status
                        )
                        VALUES (
                            :playerId,
                            :clubId,
                            :seasonId,
                            'ACTIVE'
                        )
                        """)
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        playerId
                )
                .param(
                        "clubId",
                        clubId
                )
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .update();

        jdbcClient
                .sql("""
                        INSERT INTO player_reconciliation_results (
                            season_id,
                            player_id,
                            normalized_name,
                            normalized_club_name,
                            sources_count,

                            club_resolution_source
                        )
                        VALUES (

                            :playerId,
                            'identity missing test',
                            'identity club',

                            'EXTERNAL_ID',
                            'FANTACALCIO'
                        )
                        """)
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        playerId
                )
                .update();

        service.importCsv(
                wikidataCsv(
                        playerId,
                        "",
                        "",
                        "",
                        "",
                        "",
                        "",
                        "",
                        "DATA_SOURCE_MISSING",
                        "NONE",
                        ""
                )
        );

        IdentityEnrichmentReadinessResponse response =

        assertThat(

        assertThat(

    }

    private long player(
            String name
    ) {

        return jdbcClient
                .sql("""
                        INSERT INTO players (
                            last_name,
                            display_name,
                            normalized_name,
                            active
                        )
                        VALUES (
                            :name,
                            :name,
                            :normalized,
                            TRUE
                        )
                        RETURNING id
                        """)
                .param(
                        "name",
                        name
                )
                .param(
                        "normalized",
                        name.toLowerCase()
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private int count(
            String table
    ) {
        return jdbcClient
                .sql(
                        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "
                                + table
                )
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();
    }

    private MockMultipartFile wikidataCsv(
            long id,
            String canonical,
            String first,
            String last,
            String birth,
            String nationality,
            String height,
            String foot,
            String status,
            String confidence,
            String qid
    ) {

        String sourceUrl =
                qid.isBlank()
                        ? ""
                        : "https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/"
                                + qid;

        return file(
                header()
                        + row(
                                id,
                                canonical,
                                first,
                                last,
                                birth,
                                nationality,
                                nationality,
                                height,
                                foot,
                                "",
                                status,
                                confidence,
                                "WIKIDATA",
                                qid,
                                sourceUrl
                        )
        );
    }

    private MockMultipartFile transfermarktCsv(
            long playerId,
            String externalId
    ) {

        return file(
                header()
                        + row(
                                playerId,
                                "Mario Example",
                                "Mario",
                                "Example",
                                "1992-03-04",
                                "Italia",
                                "IT",
                                "181",
                                "",
                                externalId,
                                "VERIFIED_COMPLETE",
                                "HIGH",
                                "TRANSFERMARKT",
                                externalId,
                                "https://www.transfermarkt.it/x/profil/spieler/"
                                        + externalId
                        )
        );
    }

    private String header() {
        return """
                player_id,canonical_full_name,first_name,last_name,birth_date,nationality,nationality_code,height_cm,preferred_foot,transfermarkt_player_id,identity_status,confidence,source,source_external_id,source_url,evidence
                """;
    }

    private String row(
            long playerId,
            String canonical,
            String first,
            String last,
            String birth,
            String nationality,
            String nationalityCode,
            String height,
            String foot,
            String transfermarktId,
            String status,
            String confidence,
            String source,
            String sourceExternalId,
            String sourceUrl
    ) {

        return String.join(
                ",",
                Long.toString(
                        playerId
                ),
                canonical,
                first,
                last,
                birth,
                nationality,
                nationalityCode,
                height,
                foot,
                transfermarktId,
                status,
                confidence,
                source,
                sourceExternalId,
                sourceUrl,
                "\"{}\""
        ) + "\n";
    }

    private MockMultipartFile file(
            String content
    ) {
        return new MockMultipartFile(
                "file",
                "identity.csv",
                "text/csv",
                content.getBytes(
                        StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                )
        );
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class NationalityNormalizerTest {

    @Test
    void shouldResolveItalianNationality() {
        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Italia",
                        null,
                        null
                )
        ).isEqualTo("IT");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldResolveBritishVariants() {
        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Inghilterra",
                        null,
                        null
                )
        ).isEqualTo("GB");

        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Scozia",
                        null,
                        null
                )
        ).isEqualTo("GB");

        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "England",
                        null,
                        null
                )
        ).isEqualTo("GB");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldResolveKosovo() {
        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Kosovo",
                        null,
                        null
                )
        ).isEqualTo("XK");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldUsePrimaryNationalityForMultipleValues() {
        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Francia, Guinea-Bissau",
                        null,
                        null
                )
        ).isEqualTo("FR");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldApplyVerifiedVazOverride() {
        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.normalizeNationality(
                        "Frabcia, Guinea Bissau",
                        "1131161"
                )
        ).isEqualTo(
                "Francia, Guinea-Bissau"
        );

        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Frabcia, Guinea Bissau",
                        null,
                        "1131161"
                )
        ).isEqualTo("FR");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldApplyVerifiedPessinaOverride() {
        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.normalizeNationality(
                        "Bologna",
                        "992569"
                )
        ).isEqualTo("Italia");

        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Bologna",
                        null,
                        "992569"
                )
        ).isEqualTo("IT");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldPreferCertifiedMappingOverWrongExplicitCode() {
        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Italia",
                        "FR",
                        null
                )
        ).isEqualTo("IT");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldFallbackToExplicitCodeForUnknownNationality() {
        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Unknown Country",
                        "zz",
                        null
                )
        ).isEqualTo("ZZ");
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatCode;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.time.Duration;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class IdentityAutomationPropertiesTest {

    @Test
    void disabledIsSafeByDefault() {

        assertThatCode(
                new IdentityAutomationProperties()
                        ::validateEnabledConfiguration
        )
                .doesNotThrowAnyException();
    }

    @Test
    void enabledRejectsInvalidBatchLimit() {

        IdentityAutomationProperties properties =
                new IdentityAutomationProperties();

        properties.setEnabled(true);
        properties.setBatchLimit(0);

        assertThatThrownBy(
                properties
                        ::validateEnabledConfiguration
        )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "batch-limit"
                );
    }

    @Test
    void enabledRejectsInvalidRetryDurations() {

        IdentityAutomationProperties properties =
                new IdentityAutomationProperties();

        properties.setEnabled(true);

        properties.setFailedRetry(
                Duration.ZERO
        );

        assertThatThrownBy(
                properties
                        ::validateEnabledConfiguration
        )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "failed-retry"
                );
    }

    @Test
    void validEnabledConfigurationPasses() {

        IdentityAutomationProperties properties =
                new IdentityAutomationProperties();

        properties.setEnabled(true);
        properties.setBatchLimit(10);

        assertThatCode(
                properties
                        ::validateEnabledConfiguration
        )
                .doesNotThrowAnyException();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class TransfermarktCandidateMatcherTest {

        private final TransfermarktCandidateMatcher matcher = new TransfermarktCandidateMatcher();

        @Test
        void exactNameAndClubRequiresProfileVerification() {
                var result = matcher.match(
                                "Mario Rossi",
                                "Atalanta",
                                List.of(
                                                candidate(
                                                                "1",
                                                                "Mario Rossi",
                                                                "Mario Rossi Atalanta BC")));

                assertThat(result.status())
                                .isEqualTo(
                                                "PROFILE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED");

                assertThat(result.score())
                                .isEqualTo(100);
        }

        @Test
        void surnameOnlyFantacalcioNameFindsFullTransfermarktName() {
                var result = matcher.match(
                                "Bellanova",
                                "Atalanta",
                                List.of(
                                                candidate(
                                                                "357992",
                                                                "Raoul Bellanova",
                                                                "Raoul Bellanova Atalanta BC")));

                assertThat(result.status())
                                .isEqualTo(
                                                "PROFILE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED");

                assertThat(result.score())
                                .isEqualTo(75);
        }

        @Test
        void exactNameWithoutClubStillRequiresProfileVerification() {
                var result = matcher.match(
                                "Mario Rossi",
                                "Atalanta",
                                List.of(
                                                candidate(
                                                                "1",
                                                                "Mario Rossi",
                                                                "Mario Rossi Torino FC")));

                assertThat(result.status())
                                .isEqualTo(
                                                "PROFILE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED");

                assertThat(result.score())
                                .isEqualTo(80);
        }

        @Test
        void sameTopScoreRequiresManualReview() {
                var result = matcher.match(
                                "Mario Rossi",
                                "Atalanta",
                                List.of(
                                                candidate(
                                                                "1",
                                                                "Mario Rossi",
                                                                "Mario Rossi Atalanta"),
                                                candidate(
                                                                "2",
                                                                "Mario Rossi",
                                                                "Mario Rossi Atalanta")));

                assertThat(result.status())
                                .isEqualTo(
                                                "REVIEW_REQUIRED");
        }

        @Test
        void unrelatedCandidateDoesNotPassSurnameCompatibility() {
                var result = matcher.match(
                                "Gaetano",
                                "Atalanta",
                                List.of(
                                                candidate(
                                                                "116740",
                                                                "Gaetano Scirea",
                                                                "Gaetano Scirea")));

                /*
                 * Search candidate can still be superficially compatible because
                 * Fantacalcio exposes only "Gaetano". B63.2B never persists this:
                 * the profile/team stage must confirm or reject it.
                 */
                assertThat(result.status())
                                .isEqualTo(
                                                "PROFILE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED");
        }

        @Test
        void accentsAreNormalized() {
                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("Tour\u00E8 E."))
                                .isEqualTo("toure e");
        }

        @Test
        void turkishDotlessIIsNormalized() {
                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("Y\u0131ld\u0131z"))
                                .isEqualTo("yildiz");

                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("Kenan Y\u0131ld\u0131z"))
                                .isEqualTo("kenan yildiz");
        }

        @Test
        void nordicOStrokeIsNormalized() {
                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("\u00D8stig\u00E5rd"))
                                .isEqualTo("ostigard");

                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("Leo \u00D8stig\u00E5rd"))
                                .isEqualTo("leo ostigard");
        }

        @Test
        void hojlundIsNormalizedAcrossAsciiAndNordicSpelling() {
                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("H\u00F8jlund"))
                                .isEqualTo("hojlund");

                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("Rasmus H\u00F8jlund"))
                                .isEqualTo("rasmus hojlund");
        }

        @Test
        void sorensenIsNormalizedAcrossAsciiAndNordicSpelling() {
                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("S\u00F8rensen"))
                                .isEqualTo("sorensen");

                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("Oliver S\u00F8rensen"))
                                .isEqualTo("oliver sorensen");
        }

        @Test
        void latinVariantsRemainSurnameCompatible() {
                assertThat(
                                matcher.surnameCompatible(
                                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher.normalize("Kenan Yildiz"),
                                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher.normalize("Kenan Y\u0131ld\u0131z")))
                                .isTrue();

                assertThat(
                                matcher.surnameCompatible(
                                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher.normalize("Leo Ostigard"),
                                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher.normalize("Leo \u00D8stig\u00E5rd")))
                                .isTrue();

                assertThat(
                                matcher.surnameCompatible(
                                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher.normalize("Rasmus Hojlund"),
                                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher.normalize("Rasmus H\u00F8jlund")))
                                .isTrue();

                assertThat(
                                matcher.surnameCompatible(
                                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher.normalize("Oliver Sorensen"),
                                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher.normalize("Oliver S\u00F8rensen")))
                                .isTrue();
        }

        private TransfermarktCandidate candidate(
                        String id,
                        String name,
                        String context) {
                return new TransfermarktCandidate(
                                id,
                                name,
                                "https://www.transfermarkt.com/x/profil/spieler/"
                                                + id,
                                context);
        }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.time.LocalDate;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.mockito.Mockito;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

class TransfermarktDiscoveryIdentityVerificationTest {

    private final TransfermarktDiscoveryService service =
            new TransfermarktDiscoveryService(
                    Mockito.mock(JdbcClient.class),
                    new TransfermarktDiscoveryProperties(),
                    Mockito.mock(TransfermarktDiscoveryClient.class),
                    new TransfermarktSearchParser(),
                    new TransfermarktProfileParser(),
                    new TransfermarktCandidateMatcher()
            );

    @Test
    void strongIdentitySurvivesTemporarilyDifferentRoster() {
        var verification = service.verifyProfile(
                player(
                        "Pellegrini Lu.",
                        "Lazio",
                        "Luca Pellegrini",
                        LocalDate.of(1999, 3, 7),
                        "346567"
                ),
                candidate("346567", "Luca Pellegrini"),
                profile(
                        "346567",
                        "Luca Pellegrini",
                        LocalDate.of(1999, 3, 7),
                        "Juventus FC"
                )
        );

        assertThat(verification.status())
                .isEqualTo("MATCHED_VERIFIED");

        assertThat(verification.reason())
                .contains("roster Transfermarkt temporalmente diverso");
    }

    @Test
    void strongIdentitySurvivesUnreadableRoster() {
        var verification = service.verifyProfile(
                player(
                        "Pessina Mas.",
                        "Bologna",
                        "Massimo Pessina",
                        LocalDate.of(2007, 12, 25),
                        "992569"
                ),
                candidate("992569", "Massimo Pessina"),
                profile(
                        "992569",
                        "Massimo Pessina",
                        LocalDate.of(2007, 12, 25),
                        null
                )
        );

        assertThat(verification.status())
                .isEqualTo("MATCHED_VERIFIED");
    }

    @Test
    void birthDateMismatchRejectsKnownTransfermarktId() {
        var verification = service.verifyProfile(
                player(
                        "David",
                        "Juventus",
                        "Jonathan David",
                        LocalDate.of(2000, 1, 14),
                        "533738"
                ),
                candidate("533738", "Jonathan David"),
                profile(
                        "533738",
                        "Jonathan David",
                        LocalDate.of(1999, 1, 14),
                        "Juventus FC"
                )
        );

        assertThat(verification.status())
                .isEqualTo("NOT_FOUND");

        assertThat(verification.reason())
                .contains("Data di nascita");
    }

    @Test
    void canonicalNameStillRejectsDifferentPerson() {
        var verification = service.verifyProfile(
                player(
                        "Mendy P.",
                        "Cagliari",
                        "Paul Mendy",
                        LocalDate.of(2007, 1, 13),
                        "1371793"
                ),
                candidate("1371793", "Benjamin Mendy"),
                profile(
                        "1371793",
                        "Benjamin Mendy",
                        LocalDate.of(2007, 1, 13),
                        "Cagliari Calcio"
                )
        );

        assertThat(verification.status())
                .isEqualTo("NOT_FOUND");
    }

    @Test
    void knownIdAndBirthDateAcceptShortTransfermarktProfessionalName() {
        var verification = service.verifyProfile(
                player(
                        "Ederson D.S.",
                        "Atalanta",
                        "Ederson Jose dos Santos Lourenco da Silva",
                        LocalDate.of(1999, 7, 7),
                        "607854"
                ),
                candidate("607854", "Ederson da Silva"),
                profile(
                        "607854",
                        "Ederson da Silva",
                        LocalDate.of(1999, 7, 7),
                        "Atalanta BC"
                )
        );

        assertThat(verification.status())
                .isEqualTo("MATCHED_VERIFIED");
    }

    private TransfermarktDiscoveryService.OperationalPlayer player(
            String displayName,
            String club,
            String canonicalName,
            LocalDate birthDate,
            String transfermarktId
    ) {
        return new TransfermarktDiscoveryService.OperationalPlayer(
                1L,
                displayName,
                club,
                canonicalName,
                birthDate,
                transfermarktId
        );
    }

    private TransfermarktCandidate candidate(
            String id,
            String name
    ) {
        return new TransfermarktCandidate(
                id,
                name,
                "https://www.transfermarkt.com/x/profil/spieler/" + id,
                ""
        );
    }

    private TransfermarktProfile profile(
            String id,
            String name,
            LocalDate birthDate,
            String club
    ) {
        return new TransfermarktProfile(
                id,
                name,
                birthDate,
                "Italy",
                180,
                "RIGHT",
                club,
                "https://www.transfermarkt.com/x/profil/spieler/" + id
        );
    }
}
