package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.mockito.Mockito;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

class TransfermarktDiscoveryNameFallbackTest {

    private TransfermarktDiscoveryService service() {
        return new TransfermarktDiscoveryService(
                Mockito.mock(JdbcClient.class),
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryProperties(),
                Mockito.mock(TransfermarktDiscoveryClient.class),
                new TransfermarktSearchParser(),
                new TransfermarktProfileParser(),
                new TransfermarktCandidateMatcher()
        );
    }

    @Test
    void singleInitialCreatesSurnameFallbackQuery() {
        assertThat(
                service().searchQueries(
                        "Sulemana I."
                )
        ).containsExactly(
                "Sulemana I.",
                "Sulemana"
        );
    }

    @Test
    void compoundInitialSuffixCreatesBaseFallbackQuery() {
        assertThat(
                service().searchQueries(
                        "Ederson D.S."
                )
        ).containsExactly(
                "Ederson D.S.",
                "Ederson"
        );
    }

    @Test
    void ordinarySurnameUsesOnlyOriginalQuery() {
        assertThat(
                service().searchQueries(
                        "Bellanova"
                )
        ).containsExactly(
                "Bellanova"
        );
    }

    @Test
    void firstNameInitialDisambiguatesSameSurname() {
        TransfermarktDiscoveryService service =
                service();

        assertThat(
                service.initialCompatible(
                        "Sulemana I.",
                        "Ibrahim Sulemana"
                )
        ).isTrue();

        assertThat(
                service.initialCompatible(
                        "Sulemana I.",
                        "Kamaldeen Sulemana"
                )
        ).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void compoundSuffixIsNotTreatedAsFirstNameInitial() {
        assertThat(
                service().initialCompatible(
                        "Ederson D.S.",
                        "Ederson JosÃƒÂ© dos Santos LourenÃƒÂ§o da Silva"
                )
        ).isTrue();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatCode;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.time.Duration;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class TransfermarktDiscoveryPropertiesTest {

    @Test
    void disabledConfigurationIsSafeByDefault() {
        assertThatCode(
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryProperties()
                        ::validateEnabledConfiguration
        ).doesNotThrowAnyException();
    }

    @Test
    void enabledConfigurationRequiresQueryPlaceholder() {
        var properties =
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryProperties();

        properties.setEnabled(true);
        properties.setSearchUrlTemplate(
                "https://www.transfermarkt.com/search"
        );

        assertThatThrownBy(
                properties
                        ::validateEnabledConfiguration
        ).hasMessageContaining("{query}");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsInvalidLimits() {
        var properties =
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryProperties();

        properties.setEnabled(true);
        properties.setMaxBytes(0);

        assertThatThrownBy(
                properties
                        ::validateEnabledConfiguration
        ).hasMessageContaining("max-bytes");

        properties.setMaxBytes(100);
        properties.setRequestTimeout(
                Duration.ZERO
        );

        assertThatThrownBy(
                properties
                        ::validateEnabledConfiguration
        ).hasMessageContaining(
                "request-timeout"
        );
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.condition.EnabledIfEnvironmentVariable;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
@EnabledIfEnvironmentVariable(
        named = "B65_TRANSFERMARKT_PERSISTENCE_TEST",
        matches = "true"
)
class TransfermarktProvenancePersistenceServiceTest {

    private static final String TEST_TM_ID = "999999999";

    @Autowired
    private TransfermarktProvenancePersistenceService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbc;

    private Long existingPlayerId;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {

        existingPlayerId =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM players
                        ORDER BY id
                        LIMIT 1
                        """)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        jdbc.sql("""
                DELETE FROM player_identity_provenance
                WHERE player_id = :playerId
                  AND source = 'TRANSFERMARKT'
                  AND source_external_id = :externalId
                """)
                .param("playerId", existingPlayerId)
                .param("externalId", TEST_TM_ID)
                .update();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldPersistOnlyMatchedVerifiedPopulatedFields() {

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery verified =
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery(
                        existingPlayerId,
                        "B65 Test Player",
                        "Roma",
                        "MATCHED_VERIFIED",
                        100,
                        TEST_TM_ID,
                        "B65 Test Player",
                        "https://www.transfermarkt.com/b65-test/profil/spieler/"
                                + TEST_TM_ID,
                        "Roma",
                        LocalDate.of(2000, 1, 2),
                        "Italy",
                        185,
                        "RIGHT",
                        "B65 verified test"
                );

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery notFound =
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery(
                        existingPlayerId,
                        "Ignored Player",
                        "Roma",
                        "NOT_FOUND",
                        100,
                        "888888888",
                        "Ignored Player",
                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        "Must not be persisted"
                );

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse response =
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse(
                        "2026/2027",
                        "Roma",
                        2,
                        1,
                        0,
                        1,
                        0,
                        false,
                        List.of(
                                verified,
                                notFound
                        )
                );

        int persistedFields =
                service.persist(
                        "2026/2027",
                        response
                );

        assertThat(persistedFields)
                .isEqualTo(6);

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            field_name,
                            source,
                            source_external_id,
                            evidence
                        FROM player_identity_provenance
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND source = 'TRANSFERMARKT'
                          AND source_external_id = :externalId
                        ORDER BY field_name
                        """)
                        .param("playerId", existingPlayerId)
                        .param("externalId", TEST_TM_ID)
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        assertThat(rows)
                .hasSize(6);

        assertThat(rows)
                .allSatisfy(row -> {
                    assertThat(row.get("source"))
                            .isEqualTo("TRANSFERMARKT");

                    assertThat(row.get("source_external_id"))
                            .isEqualTo(TEST_TM_ID);
                });

        assertThat(rows)
                .extracting(row -> row.get("field_name"))
                .containsExactlyInAnyOrder(
                        "CANONICAL_FULL_NAME",
                        "BIRTH_DATE",
                        "NATIONALITY",
                        "HEIGHT_CM",
                        "PREFERRED_FOOT",
                        "TRANSFERMARKT_PLAYER_ID"
                );

        Long ignoredRows =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM player_identity_provenance
                        WHERE source = 'TRANSFERMARKT'
                          AND source_external_id = '888888888'
                        """)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(ignoredRows)
                .isZero();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldIgnoreNullFields() {

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery verified =
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery(
                        existingPlayerId,
                        "B65 Test Player",
                        "Roma",
                        "MATCHED_VERIFIED",
                        100,
                        TEST_TM_ID,
                        "B65 Test Player",
                        "https://www.transfermarkt.com/b65-test/profil/spieler/"
                                + TEST_TM_ID,
                        "Roma",
                        LocalDate.of(2000, 1, 2),
                        "Italy",
                        null,
                        null,
                        "B65 null fields test"
                );

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse response =
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse(
                        "2026/2027",
                        "Roma",
                        1,
                        1,
                        0,
                        0,
                        0,
                        false,
                        List.of(verified)
                );

        int persistedFields =
                service.persist(
                        "2026/2027",
                        response
                );

        assertThat(persistedFields)
                .isEqualTo(4);

        List<String> fields =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT field_name
                        FROM player_identity_provenance
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND source = 'TRANSFERMARKT'
                          AND source_external_id = :externalId
                        """)
                        .param("playerId", existingPlayerId)
                        .param("externalId", TEST_TM_ID)
                        .query(String.class)
                        .list();

        assertThat(fields)
                .containsExactlyInAnyOrder(
                        "CANONICAL_FULL_NAME",
                        "BIRTH_DATE",
                        "NATIONALITY",
                        "TRANSFERMARKT_PLAYER_ID"
                );

        assertThat(fields)
                .doesNotContain(
                        "HEIGHT_CM",
                        "PREFERRED_FOOT"
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldBeIdempotentAndRefreshEvidence() {

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery first =
                playerDiscovery(
                        90,
                        "First verification"
                );

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse firstResponse =
                response(first);

        int firstPersist =
                service.persist(
                        "2026/2027",
                        firstResponse
                );

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery second =
                playerDiscovery(
                        100,
                        "Second verification"
                );

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse secondResponse =
                response(second);

        int secondPersist =
                service.persist(
                        "2026/2027",
                        secondResponse
                );

        assertThat(firstPersist)
                .isEqualTo(6);

        assertThat(secondPersist)
                .isEqualTo(6);

        Long count =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM player_identity_provenance
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND source = 'TRANSFERMARKT'
                          AND source_external_id = :externalId
                        """)
                        .param("playerId", existingPlayerId)
                        .param("externalId", TEST_TM_ID)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(count)
                .isEqualTo(6L);

        String evidence =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT evidence::text
                        FROM player_identity_provenance
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND field_name = 'PREFERRED_FOOT'
                          AND source = 'TRANSFERMARKT'
                          AND source_external_id = :externalId
                        """)
                        .param("playerId", existingPlayerId)
                        .param("externalId", TEST_TM_ID)
                        .query(String.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(evidence)
                .contains("Second verification")
                .contains("\"score\": 100");
    }

    private TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery playerDiscovery(
            int score,
            String reason
    ) {
        return new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery(
                existingPlayerId,
                "B65 Test Player",
                "Roma",
                "MATCHED_VERIFIED",
                score,
                TEST_TM_ID,
                "B65 Test Player",
                "https://www.transfermarkt.com/b65-test/profil/spieler/"
                        + TEST_TM_ID,
                "Roma",
                LocalDate.of(2000, 1, 2),
                "Italy",
                185,
                "RIGHT",
                reason
        );
    }

    private TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse response(
            TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery player
    ) {
        return new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse(
                "2026/2027",
                "Roma",
                1,
                1,
                0,
                0,
                0,
                false,
                List.of(player)
        );
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class TransfermarktSearchParserTest {

    private final TransfermarktSearchParser parser =
            new TransfermarktSearchParser();

    @Test
    void extractsPlayerCandidatesAndDeduplicatesIds() {
        String html = """
                <html>
                  <body>
                    <table>
                      <tr>
                        <td>
                          <a title="Mario Rossi"
                             href="/mario-rossi/profil/spieler/123456">
                             Mario Rossi
                          </a>
                        </td>
                        <td>Atalanta BC</td>
                      </tr>
                      <tr>
                        <td>
                          <a href="/mario-rossi/profil/spieler/123456">
                             Mario Rossi
                          </a>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    </table>
                  </body>
                </html>
                """;

        var result =
                parser.parse(
                        html,
                        "https://www.transfermarkt.com/search"
                );

        assertThat(result)
                .hasSize(1);

        assertThat(result.getFirst()
                .transfermarktPlayerId())
                .isEqualTo("123456");

        assertThat(result.getFirst().name())
                .isEqualTo("Mario Rossi");

        assertThat(result.getFirst().url())
                .contains(
                        "/profil/spieler/123456"
                );

        assertThat(result.getFirst().context())
                .contains("Atalanta BC");
    }

    @Test
    void ignoresNonPlayerLinks() {
        String html = """
                <a href="/atalanta/startseite/verein/800">
                    Atalanta
                </a>
                """;

        assertThat(
                parser.parse(
                        html,
                        "https://www.transfermarkt.com/"
                )
        ).isEmpty();
    }
}

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.time.LocalDate;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

class TransfermarktVerifiedIdentityOverrideTest {

    @Test
    void verifiedOverrideSuppliesIdentityWhenProfileIsMissing() {
        String displayName = "Aurelio";
        String club = "Cagliari";
        String season = "2026/2027";

        OverrideIdentity override = new OverrideIdentity(
                season,
                club,
                displayName,
                "Giuseppe Aurelio",
                LocalDate.of(2000, 3, 22),
                "457444");

        String canonicalFullName = null;
        LocalDate birthDate = null;
        String transfermarktPlayerId = null;

        String effectiveCanonicalFullName = canonicalFullName != null
                ? canonicalFullName
                : override.canonicalFullName();

        LocalDate effectiveBirthDate = birthDate != null
                ? birthDate
                : override.birthDate();

        String effectiveTransfermarktPlayerId = transfermarktPlayerId != null
                ? transfermarktPlayerId
                : override.transfermarktPlayerId();

        assertThat(effectiveCanonicalFullName)
                .isEqualTo("Giuseppe Aurelio");

        assertThat(effectiveBirthDate)
                .isEqualTo(LocalDate.of(2000, 3, 22));

        assertThat(effectiveTransfermarktPlayerId)
                .isEqualTo("457444");
    }

    @Test

        OverrideIdentity override = new OverrideIdentity(
                "2026/2027",
                "Cagliari",
                "Aurelio",
                "Giuseppe Aurelio",
                LocalDate.of(2000, 3, 22),

                ? canonicalFullName

                ? birthDate
                : override.birthDate();

                : override.transfermarktPlayerId();

        assertThat(effectiveCanonicalFullName)

                .isEqualTo(LocalDate.of(1999, 1, 1));

        assertThat(effectiveTransfermarktPlayerId)
                .isEqualTo("999999");
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.importer;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

@SpringBootTest
class PlayerImportServiceTest {

    private static final String TEST_FILE_PREFIX =
            "professional-import-test-";

    private PlayerImportService service;

    @Test
    void shouldImportValidAndInvalidRows() {

        MockMultipartFile file =
                csvFile(
                        TEST_FILE_PREFIX
                                + "mixed.csv",
                        """
                        external_id,name,club,role,quotation,fmv
                        TEST-001,Giocatore Valido,Napoli,A,25,40
                        ,Senza Identificativo,Inter,C,10,20
                        TEST-003,Senza Squadra,,D,8,12
                        TEST-004,Ruolo Errato,Roma,X,5,10
                        TEST-005,Numero Errato,Milan,P,abc,-2
                        TEST-001,Duplicato Identificativo,Napoli,A,4,8
                        TEST-007,Giocatore Valido,Napoli,A,6,9
                        TEST-008,Giocatore Valido,Napoli,A,7,10
                        """
                );

        PlayerImportResponse response =
                service.importCsv(
                        "fantacalcio",
                        "2024/2025",
                        file
                );

        assertThat(response.status())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(response.totalRows())
                .isEqualTo(8);

        assertThat(response.validRows())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(response.invalidRows())
                .isEqualTo(7);

        assertThat(response.errorMessage())
                .isNull();

        Map<String, Object> batch =
                findBatch(
                        response.batchId()
                );

        assertThat(batch.get("status"))
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(
                ((Number) batch.get(
                        "total_rows"
                )).intValue()
        ).isEqualTo(8);

        List<Map<String, Object>> invalidRows =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            row_number,
                            validation_error
                        FROM player_import_rows
                        WHERE batch_id = :batchId
                          AND valid = FALSE
                        ORDER BY row_number
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "batchId",
                                response.batchId()
                        )
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        assertThat(invalidRows)
                .hasSize(7);

        assertThat(invalidRows)
                .extracting(row ->
                        String.valueOf(
                                row.get(
                                        "validation_error"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .anyMatch(error ->
                        error.contains(
                                "ID esterno mancante"
                        )
                )
                .anyMatch(error ->
                        error.contains(
                                "Squadra mancante"
                        )
                )
                .anyMatch(error ->
                        error.contains(
                                "Ruolo non valido"
                        )
                )
                .anyMatch(error ->
                        error.contains(
                                "Quotazione non valida"
                        )
                )
                .anyMatch(error ->
                        error.contains(
                                "FMV non puÃ² essere negativa"
                        )
                )
                .anyMatch(error ->
                        error.contains(
                                "ID esterno duplicato"
                        )
                )
                .anyMatch(error ->
                        error.contains(
                                "Giocatore duplicato"
                        )
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldPreserveFailedBatchWhenHeadersAreMissing() {

        String filename =
                TEST_FILE_PREFIX
                        + "missing-headers.csv";

        MockMultipartFile file =
                csvFile(
                        filename,

                        player,team
                        Mario Rossi,Napoli
                        """
                );

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.importCsv(
                        "GAZZETTA",
                        "2024/2025",
                        file
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        BadRequestException.class
                )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "Colonne obbligatorie mancanti"
                );

        Map<String, Object> batch =
                findLatestBatchByFilename(
                        filename
                );

        assertThat(batch.get("status"))
                .isEqualTo("FAILED");

        assertThat(
                String.valueOf(
                        batch.get(
                                "error_message"
                        )
                )
        ).contains(
                "Colonne obbligatorie mancanti"
        );

        assertThat(
                ((Number) batch.get(
                        "total_rows"
                )).intValue()
        ).isZero();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldPreserveFailedBatchForEmptyCsv() {

        String filename =
                TEST_FILE_PREFIX
                        + "empty.csv";

        MockMultipartFile file =
                csvFile(
                        filename,
                        """
                        external_id,name,club,role,quotation,fmv
                        """
                );

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.importCsv(
                        "FANTAMARKT",
                        "2024/2025",
                        file
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        BadRequestException.class
                )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "non contiene righe dati"
                );

        Map<String, Object> batch =
                findLatestBatchByFilename(
                        filename
                );

        assertThat(batch.get("status"))
                .isEqualTo("FAILED");

        assertThat(
                String.valueOf(
                        batch.get(
                                "error_message"
                        )
                )
        ).contains(
                "non contiene righe dati"
        );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectInvalidSourceBeforeCreatingBatch() {

        String filename =
                TEST_FILE_PREFIX
                        + "invalid-source.csv";

        MockMultipartFile file =
                csvFile(
                        filename,
                        """
                        external_id,name,club,role
                        TEST-001,Giocatore Test,Napoli,A
                        """
                );

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.importCsv(
                        "SORGENTE_INESISTENTE",
                        "2024/2025",
                        file
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        BadRequestException.class
                )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "Fonte non valida"
                );

        Integer batches =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
                        FROM import_batches
                        WHERE original_filename =
                            :filename
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "filename",
                                filename
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(batches)
                .isZero();
    }

    private MockMultipartFile csvFile(
            String filename,
            String content
    ) {
        return new MockMultipartFile(
                "file",
                filename,
                "text/csv",
                content.getBytes(
                        StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                )
        );
    }

    private Map<String, Object> findBatch(
            Long batchId
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    id,
                    status,
                    total_rows,
                    valid_rows,
                    invalid_rows,
                    error_message
                FROM import_batches
                WHERE id = :batchId
                """)
                .param(
                        "batchId",
                        batchId
                )
                .query()
                .singleRow();
    }

    private Map<String, Object>
            findLatestBatchByFilename(
                    String filename
            ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    id,
                    status,
                    total_rows,
                    valid_rows,
                    invalid_rows,
                    error_message
                FROM import_batches
                WHERE original_filename =
                    :filename
                ORDER BY id DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param(
                        "filename",
                        filename
                )
                .query()
                .singleRow();
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.importer.admin;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

@SpringBootTest
class ImportBatchAdminServiceTest {

    private static final String TEST_FILENAME =
            "admin-import-history-test.csv";

    @Autowired
    private ImportBatchAdminService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    @AfterEach
    void cleanup() {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                DELETE FROM import_batches
                WHERE original_filename = :filename
                """)
                .param(
                        "filename",
                        TEST_FILENAME
                )
                .update();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldFilterAndReturnImportBatches() {

        Long batchId = createBatch();

        ImportBatchPageResponse response =
                service.findBatches(
                        "fantacalcio",
                        "2024/2025",
                        "completed",
                        0,
                        20
                );

        assertThat(response.content())
                .extracting(
                        ImportBatchSummaryResponse::id
                )
                .contains(batchId);

        ImportBatchSummaryResponse batch =
                response.content()
                        .stream()
                        .filter(item ->
                                item.id().equals(batchId)
                        )
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElseThrow();

        assertThat(batch.source())
                .isEqualTo("FANTACALCIO");

        assertThat(batch.status())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(batch.totalRows())
                .isEqualTo(2);

        assertThat(batch.invalidRows())
                .isEqualTo(1);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReturnBatchDetailAndInvalidRows() {

        Long batchId = createBatch();

        createInvalidRow(batchId);

        ImportBatchDetailResponse response =
                service.findBatch(
                        batchId,
                        0,
                        50
                );

        assertThat(response.batch().id())
                .isEqualTo(batchId);

        assertThat(response.totalInvalidRows())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(response.invalidRows())
                .hasSize(1);

        assertThat(
                response.invalidRows()
                        .getFirst()
                        .validationError()
        ).contains(
                "Ruolo non valido"
        );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectInvalidFiltersAndUnknownBatch() {

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.findBatches(
                        "FONTE_ERRATA",
                        null,
                        null,
                        0,
                        20
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        BadRequestException.class
                )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "Fonte non valida"
                );

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.findBatches(
                        null,
                        null,
                        "STATO_ERRATO",
                        0,
                        20
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        BadRequestException.class
                )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "Stato import non valido"
                );

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.findBatch(
                        Long.MAX_VALUE,
                        0,
                        50
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        ResourceNotFoundException.class
                )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "Batch import non trovato"
                );
    }

    private Long createBatch() {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO import_batches (
                    source,
                    season_id,
                    original_filename,
                    status,
                    total_rows,
                    valid_rows,
                    invalid_rows,
                    reconciled_rows,
                    completed_at
                )
                SELECT
                    'FANTACALCIO',
                    season.id,
                    :filename,
                    'COMPLETED',
                    2,
                    1,
                    1,
                    0,
                    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                FROM seasons season
                WHERE season.code = '2024/2025'
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param(
                        "filename",
                        TEST_FILENAME
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private void createInvalidRow(
            Long batchId
    ) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_import_rows (
                    batch_id,
                    row_number,
                    external_id,
                    external_name,
                    normalized_name,
                    club_name,
                    normalized_club_name,
                    fantasy_role,
                    valid,
                    validation_error,
                    raw_data
                )
                VALUES (
                    :batchId,
                    2,
                    'ADMIN-TEST-002',
                    'Giocatore Non Valido',
                    'giocatore non valido',
                    'Napoli',
                    'napoli',
                    NULL,
                    FALSE,
                    'Ruolo non valido: X',
                    CAST(
                        '{"role":"X"}'
                        AS JSONB
                    )
                )
                """)
                .param(
                        "batchId",
                        batchId
                )
                .update();
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\test\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\ingestion\AutomatedDataUpdateServiceTest.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verifyNoInteractions;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.refresh.DataRefreshService;

class AutomatedDataUpdateServiceTest {

    @Test
    void disabledPreservesRefreshOnly() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = new SourceIngestionProperties();
        SourceIngestionService ingestion = mock(SourceIngestionService.class);
        DataRefreshService refresh = mock(DataRefreshService.class);

        new AutomatedDataUpdateService(properties, ingestion, refresh).run("2026/2027");

        verify(refresh).runScheduled("2026/2027");
        verifyNoInteractions(ingestion);
    }

    @Test
    void requiredFailurePreventsRefresh() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = enabledProperties();
        SourceIngestionService ingestion = mock(SourceIngestionService.class);
        DataRefreshService refresh = mock(DataRefreshService.class);
        when(ingestion.ingestAll("s")).thenReturn(List.of(result("FAILED", true)));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new AutomatedDataUpdateService(
                properties, ingestion, refresh
        ).run("s")).isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);

        verifyNoInteractions(refresh);
    }

    @Test
    void optionalFailureAndUnchangedRequiredAllowRefresh() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = enabledProperties();
        SourceIngestionService ingestion = mock(SourceIngestionService.class);
        DataRefreshService refresh = mock(DataRefreshService.class);
        when(ingestion.ingestAll("s")).thenReturn(List.of(
                result("FAILED", false),
                result("SKIPPED_UNCHANGED", true)
        ));

        new AutomatedDataUpdateService(properties, ingestion, refresh).run("s");

        verify(refresh).runScheduled("s");
    }

    @Test
    void zeroFeedsCannotSilentlyRefresh() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = enabledProperties();
        SourceIngestionService ingestion = mock(SourceIngestionService.class);
        DataRefreshService refresh = mock(DataRefreshService.class);
        when(ingestion.ingestAll("s")).thenThrow(new BadRequestException("Nessun feed"));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new AutomatedDataUpdateService(
                properties, ingestion, refresh
        ).run("s")).isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class);

        verifyNoInteractions(refresh);
    }

    private SourceIngestionProperties enabledProperties() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = new SourceIngestionProperties();
        properties.setEnabled(true);
        return properties;
    }

    private SourceIngestionResponse result(String status, boolean required) {
        return new SourceIngestionResponse(
                1L, "f", "PLAYERS", "FANTACALCIO", "s", status,
                null, null, null, null, null, null, null, required
        );
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;

@SpringBootTest(
        properties = {
                "app.data-refresh.scheduler.enabled=false",
                "app.production-automation.stale-threshold=1s"
        }
)
class AutomationRunServiceIntegrationTest {

    @Autowired
    private AutomationRunService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbc;

    @BeforeEach
    void clean() {

        jdbc.sql("""
                DELETE FROM automation_runs
                """)
                .update();
    }

    @Test
    void completedRunPersistsCompleteExecutionState() {

        long runId =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        service.stage(
                runId,
                "LISTONE"
        );

        service.stage(
                runId,
                "INGESTION"
        );

        service.stage(
                runId,
                "REFRESH"
        );

        service.complete(
                runId,
                101L,
                3,
                202L
        );

        AutomationRunResponse latest =
                service.latest(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(latest.id())
                .isEqualTo(runId);

        assertThat(latest.status())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(latest.stage())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(latest.listoneRunId())
                .isEqualTo(101L);

        assertThat(latest.ingestionRunCount())
                .isEqualTo(3);

        assertThat(latest.refreshRunId())
                .isEqualTo(202L);

        assertThat(latest.completedAt())
                .isNotNull();

        assertThat(latest.errorMessage())
                .isNull();
    }

    @Test
    void databasePreventsConcurrentAutomationForSameSeason() {

        long first =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        ConflictException.class
                );

        service.fail(
                first,
                new IllegalStateException(
                        "test cleanup"
                )
        );
    }

    @Test
    void staleRunIsFailedAndCanBeReplaced() {

        long stale =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        jdbc.sql("""
                UPDATE automation_runs
                SET last_heartbeat_at =
                    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '2 seconds'
                WHERE id = :id
                """)
                .param("id", stale)
                .update();

        long replacement =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(replacement)
                .isNotEqualTo(stale);

        String oldStatus =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT status
                        FROM automation_runs
                        WHERE id = :id
                        """)
                        .param("id", stale)
                        .query(String.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(oldStatus)
                .isEqualTo("FAILED");

        service.fail(
                replacement,
                new IllegalStateException(
                        "test cleanup"
                )
        );
    }

    @Test
    void failureIsPersistedAndSanitized() {

        long runId =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        service.stage(
                runId,
                "LISTONE"
        );

        service.fail(
                runId,
                new IllegalStateException(
                        "https://example.test/feed?api_key=SUPER_SECRET"
                )
        );

        AutomationRunResponse latest =
                service.latest(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(latest.status())
                .isEqualTo("FAILED");

        assertThat(latest.stage())
                .isEqualTo("LISTONE");

        assertThat(latest.completedAt())
                .isNotNull();

        assertThat(latest.errorMessage())
                .doesNotContain(
                        "SUPER_SECRET"
                );
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

@SpringBootTest(
        properties = {
                "app.data-refresh.scheduler.enabled=false",
                "app.source-ingestion.enabled=false",
                "app.fantacalcio-listone.enabled=false",
                "app.production-automation.stale-threshold=2h"
        }
)
class B71AutomationRetryPolicyIntegrationTest {

    @Autowired
    private AutomationRunService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbc;

    @BeforeEach
    void cleanAutomationRuns() {

        jdbc.sql("""
                DELETE FROM automation_runs
                """)
                .update();
    }

    @Test
    void failedExecutionCanBeRetriedAndLeavesNoRunningResidue() {

        long first =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        service.stage(
                first,
                "REFRESH"
        );

        service.fail(
                first,
                new IllegalStateException(
                        "first execution failed"
                )
        );

        String firstStatus =
                status(first);

        assertThat(firstStatus)
                .isEqualTo("FAILED");

        long retry =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(retry)
                .isNotEqualTo(first);

        service.stage(
                retry,
                "REFRESH"
        );

        service.complete(
                retry,
                null,
                0,
                9001L
        );

        AutomationRunResponse latest =
                service.latest(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(latest.id())
                .isEqualTo(retry);

        assertThat(latest.status())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(latest.stage())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(latest.refreshRunId())
                .isEqualTo(9001L);

        assertThat(latest.completedAt())
                .isNotNull();

        assertThat(runningCount())
                .isZero();

        assertThat(totalCount())
                .isEqualTo(2);
    }

    @Test
    void completedHistoryDoesNotPreventLaterExecution() {

        long first =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        service.complete(
                first,
                null,
                0,
                8001L
        );

        long second =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(second)
                .isGreaterThan(first);

        service.complete(
                second,
                null,
                0,
                8002L
        );

        assertThat(runningCount())
                .isZero();

        assertThat(totalCount())
                .isEqualTo(2);
    }

    private String status(
            long id
    ) {

        return jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT status
                FROM automation_runs
                WHERE id = :id
                """)
                .param("id", id)
                .query(String.class)
                .single();
    }

    private int runningCount() {

        return jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM automation_runs
                WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
                """)
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();
    }

    private int totalCount() {

        return jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM automation_runs
                """)
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;

class RemoteCsvClientTest {

    private HttpServer server;
    private SourceIngestionProperties properties;
    private String baseUrl;

    @BeforeEach
    void start() throws Exception {
        server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 0), 0);
        server.start();
        baseUrl = "http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort();
        properties = new SourceIngestionProperties();
        properties.setAllowHttp(true);
        properties.setAllowPrivateHosts(true);
        properties.setMaxBytes(64);
    }

    @AfterEach
    void stop() {
        server.stop(0);
    }

    @Test
    void downloadsValidCsv() {
        route("/ok", 200, "a,b\n1,2\n");
        RemoteCsvClient.FetchResult result = new RemoteCsvClient(properties)
                .fetch(baseUrl + "/ok");
        assertThat(new String(result.bytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)).contains("1,2");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsNon2xx() {
        route("/bad", 503, "no");
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new RemoteCsvClient(properties).fetch(baseUrl + "/bad"))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("503");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsEmpty() {
        route("/empty", 200, "");
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new RemoteCsvClient(properties).fetch(baseUrl + "/empty"))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("vuoto");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsOversize() {
        route("/large", 200, "x".repeat(65));
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new RemoteCsvClient(properties).fetch(baseUrl + "/large"))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("limite");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsObviousHtmlResponse() {
        server.createContext("/html", exchange -> {
            byte[] body = "<html>login</html>".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().add("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8");
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(200, body.length);
            exchange.getResponseBody().write(body);
            exchange.close();
        });
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new RemoteCsvClient(properties).fetch(baseUrl + "/html"))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("HTML");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsInvalidSchemeAndPrivateHostByDefault() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new RemoteCsvClient(properties).fetch("file:///tmp/a"))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class);

        properties.setAllowPrivateHosts(false);
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new RemoteCsvClient(properties).fetch(baseUrl + "/ok"))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("privato");
    }

    @Test
    void redirectTargetIsRevalidated() {
        server.createContext("/redirect", exchange -> {
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().add("Location", "file:///tmp/x");
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(302, -1);
            exchange.close();
        });
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new RemoteCsvClient(properties).fetch(baseUrl + "/redirect"))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class);
    }

    private void route(String path, int status, String content) {
        server.createContext(path, exchange -> {
            byte[] body = content.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(status, body.length);
            exchange.getResponseBody().write(body);
            exchange.close();
        });
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatCode;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class SourceIngestionPropertiesTest {

    @Test
    void disabledConfigurationDoesNotRequireFeeds() {
        assertThatCode(new SourceIngestionProperties()::validateEnabledConfiguration).doesNotThrowAnyException();
    }

    @Test
    void enabledConfigurationRequiresAtLeastOneEnabledFeed() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = enabled();
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration).hasMessageContaining("almeno un feed");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsDuplicateIdsAndMalformedFeed() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = enabled();
        SourceIngestionProperties.Feed first = feed("players");
        SourceIngestionProperties.Feed second = feed(" PLAYERS ");
        properties.setFeeds(List.of(first, second));
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration).hasMessageContaining("duplicato");

        first.setType("UNKNOWN");
        properties.setFeeds(List.of(first));
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration).hasMessageContaining("tipo feed");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsInvalidLimitsAndTimeouts() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = enabled();
        properties.setFeeds(List.of(feed("players")));
        properties.setMaxBytes(0);
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration).hasMessageContaining("max-bytes");
        properties.setMaxBytes(1);
        properties.setMaxRedirects(-1);
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration).hasMessageContaining("max-redirects");
        properties.setMaxRedirects(0);
        properties.setConnectTimeout(Duration.ZERO);
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration).hasMessageContaining("connect-timeout");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsZeroAndNegativeRequestTimeout() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = validEnabled();
        properties.setRequestTimeout(Duration.ZERO);
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration)
                .hasMessageContaining("request-timeout");

        properties.setRequestTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(-1));
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration)
                .hasMessageContaining("request-timeout");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsUnsafeFilename() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = validEnabled();
        properties.getFeeds().getFirst().setFilename("../../feed.csv");
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration)
                .hasMessageContaining("filename");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsMalformedUrlAndUnsupportedScheme() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = validEnabled();
        properties.getFeeds().getFirst().setUrl("https://exa mple.test/feed.csv");
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration)
                .hasMessageContaining("URL feed");

        properties.getFeeds().getFirst().setUrl("ftp://example.test/feed.csv");
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration)
                .hasMessageContaining("schema URL");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsBlankSourceSeasonAndUrl() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = validEnabled();
        SourceIngestionProperties.Feed feed = properties.getFeeds().getFirst();

        feed.setSource(" ");
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration)
                .hasMessageContaining("source");

        feed.setSource("FANTACALCIO");
        feed.setSeason("");
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration)
                .hasMessageContaining("season");

        feed.setSeason("2026/2027");
        feed.setUrl(" ");
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration)
                .hasMessageContaining("url");
    }

    private SourceIngestionProperties enabled() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = new SourceIngestionProperties();
        properties.setEnabled(true);
        return properties;
    }

    private SourceIngestionProperties validEnabled() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = enabled();
        properties.setFeeds(new java.util.ArrayList<>(List.of(feed("players"))));
        return properties;
    }

    private SourceIngestionProperties.Feed feed(String id) {
        SourceIngestionProperties.Feed feed = new SourceIngestionProperties.Feed();
        feed.setId(id);
        feed.setType("PLAYERS");
        feed.setSource("FANTACALCIO");
        feed.setSeason("2026/2027");
        feed.setUrl("https://example.test/feed.csv");
        return feed;
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\test\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\ingestion\SourceIngestionRecoveryConcurrencyTest.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;

@SpringBootTest
class SourceIngestionRecoveryConcurrencyTest {

    @Autowired SourceIngestionService service;
    @Autowired SourceIngestionProperties properties;
    @Autowired JdbcClient jdbc;
    Long seasonId;
    SourceIngestionProperties.Feed feed;

    @BeforeEach
    void setup() {
        seasonId = jdbc.sql("SELECT id FROM seasons WHERE code='2026/2027'").query(Long.class).single();
        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM source_ingestion_runs WHERE feed_id='recovery-feed'").update();
        properties.setAllowHttp(true);
        properties.setAllowPrivateHosts(true);
        properties.setStaleThreshold(Duration.ofSeconds(1));
        feed = new SourceIngestionProperties.Feed();
        feed.setId("recovery-feed"); feed.setType("PLAYERS"); feed.setSource("FANTACALCIO");
        feed.setSeason("2026/2027"); feed.setUrl("http://127.0.0.1/feed.csv");
    }

    @AfterEach
    void removeRuns() {
        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM source_ingestion_runs WHERE feed_id='recovery-feed'").update();
    }

    @Test
    void recentStartedRemainsBlocking() {
        insertStarted("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP");
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.start(feed, seasonId)).isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void staleStartedIsFailedCompletedAndReplaced() {
        Long stale = insertStarted("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '2 seconds'");
        service.start(feed, seasonId);
        assertThat(jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT status='FAILED' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
                       AND error_message='Ingestion interrotta recuperata automaticamente'
                FROM source_ingestion_runs WHERE id=:id
                """).param("id", stale).query(Boolean.class).single()).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentRecoveryLeavesAtMostOneStarted() throws Exception {
        insertStarted("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '2 seconds'");
        CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(2); CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);
        try (var executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2)) {
            var first = executor.submit(() -> attempt(ready, start));
            var second = executor.submit(() -> attempt(ready, start));
            ready.await(); start.countDown(); first.get(); second.get();
        }
        assertThat(jdbc.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source_ingestion_runs WHERE feed_id='recovery-feed' AND status='STARTED'")
                .query(Integer.class).single()).isEqualTo(1);
    }

    private Object attempt(CountDownLatch ready, CountDownLatch start) {
        try { ready.countDown(); start.await(); return service.start(feed, seasonId); }
        catch (Exception exception) { return exception; }
    }

    private Long insertStarted(String expression) {
        return jdbc.sql("""
                INSERT INTO source_ingestion_runs(
                    feed_id,feed_type,source,season_id,sanitized_url,status,started_at
                ) VALUES('recovery-feed','PLAYERS','FANTACALCIO',:season,'http://127.0.0.1/feed.csv','STARTED',%s)
                RETURNING id
                """.formatted(expression)).param("season", seasonId).query(Long.class).single();
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\test\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\ingestion\SourceIngestionSanitizationTest.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class SourceIngestionSanitizationTest {

    @Test
    void redactsBearerAuthorizationHeader() {
        assertThat(safe("Authorization: Bearer SUPER_SECRET"))
                .doesNotContain("Bearer", "SUPER_SECRET")
                .contains("[REDACTED]");
    }

    @Test
    void redactsBasicAuthorizationValue() {
        assertThat(safe("authorization=Basic ABCDEF"))
                .doesNotContain("Basic", "ABCDEF")
                .contains("[REDACTED]");
    }

    @Test
    void redactsPostgresqlJdbcUrl() {
        assertThat(safe("jdbc:postgresql://db-user:db-pass@secret-host:5432/prod"))
                .doesNotContain("db-pass", "secret-host", "jdbc:postgresql")
                .isEqualTo("[REDACTED]");
    }

    @Test
    void stripsHttpUrlUserInfoQueryAndFragment() {
        String sanitized = safe(
                "https://user:pass@example.test/feed.csv?api_key=SUPER_SECRET#frag"
        );
        assertThat(sanitized)
                .isEqualTo("https://example.test/feed.csv")
                .doesNotContain("user", "pass", "SUPER_SECRET", "frag");
    }

    @Test
    void redactsSensitiveKeyValue() {
        assertThat(safe("password=SUPER_SECRET"))
                .isEqualTo("password=[REDACTED]");
    }

    @Test
    void preservesOrdinarySafeMessage() {
        assertThat(safe("Import CSV fallito per struttura non valida"))
                .isEqualTo("Import CSV fallito per struttura non valida");
    }

    private String safe(String message) {
        return SourceIngestionService.safe(new IllegalStateException(message));
    }
}

            """;
        jdbc.sql(insert).update();

                9001L,
                "FANTACALCIO",

    }

    private void feed(String id, String type, String source) {
        SourceIngestionProperties.Feed feed = new SourceIngestionProperties.Feed();
        feed.setId(id);
        feed.setType(type);
        feed.setSource(source);
        feed.setSeason("2026/2027");
        feed.setUrl(
                "http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort() + "/feed.csv"
        );
        feed.setRequired(true);
        feed.setEnabled(true);
        properties.setFeeds(new java.util.ArrayList<>(List.of(feed)));
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.intelligence;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatCode;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verifyNoInteractions;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.catalog.readiness.CatalogReadinessResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.catalog.readiness.CatalogReadinessService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;

class IntelligenceCatalogPolicyTest {
    private final CatalogReadinessService readiness = mock(CatalogReadinessService.class);
    private final IntelligenceCatalogPolicy policy = new IntelligenceCatalogPolicy(readiness);

    @Test
    void blockedCurrentCatalogPreventsPremiumCalculation() {
        CatalogReadinessResponse response = mock(CatalogReadinessResponse.class);
        when(response.status()).thenReturn("BLOCKED");
        when(readiness.evaluateLatest("2026/2027")).thenReturn(response);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> policy.assertReadable("2026/2027", true))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class).hasMessageContaining("BLOCKED");
    }

    @Test
    void readyCurrentCatalogAllowsPremiumCalculation() {
        CatalogReadinessResponse response = mock(CatalogReadinessResponse.class);
        when(response.status()).thenReturn("READY");
        when(readiness.evaluateLatest("2026/2027")).thenReturn(response);

        assertThatCode(() -> policy.assertReadable("2026/2027", true)).doesNotThrowAnyException();
    }

    @Test
    void historicalProfileDoesNotRequireCurrentCatalogGate() {
        assertThatCode(() -> policy.assertReadable("2025/2026", false)).doesNotThrowAnyException();
        verifyNoInteractions(readiness);
    }
}

--- FILE: backend\src\test\java\it\fantacalciointelligence\backend\intelligence\PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculatorTest.java ---
package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.intelligence;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.intelligence.PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculator.CalculatedProfile;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.intelligence.PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculator.SeasonData;

class PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculatorTest {

    private final PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculator calculator = new PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculator();

    @Test
    void calculatesCompleteExplainableDeterministicProfileInRange() {
        SeasonData current = data("2026/2027", "C", 30, 24, 2300, 8, 7, 5, 0, 1, "6.25", "6.90");
        SeasonData previous = data("2025/2026", "C", 32, 20, 2100, 5, 5, 7, 1, 0, "6.10", "6.45");

        CalculatedProfile first = calculator.calculate(current, previous);
        CalculatedProfile second = calculator.calculate(current, previous);

        assertThat(first).isEqualTo(second);
        assertThat(first.completeness()).isEqualByComparingTo("100.00");
        assertThat(first.confidence()).isEqualTo("HIGH");
        assertThat(first.starter().score()).isBetween(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal.valueOf(100));
        assertThat(first.reliability().score()).isBetween(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal.valueOf(100));
        assertThat(first.bonus().components()).containsKeys("goalsPer90", "assistsPer90");
        assertThat(first.bonus().reasons()).isNotEmpty();
        assertThat(first.malus().components()).containsKeys("yellowCardRisk", "redCardRisk", "penaltyMissRisk");
        assertThat(first.trend().score()).isGreaterThan(BigDecimal.valueOf(50));
        assertThat(first.consistency().score()).isNull();
        assertThat(first.consistency().limitations()).singleElement().asString().contains("partita-per-partita");
    }

    @Test
    void missingDataIsUnavailableRatherThanLowScore() {
        SeasonData sparse = data("2026/2027", "A", null, null, null, null, null,
                null, null, null, null, null);
        CalculatedProfile result = calculator.calculate(sparse, null);

        assertThat(result.completeness()).isZero();
        assertThat(result.confidence()).isEqualTo("LOW");
        assertThat(result.starter().score()).isNull();
        assertThat(result.bonus().score()).isNull();
        assertThat(result.trend().score()).isNull();
        assertThat(result.trend().confidence()).isEqualTo("UNAVAILABLE");
    }

    @Test
    void bonusPotentialIsRoleAware() {
        SeasonData defender = data("2026/2027", "D", 30, 30, 2700, 5, 3, 3, 0, 0, null, null);
        SeasonData attacker = data("2026/2027", "A", 30, 30, 2700, 5, 3, 3, 0, 0, null, null);

        assertThat(calculator.calculate(defender, null).bonus().score())
                .isGreaterThan(calculator.calculate(attacker, null).bonus().score());
    }

    @Test
    void zeroMinutesDoesNotDivideByZero() {
        SeasonData data = data("2026/2027", "P", 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, null, null);
        CalculatedProfile result = calculator.calculate(data, null);
        assertThat(result.starter().score()).isNull();
        assertThat(result.bonus().score()).isNull();
        assertThat(result.malus().score()).isNull();
    }

    private SeasonData data(String season, String role, Integer appearances, Integer starts, Integer minutes,
            Integer goals, Integer assists, Integer yellow, Integer red, Integer missed,
            String average, String fantasyAverage) {
        return new SeasonData(season, role, appearances, starts, minutes, goals, assists, yellow, red, missed,
                average == null ? null : new BigDecimal(average),
                fantasyAverage == null ? null : new BigDecimal(fantasyAverage));
    }
}

    @Autowired private PlayerIntelligenceProfileService service;

    @Test
    void fbrefIsPrimaryForObjectivesButNeverForRatingsOrFantasyRole() {
        Long playerId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO players (last_name, display_name, normalized_name, active)
                VALUES ('Policy', 'FBref Policy Test', 'fbref policy test', TRUE) RETURNING id
                """).query(Long.class).single();
        Long seasonId = jdbcClient.sql("SELECT id FROM seasons WHERE code = '2025/2026'")
                .query(Long.class).single();
        Long clubId = jdbcClient.sql("SELECT id FROM clubs ORDER BY id LIMIT 1").query(Long.class).single();
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_roles (player_id, season_id, source, fantasy_role)
                VALUES (:playerId, :seasonId, 'FANTACALCIO', 'D')
                """).param("playerId", playerId).param("seasonId", seasonId).update();
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_season_statistics (
                    player_id, club_id, season_id, source, appearances, starts, minutes_played,
                    goals, assists, yellow_cards, red_cards, penalties_missed,
                    average_rating, fantasy_average)
                VALUES
                    (:playerId, :clubId, :seasonId, 'FANTACALCIO', 20, 10, 1000, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0, 6.20, 6.55),
                    (:playerId, NULL, :seasonId, 'FBREF', 30, 25, 2400, 5, 4, 6, 1, 1, 9.99, 19.99)
                """).param("playerId", playerId).param("clubId", clubId).param("seasonId", seasonId).update();

        SeasonData data = service.loadHistory(playerId, 2025).getFirst();
        assertThat(data.appearances()).isEqualTo(30);
        assertThat(data.starts()).isEqualTo(25);
        assertThat(data.goals()).isEqualTo(5);
        assertThat(data.role()).isEqualTo("D");
        assertThat(data.averageRating()).isEqualByComparingTo(new BigDecimal("6.20"));
        assertThat(data.fantasyAverage()).isEqualByComparingTo(new BigDecimal("6.55"));
    }
}
