                fc,
                "FC-OUT-GAME-002",
                "Out Of Game Player Two",
                "Roma"
        );

        markOutOfGame(
                fc,
                "FC-OUT-GAME-002"
        );

        TransferDetectionResponse first =
                service.detect(
                        fc,
                        null,
                        null
                );

        TransferDetectionResponse second =
                service.detect(
                        fc,
                        null,
                        null
                );

        assertThat(first.detectedSerieAExits())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(first.createdClaims())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(second.detectedSerieAExits())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(second.createdClaims())
                .isZero();

        assertThat(second.existingOpenClaims())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        Integer claims =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM player_transfer_claims
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND to_club_id IS NULL
                          AND verification_status IN (
                              'DETECTED',
                              'PENDING_VERIFICATION'
                          )
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "playerId",
                                playerId
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(claims)
                .isEqualTo(1);
    }

    private Long createPlayer(
            String name,
            String externalId
    ) {

        Long playerId =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO players (
                            last_name,
                            display_name,
                            normalized_name,
                            active
                        )
                        VALUES (
                            :name,
                            :name,
                            :normalizedName,
                            TRUE
                        )
                        RETURNING id
                        """)
                        .param("name", name)
                        .param(
                                "normalizedName",
                                name.toLowerCase()
                        )
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        addMapping(
                playerId,
                "FANTACALCIO",
                externalId,
                name
        );

        return playerId;
    }

    private void addMapping(
            Long playerId,
            String source,
            String externalId,
            String name
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_source_mappings (
                    player_id,
                    source,
                    external_id,
                    external_name,
                    verified
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :source,
                    :externalId,
                    :name,
                    TRUE
                )
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("source", source)
                .param("externalId", externalId)
                .param("name", name)
                .update();
    }


    private void markOutOfGame(
            long batchId,
            String externalId
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE player_import_rows
                SET raw_data =
                    COALESCE(
                        raw_data,
                        '{}'::jsonb
                    )
                    || '{"out_of_game":"true"}'::jsonb
                WHERE batch_id = :batchId
                  AND external_id = :externalId
                """)
                .param(
                        "batchId",
                        batchId
                )
                .param(
                        "externalId",
                        externalId
                )
                .update();
    }
    private void registerPlayer(
            Long playerId,
            String club
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_registrations (
                    player_id,
                    club_id,
                    season_id,
                    registration_status
                )
                SELECT
                    :playerId,
                    club.id,
                    season.id,
                    'ACTIVE'
                FROM clubs club
                CROSS JOIN seasons season
                WHERE club.name = :club
                  AND season.code = '2026/2027'
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("club", club)
                .update();
    }

    private long createBatch(
            String source
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO import_batches (
                    source,
                    season_id,
                    original_filename,
                    status,
                    total_rows,
                    valid_rows,
                    invalid_rows,
                    completed_at,
                    source_observed_at
                )
                SELECT
                    :source,
                    season.id,
                    :filename,
                    'COMPLETED',
                    1,
                    1,
                    0,
                    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                FROM seasons season
                WHERE season.code = '2026/2027'
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param("source", source)
                .param(
                        "filename",
                        "transfer-detection-"
                                + source
                                + ".csv"
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private void insertRow(
            long batchId,
            String externalId,
            String name,
            String club
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_import_rows (
                    batch_id,
                    row_number,
                    external_id,
                    external_name,
                    normalized_name,
                    club_name,
                    normalized_club_name,
                    fantasy_role,
                    valid,
                    raw_data
                )
                VALUES (
                    :batchId,
                    1,
                    :externalId,
                    :name,
                    LOWER(:name),
                    :club,
                    LOWER(:club),
                    'C',
                    TRUE,
                    CAST(:rawData AS JSONB)
                )
                """)
                .param("batchId", batchId)
                .param("externalId", externalId)
                .param("name", name)
                .param("club", club)
                .param(
                        "rawData",
                        """
                        {
                          "transferDetectionTest": true
                        }
                        """
                )
                .update();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.validation;

import static org.springframework.security.test.web.servlet.request.SecurityMockMvcRequestPostProcessors.httpBasic;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.get;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.post;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.content;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.jsonPath;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.status;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.not;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.containsString;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureMockMvc;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;

@SpringBootTest
@AutoConfigureMockMvc
class RequestValidationHttpIntegrationTest {
    @Autowired MockMvc mvc;

    @Test
    void unknownRouteUsesSecurityForAnonymousAndSanitized404ForAuthenticatedUser() throws Exception {
        mvc.perform(get("/api/v1/does-not-exist"))
                .andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());

        mvc.perform(get("/api/v1/does-not-exist")
                .with(httpBasic("user-test", "user-pass")))
                .andExpect(status().isNotFound())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.status").value(404))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.error").value("Not Found"))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.message").value("Risorsa non trovata"))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.path").value("/api/v1/does-not-exist"))
                .andExpect(content().string(not(containsString("stackTrace"))))
                .andExpect(content().string(not(containsString("user-pass"))));
    }

    @Test
    void squadConstructionRejectsRangesBudgetSlotsAndBoughtPlayer() throws Exception {
        mvc.perform(post("/api/v1/auction/squad-strategy/evaluate")
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content("""
                        {"season":"2026/2027","teams":5,"initialBudget":149,
                         "remainingBudget":150,"defenseModifier":false,"currentPhaseRole":"X",
                         "rosterSlots":{"X":-1},
                         "playersAlreadyBought":[{"playerId":0,"role":"X","pricePaid":0}],"limit":10}
                        """))
                .andExpect(status().isBadRequest());
    }

    @Test
    void liveAuctionRejectsPublicLeagueRanges() throws Exception {
        mvc.perform(post("/api/v1/auction/live/decision")
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content("""
                        {"season":"2026/2027","leagueTeams":13,"totalBudget":1001,
                         "remainingBudget":100,"currentRole":"D","currentPlayerId":1,
                         "currentPrice":1,"proposedBid":1,"playersAlreadyBought":[]}
                        """))
                .andExpect(status().isBadRequest());
    }

    @Test
    void transferClaimRejectsNonPositivePlayerAndIncoherentDomesticDestination() throws Exception {
        mvc.perform(post("/api/v1/admin/transfers/claims")
                .with(httpBasic("admin-test", "admin-pass"))
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content("""
                        {"playerId":0,"season":"2026/2027","leavingSerieA":false,
                         "destinationClubName":"Estero","source":"official",
                         "sourceReference":"reference","sourcePublishedAt":"2026-08-14T10:00:00Z",
                         "effectiveAt":"2026-08-14"}
                        """))
                .andExpect(status().isBadRequest());
    }

    @Test
    void transferClaimRejectsTargetClubWhenLeavingSerieA() throws Exception {
        mvc.perform(post("/api/v1/admin/transfers/claims")
                .with(httpBasic("admin-test", "admin-pass"))
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content("""
                        {"playerId":1,"season":"2026/2027","targetClub":"Roma",
                         "leavingSerieA":true,"destinationClubName":"Arsenal","source":"official",
                         "sourceReference":"reference","sourcePublishedAt":"2026-08-14T10:00:00Z",
                         "effectiveAt":"2026-08-14"}
                        """))
                .andExpect(status().isBadRequest());
    }
}

      kind: 'invalid-response',
    });

--- FILE: frontend\src\api\dashboardApi.ts ---
import {
  auctionRankingSchema,
  catalogReadinessSchema,
  clubSchema,
  fixtureSchema,
  playerPageSchema,
  recommendedLineupSchema,
  scoutingArrivalSchema,
  seasonSchema,
  systemStatusSchema,
} from '@/api/contracts/dashboard';
import { httpRequest } from '@/api/client/httpClient';
import { AppError } from '@/api/errors/AppError';
import type { z } from 'zod';

function query(path: string, params: Record<string, string | number | boolean | undefined>) {
  const search = new URLSearchParams();
  Object.entries(params).forEach(([key, value]) => {
    if (value !== undefined) search.set(key, String(value));
  });
  const suffix = search.toString();
  return suffix ? `${path}?${suffix}` : path;
}

async function getValidated<T extends z.ZodType>(
  path: string,
  schema: T,
  getAuthorization?: () => string | undefined,
): Promise<z.infer<T>> {
  const body = await httpRequest<unknown>(path, { getAuthorization });
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(body);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    throw new AppError('Il servizio ha restituito dati non conformi al contratto', {
      kind: 'invalid-response',
    });
  }
  return parsed.data;
}

export const dashboardApi = {
  system: () => getValidated('/system/status', systemStatusSchema),
  seasons: () => getValidated('/seasons', seasonSchema.array()),
  clubs: () => getValidated('/clubs', clubSchema.array()),
  players: (season?: string) =>
    getValidated(query('/players', { season, page: 0, size: 5 }), playerPageSchema),
  auction: (season?: string) =>
    getValidated(
      query('/auction/intelligence-rankings', { season, budget: 500, teams: 8, limit: 5 }),
      auctionRankingSchema,
    ),
  fixtures: (season?: string, matchday = 1) =>
    getValidated(query(`/fixtures/matchday/${matchday}`, { season }), fixtureSchema.array()),
  lineup: (
    season?: string,
    matchday = 1,
    squadId?: number,
    getAuthorization?: () => string | undefined,
  ) =>
    getValidated(
      query('/lineups/recommended', { season, matchday, squadId }),
      recommendedLineupSchema,
      getAuthorization,
    ),
  scouting: (season?: string) =>
    getValidated(query('/scouting/arrivals', { season }), scoutingArrivalSchema.array()),
  squads: (getAuthorization: () => string | undefined) =>
    httpRequest<unknown[]>('/squads', { getAuthorization }),
  readiness: (season: string | undefined, getAuthorization: () => string | undefined) =>
    getValidated(
      query('/admin/catalog/readiness', { season }),
      catalogReadinessSchema,
      getAuthorization,
    ),
};

import { http, HttpResponse } from 'msw';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import { httpRequest } from '@/api/client/httpClient';
import { AppError } from '@/api/errors/AppError';
import { server } from '@/test/server';

describe('httpRequest', () => {
  it('restituisce JSON nelle risposte riuscite', async () => {
    server.use(http.get('/api/v1/example', () => HttpResponse.json({ ready: true })));
    await expect(httpRequest<{ ready: boolean }>('/example')).resolves.toEqual({ ready: true });
  });

  it('mappa ApiErrorResponse preservando i dettagli', async () => {
    server.use(
      http.get('/api/v1/missing', () =>
        HttpResponse.json(
          {
            timestamp: '2026-08-22T10:00:00Z',
            status: 404,
            error: 'Not Found',
            message: 'Giocatore non trovato',
            path: '/api/v1/missing',
          },
          { status: 404 },
        ),
      ),
    );
    const error = await httpRequest('/missing').catch((reason: unknown) => reason);
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(AppError);
    expect(error).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'not-found',
      status: 404,
      message: 'Giocatore non trovato',
    });
  });

  it('gestisce errori non JSON con fallback sicuro', async () => {
    server.use(http.get('/api/v1/forbidden', () => new HttpResponse('Denied', { status: 403 })));
    await expect(httpRequest('/forbidden')).rejects.toMatchObject({
      kind: 'forbidden',
      status: 403,
      message: 'Richiesta HTTP non riuscita (403)',
    });
  });

  it.each([
    [400, 'bad-request'],
    [401, 'unauthorized'],
    [403, 'forbidden'],
    [404, 'not-found'],
    [409, 'conflict'],
    [422, 'unprocessable'],
    [429, 'rate-limit'],
    [500, 'server'],
  ] as const)('mappa lo status %s come %s', async (status, kind) => {
    server.use(http.get('/api/v1/status-case', () => new HttpResponse(null, { status })));
    await expect(httpRequest('/status-case')).rejects.toMatchObject({ kind, status });
  });

  it('invia Authorization dinamico nelle richieste protette', async () => {
    server.use(
      http.get('/api/v1/protected', ({ request }) =>
        HttpResponse.json({ authorization: request.headers.get('authorization') }),
      ),
    );
    await expect(
      httpRequest('/protected', { getAuthorization: () => 'Basic dXNlcjpwYXNz' }),
    ).resolves.toEqual({ authorization: 'Basic dXNlcjpwYXNz' });
  });

  it('supporta body JSON e risposta no-content', async () => {
    server.use(
      http.post('/api/v1/resource', async ({ request }) => {
        expect(await request.json()).toEqual({ name: 'test' });
        return new HttpResponse(null, { status: 204 });
      }),
    );
    await expect(
      httpRequest('/resource', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'test' }),
      }),
    ).resolves.toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('distingue gli errori di rete', async () => {
    server.use(http.get('/api/v1/network', () => HttpResponse.error()));
    await expect(httpRequest('/network')).rejects.toMatchObject({ kind: 'network' });
  });

  it('distingue il timeout', async () => {
    server.use(
      http.get('/api/v1/slow', async () => {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
        return HttpResponse.json({ ready: true });
      }),
    );
    await expect(httpRequest('/slow', { timeoutMs: 5 })).rejects.toMatchObject({ kind: 'timeout' });
  });
});

--- FILE: frontend\src\api\client\httpClient.ts ---
import { apiErrorResponseSchema, type ApiErrorResponse } from '@/api/contracts/apiError';
import { AppError, type AppErrorKind } from '@/api/errors/AppError';
import { environment } from '@/app/bootstrap/env';

const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;
let unauthorizedHandler: (() => void) | undefined;

export function setUnauthorizedHandler(handler: (() => void) | undefined) {
  unauthorizedHandler = handler;
}

export interface HttpRequestOptions extends Omit<RequestInit, 'signal'> {
  timeoutMs?: number;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  getAuthorization?: () => string | undefined;
}

function errorKindForStatus(status: number): AppErrorKind {
  const kinds: Partial<Record<number, AppErrorKind>> = {
    400: 'bad-request',
    401: 'unauthorized',
    403: 'forbidden',
    404: 'not-found',
    409: 'conflict',
    422: 'unprocessable',
    429: 'rate-limit',
  };
  return kinds[status] ?? (status >= 500 ? 'server' : 'http');
}

async function readBody(response: Response): Promise<unknown> {
  if (response.status === 204 || response.headers.get('content-length') === '0') return undefined;
  const text = await response.text();
  if (!text) return undefined;
  if (!response.headers.get('content-type')?.toLowerCase().includes('application/json'))
    return text;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(text) as unknown;
  } catch {
    return text;
  }
}

function toAppError(response: Response, body: unknown): AppError {
  const parsed = apiErrorResponseSchema.safeParse(body);
  const details: ApiErrorResponse | undefined = parsed.success ? parsed.data : undefined;
  const message = details?.message ?? `Richiesta HTTP non riuscita (${response.status})`;
  return new AppError(message, {
    kind: errorKindForStatus(response.status),
    status: response.status,
    details,
  });
}

function isAppError(error: unknown): error is AppError {
  return (
    error instanceof AppError ||
    (typeof error === 'object' && error !== null && 'kind' in error && 'message' in error)
  );
}

export async function httpRequest<T>(
  path: string,
  options: HttpRequestOptions = {},
): Promise<T | undefined> {
  const { timeoutMs = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS, getAuthorization, headers, signal, ...init } = options;
  const timeoutController = new AbortController();
  const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => timeoutController.abort('timeout'), timeoutMs);
  const requestHeaders = new Headers(headers);
  requestHeaders.set('Accept', 'application/json');
  const authorization = getAuthorization?.();
  if (authorization) requestHeaders.set('Authorization', authorization);

  const abortFromCaller = () => timeoutController.abort(signal?.reason);
  signal?.addEventListener('abort', abortFromCaller, { once: true });

  try {
    const response = await fetch(`${environment.VITE_API_BASE_URL}${path}`, {
      ...init,
      headers: requestHeaders,
      signal: timeoutController.signal,
    });
    const body = await readBody(response);
    if (!response.ok) {
      if (response.status === 401) unauthorizedHandler?.();
      throw toAppError(response, body);
    }
    return body as T | undefined;
  } catch (error) {
    if (isAppError(error)) throw error;
    if (timeoutController.signal.aborted) {
      throw new AppError('Richiesta annullata o scaduta', { kind: 'timeout', cause: error });
    }
    throw new AppError('Impossibile raggiungere il servizio', { kind: 'network', cause: error });
  } finally {
    window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abortFromCaller);
  }
}

--- FILE: frontend\src\api\errors\AppError.ts ---
import type { ApiErrorResponse } from '@/api/contracts/apiError';

export type AppErrorKind =
  | 'bad-request'
  | 'unauthorized'
  | 'forbidden'
  | 'not-found'
  | 'conflict'
  | 'unprocessable'
  | 'rate-limit'
  | 'server'
  | 'http'
  | 'network'
  | 'timeout'
  | 'invalid-response';

interface AppErrorOptions {
  kind: AppErrorKind;
  status?: number;
  cause?: unknown;
  details?: ApiErrorResponse;
}

export class AppError extends Error {
  readonly kind: AppErrorKind;
  readonly status?: number;
  readonly details?: ApiErrorResponse;

  constructor(message: string, options: AppErrorOptions) {
    super(message, { cause: options.cause });
    this.name = 'AppError';
    this.kind = options.kind;
    this.status = options.status;
    this.details = options.details;
  }
}

  it('accetta un base path API assoluto', () => {

    });

  it('rifiuta configurazioni mancanti o relative', () => {

  });

    expect(
      parseEnvironment({
        VITE_API_BASE_URL: '/api/v1',
        VITE_FATAL_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT: '   ',
      }),
    ).toEqual({ VITE_API_BASE_URL: '/api/v1', VITE_FATAL_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT: undefined });
  });

--- FILE: frontend\src\app\bootstrap\env.ts ---
import { z } from 'zod';

const environmentSchema = z.object({
  VITE_API_BASE_URL: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, 'VITE_API_BASE_URL obbligatoria')
    .refine(
      (value) => value.startsWith('/') || URL.canParse(value),
      'VITE_API_BASE_URL deve essere un path assoluto o un URL valido',
    ),
  VITE_FATAL_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT: z.preprocess(
    (value) => (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() === '' ? undefined : value),
    z.string().trim().optional(),
  ),
});

export type AppEnvironment = z.infer<typeof environmentSchema>;

export function parseEnvironment(source: Record<string, unknown>): AppEnvironment {
  return environmentSchema.parse(source);
}

/*
 * IMPORTANT:
 * Vite replaces import.meta.env variables statically at build time.
 * Access custom VITE_* variables explicitly so they are included
 * in the production bundle.
 */
export const environment = parseEnvironment({
  VITE_API_BASE_URL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL,
  VITE_FATAL_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT: import.meta.env.VITE_FATAL_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT,
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { AppError } from '@/api/errors/AppError';
import { shouldRetry } from './queryClient';

describe('query retry policy', () => {
  it('non riprova gli errori 4xx', () => {
    expect(shouldRetry(0, new AppError('no', { kind: 'unauthorized', status: 401 }))).toBe(false);
  });
  it('riprova una volta network e 5xx ma non oltre il limite', () => {
    expect(shouldRetry(0, new AppError('offline', { kind: 'network' }))).toBe(true);
    expect(shouldRetry(1, new AppError('server', { kind: 'server', status: 500 }))).toBe(true);
    expect(shouldRetry(2, new AppError('server', { kind: 'server', status: 500 }))).toBe(false);
  });
});

--- FILE: frontend\src\app\providers\queryClient.ts ---
import { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { AppError } from '@/api/errors/AppError';

export function shouldRetry(failureCount: number, error: unknown): boolean {
  if (failureCount >= 2) return false;
  if (!(error instanceof AppError)) return false;
  return error.kind === 'network' || error.kind === 'timeout' || error.kind === 'server';
}

export function createAppQueryClient(): QueryClient {
  return new QueryClient({
    defaultOptions: {
      queries: {
        retry: shouldRetry,
        staleTime: 30_000,
        refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
        refetchOnReconnect: true,
      },
      mutations: { retry: false },
    },
  });
}

import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { act, cleanup, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { http, HttpResponse } from 'msw';
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { AuthProvider } from './AuthProvider';
import { useAuth } from './useAuth';
import { server } from '@/test/server';

function Harness() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  return (
    <div>
      <span data-testid="status">{auth.status}</span>
      <span data-testid="admin">{String(auth.isAdmin)}</span>
      <button onClick={() => void auth.login('utente', 'segreto').catch(() => undefined)}>
        Login
      </button>
      <button onClick={auth.logout}>Logout</button>
    </div>
  );
}

function renderAuth() {
  return render(
    <QueryClientProvider client={new QueryClient()}>
      <AuthProvider>
        <Harness />
      </AuthProvider>
    </QueryClientProvider>,
  );
}

afterEach(cleanup);

describe('AuthContext Basic stateless', () => {
  it('autentica un utente e rileva capability non-admin', async () => {
    server.use(
      http.get('/api/v1/squads', ({ request }) =>
        request.headers.get('authorization')
          ? HttpResponse.json([])
          : new HttpResponse(null, { status: 401 }),
      ),
      http.get('/api/v1/admin/catalog/readiness', () => new HttpResponse(null, { status: 403 })),
    );
    renderAuth();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Login' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('authenticated')).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByTestId('admin')).toHaveTextContent('false');
  });

  it('rileva la capability admin con probe read-only', async () => {
    server.use(
      http.get('/api/v1/squads', () => HttpResponse.json([])),
      http.get('/api/v1/admin/catalog/readiness', () =>
        HttpResponse.json({
          season: '2026-2027',
          activeCatalogPlayers: 500,
          qualityPercentage: 98,
          readinessStatus: 'READY',
          totalOperationalPlayers: 500,
          totalClubs: 20,
          playersByRole: { P: 40, D: 160, C: 180, A: 120 },
          errorCount: 0,
          warningCount: 0,
        }),
      ),
    );
    renderAuth();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Login' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('authenticated')).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByTestId('admin')).toHaveTextContent('true');
  });

  it('rifiuta credenziali non valide e mantiene sessione anonima', async () => {
    server.use(http.get('/api/v1/squads', () => new HttpResponse(null, { status: 401 })));
    renderAuth();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Login' }));
    expect(screen.getByTestId('status')).toHaveTextContent('anonymous');
  });

  it('logout elimina la sessione mantenuta in memoria', async () => {
    server.use(
      http.get('/api/v1/squads', () => HttpResponse.json([])),
      http.get('/api/v1/admin/catalog/readiness', () => new HttpResponse(null, { status: 403 })),
    );
    renderAuth();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Login' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('authenticated')).toBeVisible();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Logout' }));
    expect(screen.getByTestId('status')).toHaveTextContent('anonymous');
  });

  it('una 401 successiva invalida globalmente la sessione', async () => {
    server.use(
      http.get('/api/v1/squads', () => HttpResponse.json([])),
      http.get('/api/v1/admin/catalog/readiness', () => new HttpResponse(null, { status: 403 })),
    );
    renderAuth();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Login' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('authenticated')).toBeVisible();
    server.use(
      http.get('/api/v1/protected-expired', () => new HttpResponse(null, { status: 401 })),
    );
    const { httpRequest } = await import('@/api/client/httpClient');
    await act(async () => {
      await httpRequest('/protected-expired').catch(() => undefined);
    });
    expect(screen.getByTestId('status')).toHaveTextContent('anonymous');
  });
});

--- FILE: frontend\src\auth\AuthContext.ts ---
import { createContext } from 'react';

export type AuthStatus = 'anonymous' | 'authenticating' | 'authenticated';

export interface AuthValue {
  status: AuthStatus;
  username?: string;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  getAuthorization: () => string | undefined;
  login: (username: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
  logout: () => void;
}

export const AuthContext = createContext<AuthValue | undefined>(undefined);

--- FILE: frontend\src\auth\AuthProvider.tsx ---
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type PropsWithChildren } from 'react';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { dashboardApi } from '@/api/dashboardApi';
import { AppError } from '@/api/errors/AppError';
import { setUnauthorizedHandler } from '@/api/client/httpClient';
import { AuthContext, type AuthStatus, type AuthValue } from './AuthContext';

interface Credentials {
  username: string;
  password: string;
}

function basicHeader(credentials: Credentials): string {
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(`${credentials.username}:${credentials.password}`);
  let binary = '';
  bytes.forEach((byte) => {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(byte);
  });
  return `Basic ${btoa(binary)}`;
}

export function AuthProvider({ children }: PropsWithChildren) {
  const [credentials, setCredentials] = useState<Credentials>();
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<AuthStatus>('anonymous');
  const [isAdmin, setIsAdmin] = useState(false);
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const getAuthorization = useCallback(
    () => (credentials ? basicHeader(credentials) : undefined),
    [credentials],
  );

  const login = useCallback(async (username: string, password: string) => {
    const candidate = { username: username.trim(), password };
    const authorization = () => basicHeader(candidate);
    setStatus('authenticating');
    try {
      await dashboardApi.squads(authorization);
      let admin = false;
      try {
        await dashboardApi.readiness(undefined, authorization);
        admin = true;
      } catch (error) {
        if (!(error instanceof AppError) || error.kind !== 'forbidden') throw error;
      }
      setCredentials(candidate);
      setIsAdmin(admin);
      setStatus('authenticated');
    } catch (error) {
      setCredentials(undefined);
      setIsAdmin(false);
      setStatus('anonymous');
      throw error;
    }
  }, []);

  const logout = useCallback(() => {
    setCredentials(undefined);
    setIsAdmin(false);
    setStatus('anonymous');
    queryClient.clear();
  }, [queryClient]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setUnauthorizedHandler(logout);
    return () => setUnauthorizedHandler(undefined);
  }, [logout]);

  const value = useMemo<AuthValue>(
    () => ({
      status,
      username: credentials?.username,
      isAdmin,
      getAuthorization,
      login,
      logout,
    }),
    [credentials?.username, getAuthorization, isAdmin, login, logout, status],
  );

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
}

--- FILE: frontend\src\auth\RouteGuards.tsx ---
import { Navigate, Outlet, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '@/auth/useAuth';

export function ProtectedRoute() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();
  return auth.status === 'authenticated' ? (
    <Outlet />
  ) : (
    <Navigate to="/login" state={{ from: location.pathname }} replace />
  );
}

export function AdminRoute() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  if (auth.status !== 'authenticated') return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  return auth.isAdmin ? <Outlet /> : <Navigate to="/access-denied" replace />;
}

export function PublicOnlyRoute() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();
  const target = (location.state as { from?: string } | null)?.from ?? '/';
  return auth.status === 'authenticated' ? <Navigate to={target} replace /> : <Outlet />;
}

--- FILE: frontend\src\auth\useAuth.ts ---
import { useContext } from 'react';
import { AuthContext, type AuthValue } from './AuthContext';

export function useAuth(): AuthValue {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error('useAuth deve essere usato dentro AuthProvider');
  return context;
}

export type Difficulty = 'EASY' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HARD' | 'UNKNOWN';

export function ConfidenceScore({ value }: { value: number }) {
  const safe = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, value));
  const level = safe >= 80 ? 'high' : safe >= 60 ? 'medium' : 'low';
  const label = level === 'high' ? 'alta' : level === 'medium' ? 'media' : 'bassa';
  return (
    <span
      className={`${styles.confidence} ${styles[level]}`}
      aria-label={`Confidenza ${label}: ${safe}%`}
    >
      <ShieldCheck size={14} aria-hidden="true" />
      {safe}%
    </span>
  );
}
export type Trend = 'positive' | 'negative' | 'neutral';
export function TrendIndicator({ trend, value }: { trend: Trend; value: string }) {
  const Icon =
    trend === 'positive' ? ArrowUpRight : trend === 'negative' ? ArrowDownRight : ArrowRight;
  const label = trend === 'positive' ? 'positivo' : trend === 'negative' ? 'negativo' : 'stabile';
  return (
    <span className={`${styles.trend} ${styles[trend]}`} aria-label={`Trend ${label}: ${value}`}>
      <Icon size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
      {value}
    </span>
  );
}

import { cleanup, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { FatalErrorBoundary } from './FatalErrorBoundary';
import {
  createFatalTelemetryProvider,
  setFatalTelemetryProvider,
} from '@/observability/fatalTelemetry';

function BrokenView(): never {
  throw new Error('errore riservato');
}

describe('FatalErrorBoundary', () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    cleanup();
    setFatalTelemetryProvider();
  });

  it('notifica la telemetry e mostra una UX sicura senza dettagli tecnici', () => {
    const capture = vi.fn();
    setFatalTelemetryProvider({ capture });
    vi.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => undefined);
    render(
      <FatalErrorBoundary>
        <BrokenView />
      </FatalErrorBoundary>,
    );
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert')).toBeVisible();
    expect(
      screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Impossibile mostrare questa schermata' }),
    ).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.queryByText('errore riservato')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ricarica applicazione' })).toBeEnabled();
    expect(capture).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({
        eventType: 'frontend_fatal_error',
        source: 'react-error-boundary',
        errorName: 'Error',
        routePathname: '/',
      }),
    );
    expect(JSON.stringify(capture.mock.calls)).not.toContain('errore riservato');
  });

  it('mantiene il fallback se il trasporto telemetry fallisce', async () => {
    const transport = vi
      .fn<typeof fetch>()
      .mockRejectedValue(new Error('provider non disponibile'));
    setFatalTelemetryProvider(
      createFatalTelemetryProvider({
        endpoint: 'https://telemetry.example.test/fatal-events',
        production: true,
        transport,
      }),
    );
    vi.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => undefined);
    render(
      <FatalErrorBoundary>
        <BrokenView />
      </FatalErrorBoundary>,
    );
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert')).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.queryByText('provider non disponibile')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(transport).toHaveBeenCalledOnce());
  });
});

--- FILE: frontend\src\components\feedback\FatalErrorBoundary.tsx ---
import { Component, type PropsWithChildren, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui';
import { captureFatalError } from '@/observability/fatalTelemetry';
import styles from './FatalErrorBoundary.module.css';

interface State {
  failed: boolean;
}

export class FatalErrorBoundary extends Component<PropsWithChildren, State> {
  override state: State = { failed: false };

  static getDerivedStateFromError(): State {
    return { failed: true };
  }

  override componentDidCatch(error: Error): void {
    captureFatalError(error);
  }

  override render(): ReactNode {
    if (!this.state.failed) return this.props.children;
    return (
      <main className={styles.page}>
        <section className={styles.panel} role="alert" aria-labelledby="fatal-error-title">
          <AlertTriangle aria-hidden="true" />
          <p className={styles.eyebrow}>Errore applicazione</p>
          <h1 id="fatal-error-title">Impossibile mostrare questa schermata</h1>
          <p>I dati non sono stati modificati. Ricarica lâ€™applicazione per riprovare.</p>
          <Button onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>Ricarica applicazione</Button>
        </section>
      </main>
    );
  }
}

function LocationProbe() {

      <BackButton fallbackTo="/players" />
      <output data-testid="location">{location.pathname}</output>
    </>
  );

describe('BackButton', () => {
  it('usa la cronologia browser/router prima del fallback', async () => {
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/squad', '/players/7']} initialIndex={1}>
        <LocationProbe />
      </MemoryRouter>,
    );
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Indietro' }));
    expect(screen.getByTestId('location')).toHaveTextContent('/squad');
  });

  it('usa lâ€™origine esplicita o la lista predefinita senza cronologia', async () => {
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[{ pathname: '/players/7', state: { from: '/squad' } }]}>
        <LocationProbe />
      </MemoryRouter>,
    );
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Indietro' }));
    expect(screen.getByTestId('location')).toHaveTextContent('/squad');
  });
});

--- FILE: frontend\src\components\navigation\BackButton.tsx ---
import { ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { useLocation, useNavigate, type To } from 'react-router-dom';
import styles from './BackButton.module.css';

interface BackButtonProps {
  fallbackTo: To;
  label?: string;
}

interface NavigationState {
  from?: unknown;
}

export function BackButton({ fallbackTo, label = 'Indietro' }: BackButtonProps) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const state = location.state as NavigationState | null;
  const stateFallback =
    typeof state?.from === 'string' && state.from.startsWith('/') ? state.from : fallbackTo;

  const handleBack = () => {
    const hasPreviousEntry = location.key !== 'default' || window.history.length > 1;
    if (hasPreviousEntry) void navigate(-1);
    else void navigate(stateFallback);
  };

  return (
    <button className={styles.backButton} type="button" onClick={handleBack} aria-label={label}>
      <ArrowLeft size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
      <span>{label}</span>
    </button>
  );
}

import { AlertTriangle, Inbox, LoaderCircle, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  forwardRef,
  useId,
  useState,
  type ButtonHTMLAttributes,
  type CSSProperties,
  type InputHTMLAttributes,
  type PropsWithChildren,
  type ReactNode,
  type SelectHTMLAttributes,
} from 'react';
import styles from './ui.module.css';
export type ButtonVariant = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'danger';
export type ButtonSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
export function Button({
  variant = 'primary',
  size = 'md',
  loading = false,
  children,
  disabled,
  ...props
}: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  loading?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      className={`${styles.button} ${styles[variant]} ${size === 'md' ? '' : styles[size]}`}
      disabled={disabled || loading}
      aria-busy={loading || undefined}
      {...props}
    >
      {loading && <LoaderCircle size={16} className={styles.spinner} aria-hidden="true" />}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
export const IconButton = forwardRef<
  HTMLButtonElement,
  ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & { label: string }
>(function IconButton({ label, children, ...props }, ref) {
  return (
    <button ref={ref} className={styles.iconButton} aria-label={label} {...props}>
      {children}
    </button>
  );
});
export function Input({
  label,
  id,
  ...props
}: InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> & { label: string }) {
  const uid = useId();
  const inputId = id ?? uid;
  return (
    <label className={styles.field} htmlFor={inputId}>
      {label}
      <input id={inputId} className={styles.input} {...props} />
    </label>
  );
}
export function SearchInput({
  label = 'Cerca',
  id,
  ...props
}: InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> & { label?: string }) {
  const uid = useId();
  const inputId = id ?? uid;
  return (
    <label className={styles.field} htmlFor={inputId}>
      <span className={styles.visuallyHidden}>{label}</span>
      <span className={styles.inputWrap}>
        <Search className={styles.searchIcon} size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
        <input
          id={inputId}
          type="search"
          className={`${styles.input} ${styles.searchInput}`}
          {...props}
        />
      </span>
    </label>
  );
}
export function Select({
  label,
  id,
  children,
  ...props
}: SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement> & { label: string }) {
  const uid = useId();
  const selectId = id ?? uid;
  return (
    <label className={styles.field} htmlFor={selectId}>
      {label}
      <select id={selectId} className={styles.select} {...props}>
        {children}
      </select>
    </label>
  );
}
export function Badge({ children }: PropsWithChildren) {
  return <span className={styles.badge}>{children}</span>;
}
export function StatusBadge({
  tone,
  children,
}: PropsWithChildren<{ tone: 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'info' }>) {
  return (
    <span className={`${styles.badge} ${tone === 'danger' ? styles.dangerTone : styles[tone]}`}>
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}
export function Card({ children, className = '' }: PropsWithChildren<{ className?: string }>) {
  return <section className={`${styles.card} ${className}`}>{children}</section>;
}
export function Panel({
  children,
  className = '',
  ...props
}: PropsWithChildren<{ className?: string } & React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>>) {
  return (
    <section className={`${styles.panel} ${className}`} {...props}>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}
export function Divider() {
  return <hr className={styles.divider} />;
}
export function Tabs({ labels, defaultTab = 0 }: { labels: string[]; defaultTab?: number }) {
  const [active, setActive] = useState(defaultTab);
  return (
    <div className={styles.tabs} role="tablist" aria-label="Sezioni">
      {labels.map((label, index) => (
        <button
          key={label}
          role="tab"
          aria-selected={active === index}
          className={styles.tab}
          onClick={() => setActive(index)}
        >
          {label}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
export function ProgressBar({ value, label }: { value: number; label: string }) {
  const safe = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, value));
  return (
    <div
      className={styles.progress}
      role="progressbar"
      aria-label={label}
      aria-valuemin={0}
      aria-valuemax={100}
      aria-valuenow={safe}
    >
      <div className={styles.progressFill} style={{ inlineSize: `${safe}%` }} />
    </div>
  );
}
export function CircularMetric({ value, label }: { value: number; label: string }) {
  const safe = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, value));
  return (
    <div
      className={styles.circular}
      style={{ '--metric': safe } as CSSProperties}
      role="img"
      aria-label={`${label}: ${safe}%`}
    >
      <span className={styles.circularInner}>{safe}%</span>
    </div>
  );
}
export function Skeleton({ height = '1rem' }: { height?: string }) {
  return <div className={styles.skeleton} style={{ blockSize: height }} aria-hidden="true" />;
}
function State({
  icon,
  title,
  children,
  live,
}: PropsWithChildren<{ icon: ReactNode; title: string; live?: 'polite' | 'assertive' }>) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.state} aria-live={live}>
      {icon}
      <h3>{title}</h3>
      <div>{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}
export function EmptyState() {
  return (
    <State icon={<Inbox aria-hidden="true" />} title="Nessun dato">
      I contenuti appariranno qui quando disponibili.
    </State>
  );
}
export function ErrorState() {
  return (
    <State
      icon={<AlertTriangle aria-hidden="true" />}
      title="Qualcosa non ha funzionato"
      live="assertive"
    >
      Riprova tra poco.
    </State>
  );
}
export function LoadingState() {
  return (
    <State
      icon={<LoaderCircle className={styles.spinner} aria-hidden="true" />}
      title="Caricamento"
      live="polite"
    >
      Preparazione dei dati in corso.
    </State>
  );
}
export function VisuallyHidden({ children }: PropsWithChildren) {
  return <span className={styles.visuallyHidden}>{children}</span>;
}

--- FILE: frontend\src\components\ui\ui.test.tsx ---
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { Button, Input, SearchInput, Tabs } from './index';
describe('UI primitives', () => {
  it('Button rende nome, click e disabled', async () => {
    const click = vi.fn();
    const { rerender } = render(<Button onClick={click}>Conferma</Button>);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Conferma' }));
    expect(click).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    rerender(<Button disabled>Conferma</Button>);
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Conferma' })).toBeDisabled();
  });
  it('Input collega label e consente input', async () => {
    render(<Input label="Nome" />);
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Nome' }), 'Lega');
    expect(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Nome' })).toHaveValue('Lega');
  });
  it('SearchInput supporta tastiera', async () => {
    render(<SearchInput label="Cerca profilo" />);
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByRole('searchbox', { name: 'Cerca profilo' }), 'ala{enter}');
    expect(screen.getByRole('searchbox')).toHaveValue('ala');
  });
  it('Tabs cambia selezione', async () => {
    render(<Tabs labels={['Uno', 'Due']} />);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: 'Due' }));
    expect(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: 'Due' })).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
  });
});

import { z } from 'zod';
import { httpRequest, type HttpRequestOptions } from '@/api/client/httpClient';
import { AppError } from '@/api/errors/AppError';

const nullableDate = z.string().nullable();
const importBatchSchema = z.object({
  id: z.number(),
  source: z.string(),
  season: z.string(),
  filename: z.string(),
  status: z.string(),
  totalRows: z.number(),
  validRows: z.number(),
  invalidRows: z.number(),
  reconciledRows: z.number(),
  startedAt: z.string(),
  completedAt: nullableDate,
  reconciliationStartedAt: nullableDate,
  reconciliationCompletedAt: nullableDate,
  errorMessage: z.string().nullable(),
});
const importPageSchema = z.object({
  content: z.array(importBatchSchema),
  page: z.number(),
  size: z.number(),
  totalElements: z.number(),
  totalPages: z.number(),
});
const importRowErrorSchema = z.object({
  id: z.number(),
  rowNumber: z.number(),
  externalId: z.string().nullable(),
  externalName: z.string().nullable(),
  clubName: z.string().nullable(),
  fantasyRole: z.string().nullable(),
  validationError: z.string(),
  rawData: z.string().nullable(),
});

  batch: importBatchSchema,
  invalidRows: z.array(importRowErrorSchema),
  errorPage: z.number(),
  errorSize: z.number(),
  totalInvalidRows: z.number(),
  totalErrorPages: z.number(),
});
const sourceFreshnessSchema = z.object({
  source: z.string(),
  batchId: z.number().nullable(),
  observedAt: nullableDate,
  ageHours: z.number().nullable(),
  freshMaxHours: z.number(),
  staleAfterHours: z.number(),
  requiredForRefresh: z.boolean(),
  status: z.string(),
});
const freshnessSchema = z.object({
  season: z.string(),
  evaluatedAt: z.string(),
  overallStatus: z.string(),
  sources: z.array(sourceFreshnessSchema),
  blockers: z.array(z.string()),
  warnings: z.array(z.string()),
});
const refreshSchema = z.object({
  id: z.number(),
  season: z.string(),
  triggerType: z.string(),
  status: z.string(),
  sourceFreshnessStatus: z.string().nullable(),
  sourceFreshnessCheckedAt: nullableDate,
  reconciliationMatchedPlayers: z.number(),
  generatedEvaluations: z.number(),
  generatedClubRatings: z.number(),
  startedAt: z.string(),
  completedAt: nullableDate,
  errorMessage: z.string().nullable(),
});
const automationSchema = z.object({
  id: z.number(),
  season: z.string(),
  triggerType: z.string(),
  status: z.string(),
  stage: z.string(),
  listoneRunId: z.number().nullable(),
  ingestionRunCount: z.number(),
  refreshRunId: z.number().nullable(),
  startedAt: z.string(),
  lastHeartbeatAt: nullableDate,
  completedAt: nullableDate,
  errorMessage: z.string().nullable(),
});
const catalogIssueSchema = z.object({
  severity: z.string(),
  code: z.string(),
  message: z.string(),
  playerId: z.number().nullable(),
  fantacalcioExternalId: z.string().nullable(),
  playerName: z.string().nullable(),
  club: z.string().nullable(),

});
const catalogReadinessSchema = z.object({
  season: z.string(),

  gazzettaBatchId: z.number(),

  missingFromFantacalcio: z.number(),
  qualityPercentage: z.number(),

  warnings: z.array(z.string()),
  status: z.string(),
  totalOperationalPlayers: z.number(),

  playersByRole: z.object({ P: z.number(), D: z.number(), C: z.number(), A: z.number() }),
  errorCount: z.number(),

  issues: z.array(catalogIssueSchema),
  clubSummaries: z.array(
    z.object({
      clubId: z.number(),

      P: z.number(),
      D: z.number(),
      C: z.number(),
      A: z.number(),
    }),
  ),

export type ImportBatch = z.infer<typeof importBatchSchema>;
export type Freshness = z.infer<typeof freshnessSchema>;
export type DataRefresh = z.infer<typeof refreshSchema>;
export type AutomationRun = z.infer<typeof automationSchema>;
export type ImportDetail = z.infer<typeof importDetailSchema>;
export type CatalogReadiness = z.infer<typeof catalogReadinessSchema>;

function path(base: string, season?: string) {
  return season ? `${base}?season=${encodeURIComponent(season)}` : base;
}
async function validated<T>(
  url: string,
  schema: z.ZodType<T>,
  auth: () => string | undefined,
  init?: HttpRequestOptions,
) {
  const body = await httpRequest<unknown>(url, { ...init, getAuthorization: auth });
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(body);
  if (!parsed.success)
    throw new AppError('Il servizio ha restituito dati non conformi al contratto', {
      kind: 'invalid-response',
    });
  return parsed.data;
}
export const adminApi = {
  imports: (auth: () => string | undefined, season?: string, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
    validated(path('/admin/imports', season), importPageSchema, auth, { signal }),
  importDetail: (auth: () => string | undefined, batchId: number, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
    validated(`/admin/imports/${batchId}`, importDetailSchema, auth, { signal }),
  catalogReadiness: (auth: () => string | undefined, season?: string, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
    validated(path('/admin/catalog/readiness', season), catalogReadinessSchema, auth, { signal }),
  freshness: (auth: () => string | undefined, season?: string, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
    validated(path('/admin/data-freshness', season), freshnessSchema, auth, { signal }),
  latestRefresh: (auth: () => string | undefined, season?: string, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
    validated(path('/admin/data-refresh/latest', season), refreshSchema, auth, { signal }),
  latestAutomation: (auth: () => string | undefined, season?: string, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
    validated(path('/admin/automation/latest', season), automationSchema, auth, { signal }),
  runRefresh: (auth: () => string | undefined, season?: string) =>
    validated(path('/admin/data-refresh/run', season), refreshSchema, auth, { method: 'POST' }),
};

function params(values: Record<string, string | number | boolean | undefined>) {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  Object.entries(values).forEach(([key, value]) => {
    if (value !== undefined && value !== '') p.set(key, String(value));
  });
  return p.toString();
}
async function parsed<T>(
  path: string,
  schema: z.ZodType<T>,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
  getAuthorization?: () => string | undefined,
  init?: RequestInit,
) {
  return schema.parse(await httpRequest<unknown>(path, { ...init, signal, getAuthorization }));
}

export const featureApi = {
  players: (
    filters: { search?: string; club?: string; role?: string; page: number; size: number },
    signal?: AbortSignal,
  ) => parsed(`/players?${params(filters)}`, playerPageSchema, signal),
  player: (id: string, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
    parsed(`/players/${id}`, playerDetailSchema, signal),
  ranking: (role: string, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
    parsed(
      `/auction/intelligence-rankings?${params({ role: role || undefined, limit: 100 })}`,
      rankingSchema,
      signal,
    ),
  strategy: (signal?: AbortSignal) => parsed('/auction/strategy', strategySchema, signal),
  squad: (auth: () => string | undefined, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
    parsed('/squad', squadSchema, signal, auth),
  leagueConfiguration: (signal?: AbortSignal) =>
    parsed('/league/configuration', leagueConfigurationSchema, signal),
  createSquad: (auth: () => string | undefined, leagueConfigurationId: number, name: string) =>
    parsed('/squads', squadSchema, undefined, auth, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ leagueConfigurationId, name, active: true }),
    }),
  analysis: (auth: () => string | undefined, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
    parsed('/squad-analysis', analysisSchema, signal, auth),
  addPlayer: (auth: () => string | undefined, playerId: number, purchasePrice: number) =>
    parsed('/squad/players', squadSchema, undefined, auth, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ playerId, purchasePrice }),
    }),
  removePlayer: (auth: () => string | undefined, playerId: number) =>
    parsed(`/squad/players/${playerId}`, squadSchema, undefined, auth, { method: 'DELETE' }),
  updatePlayerPrice: (
    auth: () => string | undefined,
    playerId: number,
    purchasePrice: number,
  ) =>
    parsed(`/squad/players/${playerId}`, squadSchema, undefined, auth, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ purchasePrice }),
    }),
  createSession: (auth: () => string | undefined, squadId: number) =>
    parsed('/auction/sessions', sessionSchema, undefined, auth, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ squadId }),
    }),
  sessionState: (auth: () => string | undefined, id: string, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
    parsed(`/auction/sessions/${id}/state`, stateSchema, signal, auth),
};
export type PlayerPage = z.infer<typeof playerPageSchema>;
export type PlayerSeasonStatistics = z.infer<typeof playerSeasonStatisticsSchema>;
export type Squad = z.infer<typeof squadSchema>;

describe('catalogo giocatori', () => {
  it('naviga dalla prima alla seconda pagina e torna alla prima', async () => {
    const requestedPages: string[] = [];
    server.use(
      http.get('/api/v1/players', ({ request }) => {
        const page = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('page') ?? '0';
        requestedPages.push(page);
        return HttpResponse.json({
          content: [catalogPlayer(Number(page) + 1, page === '0' ? 'Prima pagina' : 'Seconda pagina')],
          page: Number(page),
          size: 25,
          totalElements: 50,
          totalPages: 2,
        });
      }),
    );
    window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/players');
    render(<App />);

    expect((await screen.findAllByText('Prima pagina')).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Successiva' }));
    expect((await screen.findAllByText('Seconda pagina')).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(screen.getByText('2 / 2')).toBeVisible();
    await waitFor(() => expect(window.location.search).toContain('page=1'));

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Precedente' }));
    expect((await screen.findAllByText('Prima pagina')).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(requestedPages).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['0', '1']));
  });
});

      http.get('/api/v1/players', () => HttpResponse.json({ content: [realPlayer], page: 0, size: 10, totalElements: 1, totalPages: 1 })),
      http.post('/api/v1/squad/players', async ({ request }) => {
        expect(await request.json()).toEqual({ playerId: 77, purchasePrice: 10 });
        return HttpResponse.json(acquired);
      }),
      http.patch('/api/v1/squad/players/77', async ({ request }) => {
        expect(await request.json()).toEqual({ purchasePrice: 20 });
        return HttpResponse.json({ ...acquired, spentBudget: 20, remainingBudget: 980, players: [{ ...acquired.players[0], purchasePrice: 20 }] });
      }),
      http.delete('/api/v1/squad/players/77', () => HttpResponse.json(emptySquad)),
    );
    renderPage(<SquadPage />);
    await userEvent.type(await screen.findByRole('textbox', { name: 'Cerca nel catalogo' }), 'Gi');
    await userEvent.selectOptions(await screen.findByRole('combobox', { name: 'Giocatore' }), '77');
    await userEvent.clear(screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: 'Prezzo acquisto' }));
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: 'Prezzo acquisto' }), '10');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Aggiungi alla rosa' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(realPlayer.name)).toBeVisible();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Modifica prezzo' }));
    const edit = screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: `Prezzo ${realPlayer.name}` });
    await userEvent.clear(edit); await userEvent.type(edit, '20');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Salva' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('980')).toBeVisible();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Rimuovi' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Nessun giocatore ancora inserito.')).toBeVisible();
  });

  it('acquista dal catalogo nella rosa attiva senza dati fittizi', async () => {

      http.get('/api/v1/squad', () => HttpResponse.json(emptySquad)),
      http.post('/api/v1/squad/players', () => HttpResponse.json({ ...emptySquad, totalPlayers: 1, spentBudget: 15, remainingBudget: 985, players: [{ id: 101, playerId: 77, playerName: realPlayer.name, club: realPlayer.club, role: 'A', purchasePrice: 15 }] })),
    );
    renderPage(<PlayersPage />, '/players');
    const addButtons = await screen.findAllByRole('button', { name: /Aggiungi/ });
    await userEvent.click(addButtons[0]!);

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Conferma acquisto' }));
    expect(await screen.findAllByRole('button', { name: 'GiÃ  in rosa' })).not.toHaveLength(0);

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { http, HttpResponse } from 'msw';
import { server } from '@/test/server';
import { AppError } from '@/api/errors/AppError';
import { intelligenceApi, lineupSchema } from './api';

const lineup = {
  season: '2026-2027',
  matchday: 1,
  squadId: 1,
  formation: '4-3-3',
  complete: true,
  selectedPlayers: 11,
  missingPlayers: 0,
  formationScore: 80,
  roles: {
    P: { required: 1, selected: 1, missing: 0 },
    D: { required: 4, selected: 4, missing: 0 },
    C: { required: 3, selected: 3, missing: 0 },
    A: { required: 3, selected: 3, missing: 0 },
  },
  starters: [
    {
      playerId: 1,
      playerName: 'Titolare reale',
      club: 'Club test',
      role: 'P',
      opponent: 'Avversario test',
      home: true,
      fixtureDifficulty: 42,
      selectionScore: 80,
      availabilityStatus: 'AVAILABLE',
      reason: 'Motivazione reale dal backend.',
    },
  ],
  bench: [],
  maxSubstitutions: 3,
  usedSubstitutions: 0,
  remainingSubstitutions: 3,
  substitutions: [],
  warnings: [],
};

describe('intelligenceApi lineups', () => {
  it('inoltra stagione, giornata, rosa e Basic Auth al motore', async () => {
    let target: URL | undefined;
    let authorization: string | null = null;
    server.use(
      http.get('/api/v1/lineups/recommended', ({ request }) => {
        target = new URL(request.url);
        authorization = request.headers.get('authorization');
        return HttpResponse.json(lineup);
      }),
    );
    const data = await intelligenceApi.lineup(
      3,
      '2026/2027',
      42,
      () => 'Basic test-only',
    );
    expect(data.season).toBe('2026-2027');
    expect(target?.searchParams.get('season')).toBe('2026/2027');
    expect(target?.searchParams.get('matchday')).toBe('3');
    expect(target?.searchParams.get('squadId')).toBe('42');
    expect(authorization).toBe('Basic test-only');
  });

  it('normalizza a null i segnali reali omessi', async () => {
    const partialPlayer = { ...lineup.starters[0] } as Record<string, unknown>;
    ['fixtureDifficulty', 'selectionScore', 'availabilityStatus'].forEach((field) => {
      delete partialPlayer[field];
    });
    server.use(
      http.get('/api/v1/lineups/recommended', () =>
        HttpResponse.json({ ...lineup, starters: [partialPlayer] }),
      ),
    );
    const data = await intelligenceApi.lineup(1, '2026/2027', 1);
    const starter = data.starters[0];
    expect(starter?.selectionScore).toBeNull();
    expect(starter?.fixtureDifficulty).toBeNull();
    expect(starter?.availabilityStatus).toBeNull();
  });

  it('classifica come invalid-response una risposta non conforme al contratto', async () => {
    server.use(
      http.get('/api/v1/lineups/recommended', () =>
        HttpResponse.json({ season: '2026-2027' }),
      ),
    );
    await expect(intelligenceApi.lineup(1)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(AppError);
    await expect(intelligenceApi.lineup(1)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      kind: 'invalid-response',
    });
  });

  it('rifiuta un contratto lineup malformato', () => {
    expect(() => lineupSchema.parse({ season: '2026-2027' })).toThrow();
  });
});

--- FILE: frontend\src\features\intelligence\api.ts ---
import { z } from 'zod';
import { httpRequest } from '@/api/client/httpClient';
import { AppError } from '@/api/errors/AppError';

const number = z.number();
const nullableNumber = number.nullable();
const lineupPlayerSchema = z.object({
  playerId: number,
  playerName: z.string(),
  club: z.string(),
  role: z.string(),
  opponent: z.string(),
  home: z.boolean(),
  // Missing signals stay null so the UI never fabricates scores or availability.
  fixtureDifficulty: nullableNumber.optional().default(null),
  selectionScore: nullableNumber.optional().default(null),
  availabilityStatus: z.string().nullable().optional().default(null),
  reason: z.string(),
});
export const lineupSchema = z.object({
  season: z.string(),
  matchday: number,
  squadId: nullableNumber,
  formation: z.string(),
  complete: z.boolean(),
  selectedPlayers: number,
  missingPlayers: number,
  formationScore: number,
  // Collections are optional in older/partial responses; absence means no data, never fake players.
  roles: z
    .record(z.string(), z.object({ required: number, selected: number, missing: number }))
    .optional()
    .default({}),
  starters: z.array(lineupPlayerSchema).optional().default([]),
  bench: z.array(lineupPlayerSchema).optional().default([]),
  maxSubstitutions: number,
  usedSubstitutions: number,
  remainingSubstitutions: number,
  substitutions: z
    .array(
      z.object({
        outgoingPlayer: lineupPlayerSchema,
        incomingPlayer: lineupPlayerSchema,
        reason: z.string(),
      }),
    )
    .optional()
    .default([]),
  warnings: z.array(z.string()).optional().default([]),
});
export const fixtureSchema = z.object({
  fixtureId: number,
  matchday: number,
  homeClub: z.string(),
  awayClub: z.string(),
  homeDifficulty: z.string(),
  awayDifficulty: z.string(),
});
const roleMatchupSchema = z.object({
  role: z.string(),
  difficultyScore: number,
  difficultyLevel: z.string(),
  evidenceTier: z.string(),
  evidenceCoverage: number,
});
export const matchupSchema = z.object({
  fixtureId: number,
  matchday: number,
  kickoffAt: z.string().nullable(),
  clubId: number,
  club: z.string(),
  opponentClubId: number,
  opponent: z.string(),
  home: z.boolean(),
  status: z.string(),
  roles: z.array(roleMatchupSchema),
});
export const scoutingSchema = z.object({
  playerId: number,
  playerName: z.string(),
  club: z.string(),
  role: z.string(),
  season: z.string(),
  previousClub: z.string().nullable(),
  previousLeague: z.string().nullable(),
  previousCountryCode: z.string().nullable(),
  transferType: z.string().nullable(),
  adaptationScore: number,
  potentialScore: number,
  riskScore: number,
  confidenceScore: number,
  recommendation: z.string(),
  scoutingSummary: z.string(),
  eligibilityStatus: z.string(),
  updatedAt: z.string(),
});
export const seasonSchema = z.object({
  id: number,
  code: z.string(),
  startYear: number,
  endYear: number,
  current: z.boolean(),
});
export const clubSchema = z.object({
  id: number,
  name: z.string(),
  shortName: z.string(),
  slug: z.string(),
  countryCode: z.string(),
  active: z.boolean(),
});

function qs(values: Record<string, string | number | undefined>) {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  Object.entries(values).forEach(([k, v]) => {
    if (v !== undefined && v !== '') p.set(k, String(v));
  });
  return p.toString();
}
async function parse<T>(
  path: string,
  schema: z.ZodType<T>,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
  getAuthorization?: () => string | undefined,
) {
  const body = await httpRequest<unknown>(path, { signal, getAuthorization });
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(body);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    throw new AppError('Il servizio ha restituito dati non conformi al contratto', {
      kind: 'invalid-response',
      cause: parsed.error,
    });
  }
  return parsed.data;
}
export const intelligenceApi = {
  seasons: (signal?: AbortSignal) => parse('/seasons', seasonSchema.array(), signal),
  clubs: (signal?: AbortSignal) => parse('/clubs', clubSchema.array(), signal),
  lineup: (
    matchday: number,
    season?: string,
    squadId?: number,
    getAuthorization?: () => string | undefined,
    signal?: AbortSignal,
  ) =>
    parse(
      `/lineups/recommended?${qs({ season, matchday, squadId })}`,
      lineupSchema,
      signal,
      getAuthorization,
    ),
  fixtures: (matchday: number, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
    parse(`/fixtures/matchday/${matchday}`, fixtureSchema.array(), signal),
  matchups: (club: string, fromMatchday: number, toMatchday: number, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
    parse(
      `/fixtures/club/${encodeURIComponent(club)}/matchups?${qs({ fromMatchday, toMatchday })}`,
      matchupSchema.array(),
      signal,
    ),
  scouting: (
    season: string,
    filters: { role?: string; club?: string; recommendation?: string },
    signal?: AbortSignal,
  ) => parse(`/scouting/arrivals?${qs({ season, ...filters })}`, scoutingSchema.array(), signal),
};
export type Lineup = z.infer<typeof lineupSchema>;
export type LineupPlayer = z.infer<typeof lineupPlayerSchema>;

--- FILE: frontend\src\layouts\AppShell.test.tsx ---
import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { delay, http, HttpResponse } from 'msw';
import { AuthProvider } from '@/auth/AuthProvider';
import { server } from '@/test/server';
import { AppShell } from './AppShell';

afterEach(cleanup);

function renderShell() {
  const client = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } } });
  return render(
    <QueryClientProvider client={client}>
      <AuthProvider>
        <MemoryRouter>
          <AppShell>
            <h1>Contenuto</h1>
          </AppShell>
        </MemoryRouter>
      </AuthProvider>
    </QueryClientProvider>,
  );
}
describe('AppShell mobile navigation', () => {
  it('non mostra il riquadro tecnico della foundation nella sidebar', () => {
    renderShell();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Foundation F03')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Design system preview')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('apre e chiude il menu accessibile', () => {
    renderShell();
    const open = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Apri menu', hidden: true });
    expect(open).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    fireEvent.click(open);
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Chiudi menu', hidden: true })).toHaveAttribute(
      'aria-expanded',
      'true',
    );
    fireEvent.keyDown(document, { key: 'Escape' });
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Apri menu', hidden: true })).toHaveAttribute(
      'aria-expanded',
      'false',
    );
  });

  it('espone route, label accessibili e tooltip per ogni voce della sidebar', () => {
    renderShell();
    const routes = {
      Dashboard: '/',
      Giocatori: '/players',
      Asta: '/auction',
      'Live Auction': '/auction/live',
      Rosa: '/squad',
      Formazione: '/lineup',
      Calendario: '/calendar',
      Scouting: '/scouting',
      Analisi: '/analysis',
      Statistiche: '/statistics',
      Comparatore: '/comparator',
      Market: '/market',
      Impostazioni: '/settings',
    };
    Object.entries(routes).forEach(([label, path]) => {
      const link = screen.getByRole('link', { name: label });
      expect(link).toHaveAttribute('href', path);
      expect(link).toHaveAttribute('aria-label', label);
      expect(link).toHaveAttribute('title', label);
    });
  });

  it('collassa la sidebar quando si entra in una sezione', async () => {
    renderShell();
    const sidebar = screen.getByRole('complementary', { name: 'Navigazione principale' });
    await waitFor(() => expect(sidebar).toHaveAttribute('data-collapsed', 'true'));
  });
});

const playerPage = (content: object[]) => ({
  content,
  page: 0,
  size: 6,
  totalElements: content.length,
  totalPages: content.length ? 1 : 0,
});
const searchedPlayer = {
  id: 7,
  name: 'Giocatore reale',
  club: 'Squadra reale',
  clubSlug: 'squadra-reale',
  fantacalcioRole: 'A',
  gazzettaRole: null,
  fantamarktRole: null,
  sourcesCount: 2,
};

describe('P01 global search', () => {
  it('accetta input e invia con Enter mostrando un risultato navigabile', async () => {
    server.use(
      http.get('/api/v1/players', ({ request }) => {
        expect(new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('search')).toBe('Giocatore');
        return HttpResponse.json(playerPage([searchedPlayer]));
      }),
      http.get('/api/v1/clubs', () => HttpResponse.json([])),
    );
    renderShell();
    const input = screen.getByRole('searchbox', { name: /Cerca giocatori e squadre/ });
    await userEvent.type(input, 'Giocatore{enter}');
    expect(await screen.findByRole('link', { name: /Giocatore reale/ })).toHaveAttribute(
      'href',
      '/players/7',
    );
  });

  it('supporta il pulsante, loading e zero risultati', async () => {
    server.use(
      http.get('/api/v1/players', async () => {
        await delay(50);
        return HttpResponse.json(playerPage([]));
      }),
      http.get('/api/v1/clubs', async () => {
        await delay(50);
        return HttpResponse.json([]);
      }),
    );
    renderShell();
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByRole('searchbox'), 'Nessuno');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Avvia ricerca' }));
    expect(screen.getByText('Ricerca in corsoâ€¦')).toBeVisible();
    expect(await screen.findByText('Nessun giocatore o squadra trovato.')).toBeVisible();
  });

  it('rende percepibile un errore API e chiude i risultati con Escape', async () => {
    server.use(
      http.get('/api/v1/players', () => new HttpResponse(null, { status: 500 })),
      http.get('/api/v1/clubs', () => HttpResponse.json([])),
    );
    renderShell();
    const input = screen.getByRole('searchbox');
    await userEvent.type(input, 'Errore{enter}');
    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent('Ricerca non disponibile');
    await userEvent.type(input, '{escape}');
    expect(screen.queryByLabelText('Risultati ricerca')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

export function AppShell({ children }: PropsWithChildren) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [sidebarCollapsed, setSidebarCollapsed] = useState(true);
  const menuButton = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!menuOpen) return;
    const close = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setMenuOpen(false);
        menuButton.current?.focus();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', close);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', close);
  }, [menuOpen]);
  const collapseNavigation = (event: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
    setSidebarCollapsed(true);
    setMenuOpen(false);
    event.currentTarget.blur();
  };
  const navItems = auth.isAdmin
    ? [...items, ['Amministrazione', Settings, '/admin'] as const]
    : items;
  return (
    <div className={`${styles.shell} ${sidebarCollapsed ? styles.shellCollapsed : ''}`}>
      {menuOpen && (
        <button
          className={styles.backdrop}
          aria-label="Chiudi menu"
          onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
      <aside
        className={`${styles.sidebar} ${sidebarCollapsed && !menuOpen ? styles.sidebarCollapsed : ''} ${menuOpen ? styles.sidebarOpen : ''}`}
        aria-label="Navigazione principale"
        data-collapsed={sidebarCollapsed && !menuOpen ? 'true' : 'false'}
      >
        <NavLink to="/" className={styles.brand} onClick={collapseNavigation} title="Dashboard">
          <span className={styles.mark}>FI</span>
          <span className={styles.brandText}>
            Fantacalcio
            <br />
            Intelligence
          </span>
        </NavLink>
        <nav className={styles.nav} aria-label="Navigazione principale">
          {navItems.map(([label, Icon, to]) => (
            <NavLink
              key={label}
              to={to}
              end={to === '/'}
              aria-label={label}
              title={label}
              onClick={collapseNavigation}
              className={({ isActive }) => `${styles.navLink} ${isActive ? styles.active : ''}`}
            >
              <Icon size={19} aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>{label}</span>
            </NavLink>
          ))}
        </nav>
      </aside>
      <div className={styles.body}>
        <header className={styles.topbar}>
          <div className={styles.menu}>
            <IconButton
              ref={menuButton}
              label={menuOpen ? 'Chiudi menu' : 'Apri menu'}
              aria-expanded={menuOpen}
              onClick={() => setMenuOpen((open) => !open)}
            >
              <Menu size={18} />
            </IconButton>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.topbarSearch}>
            <GlobalSearch />
          </div>
          <div className={styles.league}>
            <span className={styles.profile}>
              <Users size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
              {auth.status === 'authenticated' ? 'Workspace personale' : 'Accesso pubblico'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.topActions}>
            <IconButton label="Notifiche">
              <Bell size={18} />
            </IconButton>
            <Link
              className={styles.profile}
              to={auth.status === 'authenticated' ? '/profile' : '/login'}
            >
              <span className={styles.avatar} aria-hidden="true">
                FI
              </span>
              <span>{auth.username ?? 'Accedi'}</span>
            </Link>
            {auth.status === 'authenticated' && (
              <button className={styles.logout} onClick={auth.logout}>
                Esci
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </header>
        <main className={styles.main}>{children}</main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
