import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { FormEvent, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { featureApi } from '@/features/core/api';
import { intelligenceApi } from '@/features/intelligence/api';
import styles from './AppShell.module.css';

export function GlobalSearch() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState('');
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState('');
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const region = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const normalized = submitted.trim();
  const players = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['global-search', 'players', normalized],
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => featureApi.players({ search: normalized, page: 0, size: 6 }, signal),
    enabled: normalized.length > 0,
    retry: false,
  });
  const clubs = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['global-search', 'clubs'],
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => intelligenceApi.clubs(signal),
    enabled: normalized.length > 0,
    retry: false,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    setSubmitted('');
    setValue('');
  }, [location.pathname]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const close = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!region.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) setSubmitted('');
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', close);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', close);
  }, []);

  const submit = (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const query = value.trim();
    if (query) setSubmitted(query);
  };
  const matchingClubs = (clubs.data ?? []).filter((club) =>
    club.name.toLocaleLowerCase('it').includes(normalized.toLocaleLowerCase('it')),
  );
  const pending = players.isPending || clubs.isPending;
  const error = players.isError || clubs.isError;
  const empty =
    !pending && !error && players.data?.content.length === 0 && matchingClubs.length === 0;

  return (
    <div className={styles.globalSearch} ref={region}>
      <form className={styles.searchForm} role="search" onSubmit={submit}>
        <label className={styles.visuallyHidden} htmlFor="global-search">
          Cerca giocatori e squadre
        </label>
        <Search className={styles.searchIcon} size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
        <input
          id="global-search"
          type="search"
          value={value}
          placeholder="Cerca giocatori e squadreâ€¦"
          autoComplete="off"
          onChange={(event) => setValue(event.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(event) => {
            if (event.key === 'Escape') setSubmitted('');
          }}
        />
        <button type="submit" aria-label="Avvia ricerca" disabled={!value.trim()}>
          Cerca
        </button>
      </form>
      {normalized && (
        <div className={styles.searchResults} aria-live="polite" aria-label="Risultati ricerca">
          {pending ? (
            <p>Ricerca in corsoâ€¦</p>
          ) : error ? (
            <p role="alert">Ricerca non disponibile. Riprova.</p>
          ) : empty ? (
            <p>Nessun giocatore o squadra trovato.</p>
          ) : (
            <>
              {players.data?.content.map((player) => (
                <Link
                  key={player.id}
                  to={`/players/${player.id}`}
                  state={{ from: `${location.pathname}${location.search}` }}
                >
                  <span>{player.name}</span>
                  <small>
                    {player.club} Â· {player.fantacalcioRole}
                  </small>
                </Link>
              ))}
              {matchingClubs.slice(0, 4).map((club) => (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  key={club.id}
                  onClick={() => navigate(`/players?club=${encodeURIComponent(club.slug)}`)}
                >
                  <span>{club.name}</span>
                  <small>Squadra Â· vedi giocatori</small>
                </button>
              ))}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import {

const event: FatalErrorEvent = {

describe('fatal telemetry provider selection', () => {
  it('seleziona Noop quando endpoint Ã¨ assente', () => {
    expect(createFatalTelemetryProvider({ production: true })).toBeInstanceOf(
      NoopFatalTelemetryProvider,
    );
  });

  it('seleziona il provider HTTP per un endpoint HTTPS valido', () => {
    expect(
      createFatalTelemetryProvider({
        endpoint: 'https://telemetry.example.test/fatal-events',
        production: true,
      }),
    ).toBeInstanceOf(HttpFatalTelemetryProvider);
  });

  it('usa Noop per URL invalidi o HTTP non valido in produzione', () => {
    expect(
      createFatalTelemetryProvider({ endpoint: 'non-un-url', production: true }),
    ).toBeInstanceOf(NoopFatalTelemetryProvider);
    expect(
      createFatalTelemetryProvider({
        endpoint: 'http://telemetry.example.test/fatal-events',
        production: true,
      }),
    ).toBeInstanceOf(NoopFatalTelemetryProvider);
  });
});

describe('HttpFatalTelemetryProvider', () => {
  it('invia un POST JSON privacy-safe senza Authorization nÃ© credenziali', async () => {
    const transport = vi.fn<typeof fetch>().mockResolvedValue(new Response(null, { status: 202 }));
    const selected = createFatalTelemetryProvider({
      endpoint: 'https://telemetry.example.test/fatal-events',
      production: true,
      transport,
    });

    selected.capture(event);
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(transport).toHaveBeenCalledOnce());

    const [endpoint, request] = transport.mock.calls[0] ?? [];
    expect(endpoint).toBe('https://telemetry.example.test/fatal-events');
    expect(request).toMatchObject({
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      credentials: 'omit',
      keepalive: true,
    });
    if (typeof request?.body !== 'string') throw new Error('Expected serialized JSON body');
    const serialized = request.body;
    expect(JSON.parse(serialized)).toEqual(event);
    for (const forbidden of [
      'Basic',
      'Authorization',
      'password',
      'stack',
      'message',
      'username',
      'player',
      'squad',
      'auction',
    ]) {
      expect(serialized).not.toContain(forbidden);
    }
  });

  it('assorbe un errore di rete senza rejection non gestite', async () => {
    const transport = vi.fn<typeof fetch>().mockRejectedValue(new Error('offline'));
    const selected = createFatalTelemetryProvider({
      endpoint: 'http://localhost:4318/fatal-events',
      production: false,
      transport,
    });
    expect(() => selected.capture(event)).not.toThrow();
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(transport).toHaveBeenCalledOnce());
  });
});

--- FILE: frontend\src\observability\fatalTelemetry.ts ---
export interface FatalErrorEvent {
  eventType: 'frontend_fatal_error';
  source: 'react-error-boundary';
  errorName: string;
  timestamp: string;
  routePathname: string;
}

export interface FatalTelemetryProvider {
  capture(event: FatalErrorEvent): void;
}

type TelemetryTransport = typeof fetch;

interface TelemetryConfiguration {
  endpoint?: string;
  production: boolean;
  transport?: TelemetryTransport;
  timeoutMs?: number;
}

export class NoopFatalTelemetryProvider implements FatalTelemetryProvider {
  capture(): void {}
}

export class HttpFatalTelemetryProvider implements FatalTelemetryProvider {
  constructor(
    private readonly endpoint: string,
    private readonly transport: TelemetryTransport = fetch,
    private readonly timeoutMs = 3_000,
  ) {}

  capture(event: FatalErrorEvent): void {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), this.timeoutMs);

    // AUTHORIZED_OBSERVABILITY_TRANSPORT: isolated from the authenticated business API client.
    try {
      void this.transport(this.endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(event),
        signal: controller.signal,
        credentials: 'omit',
        keepalive: true,
      })
        .catch(() => undefined)
        .finally(() => window.clearTimeout(timeout));
    } catch {
      window.clearTimeout(timeout);
    }
  }
}

const noopProvider = new NoopFatalTelemetryProvider();

let provider: FatalTelemetryProvider = noopProvider;

function validEndpoint(endpoint: string | undefined, production: boolean): string | undefined {
  if (!endpoint || !URL.canParse(endpoint)) return undefined;
  const url = new URL(endpoint);
  if (url.username || url.password || url.search || url.hash) return undefined;
  if (url.protocol === 'https:') return url.href;
  const localDevelopmentEndpoint =
    !production &&
    url.protocol === 'http:' &&
    ['localhost', '127.0.0.1', '[::1]'].includes(url.hostname);
  return localDevelopmentEndpoint ? url.href : undefined;
}

export function createFatalTelemetryProvider({
  endpoint,
  production,
  transport,
  timeoutMs,
}: TelemetryConfiguration): FatalTelemetryProvider {
  const validatedEndpoint = validEndpoint(endpoint, production);
  return validatedEndpoint
    ? new HttpFatalTelemetryProvider(validatedEndpoint, transport, timeoutMs)
    : noopProvider;
}

export function configureFatalTelemetry(configuration: TelemetryConfiguration): void {
  provider = createFatalTelemetryProvider(configuration);
}

export function captureFatalError(error: Error): void {
  try {
    provider.capture({
      eventType: 'frontend_fatal_error',
      source: 'react-error-boundary',
      errorName: error.name || 'Error',
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      routePathname: window.location.pathname,
    });
  } catch {
    // Observability must never interfere with the fatal recovery UI.
  }
}

export function setFatalTelemetryProvider(nextProvider?: FatalTelemetryProvider): void {
  provider = nextProvider ?? noopProvider;
}

const tone = (status?: string): 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'info' => {
  if (!status) return 'info';
  if (['READY', 'FRESH', 'COMPLETED', 'SUCCESS'].includes(status)) return 'success';
  if (['FAILED', 'BLOCKED', 'STALE', 'MISSING'].includes(status)) return 'danger';
  return 'warning';
};

              <div className={styles.heading}>
                <div>
                  <h2>Storico import</h2>
                  <p className={shared.muted}>
                    {imports.data?.totalElements ?? 0} batch restituiti dal backend.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              {imports.data?.content.length === 0 ? (
                <p>Nessun import disponibile per questa stagione.</p>
              ) : (
                <div className={shared.tableWrap}>
                  <table className={shared.table}>
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th>ID</th>
                        <th>Fonte</th>
                        <th>Stato</th>
                        <th>Righe</th>
                        <th>Valide</th>
                        <th>Invalide</th>
                        <th>Riconciliate</th>
                        <th>Avvio</th>
                        <th>
                          <span className={styles.visuallyHidden}>Azioni</span>
                        </th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {imports.data?.content.map((batch) => (
                        <tr key={batch.id}>
                          <td>{batch.id}</td>
                          <td>{batch.source}</td>
                          <td>
                            <StatusBadge tone={tone(batch.status)}>{batch.status}</StatusBadge>
                          </td>
                          <td>{batch.totalRows}</td>
                          <td>{batch.validRows}</td>
                          <td>{batch.invalidRows}</td>
                          <td>{batch.reconciledRows}</td>
                          <td>{formatDate(batch.startedAt)}</td>
                          <td>
                            <Button
                              variant="secondary"
                              size="sm"
                              aria-expanded={selectedBatchId === batch.id}
                              onClick={() =>
                                setSelectedBatchId((current) =>
                                  current === batch.id ? undefined : batch.id,
                                )
                              }
                            >
                              {selectedBatchId === batch.id ? 'Chiudi' : 'Dettagli'}
                            </Button>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              )}
              {selectedBatchId !== undefined && (
                <div className={styles.importDetail} aria-live="polite">
                  {importDetail.isLoading && <p>Caricamento dettaglio batchâ€¦</p>}
                  {importDetail.isError && (
                    <p className={shared.error} role="alert">
                      Dettaglio batch non disponibile: {importDetail.error.message}
                    </p>
                  )}
                  {importDetail.data && (
                    <>
                      <div className={styles.heading}>
                        <h3>Diagnostica batch #{importDetail.data.batch.id}</h3>
                        <span>{importDetail.data.totalInvalidRows} righe invalide</span>
                      </div>
                      {importDetail.data.invalidRows.length === 0 ? (
                        <p>Nessun errore di riga registrato.</p>
                      ) : (
                        <ul className={styles.errorRows}>
                          {importDetail.data.invalidRows.map((row) => (
                            <li key={row.id}>
                              <strong>Riga {row.rowNumber}</strong>
                              <span>{row.validationError}</span>
                              <small>
                                {[row.externalName, row.clubName, row.fantasyRole]
                                  .filter(Boolean)
                                  .join(' Â· ')}
                              </small>
                            </li>
                          ))}
                        </ul>
                      )}
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </section>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </AppShell>
  );
}

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Link, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { AppShell } from '@/layouts/AppShell';
import { featureApi } from '@/features/core/api';
import styles from '@/features/core/FeaturePage.module.css';
export function AuctionPage() {
  const [url, setUrl] = useSearchParams();
  const role = url.get('role') ?? '';
  const ranking = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['auction-ranking', role],
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => featureApi.ranking(role, signal),
  });
  const strategy = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['auction-strategy'],
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => featureApi.strategy(signal),
  });
  return (
    <AppShell>
      <div className={styles.page}>
        <header className={styles.hero}>
          <div>
            <span className={styles.eyebrow}>Decision engine</span>

        </header>
        <section className={`${styles.panel} ${styles.filters}`}>
          <label>
            Ruolo

                  ))}

            </div>
          )}
        </section>
        <section className={styles.panel}>

--- FILE: frontend\src\pages\CalendarPage.tsx ---
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { AppShell } from '@/layouts/AppShell';
import { intelligenceApi } from '@/features/intelligence/api';
import shared from '@/features/core/FeaturePage.module.css';
import styles from '@/features/intelligence/Intelligence.module.css';
import { Button, Select } from '@/components/ui';
export function CalendarPage() {
  const [url, setUrl] = useSearchParams();
  const matchday = Math.min(38, Math.max(1, Number(url.get('matchday') ?? 1)));
  const club = url.get('club') ?? '';
  const clubs = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['clubs'],
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => intelligenceApi.clubs(signal),
  });
  const fixtures = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['fixtures', matchday],
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => intelligenceApi.fixtures(matchday, signal),
    retry: false,
  });
  const matchups = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['matchups', club, matchday],
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => intelligenceApi.matchups(club, matchday, matchday, signal),
    enabled: Boolean(club),
    retry: false,
  });
  const update = (key: string, value: string) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(url);
    if (value) next.set(key, value);
    else next.delete(key);
    setUrl(next);
  };
  return (
    <AppShell>
      <div className={shared.page}>
        <header className={shared.hero}>
          <div>
            <span className={shared.eyebrow}>Fixture intelligence</span>
            <h1>Calendario & matchup</h1>
            <p className={shared.muted}>Giornate e difficoltÃ  calcolate dal backend.</p>
          </div>
        </header>
        <section className={`${shared.panel} ${styles.toolbar}`} aria-label="Controlli calendario">
          <div className={styles.matchdayControls}>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              disabled={matchday === 1}
              onClick={() => update('matchday', String(matchday - 1))}
            >
              Precedente
            </Button>
            <Select
              label="Giornata"
              value={matchday}
              onChange={(e) => update('matchday', e.target.value)}
            >
              {Array.from({ length: 38 }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((x) => (
                <option key={x}>{x}</option>
              ))}
            </Select>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              disabled={matchday === 38}
              onClick={() => update('matchday', String(matchday + 1))}
            >
              Successiva
            </Button>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.clubControl}>
            <Select
              label="Analisi club"
              value={club}
              onChange={(e) => update('club', e.target.value)}
            >
              <option value="">Nessun club</option>
              {clubs.data?.map((c) => (
                <option key={c.id} value={c.slug}>
                  {c.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </Select>
          </div>
        </section>
        <section className={shared.panel} aria-live="polite">
          <h2>Giornata {matchday}</h2>
          {fixtures.isPending ? (
            <p>Caricamento calendarioâ€¦</p>
          ) : fixtures.isError ? (
            <p className={shared.error}>
              Calendario non disponibile.{' '}
              <button className={shared.button} onClick={() => void fixtures.refetch()}>
                Riprova
              </button>
            </p>
          ) : fixtures.data.length === 0 ? (
            <p>Nessuna fixture disponibile per questa giornata.</p>
          ) : (
            fixtures.data.map((f) => (
              <article className={styles.fixture} key={f.fixtureId}>
                <div>
                  <strong>{f.homeClub}</strong>
                  <br />
                  <span className={styles.difficulty}>{f.homeDifficulty}</span>
                </div>
                <span>vs</span>
                <div>
                  <strong>{f.awayClub}</strong>
                  <br />
                  <span className={styles.difficulty}>{f.awayDifficulty}</span>
                </div>
              </article>
            ))
          )}
        </section>
        {club && (
          <section className={shared.panel}>
            <h2>Matchup per ruolo</h2>
            <details className={styles.difficultyHelp}>
              <summary>Come leggere la difficoltÃ </summary>
              <p>
                Il punteggio va da 0 a 100: <strong>Facile</strong> sotto 50, <strong>Media</strong>{' '}
                da 50 a 69,99 e <strong>Difficile</strong> da 70.
              </p>
              <p>
                Ãˆ una media pesata diversa per ruolo di forza complessiva, attacco e difesa
                avversari, rendimento dellâ€™avversario in casa/trasferta e debolezza offensiva o
                difensiva del proprio club. La copertura indica quanta parte dei segnali previsti
                era disponibile: non Ã¨ una motivazione generata.
              </p>
            </details>
            {matchups.isPending ? (
              <p>Analisi matchupâ€¦</p>
            ) : matchups.isError ? (
              <p className={shared.error}>Matchup non disponibile.</p>
            ) : matchups.data.length === 0 ? (
              <p>Nessun matchup disponibile.</p>
            ) : (
              matchups.data.map((m) => (
                <article key={m.fixtureId}>
                  <h3>
                    {m.club} Â· {m.home ? 'casa' : 'trasferta'} vs {m.opponent}
                  </h3>
                  <div className={shared.grid}>
                    {m.roles.map((r) => (
                      <div className={shared.metric} key={r.role}>
                        <span>
                          {r.role} Â· {r.difficultyLevel}
                        </span>
                        <strong>
                          {r.difficultyScore === null ? 'â€”' : `${r.difficultyScore}/100`}
                        </strong>
                        <small>
                          Evidenza {r.evidenceTier} Â· copertura {r.evidenceCoverage}
                        </small>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </article>
              ))
            )}
          </section>
        )}
      </div>
    </AppShell>
  );
}

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Link, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { AppShell } from '@/layouts/AppShell';
import { useAuth } from '@/auth/useAuth';
import { intelligenceApi, type LineupPlayer } from '@/features/intelligence/api';
import { featureApi } from '@/features/core/api';
import { queryKeys } from '@/api/queryKeys';
import { AppError } from '@/api/errors/AppError';
import shared from '@/features/core/FeaturePage.module.css';
import styles from '@/features/intelligence/Intelligence.module.css';
function Player({ player }: { player: LineupPlayer }) {
  return (
    <article className={styles.player}>
      <strong>{player.playerName}</strong>
      <small>
        {player.club} Â· {player.role}
      </small>
      <small>
        {player.home ? 'Casa' : 'Trasferta'} vs {player.opponent}
      </small>
      <span className={styles.badge}>{player.selectionScore ?? 'N/D'}</span>
    </article>
  );
}

function arrayOrEmpty<T>(value: T[] | null | undefined): T[] {
  return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
}

function recordOrEmpty<T>(value: Record<string, T> | null | undefined): Record<string, T> {
  return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) ? value : {};
}

const missingLineupResponse = new AppError('Risposta lineup assente', {
  kind: 'invalid-response',
});

function lineupErrorContent(error: unknown): { title: string; detail: string } {
  if (!(error instanceof AppError)) {
    return {
      title: 'Formazione non disponibile',
      detail: 'La risposta del backend non Ã¨ conforme al contratto della formazione.',
    };
  }
  switch (error.kind) {
    case 'not-found':
      return {
        title: 'Formazione non disponibile',
        detail: `Il motore non riconosce la rosa per la stagione richiesta: ${error.message}.`,
      };
    case 'invalid-response':
      return {
        title: 'Formazione non disponibile',
        detail: 'La risposta del backend non Ã¨ conforme al contratto della formazione.',
      };
    case 'network':
    case 'timeout':
      return {
        title: 'Formazione non disponibile',
        detail: 'Il servizio di calcolo non Ã¨ raggiungibile da questo browser.',
      };
    case 'server':
      return {
        title: 'Formazione non disponibile',
        detail: 'Errore interno del motore di calcolo.',
      };
    default:
      return {
        title: 'Formazione non disponibile',
        detail: error.status
          ? `Richiesta non riuscita (HTTP ${error.status}): ${error.message}`
          : error.message,
      };
  }
}

function LineupErrorState({
  error,
  onRetry,
}: {
  error: unknown;
  onRetry: () => void;
}) {
  const content = lineupErrorContent(error);
  return (
    <section className={`${shared.panel} ${shared.status} ${shared.error}`}>
      <h2>{content.title}</h2>
      <p>{content.detail}</p>
      {error instanceof AppError && error.kind === 'not-found' && (
        <Link className={shared.button} to="/squad">
          Verifica la rosa
        </Link>
      )}
      <button className={shared.button} onClick={onRetry}>
        Riprova
      </button>
    </section>
  );
}
export function LineupPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const [url, setUrl] = useSearchParams();
  const matchday = Math.min(38, Math.max(1, Number(url.get('matchday') ?? 1)));
  const squad = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.squad,
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => featureApi.squad(auth.getAuthorization, signal),
    enabled: auth.status === 'authenticated',
  });
  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.lineup(squad.data?.season, matchday, squad.data?.id),
    queryFn: ({ signal }) =>
      intelligenceApi.lineup(
        matchday,
        squad.data?.season,
        squad.data?.id,
        auth.getAuthorization,
        signal,
      ),
    enabled: auth.status === 'authenticated' && squad.isSuccess && squad.data.totalPlayers >= 11,
    retry: false,
  });
  // Keep rendering safe even if a cached/legacy payload bypasses the runtime contract.
  const retryLineup = () => void query.refetch();
  const lineup = query.data;
  const starters = arrayOrEmpty(lineup?.starters);
  const bench = arrayOrEmpty(lineup?.bench);
  const warnings = arrayOrEmpty(lineup?.warnings);
  const roles = recordOrEmpty(lineup?.roles);
  const roleEntries = Object.entries(roles);
  const missingRoles = roleEntries.filter(
    ([, summary]) => typeof summary?.missing === 'number' && summary.missing > 0,
  );
  const byRole = (role: string) => starters.filter((player) => player.role === role);
  return (
    <AppShell>
      <div className={shared.page}>
        <header className={shared.hero}>
          <div>
            <span className={shared.eyebrow}>Starting XI engine</span>
            <h1>Formazione</h1>
            <p className={shared.muted}>Selezione e motivazioni prodotte dal motore reale.</p>
          </div>
        </header>
        <section className={`${shared.panel} ${shared.filters}`}>
          <label>
            Giornata
            <select value={matchday} onChange={(e) => setUrl({ matchday: e.target.value })}>
              {Array.from({ length: 38 }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((x) => (
                <option key={x}>{x}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          {squad.data && (
            <div className={shared.metric}>
              <span>Rosa attiva</span>
              <strong>{squad.data.name}</strong>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
        {auth.status !== 'authenticated' ? (
          <section className={`${shared.panel} ${shared.status}`}>
            <h2>Accedi per configurare la formazione</h2>
            <p>La formazione consigliata richiede una rosa personale reale.</p>
            <Link className={shared.button} to="/login" state={{ from: '/lineup' }}>
              Vai al login
            </Link>
          </section>
        ) : squad.isPending ? (
          <section className={`${shared.panel} ${shared.status}`}>Caricamento rosaâ€¦</section>
        ) : squad.error instanceof AppError && squad.error.status === 404 ? (
          <section className={`${shared.panel} ${shared.status}`}>
            <h2>Crea o compila prima la tua rosa</h2>
            <p>Non esiste ancora una rosa personale attiva per questa stagione.</p>
            <Link className={shared.button} to="/squad">
              Configura la rosa
            </Link>
          </section>
        ) : squad.isError ? (
          <section className={`${shared.panel} ${shared.status} ${shared.error}`}>
            Rosa non disponibile. Riprova piÃ¹ tardi.
          </section>
        ) : squad.data.totalPlayers < 11 ? (
          <section className={`${shared.panel} ${shared.status}`}>
            <h2>Rosa incompleta</h2>
            <p>Servono almeno 11 giocatori reali per calcolare la formazione: {squad.data.totalPlayers}/11 inseriti.</p>
            <Link className={shared.button} to="/squad">Completa la rosa</Link>
          </section>
        ) : query.isPending ? (
          <section className={`${shared.panel} ${shared.status}`}>Calcolo formazioneâ€¦</section>
        ) : query.isError ? (
          <LineupErrorState error={query.error} onRetry={() => void query.refetch()} />
        ) : !lineup ? (
          <LineupErrorState error={missingLineupResponse} onRetry={retryLineup} />
        ) : starters.length === 0 ? (
          <section className={`${shared.panel} ${shared.status}`}>
            <h2>Nessuna formazione disponibile</h2>
            <p>
              {lineup.complete
                ? 'Il motore non ha prodotto titolari per questa giornata.'
                : `Il motore ha selezionato ${lineup.selectedPlayers} su 11: mancano ${lineup.missingPlayers} giocatori classificabili con evidenza reale.`}
            </p>
            {missingRoles.length > 0 && (
              <p>
                Reparti scoperti:{' '}
                {missingRoles
                  .map(([role, summary]) => `${role} (${summary?.missing ?? 'N/D'})`)
                  .join(' Â· ')}
                .
              </p>
            )}
            {warnings.length > 0 && (
              <ul className={shared.list}>
                {warnings.map((warning) => (
                  <li key={warning}>{warning}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
            <Link className={shared.button} to="/squad">
              Completa la rosa con giocatori reali
            </Link>
          </section>
        ) : (
          <>
            <section className={shared.grid}>
              <div className={shared.metric}>
                <span>Modulo ottimale</span>
                <strong>{lineup.formation}</strong>
              </div>
              <div className={shared.metric}>
                <span>Score formazione</span>
                <strong>{lineup.formationScore}</strong>
              </div>
              <div className={shared.metric}>
                <span>Selezionati</span>
                <strong>{lineup.selectedPlayers}/11</strong>
              </div>
            </section>
            <section
              className={styles.pitch}
              aria-label={`Campo formazione ${lineup.formation}`}
            >
              <div className={styles.line}>
                {byRole('A').map((p) => (
                  <Player key={p.playerId} player={p} />
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className={styles.line}>
                {byRole('C').map((p) => (
                  <Player key={p.playerId} player={p} />
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className={styles.line}>
                {byRole('D').map((p) => (
                  <Player key={p.playerId} player={p} />
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className={styles.line}>
                {byRole('P').map((p) => (
                  <Player key={p.playerId} player={p} />
                ))}
              </div>
            </section>
            <section className={shared.panel}>
              <h2>Panchina</h2>
              {bench.length === 0 ? (
                <p className={shared.muted}>Nessuna riserva disponibile.</p>
              ) : (
                <div className={shared.grid}>
                  {bench.map((player) => (
                    <Player key={player.playerId} player={player} />
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </section>
            <section className={shared.panel}>
              <h2>Motivazioni</h2>
              <ul className={shared.list}>
                {starters.map((player) => (
                  <li key={player.playerId}>
                    <Link to={`/players/${player.playerId}`} state={{ from: '/lineup' }}>
                      {player.playerName}
                    </Link>:{' '}
                    {player.reason}
                  </li>
                ))}
                {warnings.map((warning) => (
                  <li key={warning}>{warning}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </section>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </AppShell>
  );
}

--- FILE: frontend\src\pages\LoginPage.tsx ---
import { Eye, EyeOff, LogIn } from 'lucide-react';
import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '@/auth/useAuth';
import { Button, Input } from '@/components/ui';
import styles from './LoginPage.module.css';

export function LoginPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>();

  async function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError(undefined);
    try {
      await auth.login(username, password);
      const target = (location.state as { from?: string } | null)?.from ?? '/';
      void navigate(target, { replace: true });
    } catch (reason) {
      const kind =
        reason && typeof reason === 'object' && 'kind' in reason ? reason.kind : undefined;
      if (kind === 'unauthorized') setError('Credenziali non valide.');
      else if (kind === 'forbidden') setError('Accesso non consentito.');
      else setError('Servizio non raggiungibile. Riprova quando il backend Ã¨ disponibile.');
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className={styles.page}>
      <section className={styles.loginCard} aria-labelledby="login-title">
        <div className={styles.brand}>
          <span>FI</span>
          <p>
            Fantacalcio
            <br />
            Intelligence
          </p>
        </div>
        <p className={styles.eyebrow}>Sessione protetta</p>
        <h1 id="login-title">Accedi al workspace</h1>
        <p className={styles.intro}>
          Le credenziali HTTP Basic restano esclusivamente in memoria e vengono eliminate al logout
          o al refresh.
        </p>
        <form onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)} className={styles.form}>
          <Input
            label="Username"
            value={username}
            onChange={(event) => setUsername(event.target.value)}
            autoComplete="username"
            required
          />
          <div className={styles.passwordField}>
            <Input
              label="Password"
              type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
              value={password}
              onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
              autoComplete="current-password"
              required
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowPassword((value) => !value)}
              aria-label={showPassword ? 'Nascondi password' : 'Mostra password'}
            >
              {showPassword ? <EyeOff size={17} /> : <Eye size={17} />}
            </button>
          </div>
          {error && (
            <p className={styles.error} role="alert">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
          <Button
            type="submit"
            loading={auth.status === 'authenticating'}
            disabled={!username || !password}
          >
            <LogIn size={17} /> Accedi
          </Button>
        </form>
        <button className={styles.back} onClick={() => void navigate('/')}>
          Continua senza autenticazione
        </button>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Link, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { AppShell } from '@/layouts/AppShell';
import { BackButton } from '@/components/navigation/BackButton';
import { featureApi, type PlayerSeasonStatistics } from '@/features/core/api';
import styles from '@/features/core/FeaturePage.module.css';

const value = (v: number | null | undefined, suffix = '') =>
  v == null ? 'Dato non disponibile' : `${v}${suffix}`;

type StatisticColumn = {
  label: string;
  value: (statistic: PlayerSeasonStatistics) => string;
};

function isFantasyGoalkeeper(roles: Record<string, string>): boolean {
  const fantasyRole = Object.entries(roles).find(
    ([source]) => source.toUpperCase() === 'FANTACALCIO',
  )?.[1];
  return fantasyRole?.toUpperCase() === 'P';
}

function statisticColumns(goalkeeper: boolean): StatisticColumn[] {
  if (goalkeeper) {
    return [
      { label: 'Presenze', value: (statistic) => value(statistic.appearances) },
      { label: 'Minuti giocati', value: (statistic) => value(statistic.minutesPlayed) },
      { label: 'Gol subiti', value: (statistic) => value(statistic.goalsConceded) },
      { label: 'Parate effettuate', value: (statistic) => value(statistic.saves) },
      { label: 'Rigori parati', value: (statistic) => value(statistic.penaltiesSaved) },
      {
        label: 'Porte inviolate / Clean sheet',
        value: (statistic) => value(statistic.cleanSheets),
      },
    ];
  }
  return [
    { label: 'Presenze', value: (statistic) => value(statistic.appearances) },
    { label: 'Gol', value: (statistic) => value(statistic.goals) },
    { label: 'Assist', value: (statistic) => value(statistic.assists) },
    { label: 'Fantamedia', value: (statistic) => value(statistic.fantasyAverage) },
  ];
}

function sourceLabel(statistic: PlayerSeasonStatistics): string {
  return statistic.sourceExternalId
    ? `${statistic.source} Â· ${statistic.sourceExternalId}`
    : statistic.source;
}
export function PlayerDetailPage() {
  const { id = '' } = useParams();
  const q = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['player', id],
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => featureApi.player(id, signal),
    retry: false,
  });
  const goalkeeper = q.data ? isFantasyGoalkeeper(q.data.roles) : false;
  const columns = statisticColumns(goalkeeper);
  return (
    <AppShell>
      <div className={styles.page}>
        <BackButton fallbackTo="/players" />
        {q.isPending ? (
          <section className={styles.panel}>Caricamento profiloâ€¦</section>
        ) : q.isError ? (
          <section className={`${styles.panel} ${styles.error}`}>
            <h1>Giocatore non trovato</h1>
            <Link to="/players">Torna al catalogo</Link>
          </section>
        ) : (
          <>
            <header className={styles.hero}>
              <div>
                <span className={styles.eyebrow}>{Object.values(q.data.roles).join(' Â· ')}</span>
                <h1>{q.data.name}</h1>
                <p className={styles.muted}>{q.data.club}</p>
              </div>
              <Link className={styles.button} to={`/auction?player=${q.data.id}`}>
                Intelligence asta
              </Link>
            </header>
            {q.data.evaluation && (
              <section className={styles.panel}>
                <h2>Valutazione</h2>
                <div className={styles.grid}>
                  {[
                    ['Media prevista', value(q.data.evaluation.projectedFantasyAverage)],
                    ['AffidabilitÃ ', value(q.data.evaluation.reliabilityScore)],
                    ['Potenziale', value(q.data.evaluation.potentialScore)],
                    ['Rischio', value(q.data.evaluation.riskScore)],
                  ].map(([a, b]) => (
                    <div className={styles.metric} key={a}>

                </div>

            )}
            {q.data.tacticalProfile && (
              <section className={styles.panel}>

                  </div>

                    <span>ProbabilitÃ  titolare</span>
                    <strong>{value(q.data.tacticalProfile.starterProbability, '%')}</strong>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {q.data.tacticalProfile.tacticalNotes && (
                  <p>{q.data.tacticalProfile.tacticalNotes}</p>
                )}
              </section>
            )}
            <section className={styles.panel}>
              <h2>Storico disponibile</h2>
              {q.data.statistics.length === 0 ? (
                <p className={styles.muted}>Nessuna statistica disponibile.</p>
              ) : (
                <div className={styles.tableWrap}>
                  <table className={styles.table}>
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th>Stagione</th>

--- FILE: frontend\src\pages\PlayersPage.tsx ---
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { keepPreviousData, useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Link, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { AppShell } from '@/layouts/AppShell';
import { featureApi } from '@/features/core/api';
import { useAuth } from '@/auth/useAuth';
import { AppError } from '@/api/errors/AppError';
import { queryKeys } from '@/api/queryKeys';
import styles from '@/features/core/FeaturePage.module.css';

export function PlayersPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const [url, setUrl] = useSearchParams();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState(url.get('search') ?? '');
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<{ id: number; name: string } | null>(null);
  const [purchasePrice, setPurchasePrice] = useState('1');
  const role = url.get('role') ?? '';
  const club = url.get('club') ?? '';
  const page = Number(url.get('page') ?? 0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setUrl((current) => {
        const next = new URLSearchParams(current);
        const currentSearch = current.get('search') ?? '';
        if (search === currentSearch) return current;
        if (search) next.set('search', search);
        else next.delete('search');
        next.set('page', '0');
        return next;
      }, { replace: true });
    }, 350);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
  }, [search, setUrl]);
  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['players', { search: url.get('search') ?? '', role, club, page }],
    queryFn: ({ signal }) =>
      featureApi.players(
        {
          search: url.get('search') ?? undefined,
          role: role || undefined,
          club: club || undefined,
          page,
          size: 25,
        },
        signal,
      ),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
  });
  const squad = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.squad,
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => featureApi.squad(auth.getAuthorization, signal),
    enabled: auth.status === 'authenticated',
    retry: false,
  });
  const add = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => featureApi.addPlayer(auth.getAuthorization, selected!.id, Number(purchasePrice)),
    onSuccess: (next) => {
      qc.setQueryData(queryKeys.squad, next);
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.squadAnalysis });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['lineup'] });
      setSelected(null);
      setPurchasePrice('1');
    },
  });
  const duplicate = squad.data?.players.some((entry) => entry.playerId === selected?.id) ?? false;
  const missingSquad = squad.error instanceof AppError && squad.error.status === 404;
  const update = (key: string, value: string) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(url);
    if (value) next.set(key, value);
    else next.delete(key);
    if (key !== 'page') next.set('page', '0');
    setUrl(next);
  };
  return (
    <AppShell>
      <div className={styles.page}>
        <header className={styles.hero}>
          <div>
            <span className={styles.eyebrow}>Player intelligence</span>
            <h1>Giocatori</h1>
            <p className={styles.muted}>
              {query.data ? `${query.data.totalElements} profili reali` : 'Catalogo Serie A'}
            </p>
          </div>
        </header>
        <section className={`${styles.panel} ${styles.filters}`} aria-label="Filtri giocatori">
          <label>
            Cerca
            <input
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Nome giocatore"
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            Ruolo
            <select value={role} onChange={(e) => update('role', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">Tutti</option>
              {['P', 'D', 'C', 'A'].map((x) => (
                <option key={x}>{x}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            Club
            <input
              value={club}
              onChange={(e) => update('club', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Club esatto"
            />
          </label>
          <button
            className={`${styles.button} ${styles.secondary}`}
            onClick={() => {
              setSearch('');
              setUrl({});
            }}
          >
            Azzera
          </button>
        </section>
        <section className={styles.panel} aria-live="polite">
          {auth.status === 'authenticated' && missingSquad && (
            <p>Per acquistare dal catalogo, <Link to="/squad">crea prima la tua rosa</Link>.</p>
          )}
          {selected && squad.data && (
            <div className={styles.filters} aria-label="Acquista dal catalogo">
              <div className={styles.metric}><span>Giocatore selezionato</span><strong>{selected.name}</strong></div>
              <label>Prezzo acquisto<input type="number" min="1" value={purchasePrice} onChange={(event) => setPurchasePrice(event.target.value)} /></label>
              <button className={styles.button} disabled={duplicate || Number(purchasePrice) < 1 || add.isPending} onClick={() => add.mutate()}>Conferma acquisto</button>
              <button className={`${styles.button} ${styles.secondary}`} onClick={() => setSelected(null)}>Annulla</button>
              {duplicate && <p className={styles.error}>Il giocatore Ã¨ giÃ  nella rosa.</p>}
              {add.isError && <p className={styles.error} role="alert">{add.error instanceof AppError ? add.error.message : 'Acquisto rifiutato.'}</p>}
            </div>
          )}
          {query.isPending ? (
            <div className={styles.status}>Caricamento catalogoâ€¦</div>
          ) : query.isError ? (
            <div className={`${styles.status} ${styles.error}`}>
              Contratto giocatori non disponibile.{' '}
              <button className={styles.button} onClick={() => void query.refetch()}>
                Riprova
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : query.data.content.length === 0 ? (
            <div className={styles.status}>Nessun giocatore corrisponde ai filtri.</div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className={`${styles.tableWrap} ${styles.desktopTable}`}>
                <table className={styles.table}>
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th>Giocatore</th>
                      <th>Ruolo</th>
                      <th>Club</th>
                      <th>Fonti</th>
                      {squad.data && <th>Rosa</th>}
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {query.data.content.map((p) => (
                      <tr key={p.id}>
                        <td>
                          <Link to={`/players/${p.id}`} state={{ from: '/players' }}>{p.name}</Link>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                          <span className={styles.role}>{p.fantacalcioRole}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td>{p.club}</td>
                        <td>{p.sourcesCount}</td>
                        {squad.data && <td><button className={`${styles.button} ${styles.secondary}`} disabled={squad.data.players.some((entry) => entry.playerId === p.id)} onClick={() => setSelected({ id: p.id, name: p.name })}>{squad.data.players.some((entry) => entry.playerId === p.id) ? 'GiÃ  in rosa' : 'Aggiungi'}</button></td>}
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
              <div className={styles.cards}>
                {query.data.content.map((p) => (
                  <article className={styles.card} key={p.id}>
                    <Link to={`/players/${p.id}`} state={{ from: '/players' }}>
                      <strong>{p.name}</strong>
                    </Link>
                    <span>
                      <span className={styles.role}>{p.fantacalcioRole}</span> Â· {p.club}
                    </span>
                    {squad.data && <button className={`${styles.button} ${styles.secondary}`} disabled={squad.data.players.some((entry) => entry.playerId === p.id)} onClick={() => setSelected({ id: p.id, name: p.name })}>{squad.data.players.some((entry) => entry.playerId === p.id) ? 'GiÃ  in rosa' : 'Aggiungi alla rosa'}</button>}
                  </article>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className={styles.pager}>
                <button
                  className={`${styles.button} ${styles.secondary}`}
                  disabled={page === 0}
                  onClick={() => update('page', String(page - 1))}
                >
                  Precedente
                </button>
                <span>
                  {page + 1} / {Math.max(query.data.totalPages, 1)}
                </span>
                <button
                  className={`${styles.button} ${styles.secondary}`}
                  disabled={page + 1 >= query.data.totalPages}
                  onClick={() => update('page', String(page + 1))}
                >
                  Successiva
                </button>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
    </AppShell>
  );
}

    );
    renderPage();
    expect(
      // The app retries server errors twice (default backoff), so the error
      // state appears after the retries complete.
      await screen.findByText(
        'Errore interno del motore di calcolo.',
        {},
        { timeout: 6000 },
      ),
    ).toBeVisible();

  DifficultyIndicator,
  Metric,

  type Difficulty,
  type PlayerRole,
} from '@/components/data-display';
import { Badge, Card, IconButton, Panel, StatusBadge } from '@/components/ui';

import { AppError } from '@/api/errors/AppError';

function WidgetState({
  loading,
  error,
  errorText,
  empty,
  children,
}: {
  loading: boolean;
  error: boolean;
  errorText?: string;
  empty?: boolean;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  if (loading) return <p className={styles.widgetState}>Caricamento dati realiâ€¦</p>;
  if (error)
    return (
      <p className={`${styles.widgetState} ${styles.widgetError}`}>
        {errorText ?? 'Dati temporaneamente non disponibili.'}
      </p>
    );
  if (empty) return <p className={styles.widgetState}>Nessun dato disponibile.</p>;
  return <>{children}</>;
}

function lineupErrorText(error: unknown): string {
  if (!(error instanceof AppError)) return 'Dati temporaneamente non disponibili.';
  switch (error.kind) {
    case 'not-found':
      return `Rosa non riconosciuta dal motore: ${error.message}`;
    case 'invalid-response':
      return 'Il servizio ha restituito dati non conformi al contratto della formazione.';
    case 'server':
      return 'Errore interno del motore di calcolo.';
    case 'network':
    case 'timeout':
      return 'Il servizio di calcolo non Ã¨ raggiungibile.';
    default:
      return error.status
        ? `Richiesta non riuscita (HTTP ${error.status}).`
        : error.message;
  }
}

function difficulty(value: string): Difficulty {
  const normalized = value.toUpperCase();
  if (normalized.includes('EASY') || normalized.includes('FACILE')) return 'EASY';
  if (normalized.includes('HARD') || normalized.includes('DIFFIC')) return 'HARD';
  if (normalized.includes('MEDIUM') || normalized.includes('MEDIA')) return 'MEDIUM';
  return 'UNKNOWN';
}

function role(value: string): PlayerRole {
  return value === 'P' || value === 'D' || value === 'C' || value === 'A' ? value : 'C';
}

--- FILE: frontend\src\pages\ScoutingPage.tsx ---
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Link, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { AppShell } from '@/layouts/AppShell';
import { intelligenceApi } from '@/features/intelligence/api';
import shared from '@/features/core/FeaturePage.module.css';
import styles from '@/features/intelligence/Intelligence.module.css';
type Sort = 'potential' | 'adaptation' | 'confidence' | 'name';
export function ScoutingPage() {
  const [url, setUrl] = useSearchParams();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const role = url.get('role') ?? '';
  const club = url.get('club') ?? '';
  const recommendation = url.get('recommendation') ?? '';
  const sort = (url.get('sort') ?? 'potential') as Sort;
  const seasons = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['seasons'],
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => intelligenceApi.seasons(signal),
  });
  const current = seasons.data?.find((s) => s.current)?.code;
  const clubs = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['clubs'],
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => intelligenceApi.clubs(signal),
  });
  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['scouting', current, role, club, recommendation],
    queryFn: ({ signal }) =>
      intelligenceApi.scouting(
        current!,
        {
          role: role || undefined,
          club: club || undefined,
          recommendation: recommendation || undefined,
        },
        signal,
      ),
    enabled: Boolean(current),
    retry: false,
  });
  const update = (key: string, value: string) => {
    const n = new URLSearchParams(url);
    if (value) n.set(key, value);
    else n.delete(key);
    setUrl(n);
  };
  const visible = useMemo(() => {
    const filtered = (query.data ?? []).filter((x) =>
      x.playerName.toLowerCase().includes(search.trim().toLowerCase()),
    );
    return [...filtered].sort((a, b) =>
      sort === 'name'
        ? a.playerName.localeCompare(b.playerName)
        : sort === 'adaptation'
          ? b.adaptationScore - a.adaptationScore
          : sort === 'confidence'
            ? b.confidenceScore - a.confidenceScore
            : b.potentialScore - a.potentialScore,
    );
  }, [query.data, search, sort]);
  return (
    <AppShell>
      <div className={shared.page}>
        <header className={shared.hero}>
          <div>
            <span className={shared.eyebrow}>Serie A arrivals</span>
            <h1>Scouting & market</h1>
            <p className={shared.muted}>
              Solo arrivi realmente presenti ed eleggibili nel catalogo Serie A.
            </p>
          </div>
        </header>
        <section className={`${shared.panel} ${shared.filters}`}>
          <label>
            Cerca
            <input
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Nome giocatore"
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            Ruolo
            <select value={role} onChange={(e) => update('role', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">Tutti</option>
              {['P', 'D', 'C', 'A'].map((x) => (
                <option key={x}>{x}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            Club
            <select value={club} onChange={(e) => update('club', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">Tutti</option>
              {clubs.data?.map((c) => (
                <option key={c.id} value={c.slug}>
                  {c.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            Recommendation
            <input
              value={recommendation}
              onChange={(e) => update('recommendation', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Valore backend"
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            Ordina
            <select value={sort} onChange={(e) => update('sort', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="potential">Potenziale</option>
              <option value="adaptation">Adattamento</option>
              <option value="confidence">Confidence</option>
              <option value="name">Nome</option>
            </select>
          </label>
        </section>
        <section className={shared.panel} aria-live="polite">
          {query.isPending || seasons.isPending ? (
            <div className={shared.status}>Caricamento scoutingâ€¦</div>
          ) : query.isError ? (
            <div className={`${shared.status} ${shared.error}`}>
              Scouting non disponibile.{' '}
              <button className={shared.button} onClick={() => void query.refetch()}>
                Riprova
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : visible.length === 0 ? (
            <div className={shared.status}>Nessuna opportunitÃ  corrisponde ai filtri.</div>
          ) : (
            <div className={shared.grid}>
              {visible.map((p) => (
                <article className={`${shared.card} ${styles.opportunity}`} key={p.playerId}>
                  <div>
                    <span className={shared.role}>{p.role}</span>{' '}
                    <span className={styles.badge}>{p.recommendation}</span>
                  </div>
                  <h2>
                    <Link to={`/players/${p.playerId}`} state={{ from: '/scouting' }}>{p.playerName}</Link>
                  </h2>
                  <p className={shared.muted}>
                    {p.club}
                    {p.previousClub ? ` Â· da ${p.previousClub}` : ''}
                  </p>
                  <div className={styles.scores}>
                    <span>
                      <strong>{p.potentialScore}</strong>Potenziale
                    </span>
                    <span>
                      <strong>{p.adaptationScore}</strong>Adattamento
                    </span>
                    <span>
                      <strong>{p.riskScore}</strong>Rischio
                    </span>
                    <span>
                      <strong>{p.confidenceScore}</strong>Confidence
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p>{p.scoutingSummary}</p>
                  <small>
                    {p.eligibilityStatus} Â· {p.transferType ?? 'Trasferimento non classificato'}
                  </small>
                </article>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
    </AppShell>
  );
}

--- FILE: frontend\src\pages\SquadPage.tsx ---
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '@/auth/useAuth';
import { AppError } from '@/api/errors/AppError';
import { queryKeys } from '@/api/queryKeys';
import { featureApi, type Squad } from '@/features/core/api';
import styles from '@/features/core/FeaturePage.module.css';
import { AppShell } from '@/layouts/AppShell';

function message(error: unknown) {
  return error instanceof AppError ? error.message : 'Operazione non riuscita.';
}

export function SquadPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [playerId, setPlayerId] = useState('');
  const [price, setPrice] = useState('1');
  const [squadName, setSquadName] = useState('');
  const [editingPlayerId, setEditingPlayerId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [editingPrice, setEditingPrice] = useState('');

  const squad = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.squad,
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => featureApi.squad(auth.getAuthorization, signal),
  });
  const missingSquad = squad.error instanceof AppError && squad.error.status === 404;
  const analysis = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.squadAnalysis,
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => featureApi.analysis(auth.getAuthorization, signal),
    enabled: squad.isSuccess,
  });
  const league = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.leagueConfiguration,
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => featureApi.leagueConfiguration(signal),
    enabled: missingSquad,
  });

  const acceptSquad = (next: Squad) => {
    qc.setQueryData(queryKeys.squad, next);
    void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.squadAnalysis });
    void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['lineup'] });
  };
  const createSquad = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => featureApi.createSquad(auth.getAuthorization, league.data!.id, squadName.trim()),
    onSuccess: acceptSquad,
  });
  const candidates = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.squadCandidates(search),
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => featureApi.players({ search: search.trim(), page: 0, size: 10 }, signal),
    enabled: squad.isSuccess && search.trim().length >= 2,
  });
  const add = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => featureApi.addPlayer(auth.getAuthorization, Number(playerId), Number(price)),
    onSuccess: (next) => {
      acceptSquad(next);
      setPlayerId('');
      setSearch('');
      setPrice('1');
    },
  });
  const remove = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: number) => featureApi.removePlayer(auth.getAuthorization, id),
    onSuccess: acceptSquad,
  });
  const updatePrice = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ id, value }: { id: number; value: number }) =>
      featureApi.updatePlayerPrice(auth.getAuthorization, id, value),
    onSuccess: (next) => {
      acceptSquad(next);
      setEditingPlayerId(null);
    },
  });

  const current = squad.data;
  const selected = candidates.data?.content.find((candidate) => candidate.id === Number(playerId));
  const roleSummary = selected ? current?.roles[selected.fantacalcioRole] : undefined;
  const duplicate = current?.players.some((entry) => entry.playerId === selected?.id) ?? false;
  const roleFull = roleSummary ? roleSummary.current >= roleSummary.maximum : false;
  const emptySlotsAfterAdd = current ? Math.max(0, current.maximumPlayers - current.totalPlayers - 1) : 0;
  const maxAffordable = current ? current.remainingBudget - emptySlotsAfterAdd : 0;
  const invalidPrice = Number(price) < 1 || Number(price) > maxAffordable;

  return (
    <AppShell>
      <div className={styles.page}>
        <header className={styles.hero}>
          <div>
            <span className={styles.eyebrow}>Gestione rosa reale</span>
            <h1>La tua rosa</h1>
            <p className={styles.muted}>Giocatori del catalogo, budget e limiti definiti dalla lega.</p>
          </div>
          <Link className={styles.button} to="/players">Apri il catalogo</Link>
        </header>

        {squad.isPending ? (
          <section className={styles.panel}>Caricamento rosaâ€¦</section>
        ) : missingSquad ? (
          <section className={styles.panel}>
            <h2>Crea la tua rosa personale</h2>
            <p>PartirÃ  vuota: nessun giocatore o prezzo verrÃ  generato automaticamente.</p>
            {league.isPending ? <p>Caricamento configurazione legaâ€¦</p> : league.isError ? (
              <p className={styles.error}>Configurazione lega non disponibile.</p>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className={styles.grid}>
                  <div className={styles.metric}><span>Squadre</span><strong>{league.data.teamsCount}</strong></div>
                  <div className={styles.metric}><span>Budget iniziale</span><strong>{league.data.totalBudget}</strong></div>
                  {Object.entries({ P: league.data.goalkeepersCount, D: league.data.defendersCount, C: league.data.midfieldersCount, A: league.data.forwardsCount }).map(([role, maximum]) => (
                    <div className={styles.metric} key={role}><span>{role}</span><strong>{maximum}</strong></div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <p className={styles.muted}>Difesa modificata: {league.data.defenseModifier ? 'sÃ¬' : 'no'} Â· Capitano: {league.data.captainBonus ? 'sÃ¬' : 'no'}</p>
                <div className={styles.filters} aria-label="Crea rosa">
                  <label>Nome rosa<input value={squadName} maxLength={100} onChange={(event) => setSquadName(event.target.value)} /></label>
                  <button className={styles.button} disabled={!squadName.trim() || createSquad.isPending} onClick={() => createSquad.mutate()}>Crea rosa vuota</button>
                </div>
              </>
            )}
            {createSquad.isError && <p className={styles.error} role="alert">{message(createSquad.error)}</p>}
          </section>
        ) : squad.isError ? (
          <section className={styles.panel}><h2>Rosa non disponibile</h2><p className={styles.error} role="alert">{message(squad.error)}</p></section>
        ) : current ? (
          <>
            <section className={styles.grid}>
              <div className={styles.metric}><span>Budget iniziale</span><strong>{current.initialBudget}</strong></div>
              <div className={styles.metric}><span>Speso</span><strong>{current.spentBudget}</strong></div>
              <div className={styles.metric}><span>Residuo</span><strong>{current.remainingBudget}</strong></div>
              <div className={styles.metric}><span>Giocatori</span><strong>{current.totalPlayers}/{current.maximumPlayers}</strong></div>
            </section>
            <section className={styles.panel}>
              <h2>{current.name}</h2>
              <div className={styles.grid}>
                {Object.entries(current.roles).map(([role, counts]) => (
                  <div className={styles.metric} key={role}>
                    <span>{role} Â· {counts.current >= counts.maximum ? 'completo' : `mancano ${counts.remaining}`}</span>
                    <strong>{counts.current}/{counts.maximum}</strong>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </section>
            <section className={styles.panel}>
              <h2>Aggiungi un giocatore reale</h2>
              <div className={styles.filters} aria-label="Aggiungi giocatore">
                <label>Cerca nel catalogo<input value={search} onChange={(event) => { setSearch(event.target.value); setPlayerId(''); }} /></label>
                <label>Giocatore<select value={playerId} onChange={(event) => setPlayerId(event.target.value)}><option value="">Seleziona</option>{candidates.data?.content.map((player) => <option key={player.id} value={player.id}>{player.name} Â· {player.club} Â· {player.fantacalcioRole}</option>)}</select></label>
                <label>Prezzo acquisto<input type="number" min="1" max={Math.max(1, maxAffordable)} value={price} onChange={(event) => setPrice(event.target.value)} /></label>
                <button className={styles.button} disabled={!selected || duplicate || roleFull || invalidPrice || add.isPending} onClick={() => add.mutate()}>Aggiungi alla rosa</button>
              </div>
              {search.trim().length > 0 && search.trim().length < 2 && <p className={styles.muted}>Inserisci almeno due caratteri.</p>}
              {duplicate && <p className={styles.error}>Il giocatore Ã¨ giÃ  presente nella rosa.</p>}
              {roleFull && <p className={styles.error}>Il reparto {selected?.fantacalcioRole} Ã¨ completo.</p>}
              {selected && invalidPrice && <p className={styles.error}>Prezzo non valido: puoi spendere al massimo {Math.max(0, maxAffordable)} mantenendo un credito per ogni posto libero.</p>}
              {add.isError && <p className={styles.error} role="alert">{message(add.error)}</p>}
              {current.players.length === 0 ? <p>Nessun giocatore ancora inserito.</p> : (
                <div className={styles.tableWrap}><table className={styles.table}>
                  <thead><tr><th>Giocatore</th><th>Ruolo</th><th>Club</th><th>Prezzo</th><th>Azioni</th></tr></thead>
                  <tbody>{current.players.map((entry) => (
                    <tr key={entry.id}>
                      <td><Link to={`/players/${entry.playerId}`} state={{ from: '/squad' }}>{entry.playerName}</Link></td>
                      <td><span className={styles.role}>{entry.role}</span></td><td>{entry.club}</td>
                      <td>{editingPlayerId === entry.playerId ? <input aria-label={`Prezzo ${entry.playerName}`} type="number" min="1" value={editingPrice} onChange={(event) => setEditingPrice(event.target.value)} /> : entry.purchasePrice}</td>
                      <td>{editingPlayerId === entry.playerId ? <><button className={styles.button} disabled={Number(editingPrice) < 1 || updatePrice.isPending} onClick={() => updatePrice.mutate({ id: entry.playerId, value: Number(editingPrice) })}>Salva</button> <button className={`${styles.button} ${styles.secondary}`} onClick={() => setEditingPlayerId(null)}>Annulla</button></> : <><button className={`${styles.button} ${styles.secondary}`} onClick={() => { setEditingPlayerId(entry.playerId); setEditingPrice(String(entry.purchasePrice)); }}>Modifica prezzo</button> <button className={`${styles.button} ${styles.secondary}`} disabled={remove.isPending} onClick={() => remove.mutate(entry.playerId)}>Rimuovi</button></>}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}</tbody>
                </table></div>
              )}
              {(remove.isError || updatePrice.isError) && <p className={styles.error} role="alert">{message(remove.error ?? updatePrice.error)}</p>}
            </section>
          </>
        ) : null}

        {analysis.data && <section className={styles.panel}><h2>Analisi rosa</h2><p>{analysis.data.summary}</p>{analysis.data.globalWarnings.length > 0 && <ul className={styles.list}>{analysis.data.globalWarnings.map((warning) => <li key={warning}>{warning}</li>)}</ul>}</section>}
      </div>
    </AppShell>
  );
}
